tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/mesbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
'dzomaglingalargyasakyiskor/
'bringariraslobara'ichosangebazorabu'ibangamajong

sngon 'brogatam/khyod kyi mig sngar gsal ba'i nub phyogs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba grags can zhes pa'i deb 'di'i nang / go sla'i dpe dang / dang ba 'dren pa'i brgyud rim dang gtam rgyud sogs spyad de rtogs dka' ba'i nub phyogs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i sgo mo legs par phyes shing / khyod la cung cha tshang ba'i sgos gna' bo'i snyi ri si nas nye rabs mar khe si ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dar ba'i gong rol gyi nub phyogs kyi mtshan nyid smra ba gtso bo 'ga'i gzhung lugs dang khong tsho'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus re ngo sprod bgyis yod do//na gzhon grogs po la las nga tshor 'di ltar bshad de/ kho tsho mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung klog pa la sems gcig thog tu nges mi thub ste/ phyogs gcig nas shes 'dod yod cing / yang phyogs gcig nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung bklag par skrag ces zer/ de yang shes 'dod yod pa ni kho tshos mtshan nyid rig pa ni dus rabs kyi bsam blo'i snying bcud yin par shes pa dang /mtshan nyid pa'i gting zab pa'i gsung las dus rgyun nga tshos sngar bas 'jig rten dang mi tshe rtogs par blo bskyed rung pas red/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung klog par skrag pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs gting zab cing ha cang go dka' ba'i dbang gis yin te/ rgyus cha med pa'i nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa ni de ltar yin pa de bas kyang bshad ma dgos/de 'dra'i dka' ngal de dag bsal ba'i ched du deb 'di'i nang du pha lam ngo mtshar gtam rgyud kyi rnam pa lta bu'i lam nas gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i dha ༈ si

gzhigasakyi tshad gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim nang rang rang gi sa nas phyag ris bzhag 'dug a ri si khro tshe (༅4 za06 sheng13 0(213)lags kyisasngar gyi mtshan nyid rig pa spyi bsdoms sgos gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa gong du spel te rtser son par bgyis/ de nas ghi ri si'i rgyal phran bran g.yog lam lugs thor zhig tu song ba dang bstun gna' rabs mtshan nyid rig pa'ang rim bzhin nyams rgud kyi lam du chas/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs ches phyi ma gsum gyi ring / snyi ri si ni ma khe ḍo ni lngas ( bzos570ma0ba ma)dbang 'og tu bcad/ skabs de'i ring snyan grags can gyi mtshan nyid mkhan po e phe kho'i ro (7tsho'i 29160574)bya ba byung / de nas gna' bo'i ro ma'i (76 5077)dus su lu khi re tshe'u (ṭha༅lkoṣ+ṭha650('u 1 53)bya ba dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i phul tu byung ba'i tshab byed lta bu yin no//le tshan gnyis pa'i nang dus rabs bar ma nas rig rtsal bskyar dar dus kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba ngo sprod byas yod la/ de yang spyi lo dus rabs gnyis pa nas dus rabs bcu drug pa'i bar gyi lo ngo chig stong lhag gi ring /yo rob gling ni bran g.yog spyi tshogs nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs su gnas gyur cing / ye shu'i chos lugs kyi lha rig sems gtso smra ba'i 'jig rten lta tshul gyis bsam blo'i dbang zin par gyur pas/ mtshan nyid rig pa ni lha rig smra ba'i bran khol du gyur/ dper na mtshan nyid rig pa'i mkhan po o'u ghi si jin ( lhalo1 4023(1 ba)dang / o'u se lim(ṣ+ṭhaza sa 521ba 53)/ tho ma si a khe na (—6za46 khu115zas la'i0725495 ba85)sogs ni lha'i rig pa ba yang yin pa lta bu red/ kho tsho'i 'gan khur gtso bo ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i rtsod sgrub la brten nas lha'i dbang po yod pa ra sprod byed rgyu dang chos tshogs kyi dbang bsgyur 'os 'grig yin par bsgrub dgos ༵ de

red/ 'on te ye shu'i chos lugs kyi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang khul du'ang o kham ( glo(gyiji'imab)ltabu'iyar thon bsam blo ba byung zhing /kho tshos log spyod bsamablor dus yun ring por 'thab rtsod byas/ dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i rjes nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs nyams dmas su chas shing ma rtsa ring lugs kyi myu gu rim gyis 'bus par gyur pas/ rig rtsal bskyabadar du 'bod pa'i gsar dar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsam blo'i rig gsarab 'gul byung / dus skabs der rang byung tshan rig dang dam du 'brel ba'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba bha ru no (lo glo203ba0)sogs yar thon bsam blo ba byung ste/ khong tshos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzinā dad lha'i rāg par 'gog rgol byas nas spyi tshogs kyi yar thon la skul ma gang ṭā bye/ dhisum/ pa'i nang yo rob nye rabs kyi dbyin ji dang h+pha ran se'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba ngo sprod byas yod/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa nas bco brgyad pa'i bar dbyin h+pha sogs snga phyir 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje brgyud de ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam lugs btsugs pas/ chab srid/ dpal 'byor dang nyams zhib tshan rig bcas gong 'phel chen por song / de 'dra'i rgyab ljongs 'og dbyin ji'i dngos gtso ring lugs nyams myong smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba h+phu ran se si bha khon (7༅ma lho stu130042'ayis)dang / ho sgye si(r+sā7lo50660)/ lokhi(lho grol60)sogs byung /nyams myong smra ba'i nang gnas kyi 'gal ba dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi ngo bo nyis ldan gyi dbang gis rang rig sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba nyer khe le (༅༅lkoya 16005)dang rtogs thabs med par smra ba'i ('o777)sku tshab hu mo(ṣ+ṭha so7gle6)yang byung / nyams myong smra ba'i ma na nyid rig pa dang ldog ste/ yo rob gling gi yul gru chen por rte khar (bo

6po2650sku 4)dang si phe no gza' (loṣ+ṭha 77byab ba0yi)sogs rjes dpag gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba byon la/ de nas dus rabs bco brgyad par bslebs rjes/ h+pha ran se'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi stobs shugs khad kyis je cher song pas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa'i rmongs sel las 'gul dar rgyas su song la/ der brten nas yar thon can gyi dngos gtso ring lugs pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba phon chen po 'tshar longs byung / dper na lā me 'e ri(7r+sālhas khrimakhu'u 16)/ ro'use'u((7261445)/rnyis rte ro ṭha (7 070 70101)dang hel we khri'u (tshone4cho50192 53)sogs kyis mtshon no// khong tsho'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gawang sdigs ni h+pha ran se rgyal khab kyi gsar brje chen po'i bsam blo'i mtshon cha da le tsha//na bzhi ba'i nang 'jar man gyi gna' gzhung mtshan nyid rig pa ba ngo sprod byas yod de/ de yang dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mjug nas dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i stod phyed tsam la dbyin h+pha rgyal khab kyi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje legs grub byung zhing bzo las gsar brje spel bzhin pa'i sgang yin la/ rang byung tshan rig spyi tshogs tshan rig dang mtshan nyid rig pa bcas tshang ma sngar bas gong du 'phel na'ang / 'jar man ni sngar ltar bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid dbang sger gcod lam lugs kyi rgyal khab las gnas ma gyur/ yo rob gsar brje'i bsam blo'i rlabs kyi bskul 'ded la brten nas/ 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim gyis phyogs gcig nas gsar brje byed 'dod pa dang / yang phyogs gcig nas gsar brjer skrag la/'jar man gyi gna' gzhung mtshan nyid rig pa ni 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim gyi 'jig rten lta tshul gyi gzhung lugs mtshon byed red/ de'i mi sna gtso bo ni khung khri/ te ཿla dang h+pher bha khā (7lo tshob05016305)sogs byin

no// kho tshos sngon gyi mtshan nyid rig par gsar du phyogs bsdus dang spyi sdom mdzad de/ rtsod sgrub rig pa'i bsam blo dang dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa so sor sngar gyi tshad las gong du spel pas/ mar khe si ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i dngos kyi 'byung gnas su gyur/ phyis kyi mar khe si ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ni 'jar man gyi gna' gzhung mtshan nyid rig pa blang dor byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog byung pa zhig yin no//ngatshos gong gi le tshan bzhi'i steng nas mar khe si ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ma dar gong gi nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo gong du 'phel ba'i tshul mdor bsdus tsam dang / mtshan nyid rig pa'i grub mtha' so so'i shing rta'i srol 'byed lta bu'i mkhas dbang gtso bo dang khong tsho'i bsam blo ngo sprod byas pa las 'di'i skor rgyas par ni gzhan las shes dgos so/ deb mjug gi zhar byung 'di ni khyod kyis gting zab tu slob sbyong byed skabs dpyad gzhir bkod pa yin no/

dkar chagale'u dang po/ gna' po'i snyi ri si dngaro ma'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba/sa bcad dang po/ rtsa 'tshol mthil snyeg byed pa'i nyams zhib pa/wa dha le si dang mi le sin gyi grub mtha'/ (3)sa bcad gnyis pa/ ang ker brten nas chos thams cad bskrun pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba/—the dha sgo rā si dang de'i grub mtha'/ (13)sa bcad gsum pa/ me mched dang chu rgyun las gnas lugs rnyed s+t+ra// //zuXn ༷nad cardog pa ba/ (25 sa bcardo bye/ ༵/ 'bye/sems gtso ring lugs kyi gzhi grub smra ba'i shing )—hāX me ṅgi rnyi da/ (36)sa bca/ snas ba/ khungs med mtshar gtam 'don pa'i slob bu wa khe rā 'e lo dang gzen no/ (47)sa bcad 〉ga zlo/ mi re'i tshor ba bya dngos kyi tshad gzhir gzhal ge~X spya k+ta /na/ (58)sa bcardo bdun pa/ srog khrims bcad pa'i 'phags pa zhigawa sosarā 'e/ (70)sa bcad brgyad pa/ rdul phran gzhung lugs kyi rmang 'ding mkhan/ 1

wa rtemokhu re 'o/ (84)sa bcad dgu ba/ mgo rting bsgyur nas 'jig rten la lta ba'i gna' rabs mtshan nyid pa/wa lelā'o/ (93)sa bcad bcu ba/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i ches rlabs che ba'i bsam ṭī smra /si shā spyad/ cha / ) (106)sa bcad bcu gcig pa/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i rlabs che ba'i bsam blo ba/(smad cha/)wa arisi 'o 'e/ (119)sa bcad bcu gnyis pa/ spro snang ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa bsdu/phokho'i ro/ (133)sa bcad bcu gsum pa/ gna' bo'i rdul phran gzhung lugs kyi legs 'grub mkhan/wa lukhore gle'u/ (147)le'u gnyis pa/ dus rabs bar ma dang rig rtsal bskyar dar skabs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba/sa bcad ༵cu stuzhi ba/ 'khyam po nas lha'i rig pa'i slob dpon /o/snyi/sikhrin/ (163)sa bcad bco lnga ba/ lha dkon mchog gzhi grub par ra sprod byed pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba/wa o'usenam/ (174)2 sa bcad bcu drug pa/ dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsdu rub

—the rdo/ po.a/ khe na/ (185)sa bcad bcu bdun pa/ rno dbal ldan pa'i bzhar gri zhigawa welem okham/ (197)sa bcad bco brgyad pa/ bden don gyi ched du lus srog phul pa'i dpa' mdzangs 'thab mo ba/rdolharu no/ (207)le'u gsum pa/ nyerabs dbyin tha'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba/sa bcad bcu dgu ba/ nye rabs dngos gtso ring lugs dang nyams zhib tshan rig gi mes po/wa spru ran se si bha khon/ (221)sa bcazlo nyi shu: ba/ 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs kyi shing rta'i —bo~X d+ngha /sgye si/ (236)sa bcad nyer gcig pa/ nye rabs sems gtso ring lugs kyi rjes dpag gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba yang dang po/wa ren zlekhar/ (249)sa bcad nyer gnyis pa/ dbyibs rtsis rig pa'i byed thabs gong du bkur pa'i mtshan nyid pa chen po/wa sileno gza'/ (263)sa bcad nyer gsum pa/ blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis bden don brtson len byas pa'i mi/wa ljortan lo khe/ (276)sa bcad nyer bzhi bka nye rabs kyi rang rig sems gtso smra ba'i srol 'byed mkhan/ 3

wa ljorarje khyer khe le/ (289)sa bca1 nyer lnga ba/ nye rabs rtogs thabs med smra ba'i 'thus wa 47/ḍi hu mo/ (302)sa bcad nyer drug pa/ mi 'phrul chas su dper mdzad mkhan gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba/wa lhame'e ri/ (314)sa bcad nyer bdun pa/ h+pha ran se'i gsar brje chen po'i 'bod —rgyu~X/na / (326)sa bcad tshor brgyad pa/ rig gnas kun 'dus grub mtha'i dbu ge/sa//ro ṭha/ (347)sa bcad nyer dgu ba/ khe phan gyi sgo nas mi'i bya 'gul yod tshad gsal bshad byed pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba/wa helawe'i'u/ (359)le'u bzhi ba/ 'jar man gyi gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba/ sa bcad sum cu ba/ 'jar man gyi gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed/wa e man nor khrang 'i/ (373)sa bcad so gcig pa/ zab rgyas ldan pa'i phyi don sems gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid mkhan po/wa hoḥl/ (387)sa bcad so gnyis pa/ phul byung phyed tshal gyi dngos gtso smra ba'i 4 mtshan nyid rig pa ba/
wa h+pherabha khā/ (397)mchan 'grel/ (409)zhar byurdo pe/ deb 'di'i nang gi nub phyogs mtshan nyid smra ba grags can gyi lo tshigs dang gzhung rtsom gtso bo/ (415)
le'u dngana' bo'i ghi ri saumatshan nyid bra

sabacad dngayo/ rtsagatshole mthil snyeg byed ba'isnyamasazhab sda/wa wadha le si dang mi' sin gyi grub mtha'/spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 547lo'i dbyar khar/ ghi ri si'i skabs nga brgyad pa'i o lin phig yā 'gran tshogs ()'ur 'ur lang lang gi ngang 'tshogs bzhin yod la/ lo bzhir thengs gcig re 'tshogs pa'i lus rtsal 'gran tshogs ni gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i khyad du 'phags pa'i dus chen yin stabs/ snyi ri si'i mi ches mang po phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas pad ma la bung ba 'khor ba bzhin ngang gis 'dus te/ de'i steng na 'gran bsdur la lta mkhan dang /tshong rgyag mkhan/ gtam bshad mkhan/ phan tshun 'brel 'dzugs gnang mkhan sogs mi sna tshogs kyi 'du 'dzi rgya mtsho'i rlabs g.yo bzhin pa dang mtshungs/ ri ldebs su rta mig dbyibs can gyi rtswa thang du ngo mtshar 'gran rtsod tsha drag pa'i shing rta bskul nas 'gran rgyug byed cing / gzugs phung che zhing mtho ba'i cang shes brgyad kyis rang rang gi mdzes nyams ldan pa'i shing rta drud cing lus rtsal bas gcig rjes gcig gis snyeg bzhin 'gran pa la/ ltad mo ba tshos sku/ ba'i skyutā sgra dang spro ba'i bzhan sgra ni rgya mtsho'i gnyer ma ltar gcig las gaska/ ༵ /ra /da/bu skra spra ba'i me tog gi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i bgres song og tshom can zhig kyang mi tshogs kyi khrod na 'gran bsdur la gzisdus

bzhin yod de/ tsha lhang lhang gi nyi 'od kyis kho gdungs par byas pas tsha zhing skom gyis kyang gzir bar brten/ khong mgo yu 'khor nas thang la 'gyel/skabs der mi zhig gis/ ma 'grig mdzangs mi brgyal song zhes 'ur brgyab pas/ mi rnams myur gyis lam phye ste ljon pa'i bsil 'og tu 'khyer/ de nas khor chu sdud ༵ dang rngul chu phyis na'ang 'phyis zin te/ bgres song ni phyi ma'i lam la tram̐ ṭ+wāṃ 'i zlodza/ngas mi tshe las 'das zin zhes pa go 'phral mi rnams sngangs shing sdug bsngal gyis mnar/ mi mang ngang ngang shugs kyis 'dus nas dur sar skyel ma bgyis shing / khong gi bang so'i mdun du li la brkos pa'i 'dra sku bzhengs/ 'dra sku'i 'og shol du mi le sin (lkolko)lo 711—1 yo )gyi dha le si zhesabya ba khong gso skyong byas pa'i sa 'di'i 'og yun ring du gzim yod la/khong ni mdzangs mi zhig yin par ma zad/ da rung gnam dpyad rig pa ba zhig kyang yin/ zhes brkos 'dug 'di'i mi le sin gyi dha le si ni snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba dang po yin la/ yo rob mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng gi'ang mtshan nyid rig pa ba ang dang po yin no//mi le sin ni e chin mtsho'i (tsholha )shar ngogs kyi dbyi a'o ne yā (7 ༅༅)sa khul gyi ming grags che ba'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer zhig ste/yul 'di ni ghi ri si dang shar phyogs kyi shes rig ldan pa'i gna' bo'i rgyal khab (lha bho lin/ par zig gli ne ji (7〉〉zlo)dang i jib sogs/)la lar dpal 'byor dang rig gnas brje res byed pa'i 'grul lam gal chen zhig yin pas/ lag shes bzo las dang tshong las dar rgyas che la/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi gting 'thug bran g.yog dang bran g.yog bdag po/ rang dbang 'bangs mi dang sku drag bzo tshong bran bdag dang sku drag bragā bdag bar gyi 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod kyang ha cang che/ 'di 'dra'i khor

yug gi 'og tu dha le sis tshab byas pa'i gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba rnams thog mar byung / mi rnams kyis de la mi le sin gyi grub mtha' zhes 'bod do//ghi ri si'i mi rnams kyi khrod du dha le si ni mi le sin bya ba'i yul du sku drag bran bdag cig gi khyim du sku 'khrungs/ khong la chung dus nas slob gso spus bzang thob pas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' la/ nar son rjes/ khong gis tshong las gnyer pas bzo tshong bran bdag cig tu gyur/ khong gis tshong rgyag pa'i glags spyad de i jib dang bha sgye lin ( 377)la slob gnyer du phyin/ der dbyibs rtsis rig pa dang gnam dpyad rig par nang byan chud/khongagis spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 585lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 28nyin nyi 'dzin 'byung bar lung bstan kyang mi phal mo che yid ma ches/ 'on te nyin der slebs pa na dngos gnas de ltar byung / skabs der bran bdag gnyis kyis dmag 'thab 'dzingakhyed bzhin par glo bur gnam 'thibs sa rib dang nyi 'od mog por gyur pas/ kho tshos lha khros par 'dod de sngangs nas g.yul mtshams bzhag cing mnyam du bzod gsol zhus la/ phyogs gnyis ku'i ru dpon gyis phan tshun bar zhi chings bzhag mi rnams kyis gnas tshul de dha le sir zhus par/khos gad mo chen pos bzhad de/ ngas sngar nas nyin der nyi 'dzin yod pa bshad mod/ rmongs mun de dag yid mi ches/ g.yul mi 'gyed pa ni bzang na'ang / de dang lha'i bar 'brel ba ci zhig yod/ ces gsungs/khong gis gnam dpyad rig par brtson pa lhod med byed mur/ nyin gcig gi dgong mo bar snang gi skar khyim gyi 'gyur ldog la sems rtse gcig tu gzhol bas/ mdun na dong chen zhig yod pa'i nang du lhung / dong nang nas phyir bud pa na mi rmongs pa zhig gis/ khyod kyis thag ring gnam gyi gnas tshul shes pa la/ thag nye mig sngar gyi gnas tshul mi shes sam/ zhes zhal

dgod byas par/ khor brel 'tshab ci yang med par/ mtho sar gnas pa'i mi ma gtogs su zhig la gshong dong du lhung ba'i go skabs yod/ byings dong nang du 'gyel nas phyir 'dzeg mi nus pa'i mis sgang gi gnas tshul mi mthong pas/ji ltar dong nang du lhung srid ces lan skyen gyis rgol pas mi de grag med byas/khong gis gnam dpyad rig pa'i shes bya dang gnam gshes/ zhing las thon skyed kyi shes bya zung 'brel sgos tshong las bsgrubs la/ lo zhig gi dgun khar khong gis phyi lo skyu ru ra g.yur du za bar shes pas/ snga mo nas snam 'tshir khang mang po'i snum btsir 'phrul chas rin sla mos glas/ dngos gnas phyi lo skyu ru ra sngar bshad pa ltar g.yur du za bar gyur/ mi tshos rtsod bzhin rin gong mthon pos kho'i lag nas snum btsir 'phrul chas glas pas khong phyug por gyur/tshong las gnyer pas kho'i 'tsho ba la 'dang rgyag med na'ang / khong gi dga' phyogs gtso bo ni rang byung gi shes bya la nyams zhib bya rgyu de red/ mi rnams kyisakhos rgya mtshor bskyod pa'i ded dpon la dom chung skar tshom gyi gnas la dpags nas kha phyogs gtan 'bebs bya tshul bslab pa red zer/ yang khos nyin lo gcig nyin zhag 365dang / zla gcig nyin zhag 30la bcad de/ zla ba'i che chung ni nyi ma'i brgya nyi shu'i cha gcig yin par bstan pa sogs mang ngo //mi rnams kyi kha rgyun ltar na/ dha le si ni dbyibs rtsis rig par (77sna)yang ha cang zhib 'jug gi gting zab ste/ khong gis dbyibs rtsis rig pa'i nges srol (21)mi 'dra ba lnga bton pa las gcig ni sgor phyed nang gi nang 'phrad zur ni drang zur yin par gsungs pa de red/ gnas bab der rlabs che ba'i gsar rnyed cig tu 'dod la/ de'i ched du da rung mi rnams kyis skam bshas nas ston mo byas par bshad/ yang mi la las/ khong i jib na bzhugs dus yul mi tshor nyi zer gyi 'og mi'i grib gzugs dang mi lus kyi mardo tshad kyi ring tshad kyi bsdur tshad bstan cing / de rjes de gzhi byas nas

gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi grib mar brten nas gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi mtho tshad 'gre rtsis byas pas/ thabs 'dis dbyibs rtsis rig par byang cha yod pa'i i jib kyi mi rnams ngo mtshar gyi gnas su bkod/phul byung byas rjes de dag gi dbang gis/ dha le si la snyi ri si ba rnams kyis ches bkur zhing / mi rnams kyis khong la mdzangs mi zhes che 'bod byed/de ni mkhas shing blo gros ldan la phyag ris che ba'i mi zhes pa'i don no/ gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i mi rnams kyi khrod du de 'dra'i zhe sa thob pa ches nyung / lo rgyus rig pa ba tshos gsungs pa ltar na/ skabs der mdzangs mi zhes pa'i zhe sa thob pa mi bdun las byung ma myong / snyan grags can gyi chab srid pa chen po/gsar bcos pa se'u lon (77)yang mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi gras gcig go/gong gleng bshad rgyun dag las nga tshos gna' bo'i rang byung tshan rig pa zhig gi tshul mthong zin/ 'on te skabs de'i mi rnams kyis dha le si sku 'das nas lo ngo brgya phrag lhag song pa na/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba chen po a ri si khro tshes dha le si ni ches thog mar mtshan nyid rig par bsam gzhigs gnang pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin tshul bstan pa nas/ da gzod mirnams kyis der nyams snang bzhes te de nas bzung khong ni yo rob mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng gi mtshan nyid rig pa ba dang po yin par tshang mas spyi mthun du khas bzhes gnang / dha le sis mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus stong bzhag pa'i byas rjes chen po ni gang yin zhe na/ bshad na ha cang sla ste tshur bsdus na chu ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin zhes pa de red/ 'di'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa zhes pa ni 'jig rten steng gi chos yod do cog gi rtsa ba dang 'byung khungs yin par bstan/ dha le si'i tshig 'di'i don ni/ chu ni 'jig rten thog chos yod tshad kyi 'byung khungs te/ chos thams cad ni chu las byung / chu'i rnam 'gyur yin pas/ mthar slar yang chur 'thim dgos/7 de

bas na/ chu ni chos thams cad grub pa'i rmang gzhi yin no zhes pa'o//dha le sis ji ltar chu ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsar bzhed ce na/bgrang bya mang po 'gor pa'i dbang gis dha le si rang nyid kyis shul du bzhag pa'i gsung rtsom gyis gsal bshad byas pa'ang med stabs/ phyi mi dag gis tshod dpag byas pa ltar na/ ha lam dha le sis srog ldan yin tshe chu la brten nas gnas pa dper na/ nya dang / 'bu srin/ bya bye'u dang gcan gzan nas mtha' na mi'i 'gro ba gang yin kyang chu dang bral na 'tsho mi thub pa dang /sa bon la gal te chu med tshe myu gu 'bus mi srid la/ skye bzhin pa'i skye dngos chu dang bral na skam 'gro bar mthong pa dang / khong gis da dung skam sa chu yis bskor yod pas/ (snyi ri si gling phyed dang e chin mtsho'i gling phran tshang ma de ltar yin/)sa'i dkyil 'khor ni chu'i steng gi sder chen zhig tu bzhed/khyod kyis 'di ltar bsam par nges te/ gnas lugs sla mo 'di 'dra zhig mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng byas rjes chen po bzhag par brtsi rin ga la yod 'dod mod/ nga tshos da lta'i tshan rig shes bya'i tshad la bsdur na ngo ma sla mo zhig tu nges kyang / skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang bral nas gnas tshul la dpyad 'jog byed mi rung pa shes par gyis/ lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya'i yar sngon la mtshon na/ mi'i 'gro ba lha sgrung gtam rgyud nas mtshan nyid bsam gzhigs kyi phyogs su thog mar brgal ba'i dus rabs tan tan yin pas/gnas bab der/ dha le sis gang zhig chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin par bstan pa dang gsal bshad thub pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar pa'i gnas so//rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ nga tshos phyogs gnyis nas gsal bshad byed rung ste/ dang po/ dha le sis thengs dang por gang zhig chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin par bstan pa 'dis skabs der 'gro ba mis 'jig rten stong gi dngos pochi ngos 'dzin thad phyi'i rnam pa tsam las so sor thad kur ngos 'dzin dang

lan 'debs pa tsam las 'das te/ de'i rtsa ba dang mthil rtogs pa'i sgos chos thams cad kyi ches rtsa ba dang / ches spyi la khyab pa'i 'byung khungs la dpyad gzhigs byed pa mtshon la/ gal te gnad don 'di slong zin tshe/ khyad par che zhing rnyog 'dzing can gyi 'jig rten 'di gcig gyur hril por blta ba'i dbu bzung pa'ang yin te/ spyi'i cha nas 'jig rten la ngos 'dzin dang shes rtogs byung ba red/ de ltar bsam blor hril po'i lta tshul te 'jig rten lta tshul chags pa yin/ de ltar bsam pa ni phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang mthun pa red/ rgyu mtshan phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten ni drungs nas hril po gcig yin pas/ mis de ngos 'dzin byed dus thog mar cha shas dang / so so/re re bzhin bye brag tu phye nas ngos 'dzin par byed la/ 'on te gcig gyur gyi 'jig rten so sor phral ga la rung / mtshan nyid rig pa dang rnam grangs gzhan pa'i tshan rig mi 'dra sa ni/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i zhib 'jug byed yul ni 'jig rten spyi yin te/ de ni 'jig rten spyi'i ches spyir btang dang ches khyab che ba'i chos nyid kyi shes bya zhig go/ gal te mis 'jig rten spyi'i lta ba 'don thub tshe/ 'jig rten lta tshul gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs grub pa ste mtshan nyid rig pa'ang byung pa yin la/ 'di gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so// khyod kyis soms dang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis 'jig rten ngos 'dzin byed pa la kha 'thor dang cha shas nas gcig 'du dang gcig gyur/ gang mthong gang bshad mthil snyeg rtsa 'ded kyi bar gong 'phel byung pa ni blo yul las 'das pa'i yar thon chen po zhig ma red dam/de ltar yin pa'i dbang gis 'jar man gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba grags can te rgyul lags kyis/ dha le si'i chu chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin pa'i sgrub byed ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i brjod gzhi yin la/ mtshan nyid rig pa ni brjod ga'i 'di nas dbu bzung pa red/ khong gis brjod gzhi 'di baspyan

par nges par du snying stobs ches chen po zhig ldan dgos pa red/ ces gsungs so//gnyis pa/ dha le sis chu ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsar bstan pa spyir rags shing tshan rig tu mi 'gro yang / skabs der mis 'jig rten khams kyi ngos 'dzin thad/ lha sgrung gtam rgyud dang chos lugs rmongs dad kyi rgya las rim gyis thar nas rang nyid kyi blo gros la brten te phyi yul gyi 'jig rten las lkog gyur gyi gnas la dpyad zhib byed pa mtshon gyin yod/ dha le si ni bgrod lam 'di'i thog ma'i srol 'byed mkhan no/ sngon gna' bo'i ghi ri si ba rnams lhar dad cing / lha'i blo'i g.yo ba las chos thams cad byung bar 'dod/lhas skyob pa'i ched kho tshos brjid nyams ldan pa'i lha khang mang po bzhengs shing lha skur mchod 'bul byed mod/ dha le sis ni chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa rang byung khams su phyi yul du gnas pa'i chu yin pa las lha'i snying stobs min par bstan/ 'di 'dra'i lta tshul byung pa ni mi rnams kyi bsam blo chos lugs lha sgrung gis dbang bsgyur ba'i 'og nas 'ching 'grol thob ste/ phyi yul gyi dngos po'i 'jig rten las 'jig rten khams ngos 'dzin byed pa'i dbu tshugs pa mtshon la/ de ni rlabs che ba'i 'gyur ldog cig go/ 'gyur ldog de ma byung tshe/phyis kyi tshan rig kyang 'byung ga la srid/ phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang bstun nas 'jig rten gyi ngo bo ji bzhin 'jig rten khams ngos 'dzin byed pa ni yang dag pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi ngos 'dzin lam phyogs shig yin no//yin na'ang / gnas bab de'i thon skyed dang tshan rig gi chu tshad zhan pa'i rkyen gyis/ dha le si'i brjod gzhi ni thad rtogs rags par nges shing tshan rig gi sgrub byed brtan po med pas/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs zhes 'bod do//10mdor na/ thog mar 'jig rten lta tshul gyi lta ba bton cing / de nas

chos lugs lha sgrub gi 'jig rten lta tshul gyi 'ching rgya las thar par byas pas/sbyadi kāhās ni dha le sis mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng bzhag pa'i phyag rjes na dha le// si'i rjes nas/ mi le sin du'ang a nā khi se man d+dha (༅smos pokro ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 610lowa sngon gyi 546lo)zer pa dang / yang a nā khi se me ne (losmos poṣ+ṭha༅ ta lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 585lowa sngon gyi 525lo)zer pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba grags can gnyis byung / ('di gnyis spun min te dge slob kyi 'brel ba can no//)khong gnyis dha le si'i rjes su zhugs te chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa gang yin thad sngar bas yar thon can gyi gros gzhi bton/ a nā khi se man rnyis/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa ni gtan 'khel med pa dang tshad med pa'i dngos po'i rang bzhin can zhig yin te/ de la gtan dbyibs med pa (chaṭha༅)zer/ de'i nang khul du drod grang dang / skam gsher gyi khyad par 'dus 'dug la/ der 'gyur ldog 'byung du bcug pa las da gzod chos thams cad grub par gsungs/ a nā khi se me ne+e yis/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa dbugs yin te/ rlung la drod thebs pas je srab tu song nas me dang / grang pa thebs pas je mthug tu song nas chur gyur pa dang / de las grang par brten nas sar gyur par bzhed/'dirakhong gis bar snang gi sprin rlung grang pa dang 'phrad de char chur gyur pa dang / char chu de bas 'khyag pas bsdams pa la ser bar gyur pa'i gnas lugs sla mo de dmigs pa red/ 'on te khong tsho'i de 'dra'i bshad tshul la'ang sngar bzhin tshan rig gi khungs med pas/ sngar ltar 'dod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul las 'das med do//dha le si dang / a nā khi se man rnyi nas a nā khi se me ne+e bla slob gsum gyi ringagi mi le sin gyi grub mthar snga phyir ha lam dus rabs gcig tsa/ snang

zhing / 'di nas ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i dbu tshugs pa yin la/ yo rob mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'go bzung pa'ang red/ khong tshos phyi mar bzhag pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs nyung na'ang ches gal che ba'i 'go 'dzin zhig tu nges so//

sabacad gnyis pa/ sang kirabartenags chos thams cadabaskrun pa'i mtshan nyida'ag lag/wa waphe dha sgo rā si dang de'i grub mtha'/ha lam lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya lhag gi yar sngon gyi nyin gcig snyi ri si che bar grags pa'i sa khul gyi dbyi tha li'i ( lkolko)lho rgyud mtsho 'gram gyi grong khyer khi lo ḍin (mtsho smo)zhes bya bar dga' ston ya mtshan pa zhig byed bzhin 'dug ste/ thang mo cher mi mang po zhig gis brel 'tshub kyis bshas zin pa'i zog sha mang po spo sgul byas te/ zog mgo rnams (1)'di 'dra'i dbyibs can du bshams shing / de nas mi gzugs ring la snam bu'i lwa ring gyon pa brjid nyams dang bcas pa zhig de'i mthar bskor nas gral sgrig bzhin mnyam du lha la mchod gsol byed pa tsam mthong thub/ gal te zhib tu (1)dbyibs can gyi ri mo gnyis la bltas tshe/ de tsho 'di ltar bsgrigs yod de/ de'i nang nas 4 2 0ni drang zur zur gsum ma gcig gi mtha' yin la/ phyogs mtha' sani3/ phyogs mtha' 2ni 4dang / phyogs mtha' buri 5yin te tshang ma so sor rang nyid kyi mtha' dang 'dra bar gru bzhi 3〉359dang / 4〉4516dang / 585525bgos la/ gru bzhi re re'i nang du zog mgo re bshams pas khyon zog mgo9 16 25540yod pa dang / de dag la rgyang nas bltas na ri mo (1)'di 'dra'i dbyibs can du 'dug de 'dra gnyis mnyam du bsnan na zog mgo brgya tan tan red/ 13

'di ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i kun la grags pa'i nor brgya'i mchod 'bul zhes pa red/ don legs ches khyad par can dang 'phrad tshe 'di 'dra'i gzab rgyas ldan pa'i dga' ston spel la/ thengs 'di'i nor brgya'i mcho da 'bul ni/ phe dha sgo rā si gcen gcung tshogs pas khong tsho'i mgo dpon phe dha sgo rā si'i gsar rtogs gal chen zhig gi ched du 'tshogs/ de ni gong du gleng pa'i ri mo des mtshon pa'i dbyibs rtsis rig pa'i nges srol zhig ste/ drang zur zur gsum ma'i gseg mtha'i rang grangs nyis sgyur dang mtha' gzhan pa gnyis kyi rang grangs nyis sgyur gyi bsdoms 'dra ba ste/ mtshon rtags ltar bkod na/ ma 6sgo'adi ltar ro// nges srol 'di la phyis su phe dha sgo rā si'i nges srol zhes btags/ da lta nga tsho'i slob 'bring gi dbyibs rtsis bslab deb las tshang mar rgyus cha che ba red/ 'on te lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi yar sngon dbyibs rtsis rig pa'i gsar bskrun gyi dus/ 'di 'dra gsar du shes pa dang de'i thog sgrub dpang byas pa ni byas rjes gal chen zhig tu mi brtsi thabs med du zad/ ghi ri si ba rnams kyis nor brgya'i mchod 'bul byas nas dga' ston bshams pa'ang ri ba zhig go/brjid nyams ldan zhing snam bu dkar po'i lu ring gyon mkhan de ni/gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba dang rtsis rig mkhan po phe dha sgo rā si (ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 570wa sngon gyi 490yas mas)yin te/ khong ni e chin mtsho'i sā mo si gling phran (9 lo6)gyi steng g.yang ṭi brkos dkrol dang zhar la tshong gnyer ba'i khyim tshang 'byor ldan zhig tu skyes/ chung dus nas rtsis rig dang rol dbyangs la dga' zhing / dbyibs rtsis rig par de bas kyang dga' zhen che/ nar son rjes mi le sin du dha le si slob dpon du bsten par bzhud/ 'on te de dus dha le si dgung lo bgres pas khong dha le si rang nyid1 snro dngos slob a nā khi se man rnyi la bcol/ de'i gam nas gnam rig

dang dbyibs rtsis sogs shes bya'i rnam grangs mang po sbyangs/ de nas khong tsho'i shugs rkyen la brten nas phe dha sgo rā sis kyang chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa gang yin gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i phyogs la bsam gzhigs dang dpyad zhib byed pa'i dbu btsugs/de phyis khong snga phyir i jib dang / bha sgye lin sogs shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab tu phyin nas lo'i bgrang bya bcu phrag lhag gi ring slob gnyer byas te/ de ga'i rtsis rig dang dbyibs rtsis rig pa/ gnam dbyad rig pa sogs sngon thon rig gnas las bcud bsus na'ang / de dang lhan i dzib kyi chos lugs dang rab byung ba'i shugs rkyen gyis rmongs dad rjes lus kyi lta ba'ang mang po zhig bslabs 'dug rang lo bcu bzhi'i steng pha yul sā mo sir phyir 'khor la/skabs de'i sā mo si'i dbang bsgyur mkhan gyi dmangs gtso'i 'gro phyogs la yi mug ste ghi ri sir gnas spor/ mthar dbyi tha li'i lho rgyud kyi grong khyer khu lo ḍin bya bar gzhis bzung / gnas der khong gis bya 'gul mang po spel te chab srid/ rig gzhung dang chos lugs mnyam 'brel gyi tshogs pa ming la phe dha sgo rā si'i gcen gcung tshogs pa zhes pa tshugs/ 'byor phyug ldan pa'i bran bdag sku drag gi rgyud pa sum brgya lhag der bsdus pas/ phe dha sgo rā si ni tshogs pa'i 'go dpon du gyur/ khong tshos khu lo ḍin dang dbyi tha li lho ma'i rgyal phran 'ga'i srid dbang bzung ste bran bdag sku drag gi mnga' dbang je dam du bzhag tshogs pa 'di'i nang chos lugs kyi bcas khrims dam zhing /dper na sran ma'i rigs dang srog chags kyi snying bza' mi chog la/ gris me dkrug dang ber la sdod mi rung pa sogs lta bu mang / khong tsho rnam shes mi 'jig cing rnam shes gzhan du 'pho rgyu yod pa'i rmongs bshad la dad cing /bcas khrims de dag gtsang mar bsrung na sgrib pa las byang nas lnga lam du chas tshe sdug bsngal med par thar ba thob par bzhed/ rnam shes kyi sgrib di snang

ched khong tshos lus rtsal la mthong chen byed pa dang / khyad par du rol dbyangs dang rtsis rig gnam dpyad rig pa bcas la zhib 'jug bgyis pas/rtsis rig gi gzhung lugs phyogs la byas rjes nges can zhig bzhag dper na phe dha sgo rā si'i nges srol zhes pa de'i ya gyal zhig go/ khong tshos ang grangs la brten nas 'jig rten gsal bshad byas shing / rtsis rig rang bzhin can gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs khyad par ba zhig gi srol phyes/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng de la phe dha sgo rā si'i grub mthar 'bod/gang zhig chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa yin pa'i ches snga mor byung ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gnad don thad/ dha le si'i gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i dbang du btang na/ chu ni chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsar bzhed/'on te 'dod tshul de 'dras chu ni chos rnams kyi rnam 'gyur bye brag pa zhig yin tsam las de ji ltar chos thams cad du gyur pa dang / chos rnams ji ltar slar chu'i ngo bor song ba dang / chu med pa'i chos rnams dngos por brtsi mi brtsi sogs gsal bshad dka' la/ dha tshole si rang nyid kyis de dag la lan kyang mdzad med do// khong gi rjes 'brang pa a nā khi se man dhi dang a nā khi se me ne gnyis kyis gtan dbyibs med pa'am rlung gi drod grang skam gsher sogasakyi sgos chos rnams kyi skye grub 'gyur ba bcas la 'grel pa byas te yo bsrang dang kha gsab gnang na'ang / bshad tshul 'di dag ni sngar mus bzhin brtag dpyad rags pas mi rnams yid khul dka'/ dus phyis phe dha sgo rā si'i dus su slebs tshe/ gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi ngos 'dzin lam phyogs las 'das te yar thon gyi spyi mtshan bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa spyad nas gnad 'dir sngar dang gtan nas mi mthun pa'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi sgos lan mdzad pa yin no//16phe dha sgo rā sis chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa gang yin thad lan ji ltar

'debs she na/ khong ni snyan grags dgung la g.yo ba'i rtsis rig mkhan po zhig yin stabs/ grangs kyi nus par ha cang nyams 'jog byed de/ 'jig rten stong gi chos gang yin kyang tshang ma grangs tshad nges can zhig dang ma 'brel pa med de tshang mar grangs zhig mchis/ de bas na/ khong gis grangs ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsar bshad/ yang na chos thams cad grangs las mched par bzhed/ 'di'i phyogs la khong gis sgrub byed zhib rgyas bkod 'dugaphe dha sgo rā sis thog mar grangs yod tshad las rmang gzhi ni gcig ste/de ni ches rtsa ba'i sde tshan zhig red/ rgyu mtshan gcig ni spyir btang grangs ku'i thog ma yin la/ grangs gzhan rnams gcig gi steng rim bzhin gcig bsnan pa las grub/ (dper na/ 1 — 1 —2 2 1 — 3 3 1 54 lta bu'o//)yang ang grangs spyir btang ba'i rang bzhin nas bsam na/ya grangs dang cha grangs gnyis su dbye rung ste/ gcig gi thog cha ya gnyis ldan gyi rang bzhin yod 'dug rgyu mtshan gcig steng ya grangs bsnan pas cha grangs su 'gyur/ (dper na/ 1—3—4lta bu'o//)gcig gi steng cha grangs bsnan pas ya grangs su'ang 'gyur par brten/ gcig ni grangs ka yod tshad kyi rtsa ba'i rgyu cha dang chos yod tshad kyi rmang gzhi yin no//'on te ches sla ba'i gcig dang grangs ka gzhan ji ltar rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su 'gyur zhe na/ 'di la phe dha sgo rā sis ni dbyibs rtsis rig pa'i shes bya dang grangs gzhan mnyam sbyor gyis 'grel bshad byed de/ chos gang yin la dbyibs sam gzugs yod pas/ tshang ma dbye phral byas na dbyibs rtsis gzugs can nges can zhig tu 'gyur rung / dper na nga tshos nyi ma ni sgor sgor dang / mi che ge mo'i ngo dbyibs gru bzhi ma dang smin ma zur gsum ma red zer ba sogs te/ dbyibs rtsis kyi gzugs ris 'di dag kyang grangs la brten nas mtshon nus/ mdor na gang yin grangs dang 'bral mi nus 17 rmi

rmang gzhi red/ khos grangs ku'i 'go ni gcig yin la/ gcig de ni tsheg (8)yin pas/ gcig ni tsheg gi grangs ka dang / tsheg gnyis kyi bar sbrel na thig tu 'gyur/ de bas na gnyis ni thig gi grangs ka dang / tsheg gsum mnyam du sbrel na ches sla ba'i ngos mnyam zur gsum dbyibs can du 'gyur pas/ gsum ni ngos kyi grangs ka dang / tsheg bzhis ni zur ldan snyung gzugs shig 'grub stabs/ bzhi ni gzugs kyi grangs ka yin te/ dpe ris kyi lam nas mtshon na 'di lta ste/ 1ni tsheg dang / 2ni thig 3ni ngos mnyam zur gsum ma/ 4ni 'bur gzugs zur ldan snyung gzugs lta bu'o//'jig rten thog chos rnams kyi dbyibs gzugs ches mang yang tshang ma tshur bsdus na tsheg dang / thig ngos/ gzugs kyi nang 'du/ yang tsheg thig sogs kyang 1 2 3 4 sogs dang 'brel yod pas/ mthar gtugs na chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni grangs ka dang / grangs kyi nang nas kyang gcig ni rmang gzhi ste/ chos thams cad gcig gyur gyis grangs kyi steng 'bab la de ni gcig gi steng 'bab pa'o/ de ltar khong gis ni grangs kur brten nas chos thams cad bskrun pa red do/phe dha sgo rā sis grangs ka ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin par gsungs pa'i steng du da rung dngos po min pa'i 'du shes kyi snang tshul dang spyi tshogasakyi snang tshul yang grangs ga'i thog btsan gyis sbrel te/ gcig ni chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa yin pas stangs 'dzin dang / gnyis ni gcig gnyis kyi 'gal ba 'du bas bsam 'char dang / bzhi dang dgu ni 'dra ba'i grangs dang 'dra ba'i grangs su (dper na/ 28254 373—9lta bu/)gnas pas 'dra mnyam mam bden don dang / lnga ni ya grangs dang cha grangs mnyam sbyor yin pas (dper na/ 1 4'am2 3 5 5lta bu/) gnyen sgrig dang /brdiswā ni rgyu grangs (tham)min par ma zad/ ldab grangs (tshes)kyang min

lta byas rjes/ rgyud skud 'dra ba gnyis las gal te gcig la spyi rgya drug dang /cig shos la spyi rgya bcu gnyis can gyi lci tshad bkal na/ 1 2kyi bsdur tshad ltar byas na sgra brgyad tshad sbyor dbyangs dang / 2 3ltar na lnga tshad dbyangs dang / 3 4ltar na bzhi tshad dbyangs 'byin par shes rtogs byung / der brten nas khong gis grangs ga'i bsdur tshad 'brel bas rol dbyangs kyi mthun sbyor gtan la phab pa'i bsdoms tshig bzhag grangs tshad nges can gyi bsdur tshad 'brel ba yod pa'i rgyud skud la go rim ldan pa'i sgos dkrol na snyan zhing 'jibs la mthun sbyor ldan pa'i dbyangs 'byin par bzhed/ 'dod tshul 'di dag ni ngos zin yang dag yin no// 'on te khong gis ang grangs 'di dag dang mthun sbyor bar gyi snang tshul 'ud brjod chen pos spros yod de/'jig rten thams cad kyi go rim dang mthun sbyor yang grangs gas gtan la phab par bzhed 'dug spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du/ khos ni mi rnams kyis/yab mes las brgyud pa'i srol brtsi srung byas na spyi tshogs 'grig mthun yong nus zer/ mngon gsal de 'dra'i bag 'khum rnying zhen can gyi 'dod tshul gyis ni bran bdag sku drag gis dbang bsgyur bar srung skyor byas 'dug go/phe dha sgo rā sis rtsis rig dang / dbyibs rtsis rig pa dang / rol dbyangs kyi phyogs rin thang ldan pa'i lta ba re bton te byas rjes nges can bzhag na'ang / khong gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo ni nor ba zhig ste/kho'i ma tshan nyid rig pa'i brjod gzhi ste grangs ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin zhes pa'i /mas gtso ring lugs kyi rang bzhin gyi steng nas gsal bor bstan ༵ trī kā ra/ sis 'jig rten steng gi chos gang yin la grangs tshad ldan pas/grangs nges cana' zhig dang 'bral ba'i chos med ces pa ni bden la/ 'on te graXsdu de gang nas thon pa dang / grangs dang chos rnams kyi bar gyi 'brel ba

gang 'dra zhig yin pa'i thad khong nor 'khrul gyi lam la chas yod/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ grangs ku'i lta tshul ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i khrod du/ phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos kyi grangs gzhal pa'i ched rim gyis gong 'phel du song pa yin la/ de ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos kyi grangs tshad mi rnams kyi klad par shar ba red/ thog mar phyi yul gyi bya dngos dang grangs tshad yod dgos la/ de nas gzod mi rnams kyi klad pa'i nang grangs kyi lta tshul chags pa yin te/ dper na/ gdod ma'i mis 'brong zhig brngon par de la ra gnyis dang rkang lag bzhi yod par brten nas/ de dag gi klad par 1 2 4sogs kyi grangs kyi lta tshul byung / yin na'ang / de 'dra'i lta bar grub pa'i grangs la ltos bcas kyi rang skya ba'i rang bzhin yod de/ de yang chos gang yang rung pa zhig zhig pa dang bstun nas de 'jig mi srid pa'i don no//mi rnams kyis brda mtshon spyi mtshan pa (dper na/ 1 2 3 lta bu/)spyad de grangs mtshon par byed pa'i dus/ de 'dra'i grangs kyi ltos bcas rang skya'i rang bzhin ltos bcas pa sngar bas je brtan du song ta ra skabs slob chung slob ma zhig yin kyang grangs ku'i brda mtshon spyi mtshan pa bkol nas rtsi stangs rnam bzhi spyod shes pa dang / rtsis rig gi mtshon rtags las gcig gis rang dang 'tsham pa'i grangs tshad rang mtshan gang yang rung bar bkol 'os pa dper na/ mi gcig nor gcig dang ku shu gcig sogs mang / de ltar byas pas sngar grangs dang / de nas bya dngos rang mtshan pa dang de'i grangs tshad yod pa'i lta tshul 'khrul snang can byung ba red/ gal te mi rnams kyis ngos 'dzin gyi brgyud rim dkyog po'i nang go ba yang dag cig len ma thub tshe sems gtso ring lugs kyi phyogs su chas 'gro nges red/ phe dha sgo rā sis grangs ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa red ces pas/ grangs kyi rang skya ba'i rang bzhin ltos bcas par 'ud brjod byas yod de/ grangs ni phral rung dang de dīrdo bya

dngos kyi sngon du byung par 'dod pa ma zad/ chos thams cad grangs la brten nas mched par 'dod pas/ mi tsho'i klad par grangs ni gnyug ma'i 'byung rtsar byed pa red/ de ltar na phyi yul gyi bya dngos dang rang gi lta tshul gnyis kyi 'brel ba go bzlog pa'i skyon 'byung ste/ thog mar 'du shes dang / de nas dngos po yod pa dang / 'du shes las dngos po'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul 'byung bar 'gyur/ de 'dra'i 'jig rten lta tshul gyis grangs ni dngos yod 'jig rten dang bral ba'i phyi don gzhi grub kyi 'byung rtsar 'dod pas/ de la phyi don sems gtso ring lugs kyang zer/ phe dha sgo rā si ni yo rab mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng phyi don sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba ang dang po yin/ khong gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blos phyis 'byung mtshan nyid rig pa ba grags can phe lā 'o dang he ཿla sogs kyi phyi don sems gtso ring lugs la shugs rkyen zab mo thob/phe dha sgo rā si'i grangs ni chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsar bzhed pa'i brjod gzhi ni nor 'khrul zhig red/ 'on te nga tshos tshig sla mos 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi ngos 'dzin lo rgyus steng don snying yod pa rtsis med gtong ga la rung /brjod gzhi 'di bton pas 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi bsam gzhigs nus pa dha le si'i thad rtogs kyi gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs las gom gang mdun du bskyod 'dug dha le sis chu ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsar 'dod pa'i lta ba de phal cher mngon sum gyi bya chos bye brag pa'i steng yod pas/ skabs de'i mi'i spyi mtshan bsam gzhigs kyi tshad mi mtho bas/snga rabs phyi yul 'jig rten gyi rang bzhin dang de'i chos nyid la ngos 'dzin zab mo bskyed pa'i thabs dang bral/ rgyu mtshan rang bzhin dang chos nyid ni mngon sum du yod pa'i chos bye brag pa dang mi 'dra ste/ de tsho ni bltas na mi ma~X zhing reg na mi 'phrad pas/ spyi mtshan gyi bsam gzhigs 'ba' zhig la

brten nas shes dgos la/ phe dha sgo rā sis bton pa'i grangs zhes pa dang mi mthun te/ des ni mi'i ngos 'dzin mngon sum gyi chos bye brag pa'i bka' rgya las thar 'go bzung ste/ spyi mtshan bsam gzhigs kyi lam la gom pa gal chen zhig spos zin/ khong gis chos sna tshogs las de tsho'i thun mong gi rang bzhin spyi mtshan can grangs zhes pa gtan la phab par ma zad/ chos kyi grangs tshad kyi 'brel bar zhib 'jug byas te/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi ngos 'dzin gyi nus pa gong 'phel dang / 'jig rten gyi ngos 'dzin je zab tu song 'dug par bstan/ bya dngos tshang ma grangs dang 'bral mi rung ba dang chos la ngos 'dzin yang dag thob dgos na/ nges par du bya dngos kyi grangs tshad khong chud dang /nges tshad (tsho )la zhib 'jug byed dgos/ da lta nga tshos shes rtogs byung ba'iganas lugs dang thabs 'di dag ni phe dha sgo rā si'i 'go bzung ba'am rmang 'ding pa'ang red ce na chog go/dha le si'i gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs nas phe dha sgo rā si'i phyi don sems gtso ring lugs kyi bar bslebs pa 'dis 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis 'jig rten gyi ngos 'dzin kyag kyog gi khrod nas mdun du bskyod pa gson nyams ldan pa'i sgos gsal bshad byas 'dug dngos gtso ring lugs nas semasagatso ring lugs bar kyag kyog cig yin la/ 'on te kyag kyog bgrod pas sngar bas je zab tu phyin par mdun bskyod zer/ yin na'ang / mdun bskyod kyi khrod nas kyag kyog gsar ba 'byung ba red do// phe dha sgo rā si'i grangs zhes pas bya dngos kyi rang bzhin gyi phyogs sheg mtshon te/ de ni grangs kyi gtan khel rang bzhin gyi phyogs gcig go/ 'on te/ 'jig rten steng gi chos gang rung thams cad la grangs kyi gtan khel rang bzhin ldan par ma zad/da rung phyogs cig shos pa gal chen te spus kyi gtan khel rang bzhin yang ldan no// bya dngos gang yang rung ba zhig gi grangs tshad ni dus rgyun spus tshaX pyeng

sbrel yod de tshang ma spus tshad dang grangs tshad kyi gcig gyur gyi phung por grub/dper na/ nga tshos smyug gu gcig dang / dpe deb gnyis/ ku shu sle bo gsum zer ba la/ 'di'i 1 2 3gyi grangs ni smyug gu dang / deb dang / ku shu'i spus dang dam du sbyar te 'bral med ltar byed/ phe dha sgo rā sis grangs ka ste bya dngos kyi grangs tshad 'byung rtsa kho nar bsams shing / bya dngos la da rung spus kyi gtan khel rang bzhin gyi phyogs shig yod pa bor 'dug pas/ de ltar rang rig gi ngos 'dzin thad grangs dang spus kyi nang grub kyi 'brel ba so sor phral bas gzugs 'das rig pa'i phyogs re ba'i rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul byung ba red/ 'di yang kyag kyog gi bgrod lam zhig go/ gal te nga tshos phe dha sgo rā si'i lta ba tshur bsus te bya dngos kyi grangs tshad las spus ga'i khyad par yal bar dor na/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang skyon sna tshogs 'byung nges/ dper na/ khyod bza' chas tshong khang du song nas tshong gnyer ba la gsum dgos she na/ khyod la ka ra thum gsum mam/ yang na chang shel dam gsum mam/ ku shu gsum gang dgos rtogs mi nus/ des kyang gal te nga tshos spus ka dor nas grangs tshad tsam la brten na rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i khrod du gom gang spo dka' bar yang ra sprod byas 'dug go/24

sagacad gsum pa/ me mchen dang chu rgyunagasaganas lugs rnyed pa'i mtshan nyid rig pari/wa wahe rā khu le 'o/ledha sgo rā sis i jib tu bslab gnyer byed pa'i dus/ sā mo si dang khad mi ring pa'i e sha ya'i (sgromar+sā)nub ngogs kyi mnyam 'brel grong khyer e h+phi san (rmyu4khri7)zhes bya bar yang gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid pa grags can he rā khu le 'or (ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 540wa sngonagyi480lo)grags pa byung / khong gis chos rnams bzhur ba las 'gyur zhes pa'i bsam blo bton pas/ mtshan nyid rig pa ba mang po zhig ha las pa'i gnas su bkod/gnas bab de dang phyi rabs par yang shugs rkyen chen po thebs pas mi rnams kyis khong la 'gyur 'gul gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhes 'bod/he rā khu le 'o ni e h+phi san mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi sku drag cig gi rgyud las sku 'khrungs/ kha rgyun la khong ni e h+phi san mnyam 'brel grong khyer thog mar tshugs mkhan an ḍi no khu lo si'i (ṣ+ṭha stsam lo)rgyud pa yin la/'di ni dbang dang ldan pa'i rgyal po'i rigs yin pas/ nges srol la he rā khu le 'os rgyal rgyud bzung na'ang chog yin na'ang skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'gal ba'i shugs rkyen 'og khong sku drag gi dbang bsgyur la mi mos shing chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod la zhen log ste/ rgyal po'i go sa rang nyid kyi gcen gcung la bskyur/ rang nyid e h+phi san gyi phyi rol gyi lha khang gi nye 'gram du dben gnas bsten te rang byung dang spyi tshogs kyi shes byar zhib dpyad bsam gzhigadī ཿsa

nas 'tsho ba ngan ngon la rol/ la las khong dang byis pa rnams lhan du cho lo rtse ba mthong 'phral ngo mtshar zhing mtha' bskor te khyod kyis de ltar byed don ci zer/ khong gis skad gsang mthon pos/ khram pa khyod tsho ngo mtshar rgyu ci zhig yod/ khyod tsho'i chab srid las 'gul spel pa las 'di mi bzang ngam zer/mi mang po zhig khong gis mnyam 'brel grong khyer la bca' khrims gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i re ba zhus kyang snang yul du ma bzhag mi rnams kyis yang bskyar chab srid kyi don 'gar ci yang mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa rgyun 'khyongs byed don ci zhes pa la/ khong gis rgyu mtshan ni khyod tshos sa bshad rdo bshad byed pa'i ched du yin zhes lan btab/ bshad rgyun 'di dag la bltas na/ khong ni rang bzhin gyi nga rgyal mtho zhing skabs de'i spyi tshogs la mi mos pa/shes pa rang bzhin du gnas la rang gcig pur bsam gzhigs la dga' ba'i mi zhig red/ khong ni khyim chorgyud mthon po'i rigs su 'khrungs na'ang / sku drag gi dbang bsgyur la phyogs shing chab srid las 'gul la 'khol ba'i phe dha sgo rā si dang mi mtshungs/ khong gis bran bdag lam lugs kyi dbang bsgyur la dgag pa byed cing / phyi rgyal gyi dbang sgyur pa la'ang gtan nas mgo sgur pus 'dzugs mi byed/ bshad rgyun ltar na/ stag gzig gi rgyal po dha lo'u hri zhu ba ni he rā khu le 'o'i yon tan la yid smon skyes te khong gi pho brang du dpe khrid la spyan drangs kyang sems gzengs mthon pos dang len ma gnang / yin na'ang sku drag gi khengs sems kyis mang tshogs la mthong chung dang kha bral nas gcig pur gnas pa dang / de ltar dgung lo drug cur bslebs tshe dmu rdzing gi nad kyis sku 'das/ khong gi tshe hril por mtshan nyid rig par dpyad sbyangs byas shing / brtson pa lhod med la brten nas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang bsam blo gting zab thob pa red bong gis rang byung gi rnam bshad ces pa/ /zhung zhig mdzad mod lo mang 'gor bas/ da lta rtsom ral kha thor tsam

las nga tsho'i bgo skal du ma gyur/ kha thor de dag dang gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid pa gzhan dag gi gsung las nga tshos he rā khu le 'o'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo rtogs nus so//snyi ri si'i dus snga mo'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba dang 'dra bar nye rā khu le 'os kyang 'bad pas chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa gang yin thad nyams zhib byas te/ khong gis snga ma dag dang lta ba mi mthun pa ste me ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa red ces bton/ khong gis 'jig rten khams ni lha'i blo'i g.yo ba las bskrun pa ma yin la/ mi gang yang rung ba zhig gis bskrun pa'ang min/de ni 'das pa dang da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus gang yin kyang dus rgyun du rtag brtan gyi me mched cig las ma 'das te/ de tshad nges can zhig la brten nas 'bar zhing / tshad nges can zhig la brten nas zhig par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ 'di'i don gang yin zer na/ 'jig rten gyi steng chos rnams ma byung ba'i gong rol du/ 'jig rten hril po ni bar med par 'ur 'ur 'bar bzhin pa'i me mched cig yin pas/ me ni chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa dang / chos thams cad me la brten nas byung pa red/ de bas na 'byung rtsa 'di ni me mched kyi 'jig rten yin pa las lha'i blo'i g.yo ba las byung ba min la mis bskrun pa'ang min/ de ni dngos yod dang rang byung gi sgo nas gnas bzhin pa zhig yin no/ khong gis chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa ni dngos su gnas pa'i dngos po'i rnam 'gyur (chu) zhig la bshad pa ni/ dha le si sogs kyi gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bzhed phyogs rgyun 'dzin byas pa red/khong gis nan 'dzugs kyis 'jig rten 'di ni dngos su rang byung du gnas la/gzhung lugs kyi steng chos lugs rmongs dad dang lha sgrung las bshad pa'i rang byung 'jig rten smra ba'i lta ba nor yod par gsal por bsgrubs/ he rā khu le 'os 'phrul snang gi lha dang mi'i rang ngos kyi 'dod mos las ma yin2 snar/

khos ni dngos yod kyi phyi yul 'jig rten las chos rnams kyi gsang par nyams zhib byas pas/ de ni kha phyogs yang dag cig yin no/te rā khu le chos chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa rtag brtan gyi me mched du 'dod pa las ches ngo mtshar gyi gnas ni mched ces pa'i yig 'bru la thug 'duga'adi'i me mched ni 'bar bzhin pa'i me la zer/ khyod kyis 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba'i me mthong myong ngam/ li dmar gyi mdog la 'khu ba'i me lce mched bzhin pa'i drod shugs kyis phyogs bzhi'i mkha' dbugs phan tshun rgyu bar bskul nas du sprin gnam mthar skyel bzhin pas/ skad cig tsam la'ang mi 'gul bar 'dug pa'i go skabs dang bral/ me mched kyis 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa gsal bshad byed pa ni dha le si sogs kyi chu dang rlung las ches gsal bar 'gul skyod 'gyur ldog ni chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa yin par bstan 'dug rgyu mtshan chu dang rlung ni skabs 'gar 'gul skyod byed kyang skabs 'gar de ltar mi byed la/ 'ur 'ur 'bar bzhin pa'i me mched ni rang nyid zad reg bar 'gul skyod kho nar gnas pa dang / gal te rgyu rkyen dang 'phrad na slar yang 'bar srid pas/ de ni 'bar ba zhig pa 'barab zhig pa 'barab sogs mtha' med du gong 'phel la bgrod pa'i brgyud rim zhig go/he rā khu le khro'i legs bshad dum bu 'di'i nang / da rung rin thang ldan pa'i bsam blo zhig mchis te/ khong gis 'dod pa'i chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa me ni tshad nges can zhig la brten nas 'bar zhing tshad nges can zhig la brten nas zhig par bshad pa 'dis ni/ me mched 'di'i 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog ('bar ba dang zhig pa )la chos nyid ldan zhing / chos nyid nges can zhig dang bstun par byed/ khong gis da rung thams cad me'i ngo bor gnas 'gyur zhing / me yang thams cad du gnas 'gyur ba ni tshong zog gser la ༵༵sa pa dang / gser tshong zog tu brjes pa dang mtshungs/ zhes bshad

pas/ gser dang tshong zog phan tshun brjes pa ni tshad gzhi nges can zhig dang bsdur nas byed pa las gang 'dod ga la yin/ de mtshungs me dang chos thams cadakyi gnas 'gyur yang gang 'dod ma yin par tshad nges can zhig ldan te/de yang me dang chos thams cad kyi gnas 'gyur la'ang chos nyid dang ldan pa'i don no// chos nyid de la nye rā khu le 'os lo snyi si (76mo)zhes btags/()khong gis lo ghi si 'di ni rtag brtan ther zug tu gnas la/ mi tshos de shes min la ltos pa med par chos thams cad lo ghi si la brten nas byung ba yin te/ de'ang lo ghi si ni phyi yul du gnas pa dang mi'i 'du shes la mi ltos pa zhig yin la/ de mtshungs de la'ang spyi khyab rang bzhin ldan pas/ chos thams cad kyis lo ghi si 'di nyid gzhir 'dzin dgos/ 'di ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng ches snga mor bya dngos thams cad kyi 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog la phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid kyi bsam blo ldan par mngon gsal du bstan pa red/(skabs der da rung chos nyid ces pa'i tha snyad med la/ ho rā khu le 'os bton pa'i lo ghi sir chos nyid ldan pa'i bsam blo 'dus 'dug rjes su tha snyad 'dir brten nas gtan tshigs zhes pa'i tha snyad byung / de'i nang du'ang chos nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi don ldan no//)he rā khu le khros thengs dang por chos thams cad kyi 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog la chos nyid ldan pa'i bsam blo bton pa 'dir 'gro ba mi'i lo rgyus thog ha cang gal che ba'i don snying ldan la/ des phyi rabs par lam phyogs yang dag pa zhig bstan 'dug ste/ de'ang 'jig rten shes rtogs dang bcos sgyur byed par nges par de'i phyi yul gyi chos nyid khong du chud dgos shing phyi yul gyi chos nyid ltar bya ba bsgrub dgos/ dus phyis tshan rig pa mang po lam phyogs 'dir bstun nas mu mthud du mdun bskyod gnang bas/ da gzod phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten gyi chos nyid gsal bshad thub pa'i rig tshan mdā zlo'i

srol btod/ dper na/ dngos lugs dang / rdzas 'gyur/ skye dngos sogs rang byung chos nyid kyi shes bya dang 'brel ba/ chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/bca' khrims sogs spyi tshogs chos nyid kyi shes bya dang 'brel ba yin la/mtshan nyid rig pa ni 'jig rten hril por zhib 'jug byed pa'i ches spyi khyab dang ches spyir btang ba'i chos nyid kyi shes bya'o//he rā khu le 'os me mched kyis 'jig rten gsal bshad byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i bsam blo ni/ 'jig rten hril po'i chos thams cad bar chad med par 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog gi tshul du gnas pa yin la/ bsam blo 'di ni de 'dra'i shugs drag cing 'bur du thon pas/ nga tshos da rung khong gi chu rgyun gyi dpe las rtogs nus te/ thengs shig te rā khu le 'os mi 'ga' pus mor bslebs pa'i gtsang por zhugs nas pha rol du 'gro ba mthong pas/ khong gis mis thengs gnyis la gtsang po gcig brgal mi nus/ zhes nang don zab cing gson nyams ldan pa'i legs bshad gnang bar/ gam gyi mi tshos de ma rtogs par khor/ ngas zhogs par gtsang po 'di brgal nas pha rol du song la/ phyi dro yang der zhugs te phyir yong ba yin pas/ ci'i phyir thengs gnyis la gtsang po gcig brgal mi nus zhes dris par/ ho rā khu le chos bzhan de lan mi gnang bar mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs bzung / de nas cung 'gor phyin khong gis tshig gcig bsnan nas/ nga tsho gtsang po 'dra mtshungs gcig la zhugs nus la yang zhugs mi nus/ nga tsho gzhi grub la dang yang gzhi ma grub ces bshad pas/nyan mkhan de sngar bas mgo 'thom par gyur/ tshig de gnyis kyi don ngo ma gang yin zhe na/ yin pa ni hi rā khu le 'os lang long du 'bab pa'i gtsang po dper bkod de chos thams cad mu mthud du 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog byed pa'i bsam blo bstan/ legs bshad 'di gnyis kyi nang chos thams cad ga~X po dang 'dra bar brtan po dang 'gyur med kyi phyogs shig dang /

(gtsang po gcig pa)/ yang mu mthun du 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog gi phyogs shig (thengs gnyis la zhugs mi nus pa'am/ zhugs nus la yang zhugs mi nus pa/)kyang yod pa'i gnas lugs zab mo 'dus 'dug dper na gtsang po gcig la mtshon na de shā 'od du ma gyur par mi rnams brgal nus pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ldan tshe/ de ni sngar ltar 'dra ba'i gtsang po gcig pu yin pas/ 'di ni de'i brtan brling 'gyur med kyi phyogs shig yin la/ 'on te de ltar yin kyang gtsang po'i chu skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par mdun du bskyod pas/ mis thengs dang por zhugs nas reg pa'i chu de thengs gnyis par slar yang zhugs dus bzhur zin par brten/ de dus 'asdod pa'i chu ni gsar du thon pa'i bzhur chu yin/ 'di ni de 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog gi phyogs shig yin stabs/ mi zhig thengs gnyis la gtsang po gcig pur zhugs mi nus zhes bshad pa red/ de bas gsal du bshad na/ thengs 'dra ba gcig la gtsang por zhugs kyang chu ni bar med du bzhur bzhin yod/ mi rnams mdun du gom gang spos tsa na mu mthud du bzhur chu gsar bar 'phrad srid pas/ nga tsho 'dra ba'i gtsang po gcig la zhugs nus la yang zhugs mi nus zhes bshad/ mi la las nang don 'di dag bzhur chur rkang reg rkang btegs slar zhugs/ sngar chu de min/ zhes yi ge bcu gnyis kyi nang 'dus yod la/ (de yang stabs bde bas 'grig) de 'dra'i lta tshul gyis nga tshor bsam na'ang 'dra ste/ de yang mu mthud du 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog gong du 'phel bzhin pa'i mir mtshon na/ skad cig re re'i bdag dang de'i sngon nam rjes kyi bdag tshang ma gcig mtshungs min/ dper na/ da lta ngas dpe klog byed pa la/ de'i sngon ngal gso ba dang de'i rjes ngas za ma bza' ba sogs skad cig re rer gnas pa'i nga myur gyis 'jig 'gro ba red/ 'on te phyogs gzhan zhig nas nga ma shi tshe nga ni da rung sngar ltar gcig pa'i nga nyid rdo sbyor

bzhin dngos su yod do// der brten nga tsho dngos su gzhi grub la yang dngos su gzhi ma grub ces bshad pa yin/ he rā khu le sto'i tshig 'di gnyis kyis 'jig rten gyi bya dngos yod tshad tshang ma ni 'gul skyod dang 'gyur med/ gzhi grub dang gzhi ma grub pa'i 'gal zla'i gcig gyur yin par gsed 'grol gting phyin pa byas yod/ de bas na/ nga tshos 'jig rten la ngos 'dzin yang dag bskyed dgos te/ bya dngos ni sor gnas 'gyur med dang rtag tu gnas parabalta mi rung ngo // 'o na ji ltar blta zhe na/ nges par du 'gyur med kyi khrod na 'gul skyod dang / gzhi grub kyi dus su gzhi ma grub par bltas te phyogs gnyis ka mnyam du sbrel na/ da gzod bya dngos la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i /phyogs re ba dang rang shed rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul sngon 'gog byed nus he rā khu le chos chos rnams thams cad bzhur 'gyur gyi bsam blo bton par ma zad/ da rung sngar bas bya dngos kyi 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog gi rgyu gang yin rnyed yod de/ khong gis bya dngos thams cad 'gal zla'i phyogs gnyis kyis grub la/ phyi ngos nas bltas na 'gyur med dang mthun sbyor yin pa'idangos po de dag la don dngos ldog phyogs su gnas pa'i 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod kyis khengs 'dug dper na gzhur mtshon na/ gzhu shing gi shugs bskyed pa la gzhu rgyud dam du 'gro zhing / skyed pa dang dam po ste 'gal phyogs su chas pa'i stobs shugs rigs gnyis mnyam du sbrel bas gzod gzhu zhig grub/ yang rol dbyangs la mtshon na/ de la dbyangs mtho dman dang /dbyangs thung lta bu ldog zla'i dbyangs mnyam du sbyor ba las gzod snyan zhing 'jebs la 'gyur khug ldan pa'i rol dbyangs 'khrol thub pa byung / mdzes rtsal yang de bzhin yin te/ de yang nag po dang / dkar po/ dmar po dang seX ༵ sogs ldog phyogs su chas pa'i mdog rnams mnyam du bsres pas/ da

gzod tshon ris bkra ba'i ri mor gyur pa red/ 'jig rten steng rol mo ba su yin kyang dbyangs kher rkyang las snyan 'jibs kyi rol dbyangs 'khrol mi nus la/ rjong ri mo ba yin kyang 'dra ste tshon sna gcig gis mdzes pa'i ri mo 'bri mi thub kho//ngagis da rung bya dngos kyi phyogs gnyis ka phan tshun 'gal ba dang /phan tshun phyir 'bud byed par ma zad/ phan tshun rgyab rten yang byas 'dug ste/gcig med na cig shos kyang don snying med par 'gyur tshul bstan yod/ khong gis nad yams kyis bde thang ni skyid por bsgyur zhes dang / yang thang chad pas ngal gso ba ni spro skyid du bsgyur zhes gsungs pas/ nad thebs myong ba'i mis gzod bde thang gi rin thang shes la/ lhod med kyi slob sbyong dang las ka 'grub phyin da gzod ngal gso'i spro skyid myong thub/'gal zla'i phyogs gnyis phan tshun brten nas gnas par ma zad/ da rung phan tshun gnas 'gyur byed srid/ khong gis nga tsho'i skye ba dang 'chi ba/sad pa dang gnyid pa/ gzhon pa dang rgas pa rnams mtha' gcig tu gcig mthun yin la/ snga ma gnas gyur na phyi mar dang / phyi ma gnas gyur na snga mar 'gyur zhes bshad/ mi zhig la mtshon na nyin rer de'i steng gi phra phung mang po 'chi ba dang / de dang dus mnyam du phra phung gsar ba yang mi nyung ba re 'byung pa dang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs byings la bltas na/ dus rgyun mu mthud du mi la la skye ba dang la la shi 'gro la/ de ni skye ba dang 'chi ba gnas gyur pa red do//ci zhig la rgyu rkyen gyis bya dngos kyi 'gul skyod 'gyur ldog dang 'gal zla'i phyogs gnyis kyi gnas 'gyur la bskul 'ded thebs pa yin zer na/ he rā khu le 'o dang phe dha sgo rā si rnam gnyis kyis brnan bshad byed pa'i mthun sbyor dang go rim zhes pa'i don mi 'dra/ he rā khu le 'os 'gal zla'i phyogs gnyis kyi phan tshun phyir 'bud kyi 'thab rtsod ni bya dngos 'gul 'gyur 3rdo rtsa

ba'i rgyu rkyen du 'dod de/ khong gis 'thab 'khrug ni chos rnams kyi pha yin la chos rnams kyi rgyal po'ang yin/ 'thab 'khrug ni spyir btang dang / bden donani 'thab rtsod de/ yod tshad 'thab rtsod dang rang bzhin la brten nas byung pa yin zer/ bsam blo 'di dag ni gnas bab kyi spyi tshogs 'gal ba'i phyogs bsdoms gting tshugs pa zhig go/ ngo ma 'thab 'khrug brgyud de ghi par g.yul 'thab (lkoṣ+ṭhalor+sā)kyi skabs ghi ri sis gzod par zig gi tshur rgol bzlog nas pham par mdzad pas yongs su dar ba'i dus skabs su pon/ bran bdag dmangs gtso bas kyang yang bskyar rus rgyud sku drag tshor 'thab rtsod byas pas/ da gzod bran bdag dmangs gtso lam lugs 'dzugs thub dang sra brtan byed nus par gyur/he rā khu le 'o rang nyid bran bdag sku drag gi rgya las thar med la/ chab srid 'thab rtsod la yang gang nus kyis ma zhugs mod/ 'on te khong nyid kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang nan tan gyi nyams dpyad dang bsam gzhigs gang zhib byas pa las bton pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i tha tshig de dag gis/ khong 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi rno ngar can gyi spyi tshogs 'gal ba dang shugs drag pa'i gral rim 'thab rtsod yang dag pa'i sgos mtshon yod/ khong gi chos rnams thams cad bzhur 'gyur gyi bsam blo dang / 'gal zla'i phyogs kyi 'thab rtsod kyis bya dngos gong du 'phel ba'i bsam blo la yar thon gyi don snying dang ldan no// rgyu mtshan chos thams cad 'gyur ldog byed na bran bdag sku drag gi dbang sgyur yang rtag tu gnas mi thub pa bshad ma dgos/ bsam blo de ni gsar du dar ba'i bzo tshong bran bdag gis rnying zhen bag 'khum gyi sku /sna pa/ zlo/kā la dbang cha rtsod len byed pa'i bsam pa'i drag chas stobs 34nye rā khu le 'o ni yo rob mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng chos rnams

thams cad bzhur 'gyur dang / bya dngos tshang ma ni 'gal zla'i phyogs kyi gcig gyur dang / 'gal zla'i phyogs gnyis ka phan tshun phyir 'bud/ yang phan tshun rgyab rten dang phan tshun gnas 'gyur byed pa/ der brten nas bya dngos kyi 'gul 'gyur la skul 'ded thebs pa'i bsam blo thengs dang por bton pa'i mtshan nyid pa yin te/ bsam blo 'di dag ni rtsod sgrub rig pa'i ches rmang gzhi dang ches gtso gal che ba'i brjod bya yang yin no// de bas na gsar brje'i slob dpon gyis he rā khu le tho'i phyag rjes la khas len ches cher mdzad de/ en ke sis/ thams cad 'gul skyod dang thams cad mu mthud du 'gyur ldog mu mthud du 'byung 'jig byed par 'dod pa'i 'dod tshul gdod ma'i 'dod tshul zhig yin la/ 'on te don dngos su yang dag pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul du grub pa ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul yin par ma zad/ de ni he rā khu le chos thengs dang por gsal bor bton pa red/ ces dang / dule nyin gyis kyang / lha rā khu le 'o trī /bye sgrub rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi gras sheg go / zhes gsungs 35

sabacadagazhig/ semasagatso'ang lugs kyi gzhi grub smradzo'i 〉kā /shā srol 'byed/he rā khu le 'o'i nga tsho 'dra ba'i gtsang po gcig la zhugs nus la yang zhugs mi nus pa dang / nga tsho gzhi grub la yang gzhi ma grub ces pa'i legs bshad des gson nyams ldan la gting zab pa'i sgo nas chos rnams thams cad bzhur 'gyur byed pa'i bsam blo mtshon no// bsam blo 'di bton rjes/gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i khrod du shugs 'gul chen po byung / mtshan nyid rig pa ba mang po zhig la'ang sngar bas mtshan nyid rig pa'igand don gal chen dag la dpyad bsdur byed par skul ma thebs de yang chos thams cad 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog thams cad mu mthud du 'byung zhing 'jig par byed na/ 'jig rten steng ngo mar rtag brtan ther zug dang ngo mar dngos gnas pa'i chos sheg yod dam/ gal te yod tshe de ni gang /mis de ngos 'dzin thub mi thub/ ji ltar byas na da gzod ngos zin thub pa sogs kyi thad/ mtshan nyid mkhan po dag gis bsam gzhigs gting tshugs pa byas te/ rang rang gi sa nas 'grel bshad mi mthun pa re byung par ma zad/de la mdung rtse kha sprod kyi brgal lan mang du byas so//thog mar ho rā khu le 'o'i chos rnams thams cad bzhur 'gyur gyi bsam blor rgol ba byed mkhan ni/ ad li 'e mnyam 'brel grong khyer du bzhugs pa'i phaX ṭī ni zle (spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 540 sngon gyi 470lo/)dang khong gi mchan ri

bu gzan no (spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 490wa sngon gyi 470lo)ste/ khong rnam gnyis ad li 'e nas yin par ma zad/ mtshan nyin rig pa ba 'ga' bsdus pas grub mtha'i bye brag cig tu gyur/ de la ad li tshe'i grub mtha' zhes grags so//phar me ni rnye ni ad li tshe'i yul du 'byor phyug ldan pa'i bran bdag sku drag cig gi khyim du sku 'khrungs/ khong 'jig rten 'dir byon dus dbyi tha li lho ma'i phyogs su yod pa'i ghi ri si mnyam 'brel grong khyer tshugs nas cung ma 'gor pas/ de dus da rung cung zad rjes lus kyi khul zhig ste/ lag shes bzo las dang tshong las gtan nas dar khyon mi che zhing / bran g.yog lam lugs kyi zhing las dpal 'byor gyi shugs shin tu che/ sa zhing phal mo cher dbang mnga' ba'i bran bdag sku drag ni chab srid kyi steng dbang sgyur pa bor gyur 'dug lo na gzhon dus kyi phar me ni rnye ni mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi chab srid bya 'gul la hur thag sgos zhugs shing / bran bdag sku drag gi srid dbang sra brtan gyi ched khrims lugs gtan 'bebs gnang / khong mnyam 'brel grong khyer ches mang por 'grim skor byas pas/ khu lo ḍin nas phe dha sgo rā sna'i /ba mtha'i shugs rkyen thebs te mtshan nyid rig par zhib 'jug byed pa' 'pha sdo zlo r+sha /rnye'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba ni khong gis mdzad pa'i rang byungagi rnam bshad ces pa'i gsung rtsom du bsdus yod la/ gsung rtsom 'di sngar lo ngo brgya phrag 'gar dar khyab byung myong mod rjes su thor brlag tu song /de nas dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i nang yo rob kyi mkhas pas gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid mkhan po gzhan dag gi gsung rtsom du phar me ni rte'i gsung thor bkod pa rnams phyogs bsdu gnang zhing khong gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i snyan rtsom tshigs bcad brgya lhag lag son byung pas/ mi rnams kyis gzod phar me ni rnye'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo phal cher rtogs par gyur/ rtsom di/'i

khyadachos ni lha sgrung snyan ngag gi mgo dang lha mo'i (77)kha g.yar nas spyi mtshan gyi gtan tshigs rigs dpyad dang sgrub byed zung du sbrel te thun mong min pa'i gzhi grub kyi gzhung lugs sheg bton 'dug go/'o na ji 'dra zhig la gzhi grub zer na/ gzhi grub ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i go don zhig ste/ de ni snyi ri si'i yi ge las tshur bsgyur ba red/ ༷de yod pa 'am yin pa'i don no/ brda sprod kyi nang / byed po gang yin dang ji 'dra zhig byed par ston byed yin la/ dper na nga tshos 'di ni dpe deb cig yin zhes pa'am/ mi zhig gis dpe deb lta bzhin yod ces pa'i dpe deb de 'am mi zhig gis dpe char lta ba'i snang tshul ni gzhi grub po// mi rnams kyis 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gnang skabs/ bya dngos bar gyi khyad par la shes rtogasabyung pa yin te/ dper na radi ni mi dang / de ni lha/ 'di ni ljon shing dang / de ni ri bo red/ 'di ni che la de ni chung ngu red/ 'di ni mdzes la de ni mdog nyes red zer ba sogs lta bu'o// 'dir mi dang / lha/ ljon shing / ri bo/ che ba/ chung ngu / mdzes pa/ mdog nyes sogs ni bya dngos kyi bar khyad par phye ba'i dmigs bsal rang bzhin no// 'on te de dag gi bar thun mong gi rang bzhin ldan nam zhe na/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba dag gis bsam gzhigs byed pa'i gnas yim la/ phar me ni rnyes/ gal te bya dngos 'di dag thams cad las de dag gi thun mong rang bzhin 'tshol dgos na/ de ni yin pa ste gzhi grub gcig pur rtogs te/de'ang ji ltar yin zer na/ bya dngos kyi bar ho bag ji snyed cig yod kyang de tshor thun mong gi rang bzhin zhig yod de/ de ni gzhi grub ste de tsho tshang ma dngos yod yin pa'i phyir ro// de bas na gang zhig red dam yang na ci zhig yod ces bshad rung nga 'i yul thams cad gzhi grub red ces zer rung / rgyu mardospya der brten/ gzhi grub ni rgya khyon ches che zhing lkog gyur gyi tshad shin tu

mtho ba'i go don zhig tu gyur/gal te khyod kyis gtan tshigs rig pa spyir btang pa'i shes bya bslabs myong na/ spyi mtshan gang yin la go don (spyi mtshan gyis mtshon yul gyi khyad ldan ngo bo la go)dang khyab byed (spyi mtshan gyis mtshon yul gyi spyi bsdoms la go)kyi phyogs gnyis yod la/ go don dang khyab byed kyi 'brel ba ni bsdur tshad ldog par 'gro ste/ spyi mtshan zhig gi go don ji ltar mang na de'i khyab byed de ltar chung ngur 'gro la/ de las ldog ste spyi mtshan zhig gi go don ji ltar nyung na de'i khyab byed de ltar cher 'gro ba dang / gzhi grub ces pa'i spyi mtshan 'di dang spyi mtshan gzhan pa bsdur na de la khyad chos mngon du gsal ba zhig mchis te/ de'ang de'i khyab byed ches che la go don ches chung ngo // de'i khyab byed kyi nang dngos po dang shes pa/ dngos yod dang snang 'phrul sogs 'jig rten steng na bya dngos gang yod thams cad gzhi grub ces pa'i spyi mtshan gyi nang mi 'du ba gcig kyang med/ 'on te phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na de'i go don ni ches chung la/ chung nas don stong rdzas med du 'gyur ro// de'ang nga tshos chos rnams kyi thun mong rang bzhin spyi mtshan dang snying bsdus byed skabs/ bya dngos kyi rang bzhin dang grangs tshad sogs khyad chos mtha' dag dor pas/shul du ni ches cher stabs bde dang de las nyung bas med pa'i thun mong gi rang bzhin te yod dam yin zhes pa lus la/ de dag tshang ma gzhi grub kyang yinano// de bas na/ gzhi grub ni thams cad 'du rung dang yang don stong rdzas med kyi ches spyi mtshan can gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i go don zhig red/phar me ni rnyes ji ltar khong gi gzhi grub smra ba'i don gling pa red ce na/khong gis dang thog nas mtshon byed rang bzhin can gyi lha sgrung bsdus brjod snyan ngag gi rnam pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs gnyis nas 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi thabs lam bton 'dug ste/ khong shing rtar bzhugs nas mtshan na/ /ma

rig pa mtshon)nas 'od zer (mtshan nyid rig pa'i gnas lugs mtshon)gyi phyogs su yul skor byed pa'i dbu bzung / shing rta myur gyis bskyod de nyin mtshan mtshams (bden don dang bsam 'char gyi mtshams) kyi sgo mo cher bslebs tshe/ sgo srung gi drang bden lha mos khor sgo chen phyes te/ snying nye ba'i ngang sne len byas shing / nga'i lag pa g.yas par 'jus nas bshad rgyur/ na gzhon/ khyod ni 'chi med kyi kha lo ba'i 'ong grogs la brten/ cang shes bzhi ldan gyi shing rtar bzhugs nas bdag gi sgo rtsar thon par dga' bsu zhu/ zhes zer/ de nas lha mos khong la 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa ngos 'dzin gyi thabs lam gtan nas mi 'dra ba gnyis bstan/ de'ang thabs dang po ni so so skye bos (mi spyir btang pa/)'jig rten ngos 'dzin phyogs kyi bsam 'char dang /cig shos ni mthar thug bden don gyi yang snying (gzhi grub ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin pa/)khong du chud pa'i gnas lugs yin zer/ yang lha mos khong la/ so skye'i bsam 'char la brten nas bden don mthong mi srid/ des na khyod kyi bsam blo de 'dra'i lam las ring du 'bral 'dod na/ goms srol gyi stobs kyi gzhan dbang du mi 'gyur bar/ gtan nas mi gsal ba'i mig dang / sgra 'ur ba'i rna ba dang lce kho na tshad gzhir bzung zhing khyod kyi blo rig la brten nas rtsod gleng bsdum par byed dgos so// 'dir don dam par phar me ni rnyes lha mo'i kha g.yar nas mi rnams la 'di ltar gdams 'dod pa yin te/de yang tshor ba'i ngos 'dzin (mig dang / rna ba dang / lce shes sogs la brten nas myong ba'i ngos zin)tsam la yid rton mi rung / des ni bden don rtogs mi nus pa dang / bden don rtogs par 'dod na khyod kyi gam du lam gcig pu las mi 'dug pas/ de spobs pa cher bskyed kyis rtsi srung bya dgos/de ni gang zhe na blo rig dang bsam blor brten nas rigs pas dpyad de 'jig rtenā zlos 'dzin gyi bden don gyi lam de'o//

nga tshos phyi yul 'jig rten gyi rang bzhin dang de'i chos nyid ngos 'dzin par bya dgos na/ ngo mas rjes dpag gi bsam gzhigs bed spyod byed dgos/yin na'ang / phar me ni rtes rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin nges par tshor ba'i ngos 'dzin la brten dgos par ma rtogs par/ rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin dang tshor ba'i ngos 'dzin gnyis so sor phral nas gang thub kyis tshor dbang gi nus par mthong chung byas shing / kher rkyang gi ngang rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin gal chen du brnan bshad byas pas/ khong ni rang shugs kyis dngos gtso ring lugs la kha bral nas sems gtso ring lugs kyi phyogs su bsnyen par chas so//phar me ni rtes mi rnams la ji ltar bden don gyi lam la bgrod de gnas lugs rnyed par gdams she na/ khong gis bden don gyi lam dang bstun nas mdun du bskyod cing / chos rnams kyi mthar thug gi gnas lugs rtogs pa la/thog mar nges par du bsam blor gzhi grub gzhir bzhag dang / gzhi ma grub pa dgag par byed dgos par 'dod/ khong gis de ltar byed dgos pa'i sgrub byed dang bcas gzhi grub gzhir bzhag bya dgos don ni nga tsho'i ngos 'dzin la nges par yul zhig dgos pa dang / gzhi ma grub pa dgag dgos don ni khyod gzhi ma grub na khyod ngos 'dzin thabs med par ma zad brjod du'ang med par 'gyur la/ gal te gzhi ma grub tshe yul med pas ngos 'dzin thabs ga la zhig ste/ brjod med du 'gyur pa'ang smos ma dgos so// gzhi ma grub pa dgag pa ni gzhi grub gcig pu nges gtan byed pa'i thabs mchog go/ 'di ni phar me ni rte'i gzhi grub smra ba'i (647)khrod kyi brjod gzhi gal chen zhig ste gzhi grub kho na'o zhes pa de red/ de las gsal bar bshad na/ gzhi grub ni gzod 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin pa dang / 'jig rten gyi gcig gyur ni gzhi grub kho nar rag las zhes pa'o//gong gleng bltas ma thag ha cang go dka' zhing lkog tu gyur pa'i //nga

lugasakyi shugs su nges don gyi 'thab rtsod cig bskungs 'dug ste/ de yang phar me ni dhes rtsal gang yod kyis gzhi ma grub pa dgag cing gzhi grub kho na las med par nan gyis sgrub pa'i mdung rtse he rā khu le 'o'i chos rnams thams cad bzhur 'gyur du 'dod par bstan/ rgyu mtshan khong gis/ nga tsho gzhi grub la yang gzhi ma grub ces pa'i brjod gzhi bton nas/ spyi tshogs chab srid lam lugs dang mi rang nyid dang bcas pa 'dus pa'i 'jig rten steng gi bya dngos mtha' dag mu mthud du gong 'phel 'pho 'gyur du gnas pas tshang ma gzhi grub nas gzhi ma grub par gnas gyur te mthar 'jig par 'gyur srid ces gting zab pa'i bshad pa gnang / brjod gzhi 'di bstan pa'i bden don nam gnas lugs la spyi tshogs steng bag 'khum rnying zhen can rnams dngangs shing ngo rgol byas shing / lhag par du dbang bsgyur bran bdag sku drag tshor bran g.yogagi ngo rgol dang bzo tshong bran bdag gsar du dar ba'i 'gyur ldog gi tshul mthong pa na/ gdod ma'i bden don de la de bas kyang 'jigs par gyur/kho tsho'i re bar skabs der gnas pa'i bran bdag sku drag gi srid phung (74)rtag brtan 'gyur med du gnas na 'dod pas/ phar me ni rtes gzhi ma grub pa dgag cing gzhi grub brnan bshad byed pa'i brjod gzhi dang sgrub byed don dngos su spyi tshogs steng bag 'khum rnying zhen gyi bsam phyogs 'di dag mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid kyi go don zhig go/phar me ni rnyes gzhi grub gcig pu las med pa gsal bshad byed pa'i phyir du khos brgal lan mtha' chod pa byas te/ gzhi grub kyi rmang gzhi'i khyad chos kyi sgrub byed 'di ltar bkod yod de/ dang po/ gzhi grub ni skye med 'jig med dang thog mtha' med la rtag brtan 'gyur med cig ste/ khong gis de'i sgrub byed la gal te gzhi grub ni 'byung na rnam pa gnyis su nges la/ yang na /spra grub las 'byung pa 'am/ yang na gzhi ma grub pa las 'byung dgos/

galasrid gzhi grub las 'byung zer na gzhi grub las gzhi grub 'byung dgos pas/ gzhi grub kyi khungs sngar ltar bshad thub med pa dang / gal srid gzhi ma grub pa las 'byung na gzhi grub kyi chos gzhi ma grub kyang zer rung pas/ de ni phan tshun nang 'gal du 'gyur pas mi 'grig go/ rgyu rkyen las 'byung pa'i chos kho na gzod 'jig rgyu yod pas/ gzhi grub ni de ltar min rkyen 'jig rgyu ga la yod/ der brten/ gzhi grub ni skye med 'jig med cig yin la/ skye 'jig med pa'i chos la thog mtha' yang yod mi srid/ thog mtha' med pa ni dus las brgal pas rtag brtan 'gyur med kyang yin no//gnyis pa/ gzhi grub ni gcig ste rgyun mthun dang phral mi 'os pa zhig go/khong gis gzhi grub kyi chos shig yin tshe de mtha' gcig tu 'dra ste/ 'di phyogs kyi gzhi grub mang la de phyogs kyi gzhi grub nyung zhes smra mi rung / rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ gzhi grub kyi cha shas so so mtha' gcig tu 'dra ste de ni mnyam du dam por sbrel zhing cha rdzogs skyon bral dang stongs srub med pa zhig yin stabs cha phral mi rung la rgyun mthud kyi gcig yin no/gsum pa/ gzhi grub ni mi 'gul pa zhig ste/ gong du sgrub byed bkod pa ltar gzhi grub ni cha rdzogs skyon bral dang stongs srub med pas 'gul skyod kyi gzhi med ('gul skyod la yul gyi cha rkyen dgos) pas/ de ni rtag tu yul gcig dang rang nyid kyi khong du gnas la/ de ni thog mtha' med cing dus las 'das pa zhig kyang yin/ de ltar yul dus las brgal na gzhi grub ni 'gyur med 'gul med cig go/phar me ni rnyes gzhi grub kyi khyad chos la sgrub byed de dag bkod par bltas na/ 'di'i gzhi grub ni bya dngos kyi 'gyur med dang / gcig gyur/cha rdzogs kyi char zhud brjod byas shing spyi mtshan snying bsdus kyis grub pa'i ches spyir btang ba'i go don zhig las/ skye 'jig gi 'gyur ldog yod pas /ra

bcas kyi bya dngos bye brag cig bstan pa min no// de'i thun min gyi khyad chos gtso bo ni de la spyi mtshan gyi rang bzhin tshad mtho dang ldan pas red/ phar me ni rnyes dha le si sogs mtshan nyid mkhan po dag gis chu dang rlung sogs dngos po bye brag pa ga ge mo'i rnam 'gyur zhig chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsar mi bsngags la/ phe dha sgo rā si'i grub mtha' ba dag gis grangs ka chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsar smra bar yang mi mgu'o// khong gis ni chos rnams kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs dang rigs sna tshogs kyi mtshon tshul bye brag pa rnams dor nas rtag brtan 'gyur med kyi 'byung rtsa ste gzhi grub btsal 'dod pa red/ 'gro ba mi'i ngos 'dzin gong 'phel gyi lo rgyus la gzhigs na/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis 'jig rten 'byung rtsa'i ngos 'dzin thad/ dngos po'i ngang tshul bye brag pa nas grangs dang / de nas gzhi grub tu gong du 'phel nas sngar bas spyi mtshan can dang sngar bas gting je zab tu song / phar me ni rnyes gzhi grub ces pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i go don spyi mtshan can bton pa 'di ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo yar thon du song pa dang / des ni 'gro ba mi'i spyi mtshan bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa gong du son par mtshon no// yin na'ang / phar me ni rnyes spyi mtshan can gyi tha snyad gzhi grub ces pa chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa dang / don dam pa'i dngos gnas kho nar byas shing / spyi mtshan can gyi chos zhud brjod kyis spring dang por 'dod pa ni sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul du zad pha//ra me ni rte'i gzhi grub smra ba ni sems gtso ring lugs kyi slong phyogs gzhir byas nas tshan pa 'di'i dbu nas bton pa'i gnad rnams la lan mdzad 'dug dper na so so skye bos da gzod tshor dbang la brten nas chos rnams thams cad 'gul skyod dang / 'gyur ldog 'byung 'jig byed par 'ardokā la/ de ni yid rton mi nus pa'i bsam 'char tsam las bden don ga
