layin/ 'jig rten stong don dam du dngos yod dang rtag brtan gyi chos 'ba' zhig ni gzhi grub ste/ mi rnams kyis gzhi grub ngos 'dzin dgos na nges par du dbang por brten pa'i bsam 'char phyir 'bud btang la/ blo rig dang rjes dpag bsam gzhigs spyad na gzod bden don nam gnas lugs rtogs thub/ lan 'di dag tshang ma dang he rā khu le 'o'i gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs dang rang byung ( khri'i )gi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blo dang mdung rtse kha sprod du song 'dug pa ha cang gsal/ te rā khu le 'os 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa ni 'ur 'ur du 'bar zhing mu mthud du gnas 'gyur ba'i me mched yin la/ chos rnams thams cad bzhur chu ji bzhin 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog byed cing / bya dngos mtha' dag gzhi grub ('gyur med) dang gzhi ma grub pa'i 'gal zla'i gcig gyur yin par bzhed/ phar me ni rnyes de las mtha' gcig tu ldog ste/ 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa ni mi 'gul zhing mi 'gyur ba'am gzhi grub cig yin la/ gzhi grub las gzhi ma grub pa drungs nas med par 'dod/ 'gal zlar song ba'i lta tshul mi 'dra ba 'di gnyis kyis gna' snga mo lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi gong rol nas gna' bo'i snyi ri sir dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs/ rtsod sgrub smra ba dang gzugs 'das rig pa ste 'jig rten lta tshul mi mthun pa gnyis kyi bar 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod byung 'dug pa mtshon no//ci'i phyir phar me ni rnyes shed shugs yod tshad bkol nas mi 'gul zhing mi 'gyur la/ rtag brtan dang nyag gcig ( ge)tu gyur pa'i chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa zhig ste gzhi grub sgrub don gang zhe na/ gnas tshul de ni glo bur ba zhig ga la yin/ de la gting zab pa'i ngos 'dzin gyi 'byung gzhi dang spyi tshogs kyi 'byung gzhi yod de/ de'ang ngos 'dzin gyi thad nas gzhigs na/ mi rnams lag len las phyi yul gyi bya dngos la ngos zin thob cing go do/ snang

bsam blo nges can du gyur rjes/ go don dang bsam blo de dag la rang skya ltos bcas pa'i nges brtan rang bzhin yod pas/ phyi yul gyi bya dngos rnams kyi 'gyur pa dang bstun nas 'gyur ldog 'byung mi srid/ gnas tshul de 'dras mi'i bsam blor sgyid lug gi rang bzhin zhig 'byung ste/ phyi yul gyi don dngos dang mi bstun par grub zin pa'i go don dang bsam pa 'ba' zhig la brten nas dka' spyad mi myong bar 'jig rten ngos 'dzin byed 'dod par ma zad/phyi yul gyi bya dngos kyang mi 'gyur par dus rtag tu 'dod tshul dang mthun par smon no// de 'dra'i bsam blo'i gyid lug la/ phar me ni rnyes rtag brtan 'gyur med kyi gzugs nyid (64)kyi ngos 'dzin gyi 'byung gzhi zhig 'tshol par 'dod do// gral rim spyi tshogs kyi nang / de 'dra'i bsam blo'i stong gi sgyid lug ni dus rgyun yang dbang sgyur mkhan gyi bshu gzhog gral rim gyi khe phan dang mnyam du sbrel nas sra brtan du gyur/ rgyu mtshan dbang sgyur mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi myur thob khe phan bsrung ba'i phyir du skabs de'i dbang bsgyur sgrig srol bcos bsgyur yang byed mi 'dod de/ kho tsho 'gyur ldog la skrag cing nges brtan la mos/ 'gul skyod la skrag cing 'gyur med (sa )la mos/ gnas skabs la 'jigs shing rtag brtan la mos/ sna tshogs la 'jigs cing kher rkyang (sgoji— )la mos so// de ni rtsod sgrub rig pa'i bsam blo las log pa 'byung ba'i spyi tshogs kyi 'byung gzhi red/ phar me ni rnye'i gzhi grub smra bas ni 'byung gzhi de gnyis mnyam du sbrel ba las byung pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo mtshon no//

sabacad lngalda/ khungs med mtshar gtam 'don pa'islob mu gnyis/ wa wakhe rā tshe lo dang gzen no/he rā khu le 'o dang phar me ni rte rnam gnyis ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i ming grags che ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba yin la/ khong tshor sku 'tsho bzhugs kyi dus slob ma dang rjes 'brang pa mi nyung ste/ dpyad gzhi'i yig tshang du bkod pa ltar na/ khong tsho'i slob ma'i khrod na slob bu gnyis ni mtshar gtam sna tshogs bton pas grags pa ha cang rgyas/ de las gcig ni lha rā khu le khro'i slob ma khe rā tshe lo (77'a lo1ma ga/4)zer pa dang / cig shos ni phar me ni rte'i slob bu gzen no zer pa yin/ 'di rnam gnyis kyi gtam gleng ya mtshan can yin na'ang / khong tshos bton pa'i gnad don la bsam gzhigs zab bzhes gnang rgyu yod/ khong tsho'i bsdoms tshig nor na'ang de dag bsam blor nor 'khrul byung pa'i bslab bya dang len byas na/ nga tsho'i bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa gong 'phel du 'gro nges so//khe rā 'e lo'i skye 'khrungs sogs lo rgyus yig tshang du bkod pa shin tu nyung / khong sku 'das nas lo ngo rgya lhag song phyin byung ba'i gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid smra ba chen po a ri si khro tshe'i gsung rtsom gyi nang sngar yig thog tu ma bkod pa'i bya ba gnyis 'khod 'dug par brten mi rnams khong la zhib 'jug byed 'dod skyes/ bshad tshul ltar na/ khe rā 'e lo ni he rā khu le cho'i slob bu yin kyang / khong gis dge rgan gyi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i dgongs pa /shār

thug tu ma rtogs par tshig sna cha shas tsam la dmigs te thal drags par byas pas/ khong ni thal drags smra ba'i mi sna gtso bor gyur la/ dgod bro ba'i dpe yang mang po bzhag de ni gang red zer na/ sngar he rā khu le 'os/ mi thengs gnyis la gtsang po gcig tu zhugs mi nus zhes khong gis khong gi chos rnams thams cad bzhur 'gyur gyi mtshan nyid bsam blo ston par sbyar/ yin na'ang khe rā 'e los tshig 'di bzung nas de je rgyas su gtong la/ khong gi 'dod par dge rgan gyi tshig de da rung mtha' chod pa zhig min te/ nges par du mi thengs gcig la'ang gtsang po gcig tu zhugs mi nus/ rgyu mtshan chu bo ni skad cig re rer 'ur 'ur du bzhur bzhin 'dug pas chu bo de skad cig gcig la chu bo cig shos su 'gyur 'gro zhing / de ltar mu mthud du bzhur ba'i chu bo'i nang mi ni gom gang spo bar mi nus par ma zad/ tha na thengs gcig la'ang 'dra ba'i gtsang po gcig tu zhugs mi nus zer/ kha cig khong la/ khyod kyis gtsang por de ltar du bshad pa ltar/ chos gzhan dag rnams de ltar yin nam/zhes par/ khong khengs pa'i tshul gyis de ltar los yin/ ngas bshad pa'i gtsang po ni dpe tsam ste/ 'jig rten steng gi chos yod tshad skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par 'gyur ldog byed pas nam yin kyang mi 'gyur bar rtag pa'i skabs med/ skad cig skad cig tu 'gyur ba'i chos rnams tha na skad chas brda sprod dang gsal bshad byed mi thub/ rgyu mtshan khyod kyi skad cha bud ma thag khyod kyis gsal bshad bya rgyu'i dngos po de 'gyur zin nas dngos po gzhan pa zhig tu song 'dug go zer/ skabs der mi zhig gis glo bur du khe rā 'e lo lags zhes skad chen pos bos par khos der de ma thag lan mdzad/ mi des gzas nas ngo nag ston bzhin/ khyod ci zhig la da rung khe rā 'e lo yin nam/khyod kyi de ma thag bshad tshul la bltas na/ khe rā tshe lo'ang mu mthud du mi sdod padī tāgyur ldog 'byung bzhin yod pas/ ngas skad cha bshad 'phral khe rā 'e lo

ni mi cig shos su gyur zin pa ma yin nam/ zhes smos pas mtha' 'khor gyi mi rnamasade go rjes gad mo chen pos hab cha byas so/ 'on te khe rā 'e lo sngar bzhin gzengs mthon pos/ bdag gis bshad pa ni bden don yin pas blun po 'ba' zhig ni gzod yid mi rton zer/mi rnams kyis bzhad gad bslangs rjes/ khong gis da rung sngar bzhin rang nyid kyi lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byed mod/ phyis su mi rnams kyis bya ba ga ge mo re'i lta tshul bton par bskul kyang 'gal 'khrul mi 'byung ba'i chen se gol gyi lag brda kho nar bsten/ brda mtshon de'i nang don ni bya dngos rnams mu mthud du 'gyur ldog byed pas ngas de kha nas bshad mi thub/ rgyu mtshan ngas kha grag 'phral bya ba de 'gyur zin nas med par gyur song zhes pa'o//khe rā 'e los rang nyid kyi lta ba mkhregs 'dzin byas pa'i dbang gis/dus phyis zlos gar rtsom mkhan zhig gis dgod bro'i zlos gar (zlos1)zhig bsgrigs te de 'dra'i lta bar zur za byas yod de/ nang don che bsdus ni 'di ltar/ mi ka bas mi kha ba'i lag nas sgor mo bskyis te dus la bslebs kyang phyir ma sprad la/ kha ba song nas tsha 'ded byas pas/ mi ka bas kha bar/ khyod kyis shes sam/ 'jig rten steng gi chos thams cad mu mthud du 'gyur bzhin 'dug de dus sgor mo skyi mkhan gyi nga da lta'i nga min/ de bas na ngas khyod kyi skar gcig kyang mi chad zer/ kha ba khros nas 'gram lcag tsha drags pa zhig bgyis pa na/ ka bas skad chen pos/ khyod kyis ci'i phyir mi brdungs zhes par/ kha bas da lta ngas khyod rdung gin med/ de sngon khyod rdung mkhan da lta'i nga min/ rgyu mtshan 'jig rten gyi chos rnams thams cad mu mthun du 'gyur bzhin yod pas so zer/ mi gnyis kyi rtsod pa 'dum ma nus par mnyam du khrims rar chas te khrims dpon la gtad pas/ khrims dpon gyis phyogs gnyis ma'i gtug bsher la nyan rjes/ cung zad dgod zhor du da khyod /sbya bya

ba bsdum zin phyir song / thams cad mu mthun du 'gyur gyin yod na/ da lta'i khyod gnyis kyang skabs der gtug bsher bgyid pa'i khyed gnyis min zer/ dgod bro'i zlos gar 'dis nyams 'gyur dod pos mi rnams la/ gal te bya dngos kyi 'gul 'gyur gyi phyogs gcig tshad med kyis 'ud brjod dang ltos med can du byas te/ bya dngos la da rung ltos bcas 'gyur med (lko〉ltas )kyi brtan phyogs shig yod pa gtan nas khas ma blang na/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang dgod bro ba'i skyon mang po zhig 'byung zhing / de ni khe rā 'e lo'i nor 'khrul gyi 'byung gzhi red do//spyir mi rnams kyis bkur ba'i dge rgan gyi legs bshad de/ ci'i phyir slob ma'i ring mi rnams 'phya smod kyi gnas su gyur ce na/ byings he rā khu le chos bshad pa'i mi thengs gnyis la gtsang po gcig tu zhugs mi nus zhes pa ni skad cha yang dag yin te/ rgyu mtshan des chos thams cad gtsang po dang 'dra bar mu mthud du bzhur 'gyur byed pa brnan bshad byas na'ang / de dang dus mnyam du mi ni 'dra ba'i gtsang po gcig la zhugs rung bar bstan/ khong gis gtsang po mu mthud du bzhur zhing 'gyur ldog byed pa'i dbang tsam gyis da gzod thengs gnyis la zhugs mi nus zhes pa las bya ngos la da dung ltos bcas 'gyur med kyi phyogs shig yod par 'dod/ te rā khu le 'o'i tshig gi nang bya dngos thams cad 'gul skyod dang 'gyur med kyi 'gal zla'i gcig gyur yin par shugs su bstan yod pas/ de ni phyi yul don dngos kyi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blo dang mthun/ tag tag bya dngos thams cad la ltos bcas 'gyur med kyi phyogs sheg yod pa'i rkyen gyis de'i rang bzhin ni dus tshod nges can dang cha rkyen nges can zhig gi nang da rung nges brtan du gnas pas/ mi rnams kyis da gzod de la ming 'bod dang / zhib 'jug ngos 'dzin bcas bsditā nus/ yin na'ang bya dngos rnams ltos bcas 'gyur med kyi dus de

sngar bzhin 'gul 'gyur byed bzhin mchis la/ de 'dra'i 'gyur ldog tshad nges can zhig las brgal ba na da gzod bya dngos la rtsa ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog 'byung zhing / bya dngos gsar ba gzhan zhig tu 'gyur ro//dper na/ phru gu btsas ma thag pa zhig la mtshon na kho nyin bzhin nar son bzhin yod na'ang / de phru gu zhig yin stabs khyod kyis zla ba 'ga' shas nas lo 'khor gcig tsam la bstor dgos/ de nas lo bcu phrag lhag 'gor phyin kho'i lus khams dang sems khams bcas la sngar dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos gsar ba thon dus/ da gzod khyod kyis de la byis pa'am gzhon nur 'bod 'os/ phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos rang nyid 'gul skyod dang 'gyur med kyi 'gal zla'i gcig gyur yin pas/ nga tshos de nyid ngos 'dzin byed skabs/nges par du bya dngos dus nges can dang cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og ltos bcas 'gyur med dang nges brtan rang bzhin gyi phyogs mthong dgos par ma zad/ da rung bya dngos kyi mu mthud 'gul 'gyur gyi phyogs kyang mthong dgos/de ltar na da gzod phyi yul gyi 'jig rten la cung phyogs yongs dang yang dag pa'i sgos ngos zin thub/ 'on te khe rā d+dha los ni phyogs de gnyis dmigs kyis so sor phral te/ 'gul skyod las 'gyur med mi dgos la/ 'gyur ldog las nges brtan mi gleng par brten/ 'jig rten gyi bya dngos yod tshad g.yo ba nges med kyi du sprin dang / yud tsam las yal ba'i rlung 'tshub tu blta dgos byung pas/ se gol gtogs pas ston pa las smra brjod kyis mtshon thabs bral pa'i gtam dpe bzhag khe rā 'e lo'i nor 'khrul gyis nga tshor sman pa'i bslab bya 'di 'dra bstan yod de/ de'ang bden don gang yin la cha rdzogs kyi cha ldan la/ yang tshad kyang nges can zhig yod stabs/ tshad nges can de las brgal na bden don yang khungs med gtam 'chal du 'gyur/ khe rā 'e los dge rgan gyis gsung pa'i bden don gyi dgongs pa mthil phyin pa ma rdo/sa

shing / de las ldog ste 'gul 'gyur gyi phyogs 'ba' zhig bzung nas de thal drags par bcar pas/ bltas 'phral ha lam mthil phyin par mngon mod don du dge rgan gyi bzhed dgongs ngo ma 'khyog bshad byas pas/ bden don nor 'khrul du bsgyur ro//gal te khe rā 'e lo ni dge rgan gyi bzhed dgongs dang 'gal pas slob zu tshad ldan zhig min zer na/ gzen no de la bltos na dge rgan phar me ni rte'i snod ldan gyi rjes 'brang bzang po zhig red/ khong gzhon nu'i dus phar me ni rnye'i rjes su 'brangs te mtshan nyid rig par bslabs shing snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa mang po mnos/ bshad tshul ltar na phar me ni rte khong gi slob bu 'dir ha cang thugs dgyes/ khong ni blo gros kyi rtsal rgyas la smra mkhas pa zhig yin stabs bu slob kyi gtso bor gyur pa dang / ad li tshe'i grub mtha'i (tshos/༅lhatsho)thu bor bsngags/phar me ni rtes bton pa'i gzhi grub smra ba'i lugs la 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa gcig pu ni gzhi grub yin la/ gzhi grub ni dus kyi dbang du byas na thog mtha' med cing / yul gyi dbang du byas na stongs srubs ci yang med pas mi 'gyur mi 'gul pa zhig go/ gzhung lugs 'di 'dras don dam du 'gyur med kyi gzugs 'das rig pa'i lta tshul gzhi byas nas he rā khu le 'o'i 'gul 'gyur gyi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blor dgag rgol byas mod/ phyi rol gyi don dngos dang rgyab 'gal du song rkyen mi mi nyung pa 'ig gis de la dgag pa btang / gzen nos rang gi dge rgan gyi lta ba srung skyob dang khyab bsgrags byed ched gsal byed kyi dpe bcu phrag bkod de sgrub dpang byas la/ de dag gi khrod na sgrub byed ming grags can zhig yod de/ de ni mda' 'phur mi 'gul zhes pa yin la/ der rjes dpag gi thabs lam tshaX dam la brten nas 'gul skyod mi srid par bden dpang byas pa dang /

sgrub byed 'dis ni mi mi zhung pa zhig ci bya gtol med du bcar pas/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng bro ldan gyi bar bcug rol dbyangs shig tu grub po//gzen no'i sgrub byed kyi don 'di ltar bshad de/ gal te dngos chas re res rang nyid dang tshad 'dra ba'i yul zhig bzung tshe de ni 'gyur med yin la/'phur bzhin pa'i dngos chas kyis skad cig nges can ci rigs kyi nang nam yin kyang rang gzugs dang tshad mnyam pa'i yul zhig bzung tshe/ 'phur bzhin pa'i mda' ni 'gyur med mi 'gul pa zhig go/ zhes la/ 'di'i don bltas na cung zad rtogs dka' pas/ nga tshos go slar 'grel bshad cig byas na 'di ltar/ nga tshos lus rtsal ra bar mda' 'phen la lta ba'i dbang du byas tshe/ 'ben dang bar thag smi brgya'i mtshams su mda' ba bsdad cing / gal te mda' gcig gzhu rgyud las bral nas 'ben la phog reg bar gyi dus tshod ni skar cha gcig yin tshe/ da lta mda' 'phen gyi 'go bzung par byas na/mda' bas thog mar gzhu bkang pa dang / de nas 'ben la dmigs/ de nas 'phen par byed do// gzen no'i bzhed pa ltar na/ mda' de rgyud skud dang bral nas skar cha'i brgya cha gcig gi dus ni mda' ba dang bar thag smi gcig gi tshad du bslebs/ skar cha'i brgya cha gnyis kyi dus ni smi gnyis dang /gsum gyi dus ni smi gsum gyi tshad du bslebs pa sogs rigs bsgres shes la/de ltar skar cha'i brgya cha brgya ste skar cha gcig zin reg bar skad cig gang yin kyang mda' de mtha' gcig tu gnas yul nges can du yul nges can zhig bzung yod de/ de yang skad cig re re tshang mar gnas ga ge mo zhig tu 'gyur med du gnas pa dang / skad cig re'i 'gyur med kyi gnas yod cog mnyam du bsdoms pa'i grangs ni khyon sngar bzhin 'gyur med las 'gul skyod min/de bas na gzen no'i bsdoms tshig ni/ 'phangs zin pa'i mda' de don dngos su mi 'gul zhes pa ste/ 'di ni gzen no'i ming grags can sdi snab

byed mda' 'phur mi 'gul zhes pa yin no//khyod kyis 'di mthong rjes nges par du de mi 'grig ste/ ngas mda' 'gul skyod byed bzhin pa gsal ler mthong / gal te 'phangs zin pa'i mda' ni mi 'gul na ji ltar 'ben la phog srid zer na/ de ltar smra ba 'phyugs med mod/ 'on te khyod kyis kyang don dngos dang mthun pa gcig las gzhung lugs kyi steng nas 'ben la phog med(gzen no'i sgrub byed kyi 'khrul gnas)/ de lta bas na da rung phyi rgol yang dag tu brtsi mi rung ngo //gzen no'i rigs gzhung de 'dra gting zab mo zhig min yang mi mang po zhig de la mgo 'thoms par gyur/ de gang la thug ce na/ khong gi bshad tshul ltar rigs pas dpyad tshe/ 'phur mda' ni 'gyur med du ma zad/ bya dngos gang yang rung ba'i 'gul skyod tshang ma mi rung par 'gyur pas/ de ni don dngosadang gtan nas mi mthun la/ 'on te yang rigs gzhung gi steng nas dgag thabs dang bral/ gtam rgyud cig la/ skabs der gshes ka ya mtshan gzhan dang mi 'dra ba dus rgyun shing zo'i nang du 'dzul nas gnad don la bsam gzhigs byed par mos pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba ḍi o'u snyin nas (lko'i 2)slob ma'i zhal las gzen no'i sgrub byed thos rjes/ ha las te shing zo las ldang zhing ci yang mi smra bar phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed/ 'gram gyi mi rnams ci yin ha ma go bar sdod skabs/ slob bu zhig gis dge rgan gyi thugs bzhed rtogs te dga' bzhin sus 'gul skyod mi rung zhes pa red/ khyod tshos ltos dang / dge rgan 'gul skyod byas pa ma red dam/ da thengs gzen no'i sgrub byed dgag nus song / zhes pa dge rgan gyis go phyin/ dge rgan thugs khros shing dbyug rten bsnams nas slob ma'i mgo bor tag tag tsam byas te/blun po/ gzen no'i sgrub byed kyis rigs lam ston gyin 'dug khong ngo mar daX/ nus pa zhig yong pa la nges par bsam blo gtong zhing rigs lam la

brten dgos/ don dngos tsam gyis khong drungs chod pa zhig dgag mi thub cesagadams/ 'dir bsam na mtshan nyid rig pa ba 'di dang khong gi slob mas 'bad pa byas na'ang sngar bzhin dgag ma thub po//drungs nas gzen no'i 'khrul smra de dgag nus pa la/ nges par du rigs lam yang dag ldan pa'i bsam blo'i dras chas rtsod sgrub rig pa'i gzhung khong du chud dgos/ rtsod sgrub rig pa'i gzhung du/ 'jig rten steng gi chos mtha' dag 'gal bas gtams 'dug 'gul skyod kyang de las ma 'das/ches stabs bde'i 'gul skyod ni dngos gzugs kyi gnas yul spo ba yin/ spo nur byed pa'i dngos gzugs gang yin kyang ('phangs zin pa'i mda' yang 'du)skad cig rer gnas ga ge mo zhig tu yod la/ de dang dus mtshungs yang gnas der med pas/ 'gal ba de mu mthud du 'byung zhing mu mthud du'ang bsdum pa la ni dngos gzugs kyi 'gul skyod zer/ 'phangs zin pa'i mdar mtshon na/ mda' rgyud skud dang bral ba'i skad cig mar dper na skar cha brgya cha gcig gi yun la mda' bar thag smi gcig gi tshad la bslebs pa dang /dus mtshungs de yang gnas dang bral par brten nas da gzod skar cha brgya cha gnyis kyi yun la thon pas bar thag smi gnyis pa'i sar bslebs/ de dang dus mtshungs gnas de las 'das pa ni gzod skar cha brgya cha gsum gyi yun la son pas bar thag smi gsum gyi gnas su bslebs pa sogs mdas smi brgya'i mtshams kyi 'ben la phog nas mi 'bral ba'i bar ro// mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng dngos gzugs gnas ga ge mo zhig tu gnas pa la rgyun chad rang bzhin ( /gathoṣ+ṭha)zer la/ dngos gzugs gnas de nas bral te gnas gnyis par bslebs pa'i gnas gang du med pa'i skabs der rgyun mthud rang bzhin du 'bod/ de ltar dngos gzugs gnas yul spo nur gyi 'gul skyod ni rgyun chad rang bzhin dang rgyun mthud rang bzhin 'di gnyis kyi 'gaX sna'i

phyogs kyi gcig gyur yin pas gcig kyang med mi rung / rgyun chad rang bzhin la brten nas nga chos skad cig tsam gyi yun la mda'i gnas yul gtan 'bebs thub cing / rgyun mthud rang bzhin la brten nas mda' 'phen sa nas 'ben la reg gi bar 'phur thub byung / de ltar phyogs 'di gnyis mnyam du sbyor tshe/ da gzod 'gul skyod rang bzhin ngos 'dzin thub/ dpe cung go sla ba zhig bzhag na/ glog brnyan zhig gi spyin shog dang 'dra ste/ gal te nga chos glog brnyan ston byed kyi 'phrul chas las tshur blangs nas rang gis zhib tu bltas na/ 'gyur med mi 'gul ba'i gzugs ris ('di ni rgyun chad rang bzhin no//) re re bzhin mthong tsam las 'gul skyod byed pa'i glog brnyan gyi gzugs ris ni ma yin la/ nga tshos de nyid 'phrul chas su bcug ste bstan pa ('di ni rgyun mthud rang bzhin no//) na/ skar cha re rer gzugs ris nyer bzhi'i 'gul tshad ('di ni rgyun mthud rang bzhin dang rgyun chad rang bzhin gyi gcig gyur to//) kyis yol ba'i steng phud pa'i tshe/ nga tshos mthong pa ni 'gul skyod byed bzhin pa'i mi sna dang shing rta sogs su gyur/ gzin no'i nor 'khrul ni/ khong gis 'gul skyod rang ldog 'gal ba yin par ma gsan nas rgyun chad rang bzhin dang rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyi gcig gyur so sor phral pa dang / rgyun chad rang bzhin (skad cig tsam gyi yun du gnas ga ge mor yod pa/)tsam las rgyun mthud rang bzhin (skad cig tsam gyi yun la gnas de dang bral zhing yang gnas gang du'ang med pa/) ma mthong la/ khos mda'i 'phur skyod kyi dus rgyun chad rang bzhin mang po zhig bsnan tsam du go bas mda' 'phur skyod skabs kyi rgyun mthud rang bzhin ni mtha' gcig tu spangs/ de ltar byas na 'phur skyod kyi mda' ni 'gyur med 'gul med cig tu song zhing /'di 'dra'i tshul ni nga tshos glog brnyan spyin shog 'phrul chas las tshur blangs naX ḍi re bzhin blta ba dang mtshungs so//

gzen no'i 'phur mda' mi 'gul zhes pa'i sgrub byed 'di ni bsam blo'i phyogs nas bshad na nor 'dug rgyu mtshan khong gis ni 'gul skyod rang ldog gi 'gal ba mthong ma thub cing / rang ngos kyi snang tshul gzhir byas te 'gal pa'i phyogs gnyis so sor phral la/ rgyun chad rang bzhin gyi phyogs las rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyi phyogs bor 'dug pas/ bya dngos 'gul skyod kyi gnyug ma'i ngo bo dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du song / de bas na nges par phyogs re ba dang nor 'khrul gyi mjug 'bras 'byung nges/ de 'dra'i bya dngos kyi 'gal ba'i phyogs gnyis kyi 'brel ba so sor phral nas phyogs gcig las cig shos mi dgos pa'i bsam blo gtong thabs ni gzugs 'das rig pa'i lta tshul te/ de dang rtsod sgrub smra ba'i lta tshul 'gal zlar 'dug go/gzen no'i sgrub thabs dang bsdoms tshig bcas tshang ma nor yod la/yin na'ang khong gis bton pa'i gnad don des mi rnams kyis bsam gzhigasakhyed gzhi gal chen zhig gi blo sgo phye yod de/ ci zhig la 'gul skyod zer pa dang / ji ltar da gzod yang dag pa'i sgos 'gul skyod kyi rang bzhin ngos 'dzin pa bcas yin la/ gnad 'dir zhib 'jug byas pas/ mi rnams kyis rtsod sgrub smra ba'i lta tshul gyis 'gul skyod ngos 'dzin gnang par skul 'ded thebs/ gzen no'i 'phur mda' mi 'gul zhes pa'i sgrub byed ni blo gros kyi me tog cig ste/ 'on kyang de ni 'bras bu mi thogs pa'i blo gros kyi me tog cig go/ rgyu mtshan des ni mi rnams la bsam blo'i thabs lam rnam dag cig bstan med pas so// 'phur mda' mi 'gul zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyis nga tshor rang nyid kyi bsam gzhigs nus pa gong 'phel dang / yang dag pa'i sgos phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten ngos 'dzin dgos na nges par du rtsod sgrub rig pa khong du chud par bya dgos so zhes bstan to//57

sabacadadrug la/ mi re'i tshorari bya dngos kyi tshan gzhir gzhal pa'i dbyonahāg/wa phu ro ṭha sgo ra/spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 440lor/ e chin mtsho'i byang ngogs kyi a bho d+dha rā mnyam 'brel grong khyer (lo77777)gyi mkhas pa grags can phu ro bha sgo ra (ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 481wa sngon gyi 411lo/) zhes bya ba rgya mtsho brgal nas skabs der snyi ri si'i ghi ri sir grags pa'i a then sir (r+sā )'byor/ yul de'i thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing 'du long che ba'i rnam pas khong gi yid 'phrog par gyur/ gru sgye re i si ( 7467)mtsho khug tu bsnyen pa'i tshe/ mthong tshad skar tshogs ltar mnga' pa'i tshong gru dang ri ltar spungs pa'i tshong zog red/ mtsho kha nas a then si'i bar spyi le bcu phrag 'ga'i lcags ri rim pa gsum brtsigs te grong khyer srung skyob byas yod/ rgyang ring nas bltas tshe/ ri rtser krong nger lang pa'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i a then si'i srung mkhar mkhar sgor gser zangs las grub pa'i shes rab lha mo'i (ṣ+ṭha mi'i)bzheng sku chen po zhig bzhengs pa dang / ches mtho sar rdo ka ma ru dkar pos bzhengs pa'i phu 'e ni lha khang (snyematshasmosmo7lo)brjid nyams can dang /srung mkhar gyi gyang steng du rnam rgyal lha mo'i (khus/67)sku dang / mtha' 'khor thams cad du ghi ri si dang par zig g.yul 'gyed kyi skabs thob pa'i g.yul rdzas bshams 'dug mkhar gyi phyogs bzhir skyu ru ra'i ljon pa dang /ldadī /dog ldan pa'i rgun 'brum tshal/ dkar mdog dri mas ma gos pa'i rdo ka

ma rus brtsigs pa'i rtsig bzos mang po phan tshun 'od mdangs 'phro bas rtobs chog mi shes/ srung mkhar gyi nub phyogs kyi phu ne+e khu si snyin thang chen du (077long7)nyin dgu bar bzhag nas mkhar nang gi mi yod tshad 'dus te spyi 'bangs tshogs 'du thengs re 'tshogs/ skabs der spyi dmangs re re stegs bur bud de rang nyid kyis rgyal khab kyi don chen thad kyi bzhed dgongs gtam 'don bya ba'i srol yod/ srung mkhar gyi shar phyogs ni mi drug stong 'dzoms pa'i 'dri gcod las rogs khrims rwa ste thengs rer mi lnga brgyas khrims las gnyer zhing zhu sbyor snga phyi gnyis kyis bden pa brdar chog tsong rar tshong pa tshos yul gru so so nas dbor pa'i tshong rdzas nyo bar skul 'bod byed pa dang / lag bzo khang du bran g.yog 'bor grangs mang pos rdza chas dang lcags rigs kyi nyer spyad drag chas bcas las bzhin pa dang / srang lam dang thang chen du na gzhon mang po skor ma skor ma byas nas 'dus te la las lab rgyag pa dang la las rtsod gleng bar med du byed bzhin 'dugaphu ro ṭha sgo ra a then sir yong dus ghi par g.yul 'thab du kyi rjes su a then si dar ba'i rtser son skabs tag tag red/ bar skabs der bran bdag dmangs gtso pa dang sku drag phyogs 'dzin pa'i bar 'thab rtsod tsha drag pa byas phyin/ mthar spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 443lor sge li khu le'i srid dbang gis (44tshoms/77 )dmangs gtso'i phyogs 'dzin gyi srid dbang btsugs/khong tshos bsgyur bcos kyi thabs mang po bton pas 'bras bu chen po smin/ a then si ni snyi ri si'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi lte bar gyu/ li/ khu le'i srid dbang gi skrun gnyer la brten nas a then si'i bran bdag dmangs gtso'i lam lugs la gong 'phel chen po thob/ bran g.yog dang phyogs gzhan pa ma gtogs a then si'i spyi 'bangs yod tshad spyi da/chos

tshogs chen la zhugs chog der ma zad tshang mar rgyal khab kyi don chen bya 'gul la zhugs nas rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin rim pa'i dpon po 'am khrims ra'i 'dri gcod las rogs pa bcas kyi 'gan bzhes pa'i go skabs yod do//rgyal khab kyis da rung spyi 'bangs la gzhung sgrub kha snon dang zlos gar la blta ba'i kha snon gtong pa dang / spyi 'bangs chab srid dang rig gnas bya 'gul la zhugs par skul ma gtong / de 'dra'i tshul la brten nas mi phal mo ches bya bar thugs khur dang thun mong bya 'gul la zhugs par hur brtson byed la/shes yon can dang smra mkhas pa yin tshe/ da gzod tshang mas bsnyen bkur byed pa'i grub 'bras thob bo//phu ro ṭha sgo ras nyams zhib byas pa brgyud a then si'i spyi 'bangs dang /khyad par du na gzhon tsho tshang mas thun mong gi bya 'gul nang mkho ba'i bsam gzhigs dang / gtam bshad/ rtsod sgrub dang tshig rgyan sogs yon tan 'phel ba'i slob gso dang rogs ram dgos pa rtogs pas/ khong gis grogs bshes 'ga' gdan drangs shing a then sir shes rab kyi slob tshan zhes pa'i slob grwa zhig btsugs te slob ma bsdu gnyer byas/ don gnyer can su yin kyang slob yon nges can zhig sprad rjes slob khrid la nyan chog brda 'phrin bsgrags phyin na gzhon mang po 'tshang ga shig shig gis thon/ tha na ches mtho'i srid sgyur dpon po'i sras gnyis kyis rang khyim du khong spyan drangs te dpe khrid la gsan/ dus rgyun bslab gnyer pa ches mang zhing khang par ma shong pas mdzod khang zhig phyung nas der 'tshogs/ phu ro ṭha sgo ras dpe khrid kyi mtshan la shes rab kyi slob tshan zhes pa'i dbang gis khong gis rang nyid la blo ldan du 'bod/khong nas bzung ghi ri sir ched gnyer dge rgan skor zhig byung la/ kho tsho yul gru so sor bzhud de na gzhon tshos ji ltar gtam bshad/ rtsod pa/ gtug baX/ dang spyi sger gyi don dag sgrub tshul sogs slob khrid gnang pas/ 'di

dag la mi chos dpyod ldan pa (tshizloṣ+ṭha)zhes zer/ phu ro ṭha sgo ra ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i dpyod ldan pa'i mtshan nyid mkhan po'i thog ma yin la/ khong ni dpyod ldan pa'i ming grags can gyi 'thus tshab mi sna zhig go/phu ro ṭha sgo ras gang nus ci thub kyis sgye li khu le'i dmangs gtso srid dbang la rgyab skyor byas shing / khong rnam gnyis kyi 'brel ba zab pas/ dus rgyun mnyam du bca' khrims kyi dogs gnad la bgro gleng byed/ sgye li khu les da rung khong nyid gdan drangs te mnyam 'brel grong khyer gsar pa ḍo re (ṣ+ṭha4)la bca' khrims gtan 'bebs zhus/ phu ro ṭha gho ras ngo mtshar pa'i gtam bshad dang / dogs gnad la mdor bstan go sla'i sgo nas gsed bkrol bgyis pas/ mi rnams kyis nus rtsal 'gran med kyi mi zhes bsngags/dus phyis khong gis lha'i rnam bshad (mu3)ces pa'i gzhung zhig mdzad cing /de'i nang lhar mtshon na bdag gis de tsho gnas mi gnas mi shes par ma zad/de tsho ji zhig dang mtshungs par yang mi shes/ chos mang po zhig ni nga tshos ngos zin mi thub/ dogs gnad ni rtogs dka' la mi tshe ni thung ngu zhig go/ zhes gsungs/ tshig 'di dag gi nang lha yod med la dogs pa zos 'dug sgye li khu le gshegs rjes/ bag 'khum rnying zhen can gyi stobs shugs rgyas pas/ phu ro ṭha sgo ra ni lha la rmongs dad byed mkhan gyis khrims la sbyar/ de ltar khong gi gsung rtsom yang lhar mi bkur zhes mer bsregs/ mthar a then si nas bskrad de se se ler (mapotsho)bgrod skabs gru skyon byung nas sku 'das/phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i gsung ma nyams par brgyud nas 'ong pa shog thor nyung nyung tsam du zad/ de'i nang shugs rkyen shin tu che ba'i legs bshad ming grags can te/ mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi dang / gzhi grub kyi bya dngos gzhi grub kyi tshad gzhi yin la/ yang gzhi ma grub pa'i bya dngos gzhi ma grub pa'i tshad gzhi'ang red/ ces pa de'i don mtshan nyid rig pa'i sdu/da

gzhi gcig tu bsdus te/ minichos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin zhes so//tshig de dag gi don gang yin zer na/ phu ro ṭha sgo ras 'di ltar 'grel bshad byas yod de/ rlung 'dra mtshungs shig ldang pa na/ grang par snang ba'i mi la grang pa dang / mi grang par snang ba'i mi la mi grang pa dang / sbrang rtsi ni mi bde thang la mngar mo dang / nad can la kha bor snang / rlung de mthar gtug na grang ngam mi grang / sbrang rtsi mngar ram kha bo gang yin tshang ma mi 'dra ba'i mi dang mi 'dra ba'i tshor snang la rag las red/ de bas na/ mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhir gsungs/ de'ang bya dngos mtha' dag gi rang bzhin (rlung grang mi grang dang / sprang rtsi mngar mi mngar/ tha na yin min dang bzang ngan sogs 'du'o//)ji ltar 'dug pa tshod dpog byed pa'i tshad gzhi ni mi yin zhes pa'i don no// mi ci zhig la brten nas tshod dpog byed ce na/ de ni rang nyid kyi tshor snang la thug yod/ der brten go sla mo'i sgos bshad na/mi rnams chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin zhes pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i brjod gzhi 'di'i nang don ni/ mi re re'i tshor snang ni bya dngos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gzhal pa'i tshad gzhi yin zhes pa'o//tsho phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i brjod gzhi 'di byung pas mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus steng don snying gal chen zhig bzhag khong gi gong rol gyi mtshan nyid mkhan po dang / dha le si nas nye rā khu le 'o'i bar thams cad chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa gang yin la nyams zhib byed pa gal chen du bzung / khong tshos 'bad 'bungs byas nas 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa mthar gtug na gang yin dang / rang byung khams ni ji ltar gnas pa dang 'gyur pa sogs kyi don gsal bshad byas pas/ mi rnams kyis de dag la rang byung mtshan nyid rig pa ba zer ro// he rā khu le 'os chos thams cad kyi gzhi grub dang gzhi ma grub pa'i 'a~X gnad bton la/ phar me ni rnyes rjes dpag gtso 'don gyis lkog gyur

gyi rigs dpyad kyis gzhi grub las med pa bsgrubs shing / mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin yal bar dor nas gzhi ma grub pa khas ma blangs/ khong gi rigs gzhung don dngos dang bral zhing dngos yod 'tsho ba las ring du song / des ni mi'i bsam gzhigs kyi nus rtsal gong du 'phel pa ma gtogs don dngos kyi gnad don gang la yang phan ci yang mi thogs/ 'on te phu lo ṭha sgo ras bton pa'i brjod gzhi des ni/ thog mar mtshan nyid rig pa'i dgongs don la sngar bas 'gyur ldog gal chen zhig byung pa mtshon te/ 'di nas bzung chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsar nyams zhib byed pa'i gnas gyur te mi dang chos rnams kyi bar 'brel la zhib 'jug byas pas/ lkog gyur dang don gyis dben pa'i bsam gzhigs las thar te dngos yod la kha phyogs shing / rang rig dang phyi yul gyi 'brel ba'i ngos 'dzin smra ba'i gnad don gsal bshad byed pa'i skabs su thug de rjes mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin par bton pa'i brjod gzhi 'dis/ thengs dang por mi chos thams cad kyi gtso bor bzhag la/ des ni skabs der mis rang nyid kyi stobs shugs kyi gdeng mthon por yod pa mtshon pa dang / shed shugs ldan pa'i sgo nas chos rnams thams cad lhas thag gcodabyed pa'i rmongs dad kyi bsam blor rdung deg byas/ gna' bo'i snyi ri sir mtshon na/ lha sgrung dang chos lugs rmongs dad sprags shing lhas dbang bsgyur pa'i lta tshul gyis mi'i lus yid la bkag rgya tshabs chen thebs/ mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhir bstan pas/ gnas bab der srol rgyun gyi sdusaji blo'i dra rgya brtol cing mi'i nus pa 'don spel byas pa'i don snying chen po da ba/rjod gzhi 'di byung pa ni glo bur pa zhig min te/ de ni gnas bab de'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang / chab srid dang rig gnas 'tsho ba bcas kyi mtshon byed cig go/ ghi par g.yul 'thab kyi rjes/ ghi ri si'i bran sdu/ga

lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor gong 'phel ches cher phyin pa dang / 'gro ba mis rang byung bsgyur bkod kyi nus shugs mu mthud du rgyas pa dang / spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'ang sngar bas phun sum tshogs par gyur/ thog ma'i ri dwags brngon pa dang / nywa rgya 'phen pa/ nor phyugs 'tsho ba/ zhing rmon 'debs/ gter bsngogs 'don/ lcags rigs bzhu sbyang / gru bzo ba/ rgya mtshor bskyod pa/'khal 'thag sman rtsal/ gnam rig skar rtsis las gong 'phel du song nas gtam bshad/ rtsod pa/ gtug bsher/ rgyal khab dar spel gyi las la zhugs pa/ 'di dag tshang ma mi'i nus mthu dang 'bral mi rung pa red/ 'on te skabs de ga'i mi tsho'i ngos 'dzin gyi gting da rung mi zab ste/ phal mo che ni phyi rol 'jig rten gyi phyi'i snang tshul las ma 'das pas/ rang rig gi ngos 'dzin dang phyi rol 'jig rten bar gyi 'brel pa ngo mar ma rtogs shing / mi'i rang rig gi nus pa phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid dang 'gal mi rung pa ma shes par ma zad/ mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin dang rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin bar gyi 'brel pa yang dag la'ang rgyus lon med stabs/ mi'i rang rig gi tshor ba'i nus pa che ru 'ud bskyed sla ba red/ lhag par du skabs der a then si'i dmangs gtso'i mkha' dbugs kyi rgyu ba brtas la/ gtam bshad dang rtsod par byed pa dar ba'i dus yin pas/ mi rnams kyi yid la su'i kha bde na des nyan mkhan gyi yid 'gug thub cing 'bangs mi kha bsgyur nus la/ su rtsod par mkhas na des phyogs snga pham nas rgyal khab len thub par 'dod pa las don dngos ji 'dra yin par mthong chen mi byed do// phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin zhes pa 'di ni khong gis dus skabs de'i spyi tshogs chab srid 'tsho ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa stong thun du bstan pas/ des ni mi rnams hur brtson sdiX snrodro // zlo 'gul dang spyi tshogs 'tsho bar zhugs par skul ma gtong pa'i

phu ro ṭha sgo ras bton pa'i mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin zhes pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i brjod gzhi 'di skabs de'i lo rgyus cha rkyen la mtshon na yar thon gyi phan nus dang ldan la/ de'i nang lugs mthun gyi rgyu cha yod mod/ spyir bshad na de ni nor 'khrul can gyi sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i brjod gzhi zhig red/mis bya dngos la tshod dpog byed dus tshor ba dang 'bral mi rung bar 'dod pa ni brjod gzhi 'di'i nang gi lugs mthun gyi cha yin te/ rgyu mtshan misakhya dngos ngos 'dzin dgos na/ thog mar nges par du mig rna ba sna lce lus sogs kyi tshor dbang la brten nas/ da gzod bya dngos de gzhi grub 'am ma grub dang de'i phyi tshul rtogs thub/ tshor dbang de dag ni sge'u khung dang 'dra ste/ brtol nas nang du nyi zer 'phros na/ mi'i 'du shes kyis da gzod phyi'i bya dngos rnams so sor 'byed nus/ yin na'ang tshor ba ni mis bya dngos ngos 'dzin pa'i dbu 'ba' zhig las mjug grub pa min/ 'go 'di nas mi'i ngos 'dzin gtan nas mi mthun pa'i lam phyogs gnyis su gong du 'phel rung ste/ lam phyogs gcig ni tshor ba phyi rol gyi bya dngos las byung zhing / de ma zad da rung nges par tshor ba mang po bsags gnyer byas te mthar 'du shes kyi blang dor la brten tshe/ da gzod ngos zin gyi tshad phyi'i snang tshul tsam las 'das srid la/ phyi rol gyi bya dngos kyi rang bzhin dang chos nyid sngar bas ngos 'dzin gting zab tu phyin nas cung phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'byung nges pas/ de ni yang dag pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi ngos 'dzin lam phyogs shig red/ lam phyogs cig shos ni dang po dang dngos 'gal du gnas te/ 'dis tshor ba ni rang rig nyid la brten nas byung zhing /rang rig gi tshor ba ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos thag gcod byed du 'dod/lam phyogs 'di ni phyi rol yul dang rang rig gi 'brel pa mgo mjug ldo/ sna'i

sems gtso ring lugs kyi ngos 'dzin lam phyogs red/ phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i brjod gzhi 'di la lugs mthun gyi phyogs yod na'ang / yang dag pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lam phyogs la ma phyogs par/ kho'i ngos 'dzin rang rig gi tshor b.ragatad par ma zad/ rang rig gi tshor pas phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos kyi tshab byas te mi re'i tshor bas bya dngos kyi rang bzhin thag gcod byed pa'i tha tshig nor 'khrul can bton/ de ltar khong ni sems gtso ring lugs kyi bgrod lam nor 'khrul can la zhugs so// nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos ni tshor pa'i 'byung khungs yin la/ mi'i tshor ba ni phyi rol bya dngos kyis mtshon pa red/ phyi rol gyi bya dngos la 'gul 'gyur gyi phyogs shig yod par ma zad/ da rung 'gyur med dang nges brtan gyi phyogs sheg kyang yod/ de bas na mis da gzod de tshor ba dang de tshur snang byed/ phyi rol gyi bya dngos 'gyur pa dang bstun nas mi'i rang rig gi tshor ba'ang 'gyur ldog byed/ dper na/ dgun dus kyi rlung dbyar kha'i rlung las lhag par grang la/ de ni phyi rol 'jig rten gyi dus tshigs dang drod tshad kyi 'gyur ldog mi'i tshor bas myong pa mtshon pa red/ de las gzhan mi'i tshor pa rang nyid la rang rig gi rang bzhin ldan pas kyang nges brtan min pa dang 'gyur pa che ba'i phyogs shig yod de/ de yang bya dngos gcig mi mi mthun pa la tshor snang mi 'dra ba yod srid pa dang / tha na mi gcig dus mi 'dra ba dang cha rkyen mi 'dra bar brten nas tshor snang mi mthun pa 'byung pa'ang yod/ dper na/ rlung 'dra ba zhig lus phung bde thang can dang lus phung zhen pa gnyis la mtshon na/ mi gcig pu 'gul skyod chen po byed pa'i dus dang cham pas tsha brgyab pa'i dus/ gon pa 'thug po gyon pa'i dus dngasrab bu'i dus kyi tshor snang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/ snga ma ni bsil bde dkā 6/ phyi ma la grang mnar gyi tshor snang 'byung / de lta bas na/ phu ro ṭha sgo

ras bshad pa ltar/ rlung grang mi grang mi re re'i dus mi 'dra ba'i tshor snang gis thag bcad pa yin nam zhe na/ de ni ga la yin/ rgyu mtshan rlung gi drod grang gi tshad la phyi rol yul gyi tshad gzhi zhig yod de/ tshad nges can gyi dus tshod dang khyab khongs la mtshon na tshad gzhi de ni nges brtan yin/ dper na rlung gi drod tshad nga tshos drod grang dpyad chas kyis gzhal thub par ma zad/dus rgyun du yang bskyar tshan rig tshod lta byas nas/ skyes bu nad med cig la tshor bde myong pa'i drod tshad (rlung yang 'du'o//)ni hra hri to'u grangs nyer lnga yas mas su to'u lnga ma brgal ba yin/ de las mtho na drod che ba dang / de las dma' na grang pa'i tshor ba skyes/ der brten deng rabs kyi mkha' rlung snyoms sgrig gi nyer spyad kyis spyir btang de'i khyab khongs su tshad 'dzin nus/der bltas na drod grang ni mi'i rang rig gi tshor ba zhig yin mod/ 'on te de ni phyi rol gyi drod tshad las byung pas/ sngar ltar phyi rol yul gyi tshad gzhi zhig dang 'bral thabs med/ phyi rol gyi bya dngos dus tshod nges can dang / khyab khongasanges can gyi nang nges brtan gyi rang bzhin tsam ni da gzod bya dngos tshod dpog gi tshad gzhi ngo ma yin/ mi'i tshor snang gis ji bzhin de mtshon tsam las 'thus tshab byed mi thub bo//mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin pa'i brjod gzhis tshor pa phyi rol gyi bya dngos la byung bar mi 'dod la/ tshor ba'i phyi rol yul gyi tshad gzhi khas mi len/ mi re'i tshor ba bya dngos gzhal pa'i tshad gzhir byas na nges par du 'di 'dra'i mtha' 'bras 'byung ste/ bdag gis ngo ma dang bzang por 'dod pa zhig khyod kyis rdzun ma dang ngan par 'dod pa dang / da lta bdag gis ngo ma dang bzang por 'dod pa cung 'gyings phyin tshor pa 'gyur nas rdzun ma dang ngan par brtsi ba yod pas/ de ltar 'gal zlar gyur pa'i tshod dpog gang yin kyang tshang ma bden don du 'gyur yang rung la/ mi su yin kyang tshang ma~X /nga

nyid kyi tshor snang la brten nas yin min gzhal na rang shugs kyis thun mong gi bden don khas len mi srid do//de 'dra'i bya dngos dang mi'i tshor ba'i 'gul 'gyur rang bzhin dang ltos bcas rang bzhin la phyogs re 'ud bskyed byas shing / de dag la nges brtan rang bzhin (7tshoṣ+ṭha)dang nges gtan rang bzhin ( tshoṣ+ṭha)yod pa khas mi len pa'i lta ba ni/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang de la ltos bcas rang lugs zer/ khe rā 'e los phyi rol gyi bya dngos kyi 'gul 'gyur gyi phyogs phyogs re 'ud bskyed byas la/ bya dngos kyi 'gyur med dang nges brtan gyi phyogs kyi ltos bcas ring lugs khas ma blangs pa dang / 'on te phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi yin zhes pas/ de nyid mi dang chos rnams kyi 'brel pa'i steng 'phros pa las mi'i ngos 'dzin gyi yul du gnas bsgyur pas/ de ni ngos 'dzin smra ba'i ltos bcas ring lugs yin no// de dag gi mthun sa ni tshang mas phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos kyi gnyug ma'i ngo bo 'khyog bshad byas te/ phyi rol yul gyi bden don khas mi len pa'i sems gtso ring lugs yin no//gal te mi rnams kyis ltos bcas ring lugs kyi lta tshul gzhir bzung nas bya spyod la mdzub ston byas na khungs med bab col gyi mtha' 'bras 'byung nges te/ ngan po/ jag pa/ rkun ma/ rdzun po/ sbag pa gang yin tshang mas 'phrog bcom/ mi gsod/ mgo skor/ rgyan 'jog sogs las bzang por bsgrags rung la der sus kyang the gtogs mi 'os so// rgyu mtshan kho chos bya ba de dag byed skabs kyi rang nyid kyi snang pa ni bzang pas/ de dag tshang ma bden don yin no// de ltar mi rnams kyi thun mong spyod lam gyi tshad gzhi dor pas spyi tshogs 'tsho ba zang zing du 'gyur srid do//68phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i brjod gzhi 'dir sems gtso ring

lugs dang ltos bcas ring lugs kyi nor 'khrul rang bzhin mchis pas/des ni bran bdag dmangs gtso'i lam lugs kyi 'og mi mang po zhig rang mos gangasnrub dang thal che ba'i rang dbang can gyi phyogs su chas par rogs byas shing / bran bdag gi mnga' bsgyur sgrig rim gyi sra brtan la gnod par gyur/der brten phyis nas byung pa'i mtshan nyid mkhan po dper na so khi rā d+dha dang phe lā 'o sogs kyis mtha' gcig tu dgag rgol mdzad/ phu ro ṭha sgo ra rang nyid kyis kyang ltos bcas ring lugs kyi sdug 'bras myong la/ ldog phyogs su chas pa'i tshod dpog gang yin bden don yin na/ 'o na mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhi min zhes pa'ang de mtshungs bden don yin pas/ de ltar na rang nyid kyi 'dod bzhed kyang khas ma blang par gyur to//phu ro ṭha sgo ra nas dar pa'i dpyod ldan pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i dgongs par ltos bcas ring lugs/ rang rig ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs kyi zhan cha ldan la/ de bas na de phyis dpyod ldan pa'i khrod kyi mi la las ched gnyer gyis 'khyog bshad kho nar brten nas dkar nag go ldog dang bden rdzun mnyam bsres byas pas yul skor khram par gyur/ dpyod ldan gyi mtshan snyan nyams dmas su gtong / phyis su kho tshor dgag rgol byed mkhan tshos de dag la 'khyog bshad pa zhes 'bod/ kho tsho'i nus pa'ang bhe li khu le'i dus kyi phu ro ṭha sgo ra dang gtan nas mi 'dra'o//69

sabacadabadun pa/ srog khrimasagacad pa'iphagaphags patshunagawa so khi rāthe/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs lnga ba'i mjug tu/ a then si'i mi tshogs 'du yul du dus rgyun na gzhon mang pos mi dar la bab pa zhig bskor nas 'dug pa mi tshos mthong nges shing / der la las khong la rtsod pa gang thub byed pa dang /la las kha khu sim por khong gi thogs med kyi rtsod gleng la nyan pa dang / na gzhon mang po zhig gi gdong la yid smon byed pa'i nyams 'gyur gsal ler mngon 'dug gal te dar la bab pa'i mi de'i gam du cung bsnyen tshe/ khong ni gzugs thung la sbom pa/ dpral pa byi bo/ mig zung 'bur pa/ gdong stog sna leb/ kha che/ mchu mthug grod pa che ba zhig ste song na 'khyar 'khyor yab yob tu 'gro bas dgod bro ba zhig go/ khong gi byad gzugs de 'dra'i mi sdug pa zhig ste/ tha na la las khong ni ghi ri si'i lha sgrung nang gi mdog nyes hā li si (67lo)()dang bsdur par byed/ khong gi gyon gos kyang lo hril por lu ring rnying ral zhig las mi gyon la/ dgun dus su'ang rkang rjen du yar rgyugs tshur rgyugs byed do// yin na'ang phyi mdog nyes po der gzhan gyis 'gran dka'i blo gros khyad par ba dang ha cang grim pa'i smra brjod kyi yon tan dang ldanastabs/ khong gis gnas bab de'i na gzhon mang po'i dang ba drangs par ma zad/ nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng du yang shu/sdu rkyen gting phyin thebs/

dar bab kyi mi de ni gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i snyan grags ldan pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba so khi rā tshe (smo loṭha)yin te/ khong ni spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 469lor a then si'i lag shes bzo rlos gnyer pa'i khyim zhig tu sku bltams/khong gi yab ni rdo bzo dang yum ni btsa' rogs a ce zhig go/ so khi rā 'e na so chung dus rang gi yab kyi gam nas rdo brkos lag rtsal bslabs shing /bshad rgyun la a then si'i srung mkhar gyi spus dag la mdzes pa'i lha sku la la khong gis bzhengs par bshad/ so khi rā 'e brkos dkrol la byang cha che mod/'on te khong gi phyag rjes gtso bo ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i stong bzhag yod do//pokhi rā 'e khong na gzhon gyi dus ni ghi par g.yul 'thab mjug bsgril nas a then si'i bran bdag dmangs gtso ha cang dar pa'i skabs red/ a then si'i grong khyer nang mkhas pa mang zhing sa cha ga sa gar mi tshogs 'dus nas gtam bshad dang rtsod pa byed pas bsam blo shin tu hur por 'dugaso khi rā 'e ni de 'dra'i dar srol gyi shugs rkyen 'og sngar dpyod ldan par bston nas rtsod thabs kyi rtsal sbyangs/ dpyod ldan pas bton pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gnad don mang pos khong gi blo sgo phye la/ khong nyid mtshan nyid rig par ha cang spro ba skyes/ yin na'ang khong gis dpyod ldan pa'i bzhed tshul gang yin khas mi len/ khong yon tan la sbyang 'dod shugs drag skyes nas mtshan nyid rig pa ba mang po'i gsung rtsom rang sbyong mthil phyin mdzad pas/yon tan phun sum tshogs pa khong du chud de rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo grub/sngar gyi dha le si dang ho rā khu le 'o sogs rang byung mtshan nyid rig pa'i mkhan po dag dang mi 'dra ste/ so khi rā 'e yis mtshan nyid rig pas rang byung khams la dpyad 'jug nges par mi rung / rgyu mtshan rang byung khams kyi yod tshad lhas dmigs yul ldan pa'i sgo nas bskrun bzo dang bkod sgrig byalha zlos/

mis ni lha'i don dag la the gtogs ma rung par bzhed/ yang stobs shugs chen po bton nas chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsar nyams zhib byas pas mi'i bya byed dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi gnad don thag ma chod do zer/ de lta bas na/khongagis ched du mi rnams spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang dus rgyun 'phrad pa'i don mang po ste/ dper na ci zhig ni drang bden dang / gzhung drang / spobs pa/chog shes/ spyod bzang sogs la dpyad bsdur byed la/ khong dang mi mang por gros bsdur dang rtsod pa byed yul gtso bo ni kun spyod kyi gnad don yin no//khong ni nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng ches snga mor mi'i mi chos kunaspyod kyi don mtshan nyid rig pa'i gtso bor smra ba'i mtshan nyid mkhan po zhig go/ der brten mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus mkhan po la las so khi rā 'e yi phyag rjes ni mtshan nyid rig pa lha yul nas mi yul du drangs shing / des 'tsho ba dang kun spyod/ bzang po dang ngan par bsam gzhigs byed du bcug pa red/ ༷ces bstan to//sos rā 'e yis ci'i phyir mi'i mi chos kun spyod kyi gnad don la lhag par mthong chen byas she na/ de ni khong 'tsho bzhugs kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul la rag las yod de/ skabs der a then si'i bran bdag dmangs gtso'i lam lugs ches cher gong du 'phel bzhin pa dang dus mnyam du zhan cha mi nyung pa zhig kyang mngon 'dug ste/ 'bangs mi yongs kyis byang bu 'then nas rgyal khyab bdag skyong byed pa'i 'go dpon bdams bkod byas/ de ni phyi tshul la drang bden lta bur snang yang don dngos su bdams thon byung ba'i mi'i go rtogasag 'dra yin pa shes mi thub pas/ g.yo khram mgo skor la byang pa'i mi ngan la las g.yo sgyu'i sgos mi sems bkug nas rang nyid go sa mthon por sdod pa dang / bya don gtsigs chen gang yin spyi 'bangs tshogs chen nam khrims khar+sha spras gros bsdur brgyud de 'khrun thag gcod dgos pas/ dus rgyun kun

gyi lab brjod mang drags shing bden rdzun gyi dbye ba 'byed mi nus par brten zang zing dang nor 'chugs byung pa dang / bran bdag so so'i bar khe dbang ham gnyer gyis phan tshun phyir bskrad gang thub la zhugs/ bsam blo'i steng mtshon na/ gnas bab der dpyod ldan pa'i phu ro ṭha sgo ra sogs kyis mi ni chos thams cad kyi tshad gzhir bton pa 'dis/ mi re'i rang bdag gi tshor snang ni yin min bzang ngan gyi tshad gzhir 'dod stabs/ a then si'i spyi 'bangs khrod sngar bas so sos rang nyid 'grig par rlom zhing rnam g.yeng bag med kyi thal drags pa'i dmangs gtso'i mthar lhung pa'i grogs su gyur/gnas tshul de dag tshang ma bran bdag gi dbang bsgyur la gnod do// so khi rā 'e dgung lo so brgyad du son pa'i dus (spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 431lo)/ a then si dang si pā dhi mnyam 'brel grong khyer chen po gnyis kyi bar ghi ri sis dbang 'dzin byas pa'i r+pā ro pin ne sā rtsod 'phrog gi g.yul 'thab byung / lo ngo nyi shu lhag 'gor pa'i g.yul 'khrug de'i skabs a then si'i dmangs gtso'i lam lugs kyi zhan cha sngar bas je mngon du gyur/ de ni a then sis pham nyes blangs pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bor song / der so khi rā 'e thugs ma bde bar dgag rgol byas shing / a then si'i mi tshogs 'du ba'i gnas mang por phebs te mi rnams lta tshul bsgyur nas kun spyod bzang po zhig byed cing drang bden dang kun spyod legs pa'i 'tsho ba rol dgos par bskul ma gtong la/ der ma zad rang nyid sdis gang lcogs sgos bran bdag gi dbang bsgyur sgrig srol srung skyob la 'bazlo khi /rā/ tshes phu ro ṭha sgo ra'i mi ni chos rnams kyi tshad gzhir gsungs pa'i dgongs don la mtha' gcig tu dgag sgrub byas la/ khong gis gal te lta tshul des mdzub khrid byas na/ mi tshang mas rang nyid kyi tshor bas gzhi byas pa'i shes yon ni bden pa dang bzang po yin snyam zhing / de ltar gyi /snar

rang lta mkhregs 'dzin gyis mi rnams kyi thun mong gi 'tsho ba'i kun spyod tshad gzhi gtor bshig tu gtong ste spyi tshogs zang zing du byed srid par dgongs so//der brten/ khong gis thog mar mi rnams kyis rang yon mchog 'dzin byed par skyon ston gyi lam nas zhugs shing / skabs de'i snyi ri si'i mi rnams dad mos byed pa'i dhe ar h+phe'i dus pu ro lha khang (ṣ+ṭhapostsolo777lo)gi rtsig ngos kyi legs bshad khyod kyis rang nyid ngos 'dzin par bya zhes pa gzhi byas te/shed shugs yod tshad kyis mi rnams la rang nyid ngos 'dzin bya dgos tshul bslab pa bstan/ 'o na rang nyid ji ltar ngos 'dzin bya zhe na/ khong gis thog mar myong khrid kyi thabs la brten zhing rang nyid kyi steng nas brjod gzhi ngo mtshar pa zhig 'di ltar bzhag ste/ de ni rang nyid kyis ci yang mi shes pa rang gis shes zhes pa'i mtshon cha bkod nas ga sa gar du mi btsal nas gtam gleng byas shing rgol pa re re bzhin tshar bcad pas/ a then si'i na gzhon mang po'i bsnyen bkur thob/ gnas bab der ming la khe li h+phin (ma 'a)zer pa'i na gzhon zhig yod pas so khi rā tsher phyogs gcig nas bsnyen bkur dang yang phyogs cig shos nas dogs pa za bas/ dogs gzhi bsnams nas dhe ar h+pher bzhud cing lha a pu nor 'jig rten stong da rung so khi rā 'e las ches lhag pa'i spyang grung dang blo gros can yod dam zhes dris shing lan gnang pa'i gsol pa btab par/ lha khang gi mchod dpon gyis khong las lhag pa'i blo gros can cig med ces lha'i lung bstan bsgrags/ gnas tshul de kha cig so khi rā tsher dris tsa na/ khong gis thabs mkhas kyis/ lha de'i lung bstan gyi don dngos kyi bstan bya ni mi'i blo gros la rin thang med pa'am yang na gtan nas med ces la/ don dam par lhas ni so khi rā 'e la dmigs pa min te/ bdag gi ming mtshan gzhir bkod pa tsam du zad do// nang don ni ha lam 'di ltar/mi kā/ so khi rā je lta bu'i mi ni/ rang nyid kyi blo gros ji ltar yin pa rtogs

pa ni ngo mas bshad na rin thang ci yang med par smra ba'i mi yin la/ de ni blo gros chen po dang ldan pa'i mi yin no// zhes pa'i don red zer/ khong gis gsung pa ltar/ khong gis sngon chab srid pa dang / snyan ngag pa/ bzo pa sogs mi sna tshogs btsal nas gleng mol byas pas/ de dag la thun mong gi zhan cha zhig yod pa ni/ kho tshos ci zhig la bzang po zer par shes rlom byed kyin 'dug sod don dngos su ci yang rtogs med/ 'o na kho rang nyid ji ltar ram zhe na/ mi shes na shes rlom mi byed do/ 'di'i steng bdag ha lam khong tsho las cung rig pa mtho 'dug go/ de'i don gang zhe na/ khong lta bu rang nyid kyis ci yang mi shes par khas len pa dang / dogs pa skye spobs shing rang nyid kyi shes yon khas mi len pa'i mi ni/ da gzod blo gros dang ldan pa'i mir 'gyur nges zhes pa'o// shin tu gsal ba ltar/ so khi rā tshe'i gsung 'di dag gi mdung rtse bskor yul ni dpyod ldan pa'i shugs rkyen phog cing rang rlom che ba'i mi dag yin la/ de ltar byas pas drungs nas kho tsho rang nyid kyi yon tan la khengs pa'i blo 'bur 'joms bgyis te/ sngar bas so khi rā tshe'i lta tshul tshur bsu ba'i ched do// riso khi rā tshes/ rang nyid kyis ci yang mi shes pa ngas shes zhes par brten nas mi rnams kyi lta ba sel pa'i dus/ khong gis spyad pa'i thabs lam yang grim ste/ de 'dra'i thabs lam gyi nang zur za/ btsa' rogs kyi thabs rtsal/ phyogs bsdus dang mtshan nyid 'jog pa bcas tshan pa bzhi 'dus la/de'i khrod kyi tshan pa dang por (zur za) khyad chos khyad par ba dang ldan te/phyis su nub phyogs su byung pa'i dpe chos kyi ming la so khi rā tshe'i lta'i glan khul byed pa tu)zhes pas ni de mtshon no/ gsham du gtam rgyud de cung tsam bkod na/ a then sir ming yan la skyes pho mdzes po zhes pa'i na gzhon zhig /bye la/

ming la dbyi so tshe mu si zer/ khos dpyod ldan pa'i gzhung mi nyung pa bklags pas/ rang nyid la khyad 'phags kyi yon tan ldan par rlom zhing / sems rtse gcigagis gzhan las go 'phang mtho ba'i chab srid pa chen po zhig byed par khengs rlom shin tu che/ so khi rā 'es de shes rjes de dang gleng mol byas nas de'i 'dod pa bsgyur rgyu'i sems 'khrun bcad/ 'og tu bkod pa 'di ni kho tsho'i bar ci zhig la drang bden zer pa'i thad kyi gleng mol tshan pa zhig ste/so khi rā tshes/ dbyi so tshe mu si lags/ bdag gis thos pa ltar na khyod kyis dpyod ldan gyis mdzad pa'i dpe gzhung mang po nyar tshagasabyas 'dug pas/ de dag ༵ kā ཿ/ /dri bdag skyong gi 'jon thang bslabs tsam las ba srid pa zhig byed 'dod dbyi so ste mu sisar/ yin k+to/ bdakā ha cang de 'dra'i 'jon thang so khi rā tshes/ wa ṅgi kār ma ༵༵ du/gas/ pa'i 'jon thang zhig yin la/ 'on te khyod kyis kāsam blo e tātang / drang bden mi shes pa'i mis de zunga'i 'jon thang dbyi so ste mu sis/ngas // gizlo //ma/ blo btang zin/so khi rā tshes/ 'o na khyod kyis drang bden shes zin nam/dbyi so d+dha mu sis(mkhas rlom gyi ngang /)/ bdag gis bsam na ༵ /rdzu// pa'i drang bden gyi don shes pa zhig so khi rā theg/ khyod kyis ci zhig la drang bden gyi bya spyod zer pa'i don 'jog nus sam/dbyi 'e mu sis(khengs pa'i ngang /)/ los nus/ bdag gis py-i /tā /dro // / bye bden min pa'i bya spyod so trī tā tshes/ red ya 'o na khyod la 'dri rgyu zhig ni sru brid

dbyi so ste mu si//dra/ zlo /// // byer/so khi rā tshes/ 'o na 'phrog bcom gang yin nam/dbyi so d+dha mu sis/ de ni drang bden min pa smra ga la dgos/so khi rā tshes/ gzhan bran du bkol pa gang yin/dbyi so 'e mu sis/ de ni drang bden min pa gong dang 'dra zer/so khi rā 'es(brnan gyis)/ de ltar na bya spyod de dag las gcig kyang drang bden min 'dug gam/dbyi so tshe mu sis/ drang bden ga la yin te/ gal te drang bden yin na khungs med gtam 'chal du 'gyur ro/so khi rā tshes/ gal te dmag dpon zhig gis dpung khrid de nga tsho dgrar lta ba'i rgyal khab cig g.yog tu bkol phyir bzhud na/ de ni drang bden min zhes bshad rung ngam/dbyi so 'e mu sis/ de ga la rung / de ni drang bden gyi bya spyod cig go zer/so khi ra tshes/ gal te khos g.yul 'jug byed dus dgra bor slu brid 'a kyi sgos dgra bo'i nom rdzas 'phrog len dbyi so 'e mu si//sa/ /dro // /lhan/ los yin zer/so khi rā 'es('gal pa bton pa/)/ khyod kyis de sngon slu brid dang /'phrog bcom/ gzhan bran du bkol pa tshang ma drang bden min pa'i bya spyod du khasablangasazin/da rno de dag tshang ma yang ci'i phyir drang bden du dbyi so d+dha mu sizlo/ /// /nyid kyi khasablang la gnod byed 'jug pa shes 'phral myur gyisader tshig gi lhan pa bslan/)de sngon bdag gis bshad pa ni rang nyid kyi mi la yin te/ da ltabashad pa ni dgra bor yin zer/ 77

sokhorā tshes/ de'ang chog da ltang tshosarang nyid kyi mi'i gaspyod chen du gleng na/ gal te dmag dpon zhig dgra bos bskor ba'i skabasarang nyid kyi mnga' 'og gi dmag mi rnamasaspobs pa nyams smad pa mthong 'phral/ sru thabasakyisakho tshor dmag rogasathon bzhin 'dug ces spran te/ dmag mi tsho'i spobasapa /gshing dgra bo pham pa'i bya spyod de gang la dbyi sotshe mu si//zesdus//r+sha r+sha/sagazhigasan de ni drang bden so khi rā tshes/ gal k+ta /khye'u zhig nad thebs shing sman mi btung pa la/ kho'i skyasaphas slu thabasakyisasman btung na zhim tshul bshad pas/ mthar sman 'thung pasand /shā kā sdo/ /yi/ ///'i byisapa bslus pa'ikhya spyod dbyi so tshe mu sis/ bdag gis bsam na de yang drang bden red so khi rā tshes/ // /te mi zhig gis grogs po'i shes pa rang bzhin du mi gnas pa shesarjes/ khosarang srog gcod snyam ste /'i tram̐ brkus pa la/ de 'dra'i bya spyod ni dbyi so 'e mu si//ngasdo /spya /spya ///na los yin zer/so khi rā 'es(gom gang mdun sposakyis 'gal pa sun 'byin byas pa/)/ 'o na khyod kyisasngar dgra bor thug dusaslu brid rkun 'phrog dang bran bkol da gzod drang bden yin par khasablangasazin la/ da lta'i bya spyod 78 'di dag ni rang phyogasakyi mir yin pasaci'i phyir

yang dran bden du 'dod dam/dbyi sotshe mu sis(rang nyid la yon tan med pa khasablangs pa/)/sdu sdokā/ ci ༵ / bye / lhagazhi/sakā /nga nyid kyi lan bro ldan gyi gleng mol tshan pa 'di'i nang so khi rā tshe'i thabs lam zhes pa'i khyad chos cung gsal po zhig mthong nus te/ de'ang khong gis gzhan dang gleng molagyed dus rang nyid ni glen rmongs shig tu brdzus nas mu mthun du phyogs sngar dri ba 'don pa'i tshul gyis de nyid kyi lta tshul shod du bcug pa dang / de nas khong gis phyogs snga'i khas blang la nang 'gal byung par thal bas sun 'byin byas te/ phyogs sngas gnad don de'i thad rang nyid kyis ci yang mi shes par khas len du bcug pa red/ thabs lam 'di 'drar rgol phyi rgol gyis 'gal spangs byas par brten nas rang nyid kyi ngos 'dzin gong 'phel du gtong pa'i nang don ldan stabs/ 'di ni phyis su byung pa'i rtsod sgrub smra ba'i tha snyad kyi 'byung gzhir gyur to//⑪de ltar sun 'byin yang dag la brten nas phyogs lnga'i khas blangs nang 'gal du bstan cing de nyid kyis ci yang mi shes par khas blangs phyin/ rim pa gnyis pa ni so khi rā tshe'i btsa' rogs kyi thabs rtsal zhes 'bod pa red/'di ni phyogs sngas rang gi lta grub dor rjes/ de la rogs byas nas spyi khyab rang bzhin gyi don snying ldan pa'i bsdoms tshig 'jog pa'i thabs shig go/ so khi rā 'es de bden don btsa' bar rogs byed pa'i btsa' rogs kyi thabs rtsal zhes zer/ khong gis bsdoms tshig de dag ni ha lam mngal gyi phru gu bzhin mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i nang grub kyin 'dug pas/ bdag gi 'gan khur ni de la rogs byas nas bde blag ngang btsa' bar bya ba de yin gsungs/khong gis gsung rgyur/ khong gi ma yum ni btsa' rogs bud med cig ni/ la/

khong gi 'di 'dra'i thabs lam ni ma yum gyi btsa' rogs thabs rtsal rgyun 'dzin byas yod/ mi mthun sa ni ma yum gyis bud med kyi phru gu skye len byed pa dang / 'on te khong gis ni skyes pa'i blo gros btsa' rogs byed pa yin te/dper na/ so khi rā tshes dbyi so 'e mu si dang gling mol gzhan zhig byas pa'i rinang rtsod gzhi brtsegs ma mang po zhig brgyud nas mthar khong la so khi rā 'es/lugs srol rung pa'i bya ba sgrub pa dang mi byed pa gang yin drang bden no//zhes bton pa'i bsdoms tshig khas len du bcug 'di'i lugs srol ni bran bdag gi khe phan dang bstun pa'i kun spyod nges srol la bshad 'dug go/so khi rā tshes zur za dang btsa' rogs thabs rtsal bkol ba'i brgyud rim gyis phyogs bsdus dang nges tshig spyod pa'i thabs lam yang mtshon yod/phyogs bsdus zhes pa ni bya dngos bye brag pa mang po las de dag gi thun mong rang bzhin btsal zhing / phyogs bsdus la brten nas thob pa'i go don spyir btang pa ste bya dngos kyi nges don yang ngo // dper na/ drang bden ni lugs srol la rung ba'i bya ba sgrub pa'o zhes pa ste/ lugs srol la rung pa'i bya ba sgrub pa zhes pas drang bden la nges tshig bzhag pa red/ so khi rā tshes thabs lam de dag la brten nas drang bden dang / spobs pa/ chog shes dang spyod mdzes sogs kyi mi chos kyi go don gsal bshad byas la/ dmigs yul ni mi rnamasakyi bsam blo dang bya spyod tshad ldan tshul mthun byas nas bran g.yog spyi tshogs kyi sgrig srol srung skyong byed pa'i ched de/ so khi rā tshe'i sku tshe hril por kun spyod kyi phyogs gtsigs chen gnang zhing de'i ched du mi tshe gtong pas/ mi rnams kyis khong ni gna' bo'i nub phyogs kyi 'phags pa'o zer/yin na'ang / tshe hril por bran bdag gi kun spyod 'ud sgrog byas te bran bdag gi dbang bsgyur srung skyong byed pa'i 'phags pa de ni/ a then si'i bran bkā/ dmangs gtso shog pa'i khrims sa nas srog thog bcad pas/ mthar

rang nyid kyis dug bzhes te btson khang nas 'das/ don rkyen de ni lo ngo nyis stong lhag ring gi khrims gcod dogs gzhi chen po zhig tu gyur pas/ lo rgyus smra ba ches mang po zhig gi dga' po dang rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur/ don 'di brgyud rim ni 'di ltar/so khi rā 'e dgung lo bdun cu ba'i (spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 399lo) skabs der/ a then si'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog byung zhing / g.yul 'thab kyi skabs re zhig dbang mdzad pa'i sku drag shog pa rtsa slog btang nas bran bdag dmangs gtso shog par slar yang srid dbang thob/ so khi rā 'e ni sngar gyi sku drag shog pa dang 'brel 'dug pa dang / de'i steng khong dus rgyun ga sa ga ru mi tshor rtsod pa byas te/ mi rnams kyis rang bdag gi tshor ba yag po'i steng nas bzhag pa'i rang rlom gyi lta grub la dgag pa gnang pas mi mang po zhig mi mos par byas pa'i 'khon 'dzin dang bcas pas/ lo de ga'i zla lnga ba'i nang khong la nyes ming gnyis brjod de khrims la sbyar/ nyes ming dang po ni lhar mi gus pa dang / gnyis pa ni na gzhon ngan bsgyur byas pas/ khong la khrims khang gis srog thog gcod rgyu'i re gtug zhus/ khrims thag gcod 'go bzung dus/ a then si'i grong khyer hril por grags shing / so khi rā tshe'i grogs bshes mang po dang slob bu tshang ma yong nas zur nyan byas/ khong gi slob ma phe lā 'os mdzad pa'i so khi rā tshe'i gtam bshad bcas bkod yod pas/nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng so khi rā tshe'i dgongs pa zhib 'jug byed gzhi'i le tshan ming grags can zhig tu gyur to//khrims thag gcod dus/ so khi rā tshes zhu gtug byed mkhan dang 'dri gcod las rogs tshogs mi lnga brgyar zhal gtad nas thugs lhod bag phebs kyi ngang don dngos kyi sgrub byed bkod de/ zhu gtug mkhan gyis bton pa'i nyes ming gnyis po dag sel nus ldan du mdzad/ der rang nyid la nyesdu sang

de mi 'jug par ma zad/ da rung mi mang po las rig pa che bar bsgrubs/khongagis grogs bshes la khong 'chi bar mi 'jigs mod/ gal srid khong la srog thog bcad na/ ngo 'tsher dgos pa ni khong min te khrims thag gcod mkhan no// zhes gdams/ a then si'i khrims sa'i rgyun srol ltar na/ nyes can gyis khrims thag cung yang mo zhig gcod pa'i re ba zhu chog 'on te so khi rā tshes de ltar gyi re ba gtan nas ma zhus/ khong gi dgongs par de ltar byas na don gyis rang la nyes skyon yod pa khas blangs par bzhed/ khong gis kho'i lusangag gi bya spyod kyi dbang du byas na/ khor khrims nyes mi 'bab par ma zad/ de las byas rjes can dag dang 'dra bar a then si'i spyi spyod gsol khang nas bzhes pa 'dren 'os zhes dag 'bud byas/ khong gi slob bu tshos khor dngul sgor sum cu'i chad pa 'khur rgyu mthun pa 'byung par zhus pa ma zad/de dag kho tshos gtong par khag theg bgyis na'ang / khong gis snang med kyis kho shin tu dbul pas ches mang na dngul sgor gcig las gtong mi nus zer/so khi rā tshe'i de 'dra khengs shing 'gyur med kyi rnam 'gyur gyis 'dri gcod las rogs pa mang por khong khro bslangs/ ches mjug tu brdas thag gcod dus srog thog dgos pa'i 'dzin rtags la 281yod pa dang / mi dgos par 'dod pa'i 'dzin rtags la 220tsam las med stabs/ khong la srog khrims gcod rgyu gtan 'khel byung /spyir srog thog bcad 'phral lag bstar du gtong mod/ skabs der tan tan ṭha le blun dus bzang (5lko/07)yidang 'phrad pas/ a then si pa rnams pho nya'i tshogs pa mngags shing grur zhugs nas the lo si gling phran gyi lha khang du mchod mjal la phyin/ lhar gus pa'i phyir pho nya'i tshogs pa phyir ma bsleb par nyes can srog thog tu gtong mi 'os/ de bas na so khi rā 'e nyin suswā sbyar lhag par gson pa'i skabs byung / dus de dag tu so khi rā tshe'i slob

bu rnams dus rgyun btson khang du lta bar song / kho tshos lta rtog pa brngan gyis nyos nas btson las brgal thabs kyi 'char gzhi 'then yang so khi rā 'es gtan nas ma nyan/ khong gis kho la khrims thag bcad pa drang mo min na'ang brgyud rim ni a then si'i bca' khrims dang bstun pas/ rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims la gtor brlag byed pa las shi na 'gyod pa med zer/ cung ma 'gyang par mchod mjal pa phyir bslebs pas/ btson gnyer pas srog thog gcod par thag bcad de/ so khi rā tshes grogs bshes dang slob bu tsho'i gam nas btson gnyer pas drangs pa'i dug btungs te 'jig rten mi yul las 'das/khong ni gna' po'i snyi ri sir srog thog bcad pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba nyag gcig tu gyur to//

sabacadabargyad pa/ rdul phran gzhung lugs kyi rmang 'ding mkhan/wa warte mo khu re 'o/ston mjug gi nangs snga mo zhig la e chin mtsho'i 'gram gyi bye thang du lo tshod sum cu lhag la slebs pa'i ghi ri si pa zhig dal gyis 'gro bzhin gda'/mtsho rlung gis kho'i gser mdog gi 'jil skra 'dzings su bcug cing mtsho rlabs kyis rkang gnyis brlan yang kho bos ci yang ma tshor ba 'dra/ rgyu mtshan ni kho rang 'dang rgyag cig gi nang du zug 'dug ste/ lo ngo brgya phrag gi yar sngon du snyan grags 'bar ba'i skyes mchog dha le si yis chu ni dngos po thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa yin zhes brjod de/ 'jig rten khams kyi dngos po'i mthar thug gi gsang ba'i mdud pa dgrol 'dod skyes shing / kho'i rjes su rnam dpyod can gyi mtshan nyid pa gang mang gis 'jig rten khams kyi gzhi rtsa'i skor la 'grel ba sna tshogs byas te/ kha cig gis me red ces dang / kha cig gis rlung dang / kha cig gis sa red ces brjod kyang 'dod tshul 'di dag dngos po'i phyi'i rnam pa las brgal ma thub pas/ de dag ji ltar dbyibs dang kha dog mi 'dra ba'i dngos por gyur pa'i 'grel zhig rgyag dka' zhing / der brten nas mi rnams kyi rtsod pa mtshams ma bzhag 'o na/ 'dod tshul 'di dag bskyur nas lam gsar ba zhig btsal te thag gcod byed thub bam snyam/ skabs 'dir rlung chen gyis rlabs shig ded de mdun phyogs kyi pha bong zhig la brgyab cirdo ༵ chen po 'ig grags pa dang lhan sil bur 'thor te/ grangs med kyi

zegs mar gyur cing kho'i lus la 'phyo/ rkyen 'dir brten nas kho'i blo sgo glo bur du phyes byung / 'o/ rnyed byung / mu mtha' bral ba'i rgya mtsho chen po de mtsho rlabs gang mang du dbye chog cing / mtsho rlabs de grangs med kyi chu thigs su dbye chog gal te chu thigs re re rim bzhin dbye nas dbye thabs med pa'i chu rdul la gtugs na ni/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gzhi rtsa ma yin nam/bsam tshul 'dir brten nas kho bos 'od snang mthong bas rang dbang med par dga' spro skyes/ khong gi mdun phyogs kyi mtsho rlabs ldog rjes kyi rdzing bu zhig gi nang du nya phug mang pos rkyal rtsal 'gran bzhin pa mthong nas yang kho'i klad pa'i nang du dri ba gsar ba zhig byung / grangs med kyi chu rdul phra mo'i bar du/ gal te gcig gis gcig la sbyar ba ha cang dam pa'i dbang du btang na nya phug 'di dag ci ltar rkyal zhes 'gro zhor la bsam gzhigs byas/ kho rang mgo sgur nas bltas dus rang gi rkang gnyis bye ma'i nang du zug yod pa mthong zhing / rgyab phyogs su rkang rjes shar gnyis dpar 'dug snang tshul des yang khong gi blo sgo phyes byung / chu rdul yang phal cher bye ma 'di dag dang 'dra zhing /rdul gyi bar du mthong mi thub pa'i stong gseng yod cing nya yis rkyal 'gul byed skabs rdul chung mang po stong gseng gi phyogs su ded pa ste/ dper na/ bye ma rkang 'og nas 'thor 'gro ba ji bzhin no// de'i stabs rdul chung las gzhan da rung stong gseng yang med du mi rung ngo // zhes snyam mo//rta bdun dbang bo dgung la 'phags te dros kha'i dus la nye byung / kho rang pho ba ltogs nas phyir khyim du log cing bran g.yog gis sha dang go re drangs/ khong gis za zhor la mu mthud du bsam blo btang / gal te sha dang go re mu mthud du gtsabs nas gtsabs thabs bral ba'i bar du gtsabs na/ sha dang go re'ang ches rtsa ba'i rdul chung du gyur pa ma yin nam zhes snyam/ khong gis snang tshul mang po zhig la zhib dpyod byas rjes bsam tshul zhig je ga~X du

song / rgya mtsho'i chudang sha go re/ yang na dngos po gzhan te gang yin kyang 'dra/ de dag gi thun mong gi gzhi rtsa phyi'i rnam pa'i thog tu med cing nang gi grub cha'i steng du gnas yod/ dngos po'i phyi'i rnam pa brtol nas nang gi grub char rtog dpyod byas na gzod dngos po thams cad kyi thun mong gi gzhi rtsa shes thub snyam nas kho bas bsam blo gang mang btang mthar/ dngos po'i grub char gyur pa'i ches rtsa ba'i rdul chung de la rdul phran (4 07)zhes ming btags/de'i don ni bgos nas bgo thabs med pa ste/ khong gis kyang rdul chung 'di dag gi bar gyi stong gseng la stong cha zhes btags shing de ni rdul phran 'gul skyod byed sa red/ khong gis 'jig rten khams kyi dngos po thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa ni rdul phran dang stong cha red ces brjod do// 'di ni 'dzam gling gi ches snga mo'i rdul phran smra ba'i rtsa ba'i lta ba yin zhing gsar btod mkhan ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i hāngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba rte mo khu re 'o (ṣ+ṭha mas/kau ṅgi ṭā /re 'o yis gsar btod byas pa'i rdul phran smra ba'i nang don gtso bo ni 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten khams kyi chos thams cad ni rdul phran gyis grub pa dang / rdul phran las gzhan da rung stong cha zhes pa yod/ stong cha ni rdul phran 'gul skyod byed sa yin/ der brten chos thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa ni rdul phran dang stong cha yin/ rdul phran dang stong cha ni ches phra mo zhig yin pas mig gis mthong mi thub mod/ 'on kyang dngos su gnas yod pa red/ rdul phran gyi khyad chos ni phra ba'i mthar thug pa'i cha med cig yin pas bgo gcod bya thabs med/ grangs ku'i thad nas bshad na rdul phran ni tshad med pa zhig yin kyang ngo bo'i thad nas gcig mtshungs yin/ dper na/ gser leb cig gi thoganas brad pa'i gser rdog dang 'dra bar dbyibs dang che chung go rim gyi khya) zlor ma gtogs ngo bo'i khyad par med/ rdul phran ni 'gul skyod byed

bzhin yod/ dbyibs dang che chung mi 'dra ba'i rdul phran sna tshogs stong cha'i khrod du phyogs so sor bar mtshams med pa'i 'gul skyo da byed pa ni/ nga tshos nyi zer phra mo zhig las mthong ba'i rdul phra mo phyogs bcur go rim med par 'gul skyod byed pa dang mtshungs shing de dag 'gul skyod la brten nas gdong thug brgyab ste 'tshub 'khor byas/ 'tshub 'khor la brten nas dbyibs dang che chung / gnas dang go rim mi mtshungs pa'i rdul phran phan tshun 'byar ba dang yang na so sor phyes te/ 'jig rten khams kyi dbyibs dang kha dog tha dad du gyur pa'i dngos po thams cad grub pa red/ dngos po'i khyad par (dper na drod grang / kha dog sgra dang dri'i khyad par lta bu) thams cad ni rdul mi gcig pa'i rkyen red/ dper na kha dog nag po ni zhib tshags med pa'i rdul phran dang dkar po ni 'jam po 'od can gyi rdul phran gyis grub pa lta bu/ rdul phran gyi grub cha 'gyur tshe dngos po'i ngo bo'ang 'gyur srid/ rnye mo khu re 'o yis da rung rdul phran smra ba'i sgo nas dran shes la 'grel brgyab/ khong gi 'dod tshul ni/ mi'i rnam shes ni zhib chogs ldan zhing ril dbyibs can gyi rdul phran rigs shig gis grub cing / de dag sha lus kyi rdul phran dang 'dres nas mi'i tshe srog byung zhing tshor shes dang bsam blo ldan par gyur/ gal te de dag sha lus kyi rdul phran dang bral nas mkha' dbugs su thim tshe/ mi'i tshe srog kyang mjug rdzogs pa red/rte mo khu re 'o'i rdul phran gzhung lugs kyis de sngon dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid pa tshos rdzas kyi phyi'i rnam pa'i thog nas 'jig rten khams la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i zhan cha de khyad du bsad de/ rdzas kyi nang gi sgrig gzhi'i thad nas 'jig rten khams ngos 'dzin byed pa'i lam gsar ba zhig btod cing gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo tshad gsar ba zhig la slebs su bcug gzhung lugs 'ardi /ga

sla mo dang ragasamozhig gam yang na tshan rig dang mi mthun sa/ tshad ldan min sa'angayodamod/ 'on kyang khong gis btod pa'i lam 'dis phyi rabs kyi tshan rig pa rnams la blo sgo phyes/ nye rabs tshan rig pa'i rdul phran rig pa smra ba dang deng rabs kyi rdul phran nus pa'i ngos zin dang bed spyod tshang ma khong gis btod pa'i lam 'di rgyu nas 'phel rgyas byung ngo //rte mo khu re 'o yis kun dang mi mthun pa'i rdul phran gyi gzhung lugs smra thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ kho rang slob sbyong la sdug dus che zhing bsam ga'igs byed par mkhas shing skabs de'i tshan rig shes bya sdud len byas te/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i thog nas phyogs sdom dang mthor 'degs byas pa'i 'bras bu red/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 460yar mar du/ rnye mo khu re khro e chin mtsho'i byang phyogs kyi a bho ta lā grong khyer gyi khyim tshang phyug po zhig tu skyes/ de'i dus su a then si gtso byas pa'i ghi ri si'i grong khyer so so srid 'byor rig gsum yar rgyas byung zhing / rang byung snang tshul la zhib 'jug byed pa'i snga mo'i tshan rig pa skor zhig byung ba dang khong chos yun ring bo'i thon skyed lag len khrod kyi rgyu cha rnams nyar tshags dang phyogs sdom byas te/ rang byung gi ngos zin rim bzhin je zab tu song / dper na/ gnam dpyad kyi phyogs nas zhib cha shin tu che ba'i nyi ma'i li tho bsgrigs shing / sman dang lus khams rig pa'i phyogs nas srog chags dang mi lus kha gshags pa brgyud nas mi lus kyi grub tshul ngos zin pa dang nub phyogs lha rje zhes pa'i sman pa grags can zhis bho khe la byis byung / mtshan nyid rig pa'i phyogs nas dha le si/ he rā khu le 'o/ phar me ni rnye/ gzen no dang phu ro ṭha sgo ra bcas kyi lta ba'i rtsod pa brgyud nas bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa'ang 'phel rgyas gsar ba byung / rnye mo khu re 'o ni gzhon nu'i dus nas slob sbyong la dga' zhing gang thub kyis sngon rabs kyi rig gnas dkā rdon rig gi shes yon sdud len byas/ khong gis rang nyid me tog ldum

ra'i logs kyi khang chung zhig tu bcug nas rtse gcig gis dpe char bltas/nyin zhig khong gi pha rgan gyis mchod nor zhig khrid de khong 'gram du phyin cing yun ring bor langs nas bltas kyang khong gis ci'ang ma tshor bar mgo sgur nas dpe cha lta bzhin 'dug khong gi pha rgan sems bde nas phyir log kho tshang khyim tshang ha cang phyag po zhig yin/ khong gi pha rgan la sa zhing dang shing tog ra ba/ khang khyim ldang sgor mo gang mang yod/ 'on kyang kho rang rgyu nor 'di dag la sems 'khor bzhin med/ khong gi pha rgan tshe las 'das rjes/phu bo gnyis kyis shul bzhag rgyu nor bgo skabs khong la bgos pa ches nyung yang khong gis ci'ang mi snyam/ khong gis shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab kha shas su sngon thon gyi shes rig yod pa thos te rgyu nor tshang ma yul skor gyi phyogs su bkol zhing / lho phyogs kyi i jib la song nas dbyibs rtsis rig pa dang zhing las/chu bed sogs kyi shes byar sbyangs/ shar phyogs kyi par zig dang bha bhe lin nasaganam dpyad dang ar las kyi shes byar sbyangs par ma zad thad kur rgya gar gyi mtha' mtshams la bslebs kyang lam gyi nyen kha'i dbang gis phyir logalo du ma'i yul skor slob sbyong gis kho bo'i mig rgya sngar las bskyed cing shes yonaji cher song nas skabs de'i mthong thos ches che ba'i mkhas gral du tshud/yul skor byas te phyir log dus rgyu nor thams cad tshar zhing dbul rkyang zhig tu gyur pas 'tsho ba'ang phu bo zhig la brten/ 'on kyang kho'i mthong thos rgya che zhing shes yorna la zhib cha ldan pas mi rnams kyi dogs gnad la 'grel rgyag mi thub pa med stabs/ khong gi mtshan snyan myur gyis khyab po//de'i dus su a bho dha lā mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi khrims lugs su 'di 'dra'i thag bcad cig yod de/ su zhig gis pha mes kyis sprad pa'i las rigs 'dzin ma thub par rgyu nor brlag tshar na/ de la phung phug ( 77cha)zer zhing rgyang phud gtong dgos/ shi ba'i tshe'ang pha yul du dur 'jug rdokā mi

rung / rte mo kha re 'or phrag dog byed pa'i mi kha shas kyis khrims 'di gzhir bzung nas khrims khang la gtugs te khong gi snyan grags la gnod byas na 'dod/ khrims khang gis khrims sa 'tshogs nas zhib gcod byed skabs/khong gis 'tshab 'tshub med par rtsod pa byas/ khong na re/ mi 'ga' res bdag gis pha rgan gyi shul bzhag brlag tshar song zhes gtugs/ 'di ni bden pa red/ yin na'ang bdag gis don med du brlag pa ma yin par ches don snying ldan pa'i las don gyi phyogs su bkol spyod byas pa yin/ bdag gis rgyal khab mang bo'i ches rtsa che ba'i shes yon bslab yod cing / de dag legs sgrigacos nas mes rgyal la zhabs 'degs zhus pa yin/ bdag gi shes yon 'di dag 'a cag gi mes rgyal dang mi'i rigs kun la phan par snyam zhes rtsod lan btab/ khong gi gtam de bden dpang byed ched/ khong gis rang nyid kyis 'bri bzhin pa'i 'jig rten chen po'i ma lag ces pa'i ma yig de mi mang khrod nas sgrog 'don byas/ gsung rtsom de'i nang du mtshan nyid rig pa dang /dngos khams rig pa/ gnam dpyad rig pa/ sa khams rig pa/ rtsis rig sogs kyi gnad don mang po gsal bshad byas shing rig gnas kun btus kyi dpe deb cig dang kun nas mtshungs/ khrims dpon dang zur nyan pa tshang ma khong gi rgya che ba'i shes yon dang gting zab pa'i rtsod sgrub kyis yid dbang bkug cing mthar khrims chad mi gcod pa ma zad/ de las ldog ste pha yul du kho la zangs sku zhig bzheng rgyu dang / sgor mo mang po phul nas mu mthud du shes byar zhib 'jug byed du 'jug pa'i gros 'cham byung / kho rang tshe las 'das rjes su da rung gzab rgyas kyi dur 'jug mdzad sgo spel/ gtam rgyud 'dis gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i a bho dha lā grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis shes yon dang mkhas par ha cang brtsi bkur byed par mtshon pa ma zad/ rte mo khu re 'o'i dardoshā gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blor mi rnams kyis

dga' bsu byed pa'ang mtshon thub/rnye mo khu re 'o'i rdul phran gzhung lugs kyis phyi rol rdzas kyi 'jig rten la brten nas 'jig rten khams la gsal bshad byas shing dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs dang / chos lugs rmongs dad la ngo rgol byas pas yar rgyas spyi tshogs stobs shugs kyi rgyab skyor thob na'ang /sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid pa dang chos lugs rmongs dad stobs shugs kyis ngo rgol byas/ khong sku 'das rjes kyi lo ngo bcu phrag lhag gi ring du/gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid pa grags can phe lā 'o yis khong gi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i shugs rkyen sel ched rang nyid kyis 'tshol sdud byas pa'i rnye mo khu re 'o'i gsung rtsom tshang ma me la bsreg na bsams kyang / rjes su mi rnams kyis khong la rte mo khu re 'o'i gsung rtsom snga mo nas khyab pas me yis bsreg mi tshar zhes brjod pa dang / phe lā 'o yis khong khro'i ngang mtshams bzhag don dngos 'di las gna' bo'i ghi ri si yin rung mtshan nyid rig pa'i thad du dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs bar gyi 'gal ba ha cang tshabs che ba mtshon no//gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i rte mo khu re 'o nas da lta'i bar gyi lo ngo nyis stong lhagashi ring la/ mi'i rigs kyis rdzas kyi grub char ngos zin byed pa de dus skabs gsum brgyud yod de/ dus skabs dang po ni rte mo khu re 'o'i rdul phran gzhung lugs yin zhing / nang don gtso bo gong smos bzhin/ dus skabs gnyis pa ni dus rabs 17—19bar gyi nye rabs rdul phran gzhung lugs yin/dus skabs gsum pa ni dus rabs nyi shu ba'i tshun gyi deng rabs gzhi rdul gyi gzhung lugs yin/ rnye mo khu re 'o ni ches snga mo'i rdul phran gzhung lugs kyi srol 'dzugs mkhan yin/ sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid pa'i ngo rgol dang / rjes su yo rob dus rabs bar ma'i chos lugs stobs shugs kyi ༵/ga

'gog bcas kyi dbang gis lo stong lhag la 'gog gnon byas zhing / dus rabs bco lnga dang bcu drug pa'i rjes su nye rabs tshan rig dar 'go tshugs pa dang bstunanas r+bhe mo khu re khro'i rdul phran gzhung lugs la yang bskyar mi rnams kyis mthong chen byas/ tshan rig rmi mang po zhig gis gzhung 'dir brten nas rdzas 'gyur rig pa dang dngos khams rig pa'i tshod lta'i 'bras bu gsar ba thob cing dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rdul phran gzhung lugs la yang bskyar gzi 'od 'phros so//nga chos de ring rdul phran nus pa bed spyod dang gzhi rdul gsar ba ngos 'dzin nam rdzas kyi grub tshul la sngar las zhib 'jug zab mo byed thub pa tshang ma rdul phran gzhung lugs kyi rmang 'ding mkhan rte mo khu re 'o'i mdzad rjes yin pas sus kyang brjid mi rung ngo //92
