pham ste mjug rdzogs/ chab srid kyi thog nas bltas na/ thengs 'di'i 'thab 'khrug ni a then sis gtso byas pa'i bran bdag dmangs gtso'i lam lugs dang si bha ta yis gtso byas pa'i bran bdag sku drag lam lugs bar gyi 'gran rtsod red/ mjug mthar a then si pham nas si bha tas ghi ri si sa cha'i btsan dbang 'phrog rang nyid kyi go gnas brtan ched si bha tas gang sar bran bdag sku drag gi stobs shugs 'dzugs skyong byas te/ a then sir phe lā khro'i a zhang khe lis rnyis yas gtso byas pa'i sku drag sum cu srog shing du gyur pa'i srid dbang btsugs/ 'on kyang mi 'di dag gis mi sems 'gug ma nus te/a then si pa rnams kyis rje ngan sum cu zhes 'bod cing yun ma ring bar rtsa gtor btang ste/ a then sis slar yang dmangs gtso'i lam lugs btsugs/yin na'ang skabs 'di'i bran bdag dmangs gtso shog khag gis yun ring 'thab 'khrug dang yang yang rtsod 'phrog byas stabs/ stobs shugs la ha cang gnod cing bran bdag dmangs gtso'i lam lugs kyis nyams rgud kyi 'go bzung / phe lā 'o'i khyim rgyud dang bran bdag sku drag shog khag bar gyi 'brel dam pa'i khar chung dus nas bran bdag sku drag gi slob gso thob pas chab srid kyi phyogs nas rang shugs kyis bran bdag sku drag lam lugs la kha phyogs shing bran bdag dmangs gtso'i lam lugs la mi 'thad/ na tshod gzhon pa'i phe lā 'os srid kyi phyogs nas lag rjes shig 'jog thub na bsams/ khong gi pha ma gnyis kyis kyang chab srid la 'jug pa'i rtsal zhig sbyang na snyam ste lo nyi shu'i stong kho rang bskyal nas so khi rā tshe'i rjes 'brangs nas slob sbyong byed du bcugaso khi 'e yis a then si 'gul skyod byed skabs su/ bran bdag sku drag mi sna kha shas dang ngo shes su gyur/ phe lā 'o'i phu bo gnyis dang a zhang ni so khi rā ༵ ༵ grogs po dang rjes 'jug yin/ der brten phe lā cho chung dus nas

bsam blo so khi rā che'i phyogs su 'khor/ so khi rā 'es phe lā 'o ni sku drag grags can gyi rgyud pa yin pa shes thog slob bu 'di shes rgya che zhing rig pa rno ba/ slob sbyong la dga' ba bcas kyis ha cang thugs rtsis che zhing / phe lā khro ni rang nyid kyi bsam blo'i rgyun 'dzin pa byas te gso skyong legs po byas/ phe lā 'o'ang rang gi slob dpon la ha cang brtsi bkur che zhing rtse gcig rjes 'brangs te slob sbyong byas/ so khi rā 'e phyi la 'gro skabs phe lā 'o'ang lus dang grib ma bzhin du rjes 'brangs shing so khi ra ste'i drung nas lo ngo brgyad la slob sbyong byas te/dge slob bar du brtse dung zab mo btsugs/ phe lā khro shin tu yid tshims nas na re/ bdag gis lha la sku drin che zhu/ lhas nga rang so khi rā tshe dus rabs dang 'phrad du bcug cing khong gi slob ma byed du bcug ces so// phe lā 'o yis so khi rā tshe'i drung nas rtsal sbyangs te rang nyid kyi chab srid re ba mngon 'gyur byed dus/ a then si'i srid dbang la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ khong gi a zhang gtso byas pa'i rje ngan sum cu mgo mjug bsgyur 'phror so khi rā 'e la khrims chad bcad de bsad/ bya ba 'di gnyis kyis phe lā 'o'i ngar 'go lhod cing srid 'jug gi sems kha bsgyur/ khong gis so khi rā tshe'i bsam blo dang las don gyi rgyud bzung nas mu mthun du mtshan nyid rig pa dang chab srid zung 'brel gyi lam btsal te chab srid lam lugs yid la 'bab pa zhig 'tshol ba'i sems thag bcad de/ kho rang a then si dang gyes shing lo bcu gnyis kyi ring snga gzhug tu khe lin si mtsho 'gag (77glo ṣ+ṭha)gi mad cwa la dang h+phe gling gis jib dang gis la ne+e/ lho'i dbyi tha li dang se se lis sogs su yul skor mdzad/ khong gis sa cha 'di dag gi chab srid dang khrims lugs/ chos lugs sam slob gso'i lam lugs bcas la rtog dpyod zhib mo byas shing sa cha re re'i rtsis rig dang dngos khams/ gnam dpyad/ rol mo sogs kyi shes byar sbyangs pa dang / mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba sna tshogs la zhib 'jug bya/ sang

shesayon dang stobs 'byoraldan pa'i mi skor zhig grogs bshes su bsten no//phe lā cho rang lo bzhi bcu'i steng phyir a then sir log yun ring ma phyin par grogs mchog r+bhes ben gyis gdan drangs te se se lis gling phran gyi se'u la sgo grong khyer la 'tshams 'dri byas/ khong gis grong khyer gyi dbang 'dzin pa me+e o ne khri'u si (74khuṣ+ṭhalo)gdung rabs dang por sku drag chab srid slar gso byed dgos pa'i 'dod blo brjod de sems kha bsgyur 'dod kyang khong rnam gnyis kyi gtam ma mthun/ phe lā chos dmangs gtso'i lam lugs la dma' 'bebs byas pas mgron bdag gi thugs gtses te phal cher gsod rtsis byas/grogs lhas bin gyis ngo chen zhus par brten mi gsad rgyur byas te bran g.yog tu bsgyur nas btsongs/ stabs yag ste grogs shig gis sgor mo mang po btang nas nyos shing phyir a then sir bskyal/pham kha 'di khur rjes/ phe lā tshes so ma ha go byung / chab srid kyi phugs bsam 'grub dgos na nges par du chab srid la mkhas shing mtshan nyid rig pa dang tshan rig kyang shes pa'i mi skor zhig bskyang dgos snyam/ de nas grogs po rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te a then si'i nye 'gram gyi a kha snyam du slob gling zhig btsugs shing ming la a kha rnyem slob gling zhes btags/ tu)slob grwa 'di'i khor yug ha cang mdzes/ slob grwa'i sgo khar dbyibs rtsis rig pa mi shes na nang du 'ong mi chog ces pa'i shing leb cig bkal yod par bltas na slob grwa'i rtsis rig dang bsam gzhigs nus par ha cang mthong chen byed pa shes thub/ slob gling gi khrid gzhi gtso bo rtsis rig dang mtshan nyid rig pa yin zhing zhor du gnam dpyad lo rgyus/ khrims lugs/ rtsom rig dang rol mo sogs kyi shes bya'ang khrid pa red/ de ni yo rob kyi lo rgyus thog dbang sgyur mkhan la ched du mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i slob gling dang po yin zhing / spyi lo sngo/ spya lo ngo 387lor btsugs pa nas bzung spyi lo 529lo'i bar te lo

900lhag la gnas shing yo rob sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo'i 'byung gnas su gyur/phe lā 'o yis slob gling 'di rang nyid mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba dang chab srid phugs bsam dril bsgrags kyi rten gzhi byas te ghi ri si'i grong khyer mang po'i dbang sgyur mkhan la chab srid kyi rkang 'dzin gang mang gso skyong byas/khong gis slob gling nas lo bzhi bcu ste tshe las 'das pa'i bar du bya ba bsgrubs/ 'di'i ring la khong gis phyogs gcig nas dpe khrid byas shing phyogs gcig nas rtsom pa'i las la gzhol te/ rtog bcas smra ba (༅ ṣ+ṭha/skye)khyab bsgrags byed pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gsung rtsom gang mang mdzad pas nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs so//phe lā 'o'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i srog shing ni rtog bcas smra ba yin/ 'o na rtog bcas smra ba ni ci zhig red zer na/ khyed kyis nub phyogs rgyal khab cig gi slob 'bring slob ma zhig dang dge rgan gyi kha brda tshan pa zhig la ltos/slob ma na re/ dge rgan lags/ khyed kyis nyin 'ga'i sngon du phe lā khro'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo'i snying bo ni rtog bcas smra ba red ces gsungs kyang bdag gis da rung ha mi go der brten khyed kyis go snaba'i 'grel zhig brgyab na chog gam/ dge rgan na re/ de ni dka' mo zhig red/ ngas gsal zhib zhig bshad e thub blta//rdo rnyi dri'i shārnyi sna ṭā // zlo//ma po mtshar zhing sdug pa zhig btogs nas)khyod /sna // / re/ /ma/sna /kyang nyin 'ga'i rjes su 'dab ma rnams lhung zhing kha dog nyams te slo sgog kā gci/ pur sbyog dus/ khyed kyis da rung mdzes zhes brjod thub bam/(dī / / der/ sge'u shāX phyi r+sha/sa bu mo zhig bzhud song /)dge gon na re/ (bu mo bstan nas)ltos/ kho mo ni mdzes sdug ldan pa'i gzho/ lto ma

zhig red/ yin kyang lo bcu phrag 'ga'i rjes su skra dkar bzhin gnyer can gyi rgan mo zhig tu 'gyur srid/ khyod kyis da rung de mdzesazhes brjod thub bam//lha sna / / re/ /ga sdus zlo /sa pa la/slob ma na re/ de la 'gyur ldog byung nas sngar gyi mdzes sdug nyams pa'i phyir zer/dge rgan na re/ 'grig song / dpe 'di gnyis las bstan don/ dngos po bye brag pa zhig yin phyin/ dper na me tog dang bu mo'i mdzes pa bzhin thams cad ni 'phral tsam ste 'gyur ldog 'byung srid pas mi rtag pa red/slob ma na re/ 'o na/ 'jig rten du rtag brtan 'gyur med kyi mdzes pa yod dam zhes dge pa/ /na re/ yod/ de ni phe lā 'os bshad pa'i mdzes sdug rang nyid yin zhing der mdzes sdug gi rtog bcas kyang zer zhes la/slob ma na re/ 'o na rtog bcas zer ba 'di ci zhig red ces par/dge rgan na re/ de ni phe lā 'o'i gsar btod red/ rtog bcas la khong gis (1 74)zer/ de ci zhig red ce na/ khong gis 'di ltar 'grel yod de/ nga tshos dngos po bye brag pa'am rang mtshan pa gang mang zhig la ming zhig btags tshe/ de dag la spyi'i mtshan zhig yod de/ dper na cog tse gru bzhi ma dang cog tse gor gor/ cog tse ring mo ltabu ste 'jig rten khams su dbyibs sna tshogs dang cog tse bye brag pa mang po yod kyang / nga tshos cog tse zhes pa'i ming gcig gis bsdus na/ chog tse zhes pa'i ming 'di rtog bcas yin/slob ma na re/ 'o na/ cog tse lasagazhan pa'i bye brag gi dngos po ste dper na/ rdo 'di dang sdong bo 'di/ khang pa 'di la sogasapa kun la rtog bcas zhig yod dam/dge rgan na re/ yod de/ phe lā 'os dngos po mtha' dag la rang nyid kyi rtog bcas yod ces bshad/ cog tse la cog tse'i rtog bcas yod/ rdo la rdo'i rtog bcas yod cing / sdong bo dang khang pa la yang de ltar ro/slob bsdu na re/ dngosapo rang mtshan pa 'di dag dang 'di'i rtog bcas ni don gcig ma

dge ni/ / trī zhes mapa /na/ te/ gnyis ka mi gcig 'di la ches nyung na'ang mi gcig saganyisayod/ thog mar/ bye brag gi dngosapo thamasacad la skye 'jig yod cing /de dag gi rtog bcas la skye 'jig dang 'gyur ldog med/ dper na/ sngar gyi cog tse de chag srid cing sdong bo de skam par 'gyur bas/ de dag la 'gyur ldog yod cing yod pa nas med par 'gyur/ cog tse dang rdo/ sdong bo/ khang pa bcasakyi sdig bcas ni chag 'jig med pa'i rtag pa zhig yin pas/ dngos su gnas pa zhig slob ma sna/ re/ gnyisapa ni ci zhig yin/dge rgan na re/ de'i 'phanas nga tshosade dag ngos 'dzin byed tshul mi gcig bye brag gidangosapo nga tshosadabang shesal brten nas ngos 'dzin byed thub ste/ dper na cog tse 'di rdo 'di sdong bo 'di ltabu nga tshosamathong thub cing reg thub pa bzhin/phelta thosadabang shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i dngos po mtha' dag la mthong rung 'jig rten zhes brjod pa yin/bye brag gi dngos po mtha' dag la 'gyur ldog 'byungasred cing 'jig srid pas/ nga tshosamathongarung 'jig rten la ngosa'adzin byas pa de gtad med cig ste/ shes bya ngo momin/ 'on kyang / rtog bcas ni nga tshos mthong mithub reg mi nusashing dbang shesal brten nas shes thabs med pas/ sems (blo)kho nar brten nasangos 'dzin byed thub pa zhig ste/ ngos zin 'di ni gzod rtag brtan 'gyur med dang gtad yod kyi shes bya yin/ khong gisartog bcasakyisagrub pa'i 'jig rten la shes thub pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes dang rtog bcasakyi 'jig rten khams kyang zer/slob ma na re/ de ltan 'jig rten khams gnyisam yin nam zhesapar/dge gon na re/ red/ phe lā khros nga tsho'i mdun du gtan nasami 'dra ba'i 'jig rten gyi khamasaganyis yod cesabashad/ gcig ni dbang shes kyi spyod yuladu gyur pa'i bye bragagi dngos pos grub pa'i mthong thub pa'i 'jig rten gyi khamasadang / gzhan gcig ni semasadang blo'ispyod yul du gyur pa'i rtog bcasagyisagrub pa'i she~Xthub

slob pa/ ༈/ga // gyi ldim dhiswā bye pa/ // 'brel ba ci zhig yod dam zhesadris par/dge rgan na re/ shesathub pa'i 'jig rten khrod kyi rtog bcas dang mthong thub pa'i 'jig rten khrod kyi chos bye brag pa gnyis las rtog bcas chesagal che zhing rtsa ba yin/rgyu mtshan ni rtog bcas kho na gtad yod dang dngosapo thamasacad kyi gzhi rtsa yin/der brten/ sdun la rtog bcas dang de nasachos bye brag pa yod pa yin zhing chosabyebrag pa ni rtog bcas la rag las yod/ phe lā chos rtog bcas ni bye brag gi dngosapo'i ma dbyibasayin/ bye brag pa'i dngos po ni rtog bcas kyi lad mo yin/zhesadang / yang khos dpe bzhag bshad par/ shing bzo zhig gis cog tse bzo skabs sude'i sems (klad pa)nang du sngon la cog tse yi rtog bcas zhig yod pa de ma dbyibasabyasate cog tse bzos pa yin pas/ cog tshe'i rtog bcas kyi lan mo tsam yin zhi( shir+sha ba/sa cog tse re re'i steng du khong gi klad pa'i nang gi cog tse'i rtog slob ༵ rdo kā cha de/ nad/mi'i klad pa'i nang gi rtog bcasate/ dper na shing bzo'i klad pa'i nang gi cog tse'i rtog bcas de gang nas 'ongs zer/dge rgan na re/ khyod kyi dri ba 'di gal chen red/ mi mang pos drisamyong / phe lā 'o'i tshig lan ni/ spyir mi thams cad la ji srid bar du mi 'chi zhing mtshams med par skye ba len pa'i rnam shes yod/ rnam shes 'di rtog bcasakyi khams su gnas shing snga mo nas rtog bcasakyi bag chagasaldan 'dug 'on kyang / rnam shes mngal du zhugasaskabs lusakyi brtse dung dang 'dod chags sogs kyi dri mas sgrib ste sngar gyi rtog bcas kyi bag chags bag tu zha bar gyur/ de dag slar yang gsar du rgyud la 'byor ched slob sbyong la brten nasasngar gyi rtog bcasakyi bag chags phyir dran bya dgos byung / dper na nga tsho 'drisache ba'i grogs dang gyesanas yun ring 'gor rjes/ de'i sngar gyi rgyan chas sogs mthong tshe grogs po de'i snang brnyan phyir dran byed thub pa lta bu'o/ zhes dang / der brten phe lā 'os slob sbyong ni phyir dran red 1hā// 'di ni khong gis so khi rā tshe'i bsam blo'i btsa' rogs thabs rtsal 'dzin

spel byas te phyir dran smra ba bton pa yin la/ khong gisaming du gragasapa'i bshad tshulader brten nasami'i klad pa'i nang gi rtog bcasakyi 'byung khungasalagasalabashaḥ bya/ shing / khong gi rtog bcas smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i grub cha gal chen slob ṭ+wāṃ r+sha ren /sa khyed la da rung 'dri rgyu zhig yod/ rtog bcas ni ji ltar byung ngam/dge gosna sdo ṭ+wā// rtog bcas la mtho dma' mi 'dra ba'i rim pa 'ga' phyesate go rim ldan pa'i ma lag cig grub yod la/ chesadama' ba ni chos bye brag pa'i rtog bcasate/ dper na/ cog tse/ mal khri dang rdo ltabu'o/ cung mtho ba ni/ dper na gru bzhi/ zlum po/ hril grangs/ ldab grangs/ 'gul skyod dang snying 'jags sogasartsis rig dang tshan rig gi rtog bcas sogs te/ de las mtho ba ni/ drang gzhagadapa' ba/ tshod 'dzin/ mdzes sdug sogs kun spyod dang sgyu rtsal gyi rtog bcasasogasayin zhing / rtog bcas 'di dag gi bla na gnas pa'i ches mtho ba'i rtog bcas ni dge ba yin/ zhes dang / yang khong gis bshad par/ dge ba zhesapa'i rtog bcas ni/ shesabya dang bden don thams cad kyi khungs yin zhing bla na med pa'i rtog bcas yin te/ dgung gi nyi ma dang mtshungs/ rtog bcas gzhan dag tshang ma dge ba'i 'od zer 'og tu go rim ldan pa'i rtog bcas kyi 'jig rten khamasashig tu gyur/ dge ba'i rtog bcas ni lha yisabaskrun/ thogs pa med pa'i lhas rtog bcasakyi 'jig rten khams las rtog bcas mi'i rnam shesasu 'jug pa dang rnam shes sha lus su bcug ste mi dang 'jig rten yongs rdzogs bskrun thub/slob ma na re/ e ma/ rtog bcas smra ba'i nang don ngo ma mi nyung ang / dge rgan lags/khyed kyis phran la mdor bsdu sla mo zhig byed thub bam/ zhes par/dge gon na re/ lo4chog mdor na/ lha yis bsgrun pa'i dge ba rtsa bar gyur pa'i rtog bcas kyi khams suganasapa'i rtog bcas ni rtag pa dang phun sum tshogasapa zhig yin la/ mngon sum gyi khams sus/nas pa'i chos bye brag pa thams cad 'phral yun tsam dang phun sum tshogs pa zhig ma yin pas/ rtog bcas ni bye /sdu 1pa'i

gzhi'amayodabyibasayinazhing / rtog bcas sngun ma dang chosabye brag pa rjesam yin/sem kyisartog bcas la ngosazin byed pa de ni gtad yod kyi shesabya yin gyi bye brag pa'i dngosapo lasaskyesapa'i tshor shesani gtad med kyi bsam 'char yin/rtog bcasakyi bag chags ni lhan skyesashig yin kyang / mi rnamasamangal lasaskyesarjes brjed song ba dang / phyir dran brgyud nas slar gsar du 'thob dgos/'didag ni phe lha chos gsungs pa'i rtog bcas smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang don gtso bo yin no//gong gi gleng sol 'di las/ nga tshos phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas smra ba de don dngos su mgo mjug bsgyur pa'i 'jig rten lta ba zhig yin pa shes thub/ khong gis 'jin rten la ngos 'dzin dang gsal bshad byed skabs mgo mjug bsgyur pa'i nor 'phyug gnyis byung ngo //thog mar phe lā chos phyi rol yul gyi dngos po dang blo ngo'i don spyi gnyis 'brel ba mgo mjug bsgyur pa ste/ khong gis bshad pa'i dngos po'i rtog bcas de/ don dngos su dngos po'i don spyi ( ṣ+ṭha)red/ dngos po bye brag pa dang spyi mtshan gyi 'brel ba der mtshan nyid rig pa'i ming zhig sbyar na/spyi dang bye brag gam khyab bya dang khyab byed kyi 'brel ba la zer/ 'di'i 'brel ba'i go rim ni/ spyir 'di ltar yin dgos te/ sngon la bye brag gi chos yod pa dang / de nas rigs mthun dngos po mang po'i nang nas spyi mthun gyi chos shig phyung ba der don spyi (rtog bcas)zer/ spyi mthun gyi chos de bye brag gi nang du gnas shing bye brag la brten nas snang ba red/ gal te bye brag gi chos re re dang kha phral tshe de dag gi spyi mthun rang bzhin yang gnas mi thub/dperan/ ku shu zhes pa'i don spyi 'di bye brag gi ku shu re re'i nang nas spyi mthun gyi chos bsdus te grub pa yin/ nga tshos ku shu zhes pa'i don spyi 'di brdotā sprabs/ ku shu re re la ku shu'i spyi mthun gyi ngo bo ldan pa mtshon/ der

brten bye brag gi chos re re dang de mtshon pa'i don spyi la khyad par yod par ma zad phan tshun 'brel dam zhing so sor 'byed thabs med/ gal te de gnyis btsan gyis so sor phral na gnyis ka gnas mi thub/ gal srid khyod rang shing tog gi tshong khang zhig tu song nas ku shu nyo tshe/ bye brag gi ku shu re re ma yin pa'i ku shu zhig khyod kyis nam yang nyo mi thub/ phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas smra ba'i nang du bye brag gi chos dang de dag don spyi'i 'byed thabs med pa'i 'brel ba so sor bkar par ma zad/ dngos po'i don spyi de bye brag gi dngos po'i sngun du khor rkyang du gnas shing bye brag gi dngos po'i ma dbyibs sam gzhi rtsar 'dod/ 'di ltar byas tshe/ bye brag dang spyi'i 'brel ba mgo mjug bsgyur te/sdun la blo dang rjes su dngos po yod pa'am dngos po blo la rag las zhes bshad pa red/ blo'i yul du gyur pa'i don spyi de/ bye brag gi dngos por ma brten par gnas pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi gzhi rtsar 'dod pa'i lta ba de ni phyi don sems gtso'i ring lugs pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul gyi dpe mtshon zhig yin/ de'i 'phro nas/ phe lā chos mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin dang rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin gyi 'brel ba go zlog yod de/ khong gis bzhed pa'i sems (blo)la brten nas shes thub pa'i rtog bcas kyi shes yon zhes pa de ni/ don dngos su rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin las ma 'das la/ tshor ba la brten nas byung ba'i bsam 'char zhes pa de ni/ don gyis mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin gyi don yin te/ mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin dang rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin gyi go rim ni/ spyir 'di ltar yin te/ mi'i dbang bor brten nas dbang bo'i yul las skyes pa'i mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin de rim gyis rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin gyi tshad du slebs pa red/ rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin ni mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin las byung zhing slar yang mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin la mdzub ston byas pa red/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byis pa zhig gis me rtsed byed skabs bsregastu /sa

tsha snang byung rjes/ me yis bsreg na tsha ba'i ngos zin skye zhing rjes su me mthong tshe sems chung byed pa ji bzhin ('jig rten gyi dngos po grangs med la/ re re bzhin rang gi mngon gyem tshor shes la brten nas rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin du 'gyur dgos pa'i nges pa med/) phe lā khro'i phyir dran smra ba las/ mi'i rtog bcas kyi shes yon de rnam shes kyi nang du gdod ma nas yod par 'dod cing /tshor ba de rtog bcas kyi shes yon phyir dran byed pa'i lag thabs shig tu 'dod/rjes dpag gi shes yon tshor ba'i nyams myong las byung ba khas mi len zhing /rjes dpag gi shes yon mi la lhan skyes su grub par 'dod pa 'di la/ mtshan nyid pa'i nang du sngon rtogs smra ba ( mi3)zer/ phe lā 'o ni nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus thog tu/ rgyud rim ldan pa'i phyi don sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi sngon rtogs smra ba'i mtshan nyid pa dang po yin/ phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ni go zlog pa'i 'jig rten lta ba zhig yin zhing / spyi'i cha nas bshad na nor 'phyug can zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang der mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'phel rgyas khrod du don snying dang nus pa gal chen ldan/rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin de mngon sum gyi ngos 'dzin las thon pa zhig yin kyang / mi'i rigs kyis 'jig rten ngos 'dzin dang sgyur bkod byed pa'i bya 'gul mtha' dag rjes dpag gi mdzub ston dang 'bral thabs med/ rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin med na/ mi'i rigs dud 'gro'i tshad las ma 'das pas rang gi tshor shes dang lhan skyes kyi nus pa la brten nas 'gul skyod byed tsam du zad/ don spyi med na/ tshan rig dang mtshan nyid rig pa yod mi srid cing tha na phan tshun bsam blo brje res dang gleng mol yang byed mi thub/ phe lā chos so khi rā 'e yis phu ro ṭha sgo ras tshor shes kyi nus par 'ud brjod dang / ngos zin de mngon sum gyi dus skabs su gnas pa'i rang rig sems gtso'i ring lu/sdu ༵ nor 'phyug la ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyun bzung nas/ rjes dpag ngos

'dzin gyi gal chen rang bzhin nan gyis bstan pa der don snying ldan yang /khong gis bshad nyes byas te/ rjes dpag gi rtog bcas de dngos po thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa bar 'dod pas yang phyi don sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi 'dam du zug khong gis bye brag dang spyi'i 'brel ba thag gcod yang dag pa zhig byed ma thub rung / khong gis bton pa'i gnad don 'dis rjes su byung ba'i mtshan nyid smra ba rnams te/ khong gi slob ma a ri si 'o 'e dang bcas pas jom gang mdun spos kyis don der zhib 'jug dang thag gcod byed par cha rkyen bskrun to//

sabacadabacur/ gna'apha'i sgori si'i chesajobs cheri'irisam blolda/(sto tā trī/ rdo 'e/ cispyi lo dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dbyi tha li'i rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi skabs su/ ri mo ba chen po lā jur gyis a then si slob gling zhes pa'i grags snyan 'bar ba'i ri mo zhig bris/ ri mo 'di'i a then si'i snyan grags che ba'i slob gling gis kha byang byas te nub phyogs rig gnas kyi yang rtser gyur pa'i mi sna lnga bcu lhag gi sku brnyan bris yod cing / de dag gi khrod du la la ni bsam gzhigs kyi tshul 'dzin cing la las rig gzhung gleng mol bya bzhin mchis/de'i nang nas ches mig dbang 'phrog pa ni ri mo'i dbus su skar tshogs dbus kyi zla ba ltar gnas pa'i mi sna gnyis te/ g.yon phyogs su bris pa'i rgan po sma ra dkar po can ni phe lā 'o yin/ khong gi g.yon lag mar la dpyangs shing g.yas lag yar bkyags nas steng phyogs bstan 'dug pa des mi rnams la dngos yod kyi steng na mtho ba'i rtog bcas kyi 'jig rten khams de yid la zungs shig ces brjod pa dang mtshungs/ khong gi g.yas phyogs su dngos slob a ri si 'o d+dha yod cing / de'i g.yon lag gis dpe deb mthug cing che ba zhig bsnams pas/ kho rang mkhas chen yin pa mtshon/ khong gis lag g.yas pa mdun phyogs su bsrings shing lag mthil mar la 'khor 'dug 'dis dngos yod kyi 'jig rten khams kho na gzod zhib 'jug gi yul yin zhes gsal 106

bshad byed pa dang 'dra/ khong gis dge rgan la gdong phyogs nas rtsod pa byed cing / khong rnam gnyis dpung bshibs te ltad mo ba'i phyogs su gom kha bsgyur/nyams dang lag brda mi 'dra ba 'di gnyis las/ yo rab gling gi ches shugs rkyen che ba'i gna' bo'i mtshan nyid smra ba rnam gnyis kyi lta ba mi mthun pa mtshon yod/ 'di ni gson nyams ldan pa'i ri mo zhig yin pas mi rnams la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs so//lā char gyis mi sna 'di gnyis ri mo'i dkyil la bshibs nas bkod par mtshon don zab mo yod de/ phe lā 'o'i slob ma mang po'i nang nas a ri si 'o 'e ni ches phul du byung ba zhig yin zhing / khong gi tshan rig dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i thad kyi mdzad rjes tshang ma dge rgan gyi yan la shor/ der brten/ mar khe sis khong la mna' bo'i ches rlabs chen gyi bsam blo ba zhes dang / yin snyi sis gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid smra ba'i nang gi ches shes yon ldan pa'i mi sna zhes brjod pa red/ phe lā 'o dgung lo drug cu bzhes skabs (spyi lo'i sngon 367lo) der/ a kha lham slob gling du gzhon nu pho sgo can zhig 'ongs/khong ni thag ring e chin mtsho'i byang 'gram gyi si tha cis la grong khyer nas a then sir ched du bslab gnyer byed par 'ongs/ khong gi mtshan la a ri si sto 'e zer zhing dgung lo bcu bdun yin/ pha'i ming la ne+e khi mā khe zer zhing ghi ri si'i byang phyogs kyi ma khe ḍo ni lnga'i rgyal po a men tha'i lha rje red/ khyim tshang gi shugs rkyen la brten/ kho rang chung dus nas rang byung gi shes bya la dga' zhing khyad par du skye dngos rig par dga'/ rjes su kho'i pha ma gnyis tshe las 'das pas gnyen nye zhig gis bskyangs/ kho rang phe lā 'o'i snyan grags kyis bkug nas ched du dge rgan la bsten par 'ongs pa red/ phe lā 'os kho rang rig pa rno zhing shes yon sbyong 'dod che ba'i khar khyim chen gyi rgyud yin pa bcas la dmigs nas slob gling du zhugs su bcug 107

dang thog mi rnams kyis sa gzhan gyi kha skad 'dres pa'i gzhon nu 'dir mnyam 'jog mi byed mod/ 'on kyang yun ring ma 'gor bar mi rnams kyis kho rang bsam gzhigs dang rtog dpyod la mkhas shing sdug rus che ba shes la/khor shes yon mang po 'byor bas yun mi ring bar mi gzhan pa rnams kyi sngun la shor nas slob gling gi yang rtser gyur/ a ri si 'o 'es ci nus kyis phe lā 'o'i drung nas bslab gnyer byas/ yin na'ang kho rang la kher rkyang gis bsam blo gtong ba'i yon tan mnga' bas dge rgan gyi zer sgros mi 'brang / khong gis phe lā 'o'i lta bar dogs 'dri byed phod cing dge rgan dang slob ma rnams la rtsod pa byed/ phe lā 'o slob ma 'dir shes yon ldan pas ha cang dga' na'ang /de'i kher rkyang gi bsam pa der mi 'thad pas/ khong gis phyogs gcig nas a ri si 'o tshe ni slob gling gi yang rtse red ces bstod bsngags byed pa dang /phyogs gcig nas 'khang ra byas te/ khong ni rte'u u tshugs shig dang mtshungs/btsas nas yun ring ma song bar rang gi ma la 'phra rgyag pas mgo la mthur bskon /gos zhes bshad/ a ri si khro 'e ni phe la khro'i sems kyi 'gal ba zhig tu gyur a ri// si khyo 'e dgung lo bcu bdun nas so bdun bar a kha snyam slob gling nas lo ngo nyi shur bzhugs shing / de'i ring la khong gis gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i shog khag so so'i mtshan nyid smra ba rnams kyi gsung rtsom la nan tan gyis gzigs shing / mi chos rig pa/ chab srid rig pa/ tshig rgyan rig pa/ rtsod pa'i rtsal dang skye dngos rig pa/ dngos khams rig pa/ gnam dpyad rig pa sogs rang byung tshan rig la zhib 'jug mdzad/ bslab gnyer mjug rdzogs rjes mu mthud du slob gling du bzhugs te/ phe lā 'or rogs byas nas slob khrid kyi las la zhugs shing mu mthun du rig gzhung zhib 'jug la gzhol/ slob glid ༵ slob sbyong sga khor yug bzang po dang khong bi lhod med kyi sdug rus 'a

brten nas khor mtshan nyid rig pa dang tshan rig shes bya'i rmang gzhi brtan po bzhag de nas bzung kho'i mkhas mdzangs kyi snyan grags rim gyis khyab po//'di'i skabs su ghi ri si'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog chen po byung / sto lo pin ne+e sa 'thab 'khrug gi rjes su ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer so so'i stobs shugs nyams shing bran g.yog dang 'og rim mi ser gyis bran bdag la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod gcig 'jags gcig langs su gyur/ mnyam 'brel grong khyer so so'i bar dang mnyam 'brel grong khyer nang khul gyi chab srid shog khag so so'i bar gyi 'gal ba tshabs chen du gyur cing / ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi lam lugs nyams dmas su song / 'di skabs su/ ghi ri si'i byang phyogs kyi ma khe ḍo ni yā ni spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi ba'i 'gor bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal po'i rgyal khab tu gyur cing lha ri si'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer mang po dang 'brel zhing de'i rig gnas bslabs/ rgyal po h+phi lis gdung rabs gnyis pa'i (4khri747)dus su/ bsgyur bcos rabs dang rim pa byas mthar/ ma khe ḍo ni yā dmag don gyi rgyal khab stobs ldan zhig tu gyur cing ghi ri si'i byang phyogs kyi sa le si'i 'gram rgyud btsan bzung byas te ghi ri si yongs rdzogs la dbang sgyur ba'i gra sgrig byas/ stobs ldan gyi ma khe ḍo ni lngas 'jigs skul 'og tu ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer so sor ma khe ḍo ni yā la 'khor ba dang ngo rgol byed pa'i khag gnyis byung / bran bdag chen po 'ga' res ma khe ḍo ni yu'i dmag shugs la brten nas bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dbang sgyur thad byung ba'i nyen kha sel te ngo rgol gyi stobs shugs 'go mnan na 'dod/ khag gzhan pas sngar gyi mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi lam lugs la srung skyob byas te ma khe 'o ni lngas rgya bskyed par ngo rgol byas na bsam/spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 338lor/ h+phi lis gdung rabs gnyis pas drag shugs kyis ma khe ḍo ni yā la ngo rgol byed pa'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung phaspya snar

btang zhing snyi ri si'i sa khul yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur te/ a then si dang bcas pa'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer so so ma khe ḍo ni yur kha phyogs pa'i shog khag gis srid dbang bzung ste ma khe ḍo ni lnga'i zur gtogs rgyal khab tu gyur cing / mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi lam lugs de ming tsam du song ngo //phe lā 'o'i tshe smad du/ khong gis a ri si khro 'e dang khong rnam gnyis kyi lta ba ha cang mi mthun pas rang gi las don rgyun 'dzin bya mi thub snyam nas/ a kha rtem slob gling de rang gi tsha bo si pho se stor sprod pa'i thag bcad/ phe lā 'o tshe las 'das rjes a ri si 'o 'e zur du phud/ kho rang ya zhi ya chung ba'i a so si sa khul du song nas slob khrid byas/ sa de'i a ṭha ne si mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi dbang 'dzin pa har me ya ni a ri si 'o 'e'i slob grogs yin zhing khong gi shes yon la ha cang yid smon byed pas rang gi tsha mo khong la chung mar byin thog kho rang h+phi lis gdung rabs gnyis par ngo sprod byas/ rgyal po h+phi lis kyis sngar nas khong gi snyan grags thos yod pas rgyal sras kyi dge rgan byed dgos zhes bshad/ spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 343lor/ h+phi lis gdung rabs gnyis pas a ri si 'o 'e la gdeng 'jog ches mtho ba'i gdan zhu'i yi ge bskur/ skur yig gi nang don 'di lta ste/ bdag la bu zhig yod/ bdag gis lha yis bu zhig gnang bar sku drin che zhu/ yin kyang lha yis kho rang khyed kyi dus skabs su skyer bcug par/ bdag gis de bas sku drin che zhu/ khyed kyi thugs khur dang shes rab la brten nas kho rang bdag dang mnyam zhing khos ma 'ong ba'i rgyal khab 'bras med du mi gtong ba zhig tu 'gyur bar bdag gis re bcos yod ces par/ a ri si 'o 'e gdan zhus ltar phe la grong khyer gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin nas dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i rgyal sras a leg gzen rti (༅777)yi dge rgan gnang /11/nga gi slob ma 'di ni 'dzam gling gna' bo'i lo rgyus thog gi btsan drag

che ba'i rgyal bo chen po a leg gzin rti yin zhing khong gis drag shugs kyis yo rob gling dang / e sha ya'i gling / h+phe gling bcas 'phred du bcad pa'i rgyal khab chen po btsugs/ dge slob 'di gnyis las gcig ni gna' bo'i ches shes yon ldan pa'i mtshan nyid smra ba chen po dang / gcig ni dmag don gyi mdzad rjes khyad du 'phags pa'i rgyal por gyur/ dge rgan gyis slob mar shugs rkyen gang 'dra thebs pa ni lo rgyus smra ba rnams spro snang skye ba'i yul zhig yin kyang / yid phangs pa zhig ni/ de'i skor gyi lo rgyus ha cang nyung bas gsal bo shes mi nus/ 'on kyang don dngos 'ga' khas len byed dgos te/a ri si 'o 'es slob gso byas par brten nas lo na gzhon pa'i rgyal sras kyis shes yon thob par ma zad/ mi'i spyod tshul skor gyi gnas lugs mang po yang shes pas/ rgyal sras kyis bdag skye mkhan ni pha ma yin la/ bdag la 'tsho ba'i rin thang shes su 'jug mkhan ni dge rgan yin zhes gsungs/ a leg gzen nyis rgyal sa bzung rjes/ a ri si 'o tshes slob grwa 'dzugs pa dang zhib 'jug byed par dngul lor 'bor chen gnang zhing bran g.yog mang po mngags nas sku g.yog byas/ yang a leg gzen rnyis dmag chen drangs nas shar phyogs su skyod skabs/ da rung mi mang po mngags nas lam rgyud kyi srog chags dang rtsi shing rtsa chen sdud nyar byas te dge rgan la bskyal nas zhib 'jug byas/ 'on kyang dge slob gnyis kyi chab srid dmigs yul mi gcig ste/ a len gzen nyis ni spobs pa ches cher bskyed cing dmag chen gyi kha lo gang 'dod du bsgyur nas phyi phyogs la btsan 'dzul rgya skyed byas te drag shugs kyis rgyal khab mang po dbang du bsdus/ yin na'ang / a ri si khro 'es ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi lam lugs la ha cang thugs khur byed cing chab srid rig pa zhes pa'i gzhung zhig mdzad/ de ni ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi lam lugs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i gzhung lugs phyogs bsdoms so//111

a ri si khro tshes ma khe ḍo ni lnga'i rgyal po'i pho brang nas phal cher lo ngo bzhir rgyal sras kyi dge rgan bzhes/ spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 336lor/ h+phi lis gdung rabs gnyis pa lkog gsod byas pas a leg gzen rnyis rgyal sa bzung /lo gnyis pa'i nang dmag chen drangs nas par zig si ri ya/ (mas/༅)h+phi ni ci dang i jib sogs su rgyang skyod mdzad/ lo 'dir a ri si 'o 'e phyir a then sir bzhud de grong khyer shar sne ru slob gling zhig btsugs/ slob gling gi khor yug mdzes shing lta na sdug pa zhig yin zhing khong gis rgyun du slob ma rnams khrid nas sdong bo'i bsil grib 'og tu bag phebs kyis 'gro zhing / 'gro zhor du slob khrid dang gros bsdur byed pas sos dal bag phebs kyi snang ba zhig ster/ a ri si 'o tshe'i mthun sbyor dang 'bad pa la brten nas/ le khu ang slob gling gi snyan grags myur du phe lā 'o'i a kha rtem slob gling las che bar gyur cing snyi ri si'i rig gzhung lte gnas su gyur/ a ri si 'o tshes lo ngo bcu gsum ring der bya ba bsgrubs shing rtsom mang po spel/spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 323lor/ a leg gzen t+ta rgyang skyod kyi lam du na ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnan mthar tshe las 'das/ 'phrin gsar de thos rjes/a then sa'i ma khe ḍo ni yur ngo rgol byed pa'i thog khag gis ngo rgol gyi 'go brtsams shing / mi 'ga' zhig gis a ri si 'o tshes a leg gzin rti'i dge rgan bzhes pas ma khe ḍo ni yur kha phyogs pa'i shog khag dang 'brel ba dam po yod snyam nas lha la mi gus pa zhes pa'i nyes ming btags te khrims rar gtugs/ a ri si cho tshes rang nyid so khi rā je'i shul du lhung 'gror dogs nas khār lje si grong khyer (ltalo777)du bros/ lo gcig gi rjes su sa der gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i ches rlabs che ba'i bsam blo ba de nyid dgung grangs re gnyis bzhes thog sku gshegs so//11sna ri si 'o tshe ni shes yon shin tu che ba'i gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i gsung

rtsom ches mang ba'i mtshan nyid pa zhig yin zhing / kha rgyun ltar na/ khong gis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom chig stong lhag yod par grags/ gsung rtsom de dag gi nang don mtshan nyid rig pa dang / gtan tshigs rig pa/ chab srid/ mi chos/ lo rgyus/ dngos khams/ skye dngos/ gnam dpyad dang rtsom rig sogs la 'brel bas/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i shes bya kun khyab kyi dpe deb cig red ces smra chog kho rang shes yon che ba'i thog dbye zhib dang phyogs bsdus la mkhas pas shes bya mang po zhig rigs chen bzhir bkar pa 'di ltar/shes byar dbye na/ 1 gzhung lugs kyi shes bya dang / 2 don dngos kyi shes bya dang / 3 nyer spyod kyi shes bya dang / 4 bslab gnyer lag cha bcas bzhi ste/ dang po gzhung lugs kyi shes bya la mtshan nyid rig pa dang po dang /dngos khams rig pa (mtshan nyid rig pa gnyis pa'ang zer/)dang / gnyis pa don dngos kyi shes byar mi chos rig pa dang / chab srid rig pa/ dpal 'byor rig pa/ gsum pa nyer spyod kyi shes byar tshig rgyan rig pa/ snyan ngag rig pa dang mdzes rtsal te gsum dang / bzhi ba bslab gnyer lag char gtan tshigs rig pa bcas so//a ri si sto 'e ni nub phyogs kyi lo rgyus thog shes byar rigs bkar ba'i mkhas dbang thog ma yin zhing / de nas bzung gtan tshigs rig pa/ mi chos rig pa/ chab srid rig pa dang skye dngos rig pa sogs la so sor zhib 'jug byas shing rmang gzhi bting pas rig pa'i gnas de dag gi srol 'dod mkhan por gyur/gong gi tshul de las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni/ khong gis gzhung lugs kyi shes bya gnas dang por bzhag cing / de'i nang nas mtshan nyid rig pa dang po de ches mtho ba'i gnas la bzhag khong gis mtshan nyid rig pa dang po de rig pa'i gnas gzhan las logs su bkar te gal che'i gnas su ba'/ snar

mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus su don snying gal chen ldan/ mtshan nyid rig pa dang po de shes bya kun gyi gtso bor 'jog don ci yin zhe na/ de ni de'i zhib 'jug byed yul rig pa'i gnas gzhan las rgya che ba'i phyir/ de ni gzhagrub rang nyid dang de'i rang bzhin ched du zhib 'jug gi yul byas pa'i shes bya zhig yin/ a ri si 'o che'i 'dod tshul 'di ni sngon gyi ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa bsam blo'i thog nas gong du 'phel ba red/ nga tshos gong du ngo sprod byas pa ste/ a ri si 'o tshe'i sngun gyi lo ngo brgya lhag gi ring du/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i ad li tshe'i grub mtha'i phar me ni rnyes he rā khu le 'o'i dngos po thams cad bzhur 'gyur dang me mched ni 'jig rten gyi gzhi rtsar 'dod pa der ngo rgol byed ched gzhi grub skor gyi gzhung lugs cha tshang zhig smos shing /mi 'gyur mi 'gul ba'i don spyi kho na ste gzhi grub ni chos kun gyi gzhi rtsar 'dod cing 'di ni sems gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba yin/ rjes su phe lā khros lta ba 'di phyogs sdom byas te 'jig rten gnyis kyi gzhung lugs gsar du btsugs/ khong gis phar me ni rte'i gzhi grub de rtog bcas kyi 'jig rten gnyis kyi nang gi bye brag gi rtog bcas su gong 'phel btang zhing / he rā khu le 'o'i mi rtag pa'i chos de mngon sum gyi 'jig rten khams kyi chos bye brag pa mang por bsgyur cing de dag gi rtog bcas thod gtugs/ 'on kyang 'jig rten khams gnyis kyi 'brel ba gsal bshad kyi skabs su rtog bcas ni chos bye brag pa'i gzhi rtsar 'dod/ der brten/ rtog bcas smra ba ni phar me ni rnye'i sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi rgyun bzung nas 'phel rgyas gtong pa red/ a ri si khro tshes dge rgan gyi rtog bcas smra ba'i lta bar dgag pa rgyab cing phar me ni lha'i gzhi grub kyi gzhung lugs la mu mthud du dbye zhib byas/ a ri si 'o tshe'i 'dod tshul ni/ 'jig rten du gzhi grub kyi chos ha cang mang / der brten nga tshozhi zlos 'dzin de gzhi grub kyi don spyi tsam gyi tshad la tshim na mi 'os shing

dngos yod kyi khrod nas dngos po'i gzhi grub kyi khyad par gzhir bzung nas dbye zhib byed dgos/ dper na/ skye dngos kyi gzhi grub la zhib 'jug byed pa ni skye dngos rig pa dang / chab srid kyi snang tshul gyi gzhi grub la zhib 'jug byed pa ni chab srid rig pa la sogs pa lta bu'o// khong gis 'di ltar dbye zhib byas shing tshan rig de dag gsar btod byas/ tshan rig 'di dag so sor bkar rjes/ yang khong gis 'di ltar 'dod de/ da rung gzhi grub rigs shig ni tshan rig bye brag par ched du mi gtogs shing tshan rig sna tshogs kyi khrod du med mi rung ba zhig ste/ der khong gis gzhi grub kyi gzhi grub tu gyur pa zhes zer zhing / de ni don spyi dang de'i 'brel ba yin/ dper na/ rang bzhin/grangs ka dang 'brel ba sogs te/ bye brag tshan rig thams cad du gzhi grub la/ 'on te bye brag gi tshan rig gang gis kyang de dag la zhib 'jug mi byed/de ni mtshan nyid rig pa dang po'i zhib 'jug byed yul yin/ a ri si 'o 'es mtshan nyid rig pa dang po dang bye brag gi tshan rig la mngon gsal gyi khyad par gsum yod par 'dod la/ de'ang thog mar mtshan nyid rig pa dang po'i zhib 'jug byed yul ni gzhi grub rang nyid yin zhing tshan rig bye brag pa'i zhib 'jug byed yul ni gzhi grub rang mtshan pa sna tshogs te/ de'i 'phro nas/mtshan nyid rig pa dang po'i zhib 'jug byed yul du gyur pa'i gzhi grub ni cha tshang zhig dang / bye brag tshan rig gi yul du gyur pa'i gzhi grub ni cha shas shin yi na/ gsum pa ni/ mtshan nyid rig pa dang pos rdzas kyi ches thorme ma rgizhi rtsa dang ches mtho ba'i rgyu rkyen la zhib 'jug byed cing / bye bragi gi tsha/ rig gi 'jug 6la sna byeX brag gi rgyu rkyen yin/ 'di dag la nga tshos shes thub te/ a ri si 'o tshe'i mtshan nyiXd rig pa dang po de don dngos su da lta'i mtshan nyid rig pa yin/ a ri si 'o tshes mtshan nyid rig pa de bye brag gi tshan rig las bkar te khor rkyang gi shes byar 'gyur du bcug pa ni khong gi mdzad rjes chen ༵ byin

zhing / mi'i rigs kyi dbye zhib/ phyogs sdom dang don spyi'i bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa'i gong 'phel chen po zhig kyang yin/ a ri si khro 'e'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang po zhes pa'i rnam bshad de/ rjes su gzugs 'das rig pa zhes pa'i gzhung du bzhag cing / de nas bzung gzugs 'das rig pa zhes pa'i ming 'dir nudī phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus su go don khyad par ba zhig yod par rgyu~X bye ༵// ༵ d+dha ni phe lā 'o'i thugs sras yin la dge rgan brtsi bkur yang byed mod/ 'on kyang zer sgros kyi rjes mi 'brang ste/ a kha rtem slob gling du slobasbyong byed skabs phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas kyi 'jig rten zhes par dogs pa skyes shing de dus slob gling du rtsod gleng zhig byung / 'jig rten gyi dngos po kun la rang nyid dang mthun pa'i rtog bcas shig yod med kyi bskor te/ slob ma 'ga' res khyad du 'phags pa'am rin thang can gyi dngos rdzas kho nar rtog bcas yod pa las 'dam bag dang gad snyigs lta bur yod mi srid ces dang /slob ma 'ga' res dge rgan gyis chos thams cad la rtog bcas yod ces gsungs pas 'dam bag dang gad snyigs la'ang rang nyid kyi rtog bcas los yod ces dgag lan btab pas phyogs gnyis kyis thag ma chod par phe lā 'or dris/ khong gis thog khag sngun mar rgyab skyor dang phyi ma'i bshad pa la khungs med red ces gshe gshe btang / yin na'ang khong gis kyang mdor bsdu ma thub/a ri si 'o tshes rtsod gleng 'dir zhib 'jug zhib mo byas mthar phyogs gsar ba /sa rdog bcas smra ba la dgag pa gting zab cig brgyab/ khong gis bstan na tho/ ga mar/ dngos po'i gzhi grub de bye brag pa'am re re ba zhig yin/dper na/ shing khang 'di zhes pa'i tshe/ bye brag pa'i khang pa mang bo las byung bsdo ༵༵ pa'i don spyi de bye brag pa'i khang pa re re'i khrod du gnas pa las/ de

dag dang bral nas khor rkyang du gnas mi thub/ yang khong gi zhal nas/ phe lā 'os dngos po gsal bshad byed ched de dag dang mthun pa'i rtog bcas zhig brjod kyang der snying bo med do zer/de'i 'phror/ dngos po bye brag pa gdod nas yod pa zhig yin gyi rtog bcas las 'phros pa zhig min/ phe lā 'os rtog bcas ni ma dbyibs (07)dang dngos po bye brag pa ni de'i lad mo ( 7)dang bgos thob pa yin zhes pa de/ don med kyi tshig skam zhig tu snang / gal te dngos po bye brag pa'i ma dbyibs de rtog bcas yin zer na/ dngos po glang rung la ma dbyibs du ma yod par 'gyur/ dper na/ ro mngar ba'i ku shu dmar po gcig ces pa'i tshig 'di'i nang du/ gcig dang dmar po/ mngar mo dang ku shu bcas rtog bcas bzhis ma dbyibs byas mod/ 'on kyang rtog bcas 'di dag ji ltar lhan du 'dzoms pa red zer na/ rtog bcas smra bas 'grel rgyag mi thub/gsum pa ni/ dngos po bye brag pa'i skye 'jig dang 'gyur ldog yod cing /phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas ni 'gyur med rtag brtan zhig yin pas gnyis ga'i 'gal ba gsal po red/ gal te dngos po bye brag pa dang rtog bcas thod gtugs thub na/ de yang skye 'jig med pa'i rtag pa zhig yin dgos mod/'on kyang don dngos thog tu de ltar ma yin/ 'o na/ mi 'gyur ba'i rtog bcas las 'gyur sla ba'i dngos po bye brag pa ji ltar byung zhe na/ de ni phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas smra ba'i thag gcod bya mi thub pa'i 'gal ba zhig red/gong smos phyogs gsum las gzhan khong gis da rung rtog bcas smra ba la phyogs mang bos dgag pa brgyab/khong gi grogs po 'gas thos rjes kho la kha ta byas te na re/ phe lā 'o ni mkhas dbang yin zhing khyed kyi dge rgan yang yin pas/ de ltar byas na mi 'os zhes bshad par khong gis 'di ltar lan btab/ nga rang dge stu/ la

dga'/ 'on kyang bden don la de bas kyang dga' zere/ 'di'i thog nas kho rang rmongs 'jug mi byed pa'i bsam blo mtshon thub bo// a ri si 'o 'es rtog bcas smra ba'i dgag sgrub de phe lā 'o'i sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi gnad la phogaphe lā 'os rtog bcas de bye brag pa'i dngos po las logs su gnas pa zhig tu 'dod cing spyi bye brag gi 'brel ba so sor phyes/ a ri si 'o tshes bye brag pa'i dngos po'i mngon sum rang bzhin khas blangs te dngos po'i spyi mtshan de bye brag gi dngos po'i khrod du yod ces bstan pas lta ba 'di yang dag pa zhig red/ le nyin gyis/ a ri si 'o tshes rtog bcas smra ba la dgag pa ni spyir btang ba'i sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi dgag sgrub cig red ces bshad/ ⑫a ri si khro tshes phe lā khro'i rtog bcas smra bar dgag pa des sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi ngo bo dmar rjen du btang bas/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus thog tu yongs khyab kyi snying po ldan pa zhig go/yid phangs pa zhig ni/ khong gis rtog bcas smra bar dgag sgrub byas pa mthar thug ma yin/ don spyi ni bye brag pa'i khrod du gnas par gsal bshad byas pa'i thad nas kho rang yang dag pa yin mod/ 'on kyang khos rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang po'i gzhung lugs rgyas bshad byed skabs g.yo 'gul byung zhing / tha na rang gi thog ma'i yang dag pa'i lta ba bor nas gom pa re re bzhin sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi dong nang du 'dong ste/ khong gi dge rgan phe lā 'o dang 'dra ba'i nor 'khrul byung /gna' bo'i ches rlabs che ba'i bsam blo ba 'di nyid ji ltar yang dag pa nas nor 'phyug gi phyogs su lhung ba shes 'dod na/ le'u rjes mar gzigs rogs gnang //118

sabacadabacu gcig ba/ gna'apha'i 〉ri si'i ches rlabs chelda'izosam bloli/(smad cha/)wa wa.a ri si 'o tshe/a ri si 'o 'e ni ji ltar lta ba yang dag pa nas rmongs 'khrul gyi phyogs su lhung ba red zer na/ thog mar nga tshos khong gis le khu ang slob gling nas slob bu rnams la mtshan nyid rig pa dang po de ji ltar khrid pa la dpyad pa btang na shes thub/nam mkha' dwangs pa'i ston dus kyi nyin zhig la/ slob grwa'i nang du ku shu dang rgyan 'brum rab tu smin zhing me tog sna tshogs kyis yongs su brgyan pas me tog gi dga' tshal zhig dang kun nas mtshungs/ nyin der a ri si 'o tshe'i thugs ha cang dgyes pas/ khong gis dngos su slob bu rnams la mtshan nyid rig pa dang po 'khrid rgyu'i thag bcad/ khong ni slob grwa de gsar 'dzugs mkhan yin zhing snyan grags che stabs slob bu yang ha cang mang po 'dus/ khong gis 'gro zhor bshad zhor byas nas na re/ yigazhi grub rang nyid dang de'i ngo bor ched du zhib 'jug byed pa'i tshan rig cig yod/ tshan rig de ni gzhan dang mi mthun te/ de ni chos thams cad kyi ches thog ma'i gzhi rtsa dang ches mtho ba'i rkyen la gsal bshad bgyid pa'i tshan rig cig go/ bdag gis der mtshan nyid rig pa dang po zhes btags pa yin/ bdag gis sngon dus kyi mtshan nyid pa mang po'i 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa'i sa/ gyi

gzhung lugs la zhib 'jug byas shing de dag gi thun mong gi zhan cha zhig shes byung / de ni gzhi grub rang nyid dang de'i grangs sam ngo bo/ 'brel ba'am rnam pa sogs dbye med de/ dper na/ phe dha sgo rā si yis chos thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa ni grangs yin zhes gzhi grub rang nyid dang gzhi grub kyi grangs so sor phyes med la/ kho bo'i dge rgan phe la 'os ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa'am 'byung rtsa ni rtog bcas su bzhed/ 'on te khong gis nga'i steng du ku shu mdog dmar zhing bro ba mngar mo gcig yod ces pa'i rjod byed las rtog bcas gang ni ches gzhi rtsa'i gzhi grub yin par 'grel byed ma nus te/ rgyu mtshan gzhi grub rang nyid dang gzhi grub kyi grangs tshad/ rang bzhin dang 'brel ba so sor phye med pas red/ don dngos su rjod byed de'i gcig ces pas gzhi grub kyi grangs tshad dang / dmar mdog dang bro mngar gyis gzhi grub kyi rang bzhin dang / stong du zhes pas gzhi grub kyi chos gnyis (nga dang ku shu) bar gyi 'brel ba bstan la/ de tsho tshang ma gzhi grub dang 'brel ba yod na'ang gzhi grub rang nyid ma yin/ zhes a ri si 'o 'es phyogs gcig nas bshad cing phyogs gcig nas phyag bsrings te steng gi mar dud pa'i ku shu'i ljon pa las ku shā dmar zhing che ba zhig btogs shing phyag tu bzung nas mchan bur gsungs mchan bus/ dge rgan lags/ 'o na khyod kyis gzhi grub rang nyid de ci zhig tu bzhed ces dris par/ dge rgan gyis de ni nges par du dngos gzugs sam gzugs nyid yin dgos te/ de ni gzhi grub kyi ches gtso gal che ba'i chos shig ste/ gzhan thams cad rtsa ba 'di dang 'bral mi nus la/ dper na/ku shu mdog dmar po gcig yod ces pa'i gcig dang mdog dmar po bcas ku shu dang kha bral nas rang skya bar gnas mi thub cing / de gsum gyi nang nas ku sdo ༵ gzhi grub kyi dngos gzugs te/ gcig dang mdog dmar po ni de'i

grangs tshad dang rang bzhin gyi rnam 'gyur zhes gsungs/ yang dge rgan gyis ku shu bstan te mu mthud du dngos gzugs zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i don snying gis chos thams cad grub pa'i ches rmang gzhi dang ches thog ma'i chos shig bstan pa red gsungs/ mchan bu'i khrod kyi ches lo na phra ba'i slob bu zhig gis rgan lags/ khyed kyis de ltar gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni chos thams cad kyi ches rmang gzhi dang ches thog ma'i dngos gzugs ni ku shu yin par bzhed pa red ang zhes zhus tsa na/ a ri si 'o 'os khyod nor 'dug de ltar ma yin te/kho bos 'dir ku shu dper bkod nas gsal bshad byas pa tsam du zad/ yang khong bzhad zhor du slar yang kho bos bltas na/ gzhi grub kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i dngos gzugs la ma mtha' khyad chos gnyis ldan te/ dang po ni/ dngos gzugs ni bye brag re re ba dang rang skya bar gnas pa'i chos shig ste/ dper na kho bo'i largo sgo ku shu 'di dang / ༷khoX bo'o gam ༷gyi ljorno pa 'di dang / khang pa 'di sogs lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshig sgrub cig gi nang dngos gzugs ni gtso tshig ste/ des chos gzhan ston par mi bgyid cing / chos gzhan tshang ma niX de'o yul tshig gis gsal bshad byed pa yin te/ dper na/ so khi rā 'e ni mi yin zhes pa'i tshig sgrub kyi nang so khi rā 'e ni gtso tshig dang / mi ni yul tshig ste so khi rā 'e zhes pa ci zhig yin pa ston byed do// de bas na so khi rā tshe ni dngos gzugs dang po yin no// zhes bshad pa la/ yang mchan bu zhig gis/'o na mi ni dngos gzugs su 'gyur rung ngam/ gal te nga tshos mi ni gang zag yin zhes pa'i tshig sgrub la mtshon na/ mi zhes pa gtso tshig tu gyur pa ma red dam zhes dris par/ khong gis dri ba bzang / kho bos de gsal bshad byed 'dod kyin yod/ ngas gzhigs na dngos gzugs rigs gnyis yod de/rigs dang po ni bye brag dang rang skya bar gnas pa'i chos re re ba yin la/der ni kho bos daXs gzugs gas swā zhes 'bod/ rigs gnyis pa ni1 /sdus

mthun gyi chos bye brag pa sdud pa'i don spyi ste/ de la gtan tshigs rig pa'i nang rigs zhes zer/ dper na 'dir so khi rā 'e ni mi yin zhes pa'i mi la rigs su 'bod/ de bas rigs mthun sdud pa'i don spyi la gtan tshigs rig par rigs chen du 'bod do// spyir rigs dang rigs chen gang yin kyang tshang mar dngos gzugs su'ang 'bod rung pas/ ngas 'dir de dag la dngos gzugs phal pa zhes btags so// dper na so khi rā tshe ni mi yin zhes bang /mi sne gang zegaX yin zhes pa lta bur mtshon na/ so khi rā 'e mi gang zag ces pas rang bdag —rigs rigs chen gyi 'brel ba sgrub pa red/bdag nyid ni (so khi rā 'e)da gzod dngos gzugs gtso bo dang / gzhan rigs (mi)dang rigs chen (gang zag)ni dngos gzugs phal ba tsam ste/dngos gzugs phal bas bdag nyid gsal bar byed pa las bdag nyid de so khi rā tshe'i khongs su gnas med do// zhes bshad/ skabs der slob bu bsam gzhigs la mos pa zhig gis/ dge rgan lags/ khyod kyis mtshan gzhi de'i nang mi dang gang zag kyang gzhi grub kyi dngos gzugs su byas pas/ 'di dang phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas la khyad par ci zhig yod ces dris par/ kho bos bshad pa'i dngos gzugs gtso bo dang phe lā 'o'i rtog bcas ni mi gcig ste/ thog mar dngos gzugs gtso bo ni chos gzhan rnams kyi rmang gzhi dang / dngos gzugs phal pa ni dngos gzugs gtso bor brten nas gnas pa yin la/ de 'phror dngos gzugs phal pa las dngos gzugs gtso bor ji ltar nye na de ltar de'i dngos gzugs rang bzhin mang ste/ dper na/ so khi rā 'e mi gang zag ces pa'i khrod mi'i dngos gzugs rang bzhin gang zag las mang pa lta bu'o// phe lā khro'i rtog bcas ni de las ldog ste/ khong gis go don ji ltar spyi mtshan can yin na de ltar dngos gnas par bzhed do// 123bas der a ri si 'o tshe'i dkor gnyer khol po yong nas khong la zhu don/

gong ma chen po a leg gzen rnyis shar phyogs nas pho nya mngags te ngo mtshar che ba'i srog chags dang skye dngos kyi rigs khyed la zhib 'jug bya rgyur bskyal nas thon 'dug ces pas/ de nas khong gi slob khrid kyi mtshams bzhag song /gong du a ri si 'o tshe'i dngos gzugs kyi skor gleng bar bltas na/ khong gis sngon byon dam pa tsho'i gzhung lugs la bsam gzhigs dang spyi bsdoms byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng / thengs dang por gzugs nyid (lha4)zhes pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i tha snyad 'di bton pa yin te/ khong gis dngos po'i gzhi grub kyi dngos gzugs (r+sāṣ+ṭha)dang dngos po'i ngo bo (dper na grangs tshad/rang bzhin dang 'brel ba sogs/)so sor phye zhing de nyid mtshan nyid rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi gnad gzhir bzung 'dug la/ der brten nas nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng gzugs nyid smra ba'i (lhadzi 7)gzhung lugs kyi srol phye/ khong gi dngos gzugs gtso bo dang dngos gzugs phal pa'i go gnas dang 'brel ba'i 'grel tshul ni nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng gnad don 'gangs chen te spyi bye brag gi 'brel pa'i gnad la thug 'dug gnad don de'i thad dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs kyi lta tshul 'gal ba ltag sprod du song yod de/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i phe dha sgo rā si dang / phar me ni rte dang / phe lā 'o sogs kyis ang grangs dang /gzhi grub/ don spyi'am rtog bcas spyir btang pa dag chos bye brag pa dang bral nas tshugs thub tu gnas shing / chos bye brag pa'i 'byung rtsar 'dod la/ de ni mgo mjug bzlog nas 'jig rten la lta ba'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul zhig go/ a ri si 'o 'e ni de dag dang mi 'dra ste/ khong gis chos bye brag pa'am rang mtshan par dngos gzugs gtso bo dang / de dag las byung ba'i spyi mtshan la dngos gzugs phal pa zhes btags/ de gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i thad/ a ri si 'o 'es dngos gzugs gtso bo ni rmang ga~X /nga

phal pa ni gtso bor brten dgos par bzhed/ dper na ku shu re re dang ljon pa re re sogs dngos po rang mtshan pa dag ni da gzod dngos po gzhi grub kyi rmang gzhi yin la/ nga tshos ku shu sogs kyi don spyi ku shu dang ljon pa rang mtshan pa mang po las phyung pas/ dngos po rang mtshan pa de dag dang kha bral nas rang skya bar tshugs thub tu gnas ga la thub zer bas/ lta tshul 'di ni dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba yang dag cig go/ 'on te a ri si khro 'es dngos gzugs phal pa ni dngos gzugs gtso bor brten dgos par ma zad/dngos gzugs gtso bo 'ba' zhig la brten na gzod gzhi grub thub pa ma rtogs/ dper na de ni ku shu'i don spyi ku shu rang mtshan pa re re'i steng na yod pa bzhin no// yin na'ang khong gis dngos po'i don spyi'ang dngos gzugs su 'dod par ma zad/ da dung de ni gtso gzhi'i khongs su gnas med ces gsungs pas/ de lta na khong gis gong du bshad pa'i lta ba dang nang 'gal byung yod de/ spyi bye brag la brten na da gzod gzhi grub thub par bshad pa dang / yang bye brag gi nang du de 'dus med par smra bas/ de 'dra'i brten pa'ang stong pa tsam du zad pa ma yin nam/ lta 'gal de ni a ri si khro tshe rim gyis sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'dam la lhung ba'i dbu bzung ba red/ 'on te /bas spyar a ri si 'o 'e dang khong gi slob bu tshos de ltar du gyur 'dug pa ma gas a ri// si 'o tshes a leg gzin lha'i skye dngos blangs rjes/ nyin 'ga'i 'phro nas mu mthud du dpe khrid gnang byung / thengs 'dir slob bu zhig gis thog mar dogs gzhi 'di ltar bton te/ dge rgan lags/ khyed kyis sngar mtshan nyid rig pa dang pos chos thams cad kyi gdod ma'i 'byung rtsa dang ches mtho'i rgyu rkyen la zhib 'jug bya dgos par gsungs pas/ khyed kyis bstan pardi ༵༵sa gzugs kyis chos thams cad kyi ches thog ma'i 'byung rtsa gsal

bshad byas yod la/ 'on te chos thams cad kyi 'gul 'gyur gyi ches mtho'i rgyu rkyen gang red dam/ zhes zhus par/ de ring tag tag kho bos de'i skor khrid 'dun yod de/ sngar kho bos dngos gzugs gtso bo ste dngos po bye brag pa'am rang mtshan pa ni gzhi grub kyi rmang gzhir bshad pas/ chos thams cad kyi ches thog ma'i 'byung rtsa red/ 'on te dngos gzugs gtso bo ni ji ltar 'byung zhing 'gul 'gyur byed pa red zer na/ de ni kho bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang pos gsal bshad bya rgyu'i nang don yin te/ kho bos sngon chad mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i gzhung lugs mang por zhib 'jug byed myong la/ kho tshos dngos po'i 'gyur ldog gi rgyu rkyen la nyams zhib ches cher byas yod na'ang / rte mo khu re 'o lta bu'i mkhas pa mang pos rgyu rkyen gyi phyogs re ma gtogs yongs su rtogs med stabs/ khong tsho'i lta ba ni phyogs re can du gyur 'dug kho bos dngos po mang po'i skye 'gyur la dpyad gzhigs byas mthar rgyu rkyen rigs bzhi yod pa rnyed/ dper na a bhi ro'i lha skur mtshon na/ a ri si cho 'e rang nyid de'i mdun du phebs te/ kho na re/ thog mar lha sku'i rgyu li dgos la/ gal te li med tshe li sku 'grub thabs med/ de bas na li ni de'i rgyu cha'i rgyu dang / de nas li yod tsam gyi mi chog lha sku de nyid nyi ma'i lha a bhi ro'i sku brnyan yin pas lha sku gzhan dang mi 'dra pas/ de mthun gyi khyad chos shig ldan dgos pa red/ der ni rnam pa'i rgyu zhes zer/ gsum pa/ li de nyid a bhi ro'i lha skur 'gyur ba la nges par de sbyangs rdung byed dgos la/ de 'dra'i rnam par bsgyur ba'i stobs shugs la sgul shugs kyi rgyu zer/ mthar a bhi ro'i lha sku 'dir bzhengs don mi rnams kyis bsod nams gsog ched smon 'dun zhu yul du gyur cing / de 'dra'i dngos po'i rnam pas bsnyeg bya'i dmigs yul la/ nga tshos dmigs yul gyi rgyu zhes so// 'jig rten steng gi chos yod cog gang yin kyang 'byung pya ni de'i rgyu cha dang / rnam pa/ sgul shugs/ dmigasdu snal

bcas rgyu bzhir rag ma las pa med/ de ni kho bos gsal bshad byed pa'i dngos gzugs gtso bo'i 'byung pa dang 'gul 'gyur byed pa'i rgyu rkyen te rgyu bzhi smra ba zhes pa yin no zer/yang slob bu zhig gis/ dge rgan lags/ rgyu bzhi bo de'i nang gang gal che'am/ zhes dris par/ khong gis rgyu bzhi tsam shes pas mi chog ste/ da rung de dag gi 'brel ba'ang shes dgos/ rgyu de dag las sgul shugs kyi rgyu dang dmigs yul gyi rgyu gnyis mnyam du bsres nas rnam pa'i rgyur bsdu rung / rgyu mtshan gang zer na/ rnam pa ni rgyu chas bsnyeg bya'i dmigs yul dang / rgyu cha 'gyur par bskul pa'i sgul shugs kyang yin pa'i phyir/ dper na gyo mo dang rdza g.yam ni khang ba rtsig byed kyi rgyu cha dang / khang pa ni gyo mo dang rdza g.yam las grub pa'i rnam pa dang bsnyeg bya'i dmigs yul yin la/ gyo mo dang rdza g.yam khang par 'gyur par bskul pa'i sgul shugs kyang yin no// der brten rgyu bzhi mdor bsdus na rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i rgyu'i nang du 'du/ rgyu cha dang rnam pa ni 'jig rten steng chos thams cad 'byung pa dang 'gyur ldog la med mi rung pa'i rgyu gnyis so// chos thams cad rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i gcig gyur te/ rgyu cha ni chos 'grub byed kyi rgyu'i rtsa ba dang / chos gnas pa'i rmang gzhi red/ yin kyang rgyu cha rkyang pa tsam gyi chos rang mtshan pa 'grub mi nus pas/ da dung nges par du rnam pa'ang dgos so// de ltar na chos de dang chos gzhan so sor 'byed thub nges red/ dper na/ li leb mo de lha skur gyur cing li sder li dbyug dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ der nyi ma'i lha a bhi ro'i rnam pa ldan pas red/ de bas na/ rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i go gnas dang phan nus mi 'dra ste/gnyis ka bsdur na rnam pa ni rgyu cha las kyang gtso gal che'o// rgyu mtshan rgyu cha ni rtsa ba'i rgyu tsam las de rang nyid 'gul skyod byed mi nus/ de bas na rnam pa'i bsdiX zlo la brten na/ da gzod rgyu cha dmigs yul nges can ldan pa'i chos

rang mtshan par 'gyur nges so//chos gang yin kyang tshang ma rgyu cha nas rnam par 'gyur ba ni 'gul 'gyur gyi go rim zhig ste/ rgyu char da rung rnam pa nges can zhig ma thob pa'i skabs/de'i rnam pa ni bag la zha ba'i yong tshod rang bzhin tsam yin la/ de 'dra'i ngang tshul la bag zha'i nus pa zer/ des nam zhig rnam pa thob tshe/ da gzod mngon sum gyi chos rang mtshan par 'gyur/ rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i 'brel pa ni mngon mi mngon gyi 'brel ba ste/ rgyu cha ni mi mngon pa'i rnam pa dang / rnam pa ni mngon sum du gyur pa'i rgyu cha red/ dper na/ gyo mo dang rdza g.yam gyis grub pa'i khang par mtshon na/ gyo mo dang rdzo g.yam ni de'i rgyu cha dang / khang par rnam par ma gyur pa'i gong rol gyo mo dang rdza g.yam la khang pa 'grub byed kyi mi mngon pa'i nus pa ldan tsam yin la/ de khang ba'i rnam par gyur tshe/ de 'dra'i mi mngon pa'i nus pa mngon sum du gyur pa red/ gyo mo dang rdza g.yam nas khang par 'gyur pa ni 'gal 'gyur gyi brgyud rim zhig go/ des ni nga tshor 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la bag la zha ba dang yongs su mngon pa'i khyad par yod par bstan/ de bas na kho bos bag la zha nas yod pa nas mngon du gyur nas yod pa'i 'gyur ldog gi brgyud rim la 'gul skyod ces btags/ 'di dag ni a ri si 'o 'os khong gi thag nye'i khang pa zhig mtshan gzhir bzung nas bag zha ji ltar mngon gyur du 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs la brten nas khong gi 'gul skyod kyi lta tshul brjod pa yin no//'jig rten gyi chos thams cad rgyu cha nas rnam pa dang / bag zha nas mngon gyur gyi 'gul 'gyur gyi go rim zhig brgyud dgos na/ nga tshos chos gcig gi 'gyur ldog gi brgyud rim tsam zhib 'jug byas pas mi chog ste/ nges par du chos dang chos bar gyi 'brel bar zhib 'jug bya dgos so// chos rang mtshan pa che ge mo zhig la mtshon na/ rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i 'brel ba swākā la/

chos dang chos kyi bar yang de mthun rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i 'brel ba mchis so//rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i khyad par ni ltos bcas te/ chos rang mtshan pa gang yin kyang de'i mtho rim gyi chos la mtshon na de'i rgyu cha dang / 'on te de'i dma' rim gyi chos la mtshon na de'i yang rnam pa red/ dper na/ gyo mo dang rdza g.yam ni khang ba'i rgyu cha dang / 'og te gyo mo dang rdza g.yam kyang sa 'dam gyis bzos pas/ sa 'dam la ltos na de'i rnam par gyur 'dug pa lta bu'o// der bltas na/ dma' rim gyi chos ni mtho rim gyi chos kyi rgyu cha dang / mtho rim gyi chos ni dma' rim gyi chos kyi rnam pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi bar ni rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i 'brel ba rim gyis bstar ba gzhir byas nas grub pa'i rim mang dang gdang bu ltar gyi yun ring gi brgyud rim zhig go/slob bu zhig gis mthar gtug na ji ltar yin pa gsal po zhig shes par 'dod de/ rgan lags/ 'di'i rgyu cha nas rnam pa'i rim par mthar thug rgyu ste ches dma' rim dang ches mtho rim yod dam/ zhes dris par/a ri si 'o 'es 'dang zhig brgyab nas de ni yod de/ kho bos gong du bshad zin pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad ni rgyu cha nas rnam pa dang /bag zha'i nus pa nas mngon sum gyi bar 'gul skyod byed bzhin yod cing /dma' rim gyi chos ni bag zha'i nus pa nas mngon sum du 'gyur zhing dmigs yul du bslebs te rnam par gyur la/ yin na'ang / de bas mtho rim gyi chos la mtshon na/ de ni rgyu cha'ang yin pas/ sngar bas mtho rim gyi dmigs yul dang rnam par bsnyeg par byed/ de ltar rim bzhin gong du 'phel zhing mthar ches mtho'i dmigs yul dang rnam pa zhig tu bslebs/ de ni rnam pa yod tshad kyi rnam pa ste rgyu cha med pa'i rnam pa rkyang pa (077)red/ de las ldog nas dpyad na/ ches dma' rim gyi rgyu cha ni rnam pa med pa'i rgyu cha rkyang pa'o//'di/ spyan gyi chos thams cad ni ches dma' rim gyi rgyu cha rkyang pa nas ches

mtho rim gyi rnam pa rkyang pa'i bar 'gul skyod byed bzhin yod/ chos thams cad kyi 'gul skyod kyi rgyu rkyen khrod mthar gyi rtsa ba ni rnam pa rkyang pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan kho bos bshad zin ltar/ rgyu cha ni gzhan dbang dang / rnam pa kho na ni gzod rang dbang can gyi sgul shugs yin pas/ des ni rgyu cha'i 'gyur ldog la skul 'ded byed/ rnam pa rkyang pa ni chos thams cad kyis bsnyeg bya'i ches mtho'i dmigs yul dang mthar thug gi skul 'ded kyi stobs shugs yin zhing /rnam pa rkyang pa rang nyid mi 'gul zhing chos gzhan gyi skul 'ded la ma ltos na'ang / des ni chos gzhan 'gul skyod byed par skul 'ded byed/ de bas na/ kho bos de'i ming la mi 'gul pa'i gdod ma'i skul mkhan nam ang dang po zhes btags zhes par/ slob bu zhig gis/ mi 'gul pa'i gdod ma'i skul mkhan de nga tshos tshor nus sam zhes dris tsa na/ khong gis de tshor mi nus te/de ni nyams su myong thub pa'i chos las brgal ba'i rtag brtan gyi sgos rang skya bar gzhi grub pa'i dngos gzugs shig red/ de ni chos thams cad kyi sngun ma yin pas mi skye mi 'jig la mi 'gul ba zhig ste chos rnams 'gyur ldog byed pa'i mthar thug gi 'byung rtsa yin zhing / de 'dra'i dngos gzugs de ni lha yin zhes la/ a ri si sto 'es ches mjug khyad lhag tu lha'i gal chen gyi phyogs brnan bshad byas so//a ri si 'o khres le khu ang slob gling du nyin de'i dpe khrid mjug rdzogs/khong gi slob bu tshos dge rgan gyis khrid pa'i nang don la rang dang mthun pa'i go ba len bzhin khad kyis rang sar chas song /a ri si 'o 'es nyin der 'khrid pa'i nang don ha cang 'gangs che ste/phyis su khong gi bu slob dag gis gzugs 'das rig pa zhes pa'i deb nang bkod pas/ nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng shugs rkyen chen po thebs/ 129

da skabs nga chos a ri si khro 'es gsung pa'i nang don de dag la ngos zin dang gdeng 'jog ji ltar byed ce na/ a ri si 'o tshe'i gzhung lugs de dag gong du gleng pa ltar dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs kyi lam phyogs gnyis kyi bar du yo bar byed cing / phyis su sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'dam nang du zug pas/ khong gi dge rgan phe lā khyo dang 'dra ba'i nor 'khrul byung / nga tshos der dbye dpyad cung byas na/ a ri si 'o khres 'dir rgyu bzhi smra ba bton te thabs gang yod kyis dngos po'i 'gul 'gyur gyi 'byung rkyen btsal 'dod stabs/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i bsam blo ba chen po 'di nyid kyis rang byung khams kyi chos nyid la 'bad 'bungs kyis nyams zhib byed pa'i snying stobs mtshon/ khong gis rgyu bzhi'i nang gi rgyu cha'i rgyu ni chos thams cad 'grub byed kyi ches rtsa ba'i rgyu dang / chos thams cad gzhi grub kyi rmang gzhir bzhed/ lta tshul de ni sngon gyi mtshan nyid pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba'i rgyu 'dzin dang gnad bsdus gsar pa zhig yin pas yang dag tu gnas mod/ 'on te khong gis rnam pa dang rgyu cha'i 'brel ba gling dus/ rgyu char mthong chung dang rnam pa'i go gnas dang phan nus la phyogs re'i 'ud brjod bgyis pa dang / der ma zad rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i 'brel ba so sor phral pas/ yang dag pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta tshul las gol sar zhugs so// a ri si 'o 'es rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i 'brel ba dang bag zha'i nus pa dang mngon sum gyi 'brel ba mnyam du sbrel nas/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad ni bag zha'i nus pa nas mngon sum du mu mthud du 'gul 'gyur byed pa'i brgyud rim gsal bshad byas/ gzhung lugs des kyang nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus stong don snying gal chen dang shugs rkyen gang zab thebs/ khong ni nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus thog bag zha'i nus pa dang mngon sum gyi ༵༵༵ ba bton pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba yin te/ khong gis chos thams

cad la dma' rim nas mtho rim du gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim ldan zhing / der ma zad rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i gcig gyur ni 'gul skyod kyi nges ldan gyi cha rkyen du bzhed pas/ don mthun gyi rtsod sgrub rig pa'i bsam blo de dag gis phyis kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba mang por shugs rkyen thebs la/ dper na nye rabs sems gtso ring lugs kyi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i slob dpon he sgol dang bcas pa yin no// yin na'ang / khong gis rang nyid kyi rig gzhung sngar bas rgyas spros gnang skabs sems gtso ring lugs dang gzugs 'das rig pa'i phyogs su lhung / spyir phyi rol 'jig rten gyi chos ni bag zha'i nus pa nas mngon sum du gong du 'phel pa'i brgyud rim ni thug med cig go/ 'on te a ri si 'o 'es rang 'dod kyis de la mtha' 'dzin byas shing / thug mtha' de ni rgyu med kyi rnam pa rkyang pa ste/ mi tshos tshor mi nus pa'i mi 'gul pa'i gdod ma'i skul mkhan nam skul shugs ang dang po yin no// khong gis de nyid rgyu cha (bag zha'i nus pa)gzhi grub kyi dngos gzugs las snga bar 'dod cing tha na de la lha zhes 'bod/ de ltar byas pas rgyu cha dang rnam pa'i gcig gyur phyogs yongs nas so sor phral pa ma zad/ khong gi sngar gyi yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ltag sprod du chas la/ khong gi dge rgan phe lā khro'i rtog bcas ni chos rang mtshan pa las snga ba'i 'dod pa dang khyad med du gyur pas/ yang bskyar sems gtso ring lugs kyi nor 'khrul la zhugs/ nor 'khrul de ni phyis kyi chos lugs lha'i rig pa dang sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid pas mu mthun du rgyun 'dzin dang gong 'phel du gtong ngo //a ri si 'o 'e ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i ches shes rgya che zhing ches rlabs che ba'i bsam blo ba zhig dang / nub phyogs kyi gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng bsam gzhigs dang gsed bkrol la ches mos pa'i mi zhig go/khong gis gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo phyogs di/zlos

gnang ste de nyid kyi tshad je mthor gtong pas/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo'i phyogs su phyag rjes mang po bzhag 'on te 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis 'jig rten ngos 'dzin dang 'jig rten lta tshul gyi gzhung lugs yang dag cig chags rgyu ni 'gal ba sna tshogs dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i brgyud rim zhig ste/ a ri si khro 'e lta bu'i bsam blo ba chen po'ang dus rabs dang gral rim gyi rgya las thar ma thub na nor 'khrul gyi 'dam la zug pa smos med red/ nga tshos sngon byon dag blang bya nan drags byed mi rung mod/ 'on te khong gi nor skyon la dpyad dgos te/ de ltar byas na nga tsho'i bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa gong 'phel la 'gro bas sman cha che'o//132

sabacadabacu gnyis pa/ zo snanga'ang lugs kyi mamo'i/nyida'ag pali/wa e phe kho'iro/khyod kyis thengs dang por 'di 'dra'i smag mun du/ 'od snang 'tsher ba'i dpal 'bar mthon por sgrengs/ khyod kyis ches thog mar 'tshe srog gi bde skyid kyi dmigs yul gsar bar bgyis/ khyod kyis bdag la lam ston mdzad bzhin mchis/ khyod ni snyi ri si ba'i gzi ldan gyi 'od zer ro// zhes pa 'di ni/ gna' bo'i ro ma'i phul byung snyan ngag pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa ba lu khi re ste'u (ṭha༅lkoṣ+ṭha)yis snyan ngag ring mo dngos po'i rang bzhin gyi rnam bshad (7༷'i7)ces pa'i nang / khong las lo ngo gnyis brgya lhag gis snga ba'i ghi ri si'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba e phe kho'i ror (cha lo )bstod bsngags mdzad pa yin la/ lu khi re tshe'us gus pa'i yid byed kyis khong gi snyan ngag tu e phe kho'i ror yab ces 'bod cing ngang dkar dang rta mchog cang shes kyi dper bzhag khong gi gsung rtsom ni rtag brtan 'gyur med kyi legs bshad du bsngags par ma zad/ rang nyid kyis kyang e phe kho'i ro dmigs dper bzung ste mtha' gcig tu khong gi rjes su 'brangs par khyab bsgrags byas so//yang de nas lo ngo chig stong lhag song rjes/ na gzhon slob chen pa mar khe si la'ang e phe kho'i ro'i mtshan nyid rig par zhib 'jug byed 'dod 'khrungs shing / rang nyid kyis ḍho mo khu re khro'i rang byung mtshan nyid stu/ pa

dngas phe kho'i ro'i rang byung mtshan nyid rig pa'i khyad par zhes pa'i 'bum rams pa'i dpyad rtsom mdzad de/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i rlabs che ba'i rdul phran dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba gnyis kyi gzhung lugs bsdur nas dpyad gzhigs cung mtha' chod pa gnang mthar/ e phe kho'i ro ni ches rlabs che ba'i sgo ri si'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i bsam blo ba red ces bsngags brjod mdzad par ma zad/ e phe kho'i ro'i dngos gtso ring lugs dang lha med smra ba'i bsam blo spyad de/ gnas bab de'i 'jar man gyi log spyod dbang sgyur mkhan dang chos lugs lha'i rig par dgag rtsod bgyis so//gong gi dpe 'di gnyis kyi thog nas e phe kholaros nub phyogs mtshan spyad /ga pa'i bsam blo'i lo rgyas steng shugs rkyen rgya khyab tu thebs pa mtshon da e// phe kho'i ro ni gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i phyi dus kyi phul du byung ba'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig ste/ spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 341lor sa mo si gling phran du sku bltams/ khong gi a pha ni grong sde'i dge rgan yin pas theng 'bab de 'dra mi bzang / e phe kho'i ro lo na phra dus nas rang 'dod kyis bsam gzhigs byed par dga'/ zer sgros ltar na khong dgung lo bcu bzhi bzhes thog gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i rtsom pa grags can hi se i 'e (blomatshoṣ+ṭha)yis mdzad pa'i lha sgrung byung ba'i snyan ngag lha'i ma lag (77)ces pa bklags te/ khyod kyis bdag la mdzub ston gnongs dang / lha ni gang nas 'ong la/ sa gzhi ni gang nas 'byung zhing grub/ lang long 'phyur pa'i gtsang po/ 'byams klas pa'i chu gter dang gnam mkha'i skar tshogs de dag da rung mkha' dbyings su dge sdig la dbang byed pa'i ye shes kyi lha/ de dag tshang ma ji ltar 'byung zhing thog ma'i rnam pa ji 'dra zhig khyod kyis bdag la mardodī spyan gnongs dang / kye kye nga yi ngag gi lha/ snyan ngag gi lhas/ thog

mar ni rnyog rdzob yug gcig ste/ tshang ma rnyog rdzob las skye zhes lan mdzad/ces par 'phrad skabs/ lo na phra ba'i e phe kho'i ro ngag gi lha'i lan la yid ma ches nas/ dge rgan la rnyog rdzob de'ang gang nas 'ong dris par/ dge rgan gyis lan ldon ma nus/ e phe kho'i ros mtshan nyid rig pa ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung rtsar nyams zhib byed pa'i rig gnas shig yin zhing mi'i blo gros bskyed thub tshul gzhan las thos pas/ khong gis mtshan nyid rig par 'bad 'bungs byed rgyu sems thag bcad do//de nas dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes thog a then sir song nas mu mthun du mtshan nyid rig pa dang rang byung tshan rig gi shes byar sbyangs brtson gnang /lo der ma khe ḍo ni lnga'i rgyal po a leg gzen rnyi rgyang skyod kyi lam bar bsnyun nas sku 'das/ a then si ba rnams glags der bstun nas ma khe ḍo ni yu'i drag spyod la ngo rgol bgyis pas/ a ri si 'o 'e mi 'bro thabs med byung / yin na'ang / ma khe 'o ni lngas dpung chen gyi sde bkol nas ghi ri si ba rnams cham la phab/ a then si slar yang dbang 'og tu bcad de mi mang mthar skyod gtong /e phe kho'i ro dang khong gi a pha yang khe lo h+phin du sgyugs/ rjes su yang le si bho gling phran dang ya zhi ya chung du bzhud de slob grwa btsugs shing / e phe kho'i ro rang nyid kyis mtshan nyid rig pa'i bslab khrid gnang /spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo 306lo ste/ e phe kho'i ro phyogs mthar ldom nas lo yi bgrangakhya bcu phrag lhag 'gor rjes/ a then sir phyir 'byor te gnas gzhi bzung / khong la grogs bshes 'gas rogs byas nas me tog dga' tshal du slob gling zhig btsugs pas/ mi rnams kyis der me tog dga' tshal pa'i grub mtha' (7༅lhacho)zhes btags/ slob gling de'i nang dbul po/ bud med dang bran g.yog bsdus te slob sbyong byas stabs/ ghi ri si'i slob gling mang po las ches blo sgo gsal pa zhig red/ slob gling du sgrig lam dam zhing ༵༵ ma

'dra mnyam dang phan tshun brtse ldan gyi sgo nas 'tsho ba rol bzhin mchis/ kho tshos blo sbyong gtso bor byas te shes yon la brtson pa las phyi'i zang zing gi dngos po tsam gyi 'tsho bar snang chung byed la/ kho tshos mi tshe'i dmigs yul ni spro skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba don du gnyer rgyur bzhed/ de bas na mi rnams kyis e phe kho'i ro la spro snang ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhes 'bod/ e phe kho'i ro rang nyid kyis slob gling du dpe khrid dang zhib 'jug gi las lo ngo sum cu lhag tu bgyis/ khong ni gzhung drang zhing gzhan phan che ba zhig ste/ a then sir 'bru rigs dkon skabs/ rang gis gron chung byas te rang skal slob bu tshor bgos pa dang / khong gi lus stobs mi bzang ste dus rgyun na ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar la/ 'on te nam yin kyang spro snang ldan pa'i sgos na ba'i bdud la ngo rgol byas/ khong gis da dung grogs bshes shig gi 'phrin yig tu/ba'i tshe srog mthar thug pas/ zag bcas kyi phung po'i sdug bsngal skad chas mtshon mi nus/ 'on kyang ngas nga tsho'i las don dang bsam blo dran tshe/ nga'i sems kyi spro bas sdug bsngal de dag zil gyis gnon zhes bris la/ e phe kho'i ro'i bsam blo yar thon dang mi gshes khyad 'phags shig yin stabs/ slob bu tsho'i khrod na snyan grags ha cang che/ khong gi slob bu dag gis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar dge rgan gyi rig gzhung la rtsis mthong byas pas/ khong gis btod pa'i grub mtha' ni lo ngo drug brgya lhag la mu mthud du dar thub byung /e phe kho'i ros bton pa'i spro snang ring lugs kyi gzhung don gyi rtogs dgos na/ thog mar rig gzhung de bton pa'i dus rabs kyi rgyab ljongs shes dgos te/ e phe kho'i ro'i mi tshe ni ghi ri si rigs gzhan gyis dbang 'og tu bcad cing mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi bran g.yog lam lugs nyams rgud du song la/ spyi tshogs zing 'tshub che ba'i dus su rol dgos byung ste/ ma khe ḍo ni yā di16 snyi ri si cham la phab par ma zad/ de'i rang dbang mnyam 'brel grong

khyer dang dmangs gtso'i chab srid rtsa brlag gtong nas bran bdag sku drag gi sger dbang lam lugs kyi dbang gcod slar gso bgyis shing / kho tsho'i dbang 'og tu tshud pa'i i jib tu brjid nyams ldan pa'i grong khyer chen po a leg gzin zli btsugs te/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas tshan rig gsar ba'i gzhir byas pas/ sngar gyi a then si'i go gnas nyams smad du gyur/ ma khe ḍo ni yur rgyab brten pa'i bran bdag sku drag tshos khengs dregs gtum spyod dang bag med rgyas spros kyi 'tsho ba rol pa dang / bran bdag chung 'bring la 'thab 'khrug gi gnod pa thebs te sngar gyi go gnas las nyams pa dang / mi ser spyir btang ba tsho'i 'tsho ba nyin bzhin je zhan du song la/ rgya che'i bran g.yog gi gnas bab ya nga ba'i gnas su gyur/ spyi tshogs byings la skyo snang / re chad dngaskyi g.ya' bas mnar/ mi tsho sngar mnyam 'brel grong khyer gyi lam lugs 'og thun mong gi don la sems khur dang spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang tshul yal te thabs gang yod kyis dka' ngal la bros byol byed cing rang gi bde 'jags don du gnyer bar 'bad/ de 'dra'i bsam phyogs kyi shugs rkyen 'og mtshan nyid rig pa bas zhib 'jug bgyid pa'i gzhi tsa'ang rang byung khams kyi chos rnams kyi 'byung rtsa las 'gyur te mi tshe'i kun spyod kyi gnad la phyogs par gyur/skabs der/ phe lā cho slob gling gi slob gtso rabs gsum pa si no khi lā tshes phe lā 'o'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang chos lugs rmongs dad mnyam du sbrel nas lha 'dre dang rnam shes mi 'jig pa'i lta ba bsgrags spel byas pas/ mi rnams kyi yid kyi 'jigs skrag je cher song / si lha lngar 'bod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi grub mtha' yizhig gis las dbang smra ba (ṣ+ṭha ྅)dang 'dod spang ring lugs kyi lta ba dril bsgrags byas te/ mi rnams kyis las dbang brtsi dgos shing /ri dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod spro snang gi 'dod yon 'tshol bar ngo rgol byed/ da rung mtshan nyid rig pa ba phe ron /ḍā k+ṣe

957500)zer bas 'thus tshab byas pa'i som nyi ring lugs kyi grub mtha' zhig gis/ bla na med pa'i dge ba ni dpyad 'jog ci yang mi byed pa yin zhes bsgrags/ kho tshos mis ni chos gang la'ang yin min dang dge sdig sogs kyi khyad par mi 'byed cing tha na phyi rol gyi 'pho 'gyur gyis rang sems mi g.yo ba bya dgos par bstan/ de 'dra'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo byung pa dang dar spel du song pa ni/ skabs der ghi ri si'i bran bdag 'ga'i nyams rgud kyi dus su thabs zad dang mngon sum gyi skyo snang gi yid byed la g.yol thabs byed pa mtshon la/ yang don dngos su bran bdag sku drag dbang sgyur log spyod mkhan gyi dgos mkho dang bstun pas/ mi rnams kyi sems khams la gnod skyon gtong bzhin yod do//de ltar bsam blo'i khyab khongs su mun nag dang rtog rdzob kyi dri mas bkang ba'i dus su/ e phe kho'i ros mang 'dod khyad sel gyis dngos gtso ring lugs kyi dar cha mthon por bsgrengs te/ rte mo khu re khro'i rdul phran gyi gzhung lugs kyi rgyun bskyangs shing gong du spel nas spro snang ring lugs dang lha med smra ba'i rig gzhung bton/ khong gis mtha' gcig tu chos lugs rmongs dad dang las dbang smra bar dgag rgol bgyis pas/ skabs de dang phyis kyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blor shugs rkyen 'gran pa'i do dang bral ba thebs so//e phe kho'i ro'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo'i gzhi ni mi chos kyi gnad de/ khong gis mi su yin kyang tshang mas nges par rang dbang rang mos kyis 'jig rten mi yul gyi bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba gnyer zhing myong dgos la/ spro snang thob pa ni mi tshe'i bde skyid ches chen por bzhed/ spro snang ni mis bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba gnyer ba'i thog ma yin la de'i dmigs yul yang yin pas/ spro snang ni rdo ༵ 'dir gnyer bya'i bla na med pa'i dge ba'o zer/ khong gi zhal nas/

nged cag gi blang dor gang yin spro snang ldan min gyis gzhi bya dgos shing /nged cag gi mthar thug gi dmigs yul yang spro snang thob rgyu las lta ci/ zhes gsungs/ e phe kho'i ros spro snang ni ches gtsigs chen gyi sar bzhag pas/khong gi mi chos kyi rig gzhung la mi tshos spro snang ring lugs zhes 'dogs par byed do//ci zhig ni spro snang (bde ba) yin zhe na/ e phe kho'i ros/ nga tshos bshad pa'i spro snang ni lus sems kyi sdug bsngal med pa'am/ yang na gdos bcas kyi phung po'i bde thang dang sems kyi zhi gnas shig la zer gsungs/khong gis spro snang ni dge ba dang / sdug bsngal ni sdig pa yin la/ spro snang ni sdug bsngal med pa ste/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshe spro snang 'byung mi srid/ de gnyis ni lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi dngos 'gal yin zer/ yin na'ang phyogs cig shos nas bltas na/ spro snang dang sdug bsngal yang phan tshun 'brel zhing phan tshun gnas 'gyur byed rung zhig yin te/ khong gis spro snang ngam bde ba bde ba yin kyang / gal te de las che ba'i bde ba yod tshe/ gnas skabs kyi sdug bsngal dang len byas te bde ba chen po thob thabs bya dgos gsungs/'di'i gnad ni de dag gi chod dpag dang bdams gsas la thug cing / de'i tshadagazhi ni tshon 'dzin dang chog shes so// gal te tshod 'dzin mi byed cing chog shes mi bsten na spro snang ngam bde ba'ang sdug bsngal du 'gyur te/ dper na/ bza' btung la tshod 'dzin ma byas na rgyu ma dang pho ba'i nad thon pa bzhin no// de las ldog ste rtsal sbyong hur thag byas na lus bde thang la phan pas/ nga tshos nges par dka' tshegs la mi 'jigs par rtsal sbyong rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos so// e phe kho'i ro'i bde sdug dang dge sdig gi 'brel ba'i bshad par gdod ma'i rtsod sgrub smra ba'i lta ba ldan pas yar thon gyi don snying dang bcas so// 139

lus kyi bde ba dang sems kyi bde ba gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i thad/ e phe kho'i ros/ gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po'i bde ba ni bde ba thams cad kyi rmang gzhi ste/ lus kyi bde ba med tshe/ bde ba gzhan yod mi srid par 'dod do// khong gi zhal nas/ gal te dga' phyogs kyi spro snang ngam bde ba phyung zhing /brtse dung gi spro snang dang mthong thos kyi bde ba phyung tshe/ bdag la da rung dge ba zer ba zhig ji ltar 'char kho bos mi shes/ zhes dang / dge ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni yi ga'i spro snang ngam bde ba'o// zhes gsungs/ yin na'ang / khong niganas bab de'i bde myong ring lugs pa ltar ma bsdad par lus bde khas len byed pa dang mnyam du de bas kyang sems kyi bde ba brnan bshad byas 'dug ste/ khong gis bltas na gdos bcas sha khrag gis grub pa'i phung po'i tshor bde nges par dgos mod/ 'on te de ni gnas skabs tsam du 'gyur 'gro bas/ sems kyi bde ba ni da gzod rgyun ring zhing gting zab la brtan po zhig tu 'dod/ rgyu mtshan des ni mir blo rig gsal bar byed cing tshod 'dzin dang chog shes bsten shes par bgyis nas sems kyi bde skyid myong ngo // khong gis spro snang ngam bde ba mthar thug myong ba'i lam mchog ni/ phyi'i zang zing gi 'dod yon je nyung du gtong nas ngan ngon gyi 'tsho ba rol dgos pa de yin par bzhed/ de dang dus mnyam khong gis sems kyi 'tsho ba'ang gal chen du 'dzin par bgyid do//sems kyi bde ba'am spro snang mngon du 'gyur pa'i ched du/ e phe kho'i ros lha med smra ba'i bsam blo bton te/ gnas skabs der dar khyab che ba'i chos lugs rmongs dad la dgag pa mdzad/ khong gis rnam shes kyi zhi gnas thob dgos na/ mi rnams kyi nges par du lha 'dre dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las grol dgos par 'dod/ khong gis rte mo khu re 'o'i rdul phran gzhung lugs kyi /10 bzung ste 'jig rten gyi yod tshad rdul phran dang stong pas grub la/ lha
