dkon mchog yin par 'dod do//gong gleng dag la gzhigs na/ tho ma si'i 'jig rten smra ba'i sgrub dpang dang dmigs yul smra ba'i sgrub dpang gnyis kyis ni bya dngos bye brag pa'i gzhi grub dang 'gul skyod las lha dkon mchog gzhi grub par bsgrub 'dod pa yin la/ 'di ni a ri si 'o tshe'i rgyu bzhi smra ba (༅༅7)dang rnam pa'i rgyu dang rgyu cha'i rgyu smra ba zhes pa lha'i rig pa sgrub dpang byed par bod spyod byas pa ste/ a ri si 'o tshe'i bzhed pa ltar na/ rnam pa'i rgyu dang rgyu cha'i rgyu ni bya dngos kyi kha phral mi rung pa'i phyogs gnyis yin zhing / rgyu cha'i rgyu ni rnam pa'i rgyu'i rjes su 'gro la/ rgyu cha'i rgyu'am bya dngos bye brag par brten nas kyang rnam pa'i rgyu khong du chud par brten bya dngos gzhi grub pa'i mthar thug gi rgyu la'ang gtugs thub po// tho ma sis rigs gzhung 'dir lha'i rig pa'i phyi lus g.yogs par bgyis te/ chos thams cad gzhi grub pa'i mthar thug gi rgyu rkyen ni ci sems 'grub pa'i lha dkon mchog tu bzhed do// khong gis bkod pa'i sgrub dpang de ni o'u se lim gyi gzugs nyid smra ba'i sgrub dpang las ha lam tha mal ba'i khyad chos dang sgrub byed kyang je mang du song 'dug yin na'ang nga tshos der zhib dpyad byas tshe khong gi sgrub dpang la rang steng gi nor 'khrul yod pa yang mthong sla'o//tho ma si'i 'jig rten smra ba'i sgrub dpang zhes par gtso bo ngos 'dzin thad kyi nor 'khrul gnyis byung 'dug ste/ dang po ni/ khong gis 'jig rten steng gi 'gul skyod yod tshad thabs sla mos 'gyur med 'gul skyod (7767)du bsdus so// rang byung khams su dngos gnas gnas 'gyur gyi 'gyur med 'gul skyod yod mod/ 'on te gal srid de nyid ltos med can du byas nas rang byung khams su 'gul skyod kyi ngang tshul gcig pur 'dod na/ nges par du rang byung khams las gzhan du thog ma'i skul 'ded mkhan 1sdusal

dgos par thug rgyu mtshan thog ma'i skul 'ded mkhan med tshe/ rang byung khams nas 'gyur med 'gul skyod cig 'byung mi srid do// don dam par 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad 'gul skyod byed pa'i ches mthar thug pa'i 'byung khungs dang 'gul shugs ni de'i nang du gnas pa'i 'gal ba'i rang bzhin la rag las yod pa las 'jig rten gyi phyi rol gyi chos gang la'ang gtan nas thug med/ der brten/ tho ma sis sgrig bkod byas pa'i thog ma'i skul 'ded mkhan ni lha dkon mchog ste/ de ni dngos yod 'jig rten gyi nang drungs nas gzhi ma grub pa zhig go/ nor 'khrul gnyis pa ni/ khong gis rgyu rkyen dang 'bras bu'i bar dang / ldog med rang bzhin dang glo bur rang bzhin bar gyi rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba so sor phral 'dug la/ rgyu rkyen dang 'bras bur mtshon na de gnyis ni rtsod sgrub kyi gcig gyur zhig red/ 'jig rten steng rgyu rkyen la ma bltos pa'i 'bras bu zhig gzhi ma grub la/ 'bras bu med pa'i rgyu rkyen zhig kyang gzhi ma grub pas/ rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba ni zad mtha' bral pa'i rgyun ldan zhig yin no// yin na'ang tho ma sis de gnyis kyi rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba so sor phral nas rang 'dod kyis rgyu rkyen gang yang med pa las byung pa'i thog ma'i rgyu zhes pa blo bzo byas la/ de 'dra'i chos thams cad gzhi grub kyi thog ma'i rgyu ni dngos yod 'jig rten gyi khrod du'ang de dang mtshungs par gzhi ma grub po// tho ma si'i dmigs yul smra ba'i sgrub dpang zhes pa'i nor 'khrul rang bzhin ni de bas kyang gsal te/ khong gis bya dngos bye brag pa'i phyi rol du bya dngos bye brag par kha lo bsgyur pa dang bkod 'doms gnang ba'i blo gros mkhan zhig yod par byas shing / des na de 'dra'i blo gros mkhan de ni spyi mtshan dang lkog tu gyur pa'i bsam pa'i dngos gzugs zhig las ma 'das pas/ gang la bltas kyang 'di dang o'u se lim gyis lta tshul las lha dkon mardokā /sgrubs pa gnyis la khyad par mi 'dug ste tshang ma 'phrul snang gi gzhi

grub cig yin pas so// der bltas na tho ma sis sgrub byed 'god tshul ni mngon sum gyi bya dngos bye brag pa la yin na'ang / des bsgrub pa'i lha dkon mchog ni sngar ltar khong gi klad pa'i nang du shar tsam las phyi rol dngos gnas kyi rang bzhin mi ldan pas/ tho ma si dang o'u se lim rnam gnyis kyi bsgrub tshul mi gcig kyang 'bab sa gcig tu babs 'dug go/ spyir drungs nas gzhi ma /ba zlo'i cho~X sheg ji ltar bsgrub kyang gzhi grub kyi gnas su gtan nas 'a da lha sgre /ga pa//sa bden don ston mi nus la/ yin na'ang tho ma sis spel pa'i lha'i rig pa'i ma lag la mtshon na snga dus kyi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang bsdur tshe/ de'i bsam gzhigs kyi nus shugs dang rigs gzhung gi chu tshad gang la bsams kyang gong 'phel chen po byung yod pas/ des ni chos tshogs la rigs gzhung med pa'i nyen las thar par byas pa ma zad/ da dung dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig par skul ma byas te dar ba'i rtser son/ der brten snga dus tho ma sis ma nyes kha g.yogs dang bston btsugs pa sogs myong na'ang / dus kyi 'khor mo rim bzhin bzhud pa dang bstun nas myur gyis chos tshogs kyis mthong chen gyi gnas su bkod de/ lha'i pho nya 'bum rams pa zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / chos tshogs kyis da rung khong nyid gdan drangs nas yul gru so sor dpe khrid byas te bsam blo khyab spel du gtong / mthar spyi lo 1274lor dpe khrid la phebs pa'i lam bar nas glo bur du sku 'das/ khong sku gshegs phyin chos tshogs kyis zhud bsgrags byas par brten nas sku bzhugs dus las kyang grags pa 'phel/ spyi lo 1323lor chos rgyal ( mcho)gyis 'phags pa'i mchan bu zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/ spyi lo 1829lor skabs de'i chos rgyal gyi bka' ltar/ tho ma si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ni gnam bdag chos lugs kyi nang mtshan nyid rig pa tshad ldan 'ba' zhig tu bgrangs shing /19/nga

gi gsung rtsom lha rig kun 'dus chen mo ni mchog gi sde snod dang lhan du nyar tshags byas so// de nas da lta'i bar tho ma si'i dgongs pa ni nub phyogs ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab khrod shugs rkyen shin tu che/ tho ma si'i ring lugs gsar mar 'bod pa de ni tho ma si a khe na'i lha'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi par bshus dang rgyud mthud yin la/ de bas na tho ma si a khe na'i lha'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs shes rtogs dang dgag spong byed par don snying nges can zhig ldan no//

sabacadabacubadun pa/ rno dbal ldan pa'ildanar2zhag 6sgom skyes kham/bzhar gri gleng ma thag tshang mas de ni mdzes bzo'i yo byad cig yin pa rang shugs kyis dran nges/ yin na'ang dus rabs bar ma'i skabs su rno dbal ldan pa'i bzhar gri zhig byung myong ste/ de ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i dbyin ji'i dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba we lem o kham (tsho mjo sag1111mal(gyismo'ims )zhes bya ba yin la/ der mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng o kham bzhar gri zhes 'bod par byed do//we lem o kham ni spyi lo 1300lor lon 'on dang thag nye ba'i o kham sde bar sku 'khrungs shing / yo rob gling gi ches mtha' mjug gi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba ming grags can zhig go/ 'on te khong gi dka' khag myong tshul ni tho ma si a khe na sogs snga dus kyi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba dag dang gtan nas mi mtshungs so// khong la chos tshogs kyis mthong chen ma byas par ma zad/ de las ldog ste chos tshogs kyis dus rgyun rdung rdeg byas/ sbyi lo 1309lor/ khong o khu si spror ḍi slob chen (lha lkolha (71016 )du song ste lha'i rig pa'i gzhung la sbyong brtson byas shing sbyangs 'bras g.yur du za bar gyur/ mthar phyin dus lha'i rig pa'i shes rams pa'i mtshan rtags thob po//skabs de'i srol la shes rams pa'i mtshan rtags thob pa zhig yin tshe/ slob grwa'i nang nas lha'i rig pa'i slob tshan gyi dpe khrid bgyid chog mod/ stu /ma

gyis de'i thob thang nyams su myong ma thub/ gnas bab de'i o khu si sgor ḍi slob chen gyi slob gtsos khong la slob khrid byed du ma bcug par ma zad/ lkog nas lta ba log yod ces chos tshogs la gtugs pas/ lo ngo bzhi'i ring btson nas sdod dgos byung / spyi lo 1328lo'i zla 5ba'i nang khong gis lus phung dang bsam blo'i mnar gcod ma bzod par btson las bros te/ skabs der chos tshogs dang 'gal ba yod pa'i 'jar man gyi gong ma bha h+pha le yar (༅7tsho༅)mgo bcol zhus/ bshad rgyun ltar na/ khong gis gong mar khyod kyis ral gris nga srung skyob gyis dang / ngas ni smyu gus khyod nyid srung skyob byed ces gsungs par bshad/ de rjes khong rnam gnyis phan tshun grogs tan byas nas chos tshogs la 'thab rtsod byas la/ spyi lo 1347lor gong ma bha h+pha le ya sku gshegs pas/ o kham slar yang kher rkyang grogs med kyi gnas su lhung / spyi lo 1349lor/ khong yang bskyar chos tshogs kyi khrims sar 'gro dgos byung yang nyes pa til tsam khas ma blangs shing / lo der khong la gnas skabs der yo rob gling du 'gos khyab che ba'i nad yams byi rams zhes pa phog ste sku 'das so//dus rabs bar ma'i skabs dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ni chos tshogs kyi gzhung don sgrub dpang byed spyad yin la/ o kham ni de'i mtshan nyid pa zhig yin pas/ ci'i phyir chos tshogs kyis mnar gcod byas she na/ nga tshos de shes dgos na nges par du gnas bab de dus kyi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa nang khul gyi 'thab rtsod la rgyus lon dgos pa red/dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ni dus rabs bar mar dbang bsgyur go gnas zin pa'i dpon phyogs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa yin zhing / snga phyir bar ma chad par bgrang bya brgya phrag 'ga' song / yin na'ang / dgon sde'i mardo/ spyad rig pa'ang 'gyur med cig ga la yin te/ grub mtha' 'di byung ba

nyid nas nang khul du phyogs 'gal dang 'gal zla gnas pas/ phan tshun bar rtsod gleng tsha drag pa byung myong / de'i khrod kyi rtsod gleng mang po zhig ni stongs gtam tsam du zad de/ dper na/ lha dkon mchog gi sras la 'chi rgyu yod med dang / khab rtse gcig la lha'i pho nya ji 'dra langs thub pa dang / mi zhig gis phag khrid de tshong rar song pa la/ mis phag khrid pa red dam thag pas phagakhrid pa red sogs rtsod bzhin yod/ rtsod gzhi 'di dag gis gzhan la dgod slong byed tsam las shes bya gsar ba 'don mi nus/ yin na'ang rtsod gzhi gzhan dag gi nang na'ang mtshan nyid rig pa'i don snying ldan pa'i gnad don gal chen zhig yod de/ de ni ji ltar spyi dang bye brag gi 'brel ba'i gnad la blta ba red/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i khyab byed ces pa thun mong rang bzhin dang / khyab bya zhes pa ni bya dngos bye brag pa'o// dper na/ lis (sa)ni sil tog yin zhes pa'i brjod gzhi 'dir mtshan nyid rig pa'i brda ched ltar na/ lis zhes pa khyab bya (4/ rmi/1)ste/ de ni bltas na mthong la reg na 'phrad pa'i bya dngos bye brag pa red/ sil tog ni khyab byed (r+shalo)de/ de ni lis dang / ku shu/ ngang lag(cha )tsha li ma sogs sil tog bye brag pa mang po las spyi mtshan phyogs gcig tu bsdus pas grub pa'i go don zhig yin la/ de ni spyi tsam dang / mthong mi thub pa/ reg mi nus pa zhig yin pas don spyi tsam la brten nas khong du chud par bya ba zhig go/ skabs de dus kyi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba tshos spyi dang bye brag gang dngos gnas shig yin min gyi gnad rtsod gleng mang po byas myong / kha cig lis lta bu'i dngos po bye brag pa gzod dngos su gzhi grub pa yin te/ sil tog ces pa ni spyir mi'i rtog pas btags tsam las byung pa'i chos shig red zer/ phyogs 'di la ming gtso smra ba (ṣ+ṭha77) zhes 'bod/ yang phyogs cig shos kyis sil tog lta bu'i go don spyir btang pa ni dngos su gzhi grub ste/ de ni rang skya ba'i dngos //sdus

rigs shig la/ lis lta bu'i rigs bye brag pa tshang ma sil tog gi go don las 'phros pa yin stabs dngos ma zhig min no zer/ de bas na phyogs 'di la dngos gnas smra ba (r+sā47)zhes 'bod do// gong du gleng zin pa'i o'u se lim dang tho ma si a khe na sogs ni dngos gnas smra ba pa yin te/ khong chos lhadakon mchog gzhi grub tu bsgrub pa'i thabs lam mi 'dra yang tshang mas lha dkon mchog gi ches spyir btang pa'i rang skyar gzhi grub kyis sngon 'gro byed pa khas len la/ khong tshos gzhigs na lha dkon mchog ni bya dngos bye brag pa gang la bsdur yang ches cha yongs khyab dang ches lkog gyur yin par ma zad ches dngos gnas pa zhig kyang yin stabs/ 'jig rten steng gi chos bye brag pa thams cad 'di la brten nas byung par bzhed do//we lam o kham gyi lta ba dngos gnas smra ba dang gtan nas ltag sprod du song yod de/ khong gis bya dngos bye brag pa ni gzod dngos su gzhi grub ste/gzhi grub ni bye brag gi gzhi grub yin no// gal te bya dngos bye brag pa bsal na thams cad kyang med par 'gyur pa yin no// spyi mtshan mi rnams kyis bya dngos 'dra mtshungs mang po mtshon par byed pa'i rtags dang ming tsam bkod pa las bya dngos bye brag pa'i phyi rol tu gzhi grub pa'i rang skya ba'i dngos gzugs shig drungs nas min no zer/ khong gis 'di'i ming gtso smra ba'i lta ba gzhir bzung ste sngar bas gom gang mdun spos kyis dngos gnas smra ba'i nor 'khrul la dgag bzhag gnang / khong gis dngos gnas smra mkhan dag gis bya dngosakhye brag pa'i phyi rol tu dngos gzugs kyi rnam pa zhig blo bzo byas pa lhag ma ste/ des ni bya dngos ngos 'dzin la phan ci yang mi thogs pa'i phyir te/rtsa don 'ga' spyod nus dus rtsa don mang po bkol pa ni dus tshod chud zos su gtong pa las ma 'das par dmigs nas/ dgos nges med tshe dngos gaḥ/sdu snon gtan nas mi 'os pa'i bsam gzhigs dpal 'byor gyi don

bton la/ khong gis bltas na/ dngos gnas smra mkhan dag dngos gzugs bsnan zin na/ dpal 'byor rtsa don gyi bzhar gris de dag 'breg dgos par bstan pas/ 'di ni o kham bzhar gri zhes pa'i byung khungs red/ der gzhigs tshe/ o kham bzhar gri zhes pa ni don dam par dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa nang khul du ming gtso smra bas dngos gzugs smra bar dgag bzhag byed pa'i bsam blo'i drag chas shig yin la/ o kham yang de nas bzung ming gtso smra ba'i 'thus tshab gtso bor gyur to//ming gtso smra ba dang dngos gnas smra ba'i 'gal ba phyi tsam nas bltas na ha lam tshig 'khri'i rtsed 'jo la rol bar 'dra bas/ o kham bzhar gris kyang chos tshogs la gnod nyen thebs mi nus par 'dra mod/ 'on te gal srid nga tshos gnas bab de'i lo rgyus cha rkyen gzhir byas nas dpyad na/ tshig 'khri tsam gnyer ba'i shugs su gting zab pa'i chos lugs/ chab srid dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang don 'dus yod pas/ o kham bzhar gri ni lha'i rig pa'i nang sbyil r+shas chos tshogs dang lha'i rig par snun byed kyi rno dbal ldan pa'i ral gri ga o/ kham bzhar gris dngos gnas smra mkhan gyis rtog bzo byas pa'i dngos gzugs 'breg 'dod pa ni/ don dngos su rgyud dag ye shu'i chos lugs kyi gzhung don khas len bzhed med pas yin la/ rgyu mtshan rgyud dag gi gzhung don gang yin kyang tshang mar lha dkon mchog 'di'i dngos gzugs kyi gzhi grub khas len pa sngon 'gro byas pa'i phyir ro// de bas na ming gtso smra ba dang dngos gnas smra ba'i 'thab rtsod kyis ni chos tshogs nang khul du rgyud dag dang rgyud dag ma yin pa'i bar gyi 'thab rtsod mtshon 'dug ste/ dper na/—ye shu'i chos lugs kyis mchod 'bul byed skabs tshang mas nges par lha bshos (60)gsol ston bshams te bag leb dang rgyan 'brum gyi chang 27/sa

dgose shing / de ni spyir za ma spyir btang ba zhig yin kyang chos tshogs kyis lha bshos la lkog gyur gyi tshon ris kyis byugs ched btsan gyis lha dkon mchog gis gnang ba yin zer/ kho tshos bag leb ni 'jig rten mgon po'i (70)sku lus dang / rgyan 'brum ni de'i khrag yin stabs/ rjes 'jug dad ldan dag de dag bzhes na 'jig rten mgon po dang sbrel nus shing bla med kyi gnas shig tu bsleb par bshad/ yin na'ang ming gtso smra ba dag de ni nor 'khrul rmongs bshad du bzhed de/ lha bshos gsol ston steng bza' btung tshang ma spyir btang dang dngos po bye brag pa zhig yin pas/ ci'i phyir 'jig rten mgon po'i sku lus dang sku khrag tu 'gyur/ snga dus su ming gtso smra mkhan bhe lin cwa li zer pa zhig yod pa des/ gal te lha bshos gsol ston steng ngo mas 'jig rten mgon po'i sku lus zos pa yin na/ de'i lus mchod rten chen po'i tshad dang mnyam yang mi mang 'di 'dras snga dus nas zos tshar zin zhes zur za rno ngar can gnang / yang dper na/ rgyud dag gzhung don du gnas gsum gzugs gcig smra ba'i gzhung lugs zhud brjod byas te/ 'phags yab/'phagasasras dang 'phags pa'i dgongs pa bcas gnas gsum du yod kyang mthar lha dkon mchog gcig pur 'du par 'dod/ de'i rgyu mtshan lha dkon mchog ni ches yongs khyab dang / yang ches dngos gnas kyang yin pas red/ming gtso smra mkhan tshos bye brag pa'i dngos gnas rang bzhin brnan bshad byas nas de'i gzhung don la som nyi dang khas len mi rung ba bton/ ming gtso smra mkhan lo si lin (707)gyis/ 'phags yab/ 'phags sras dang 'phags pa'i dgongs pa gzugs gcig tu 'dus pa ni mi zhig kho rang nyid yin par ma zad dus mtshungs su kho rang nyid kyi a pha dang bu bcas yin pa dang 'dra bas 'chal gtam du zad do/ zhes gsungs/ yang dper na/ ye shuswā /sna lugs kyi gzhung don gal chen cig shos ni gdod ma'i nyes ltung smra ba

yin la/ de'i don ni don dngos su 'gro ba mi'i rigs zhes pa'i go don rang skya ba'i dngos gzugs su byas nas blta ba zhig yin te/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi yab mes kyis nyes ltung gsog na de'i bu rgyud thams cad la'ang nyes pa lhan skyes su yod pas tshang mas yab mes kyi nyes pa sbyong thabs byed pa zhig go/ming gtso smra mkhan gyis de las ldog ste mi chos kun spyod kyi gtso gzhi (24)ni mi bye brag pa re yin stabs/ mi che ge mos nyes ltung gsog na kho rang nyid kyis 'gan len bya dgos pa dang / yab mes kyis de ltar byas na phyi rabs pas sbyang dgos don gtan nas med zer/ ming gtso smra mkhan a pe lhar gyis/lha dkon mchog gis mi zhig rang nyid kyi pha mas nyes ltung bsags par brten nas khor chad pa gcod pa ni sems yul la 'char dka' ba zhig red ces gsungs pa ltar/ ming gtso smra ba'i bsam blo ni rgyud dag dgon sde'i gzhung don dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du chas 'dug der chos tshogs kyis bltas na mu stegs 'chal gtam du zad pas nges par du drungs nas 'byin dgos par brten/ o kham lta bu'i ming gtso smra ba ni chos tshogs kyis mnar gcod bsun gtser byed pa'ang smos dgos so//o kham bzhar gris chos lugs kyi khyab khongs nang chos tshogs la gris bsnun par ma zad/ dza drag gi chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod khrod nas kyang chos tshogs la 'jigs skul rgya cher thebs/ yo rob bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs su ye shu'i chos lugs dbang bsgyur gral rim gyis bed spyad rjes/dpal 'byor dang chab srid nyin bzhin khyon cher phyin te rgyal mtshams las brgal ba'i chab srid kyi tshogs pa zhig tu gyur pas/ rgyal khab so so'i rgyal srid kyi dbang shugs la 'gran bsdur byas/ de ltar yo rob kyi dus rabs bar mar dmigs ldan gyi chos srid kyi dbang cha dang rgyal srid kyi dbang cha'i 'thab rtsod byung ba red/ chos dang srid kyi 'thab rtsod ni thir bshad na/ 27/sa

bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul gyi dbang cha rtsod res kyi 'thab rtsod cig yin la/ 'on te gnas bab de'i lo rgyus cha rkyen 'og rgyal srid kyi dbang cha ni spyir rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi rang btsan srung skyob dang thon skyed gong spel byed 'dod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi yar thon stobs shugs yin la/chos srid kyi dbang cha ni de las ldog ste de ni spyi tshogs kyi rul sungs shed shugs red do// spyi lo dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i gong rol la mtshon na/chos srid kyi dbang gtso che bas/ gong mar bya ba yod tshe chos rgyal la snyan 'bul zhu dgos la/ skabs de'i 'jar man gyi gong ma han re (jom/)gdung rabs bzhi ba lam lugs der ma mos pas/ mi mang po rtsa 'dzugs byas te dgag rgol bgyis mod/ chos rgyal gyi stobs shugs shin tu che stabs mthar cham la pham/ gong ma 'dis nyes chad khur nas chos rgyal gyi mdun sar 'gyod bshags dang kho rang nyid kyi chos gnas slar gso gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu dgos byung / skabs der chos rgyal des dzig nyams chen po bzhag nas/ gong ma de rkang rjen du kha ba'i nang nyin gsum la bzhengs su bcug rjes/ da gzod kho'i re thog tu bzhag der bltas na chos rgyal gyi btsan shed ni ji 'dra'i che ba zhig red ang /chos srid dang rgyal srid bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyi nang dngos gnas smra mkhan rnams chos rgyal gyi phyogs su langs nas chos dbang bla med smra ba'i lta ba bzung / de'i gzhung lugs kyi sgrub byed ni spyi bye brag dang bsdur na ches dngos gnas yin zhing spyi ni bye brag las mtho zer/ kho tshos bltas na/ chos tshogs ni rgyal mtshams brgal ba'i rtsa 'dzugs yin pas/ rgyal srid dbang cha gang la gzhigs kyang de bas dngos gnas pa yin stabs/ chos srid kyi dbang cha rang shugs kyis rgyal srid kyi dbang cha las mtho snyam mo// o kham rang gis ba/sdu ༵/ bye brag pa 'ba' zhig dngos gnas yin la/ spyi ni don gyis stong

pa'i ming btags tsam du 'dod/ de bas na rgyal srid ni chos tshogs las dngos gnas pa zhig ste/ rgyal srid kyi dbang cha ni nges par du chos srid kyi dbang cha las mtho dgos zer/ o kham ni rgyal srid kyi dbang char rgyab skyor dang cig shos la dgag pa byed do// khong chos tshogs kyi btson las bros rjes/de 'phral chos tshogs la dgag rgol byed pa'i gras su zhugs/ phal cher lo ngo gnyis kyi ring 'jar man gong ma'i srung skyob 'og chos dbang phyogs khag la mdong rtse kha sprod kyi 'thab rtsod byas pas/ chos tshogs kyis khong la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas ji ltar mi sdang ste sdang par byed do//o kham bzhar grir da rung mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi khyad chos ldan te/ de dang dngos gnas smra ba'i 'thab rtsod ni dngos gtso smra ba dang sems gtso smra ba'i 'thab rtsod dus rabs bar ma'i nang mngon pa'i rnam pakhyad par ba zhig red/ o kham gyis bya dngos bye brag pa'i phyi rol dngos gnas rang bzhin brnan bshad byas pas/ dngos gtso smra ba'i kha phyogs dang mthun la/ dngos gnas smra mkhan tshos bya dngos bye brag pa'i gzhi grub khas mi len zhing / spyi mtshan ni rang skya ba'i dngos gzugs su 'dod pas/ sems gtso smra ba kho na las ma 'das so// de ni le nyin gyis/ dus rabs bar ma'i ming gtso smra mkhan dang dngos gnas smra mkhan gyi 'thab rtsod ni dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs bar gyi 'thab rtsod dang 'dra sa yod/phonaces gsungs pa ltar ro// 'on te 'dra sa zhes pa'i shugs las mtha' gcig tu mtshungs pa ma yin par bstan/ o kham dang bcas pa'i ming gtso smra mkhan tshang mas yang dag pa'i sgos spyi dang bye brag gi 'brel ba'i gnad 'byed thub med de/ khong tshos spyi mtshan ni ming btags dang brda mtshon (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)tsam dang rang rig gi 'byung chos su 'dod pas/ de lta na spyi mtshan gyi phyi rol dngos gnas rang bzhin khas ma blangs shing / de khas ma blangs na rang 2/snas

kyis sems gtso smra ba'i phyogs su lhung srid de/ don dngos su spyi mtshan ni bya dngos rang mtshan pa yang dag phyogs bsdus dang spyir bstan pa yin stabs/de la'ang gzhan dang mtshungs par phyi rol dngos gnas rang bzhin ldan no//spyi dang bye brag ni rtsod sgrub kyi gcig gyur te/ spyir bya dngos rang mtshan pa la brten na da gzod de rang nyid kyi gzhi grub mngon thub pa dang / bya dngos rang mtshan pa yang spyi mtshan dang bral nas rang skya bar tshugs thub tu gnas mi thub po// gnas lugs de dag skabs de'i o kham sogs ming gtso smra mkhan tshos rtogs ma nus pa dang / gzhan yang / o kham sogs ming gtso smra mkhan dag rgyud dag ye shu'i chos lugs kyi gzhung don la dogs pa zos na'ang /khong tshos chos lugs lha'i rig pa hril po nor 'chugs su bsgrub 'dod pa min la bsgrub kyang ga la nus/ khong tsho'i sems gtso smra ba'i phyogs 'gro dgongs pa phal mo che lha'i rig pa'i phyi lur brten nas 'grel bshad byas pa yin stabs/de'i bsam blo'i ma lag hril po lha'i rig pa'i dra rgya las thar med de/ de ni khong tsho 'tsho bzhugs kyi dus rabs dang gral rim langs phyogs kyis thag bcad pas red do// spyir zhan cha de 'dra yod na'ang / o kham bzhar gris lo rgyus kyi gong 'phel la phan nus chen po byung pa ni sus kyang bsnyon ga la nus/des rang gi nang khul nas dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa drungs nas phyung zhing /nye rabs kyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi myu gu 'bus pa'i gegs byed sel par ma rdzutā /yo/ ///da gong du 'phel bar bsam blo'i rgyu cha legs po zhig mkho sprod 206

sabacadabacobargyad pa/ bden don gyi ched du lus srog dul pa'i dpa' mdzangs 'thab mog ciwa bha ru no/spyi lo 1600lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 17nyin ni/ yo rob mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus dang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus stong gang la mtshon na shin tu yid skyo ba'i nyin zhig yin te/ rlabs che ba'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba bha ru no (bo 2la00)zhes bya ba nyin der chos tshogs kyis gson bsreg byas zin to//nyin de'i tho rengs chu tshod gnyis kyi steng / dbyi tha li'i ro ma'i me tog sos pa'i thang chen du da rung mtshan mun gyis g.yogs 'dug glo bur du tang tang zhes dma' la skyo snang ldan pa'i cong sgra re res kha khu sim po'i mtshan dgong gi bar snang gtor pas stongs ngam gyi thang chen sngar bas mun nag dang 'jigs su rung bar gyur/ cong sgra'i brag cha slar 'khor ba dang bstun gshed ma skor zhig gis dpa' 'bar bsgrengs shing / lwa ba hral hril dang sha skem lus rid du gyur pa'i bha ru no rgyab 'ded kyis thang chen du thon/ skabs thog btsugs pa'i me khrims gcod sar/ gshed ma dag gis khong gi btson lu btsan gyis bshus/ mu zir sbong pa'i ras leb lus la bskon cing / mu mthud du drang bden gyi 'bod sgra mi 'byin pa'i phyir shing gi 'jab tse khyad par ba zhig gis lce btsir/ de rjes chur sbong pa'i thag pas lus tham10 /da

bcings shing lcags sgrog gis gsal shing la bskyon/ bshad tshul ltar na lus bcing byed thag rlon mes 'tshig pa'i tshe je dam du song nas shar zug 'gro bas lhag par mnar zug che bar bshad do// sta gon tshang ma grub rjes/ gshed mas de 'phral phyogs bzhi'i shing gi yal gar me sbar/ de ma thag bha ru no'i mtha' 'khor du me lce dgung la mched cher gyur/ skabs der chos bdag ram 'digs pa zhig sngon du song nas rgya gram brgyang shing zhig bsnams te mdun du bzhag de ni ha lam ches mthar gnang pa'i mthol bshags kyi go glags shig yin par 'dra na'ang / zhum med kyi 'thab 'dzing pa des mthong chung gi tshul gyis zhal gzhan du bskor nas shi yang chos tshogs la mgo mi bsgur pa'i 'jigs bral dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i snying stobs phyi ru mngon par byas so//me lce sngar bas je cher song ste rim gyis khong gi lus mtha' bskor/mthar brtse bral gyi ngang khong gis lus srog khyur mid byas zin to//mi gson bsreg byed pa'i gdub rtsub kyi spyod lam der mi rnams sdang sems kyis bha ru nos khrims 'gal gang byas pa red/ chos tshogs kyis de ltar bya dgos don gang sogs 'dri bar byed la/ de ni 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus kyis nga tshor 'di ltar bstan yod de/ thos na skyi g.ya' ba'i khrims gcod de ni chos tshogs dang bha ru no rang nyid bar gyi 'gal ba zhig yin par ma zad/gnas bab de'i spyi tshogs steng gi shes ldan dang kla klo/ yar thon dang log spyod bar gyi khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab rtsod cig yin pa'ang mtshon yod do//sngonaspya lo dus rabs bcu bzhi bar/ yo rob gling du gsar dar ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thon skyed 'brel ba'i thog ma'i myu gu bha ru no'i mes rgyal dbyi tha li nas 'bus shing / gnas bab der dbyi tha li'i nyis kron rgya mtsho'i (lo 7)mtha' rgyud kyi grong khyer dper na we ne si dang h+pho lor ran si sogs ni khya༄ ༵༵ can gyi gnas kyi cha rkyen gyis mtsho 'grul dang tshong las sogs dang

'brel ba'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lag bzo'i bzo grwa shin tu dar che bas/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi shed shugs kyis gnas bab ha cang legs po bzung 'dug ste/bsam blo'i phyogs su 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsam blo'i 'thus tshab dper na snyan grags che ba'i rtsom pa bo ḍan khrir (42124121 )dang bho cwa chi sogs kyis 'thab rtsod kyi mdung rtse ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi rgyab rten gnam bdag chos tshogs dang chos lugs lha'i rig par gtad de/ khong tshos mi'i rang gshes 'ching 'grol dang rang dbang rtsod len/ mi'i rin thang dang la rgyar brtsi 'jog dgos par ma zad/ mi la brten nas lhar ngo rgol byas te/ gnam bdag chos tshogs dang chos lugs lha'i rigi pa'i 'ching rgya las bsgral nas rang 'dod kyis ma rtsa ring lugs kyi khe dbang gong 'phel du gtong pa'i dbang thob par bya dgos par 'dod/ 'di'i ma gzhi byas te chos lugs lha'i rig par dgag rgol byed pa'i bsam phyogs kyis dus yun ring po'i nang dbang bsgyur gyi go gnas bzung pa'i gnam bdag chos tshogs dang chos lugs lha'i rig par mtshon na ngo mas rdung rdeg chen po zhig thebs pas/chos tshogs kyi shed shugs dang re zhig ham dzig che ba'i 'ur langs sngar bas ches cher nyams smad du gyur/ der brten/ gnas bab de'i dbyi tha li la ni yo rob 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i lte gzhir 'bod do//yin na'ang dus rabs bco lnga ba'i mjug tu slobs tshe/ 'grul lam gsar ba'i sgo phye bar brten nas yo rob gling gi tshong 'brel gyi lte gzhi tis kron rgya mtsho nas nub kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i phyogs su gnas spos stabs/ de nas bzung dbyi ba li'i bzo tshong las kyi thad gnod pa chen po thebs rkyen 'byor ldan gral rim gyi stobs shugs kyang khyad kyis nyams rgyad du chas/skabs der sngar gnya' gnon myong pa'i chos tshogs kyis gzhi byas pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin chos lugs kyi shed shugs slar gsos byung pas/ ༵ /sa

gral rim dang chos lugs bar gyi 'khon 'dzin gyis lta ba gzhan dag tshar bcad/ ming ngan kun la khyab pa'i ro ma'i chos lugs khrims gcod khang krung dbyang khrims ra zhes pa de dus byung pa red/ 'on te 'gro ba mi'i rigs shes rig dang yar thon gyi phyogs su bskyod pa ni log spyod shed shugs gang gis kyang 'gog mi nus so// ro ma'i mkha' dbyings su sprin nag 'khrigs shing dri bro ba'i char rlung ldang na'ang / bden don gyi rjes su bsnyeg pa'i dpa' bo tshos sngar ltar thabs sna tshogs kyis blun rmongs dang log spyod kyi phyogs la spobs pa zhum med kyis 'thab rtsod lhur len byed la/ bha ru no ni skabs de dus kyi sngon thon ru khag gras kyi phul byung sku tshab cig go/bha ru no ni nyams dmas su song pa'i sku drag cig gi khyim du 'khrungs/dgung lo bcu bdun gyi tshe/ gong mtho ba'i slob yon sprod ma nus par chos tshogs kyis tshugs pa'i dge sgrub khang du mi zhugs thabs med byung / de rjes lo ngo bcu drug bar gyi dge sgrub khang gi 'tsho ba'i nang / bha ru nos lha'i rig pa'i gzhung la zhib tu sbyangs mod kyang / chos tshogs kyi rul sungs su gyur pa'i gnas tshul la rgyus che ba'i rkyen gyis/ khong chos tshogs dang lha'i rig par brtse dung gi cha nas sems gting nas 'khon 'dzin che ste/ khong gis/ mi rnams kyis grwa ba zhes pa'i yi ge gnyis po bshad dus/ des ni rmongs dad dang brkam chags/ g.yo rdzus dang sdig nyes bcas kyi 'dus ming zhig bstan to// zhes gsungs myong la/ thengs shig khong thugs khros nas ye shu'i sku brnyan sge'u khung gi phyi rol tu 'phangs te mi tshos sku brnyan la mchod 'bul byed pa ni drungs nas phan thogs med pas nor 'khrul red zer/ gnas tshul de chos tshogs kyis shes pas khong la mnar gcod tshad med gtong / bha ru no ni lha'i rig par sun snang shin tu che la/ yin kyang yar thon gyi glegs bam la dkārdo byen tshad med ldan stabs/ dus rgyun nyin mtshan bar med du dpe klog

la 'bad cing / ghi sgye ne'i (cha khu)skar ma'i go la 'khor skyod sogs gzhung mang po ni dge sgrub khang nas bklags so//tshan rig dang chos lugs ni phan tshun 'dres mi nus te/ bha ru no'i klad par nyin bzhin tshan rig shes bya dang yar thon bsam blo je mang du bsags pas/ rang shugs kyis dngos yod kyi chos tshogs dang lha'i rig par phog thug 'byung pa smos ma dgos/ de ltar yun ring du bsags gnyer byas pa'i mthar nyin zhig dge sgrub khang gis btsugs pa'i rtsod gleng tshogs 'du'i steng thams cad kyis log lta mkhan tshor dmod 'dor dang dgag rgol byed skabs/bha ru no der yar bzhengs shing sgrub byed kyis log lta mkhan dag bden sgrub byas/ der brten nas dad ldan rjes 'jug dag ma dga' bar gshe gshe dang khrel dgod byed cing mchil ma 'phen pa sogs tha na khu tshur dang bcas pa steng du babs/ spyod brlang gis mtha' bskor ba'i khrod khong gis 'tsho ba rol ma nas par/ mtshan dgong der grogs bshes kyis rogs byas par brten dge sgrub khang nas bros byol du thon/ de nas bzung khong gis lo bcu drug ring rol ba'i grwa ba'i 'tsho ba mtshams bzhag khong de ltar bros phyin chos lugs khrims gcod khang gis mtshams ma bskyur bar sngar mus bzhin sngog bsher rtsad gcod byas shing ma nyes khag g.yogs kyi nyes chad bcu phrag lhag mgor bzhag mthar thabs zad de bha ru no khong nyid mes rgyal dang bral nas yul gru gzhan du 'khyam pas/ de nas bzung sku tshe phyed phyi ma'i dka' ngal ldan pa'i ldom po'i 'tsho ba rol dgos byung ngo //lo ngo bcu phrag ring la ldom pa'i dus su/ bha ru no khong nyid snga phyir lji ne+e wa ( brams6khub057 )dang / h+pha ran se/ dbyin ji/ 'jar man sogs yul gru mang por gnas bcas shing / 'tsho bar dka' khag chen po myong bar ma zad/ da rung dus rgyun gnas de ga'i chos tshogs dang chab srid ༵ /gra

bos gnod ci thebs byas so// 'on tekhong nyid de tsam la brten nas spobs pa zhum ma myong bar sngar bzhin glags gang rnyed bed spyad de chos lugs lha'i rig par 'thab 'dzing lhod med bgyis shing / sngon gyi lo ngo bcu drug po dang bsdur tshe cung zad mi 'dra sa ni skabs 'di dus kyi bha ru nos gsung rtsom mang du spel pas rang nyid kyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi ma lag cig grub la/ snga dus brtse dung tsam dang snying stobs tsam la brten te 'thab rtsod byed pa gong du 'phel nas rigs dpyad dang tshan rig spyad de chos lugs lha'i rig pa hril por 'gran rtsod byed par gnas gyur to//lha dkon mchog ni chos tshogs dang lha'i rig pas shed gang yod kyis skyabs su bskur ba'i khyad 'phags dad yul zhig ste/ chos tshogs kyis lha dkon mchog ni 'jig rten gyi phyi rol tu rang skya bar gzhi grub pa'i dngos gzugs shig dang / de ni 'jig rten gyi byed po dang skul 'ded mkhan yin par ma zad/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la bkod 'doms gnang mkhan du sgrog spel byas so//de bas na lha dkon mchog ni bla na med pa'i dbang chen kho na yin stabs/mi rnams de la dad pa 'gyur med bya ba las sim nyi cung zad kyang gtan nas skye mi 'os la/ skabs de'i tshan rig rig gnas dang 'gro ba mi'i bsam gzhigs kyi chu tshad kyi bkag rgya bcas kyi rkyen dbang gis lha dkon mchog gzhi grub par khas mi len mkhan med la yod kyang mi srid do//yin na'ang khong gis bshad pa'i lha dkon mchog dang lha'i rig pas bskur ba'i lha dkon mchog gnyis la khyad par yod 'dug ste/ khong gis lha dkon mchog ni rang byung khams kyi phyi rol na gzhi grub pa'i rang skya'i dngos gzugs sheg ma yin par/ de ni rang byung khams su gzhi grub cing / rang byuX /snas kyi bya dngos rang mtshan par brten nas mngon pa zhig dang / rang

byung khams kyi chos nyid kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa zhig tu bzhed pas/ der bltas na/ 'di'i skabs kyi lha dkon mchog la ni lkog gyur rang bzhin dang bla med dbang chen gyi rang bzhin yal 'dug pas/ don dngos su rang byung khams dang ngo bo gcig tu gyur stabs/ rang byung khams dang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs tsam du zad do// de 'dra'i lha ni chos thams cad du gnas shing /chos rnams thams cad la lha'i rang bzhin ldan zhes pa'i lta bar mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng lha kun khyab smra ba (phosa3)zer/ de ni snga dus chos lugs lha'i rig par dgag bzhag byed pa'i bsam blo'i drag chas te/ de rang nyid la lha'i rig pa'i shan yod na'ang lha dkon mchog gi ltos med dbang shugs khas mi bzhes/ de bas na srol rgyun gyi chos lugs lha'i rig par rdung deg tsha drag pa zhig bzhus so//bha ru nos bton pa'i lha kun khyab smra ba'i bsam blo dang gnas bab de'i tshan rig shes byas grub pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi lta bar 'brel ba dam po yod de/ spyi lo dus rabs bco lnga ba'i gong rol du 'jig rten khams kyi lta ba'i thad/ a ri si 'o 'e dang 'o le me'i (777)sa sgang lte gnas smra bas (lotsho 3)ri yo)dbang bsgyur ba'i go gnas bzung la/ rig gzhung de'i bzhed tshul ltar na/ sa sgang ni 'jig rten khams kyi lte gnas su bzung nas nyi zla dang rgyu skar chen po lnga bo sa sgang bskor nas rgyu zhing / 'jig rten khams kyi phyi rol tu da rung rtag brtan gyi skul 'ded mkhan zhig gis 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad bskul nas 'gul skyod byed par 'dod/ chos lugs lha'i rig pas de la cung yo bsrang byas rjes de nyid khyad 'phags 'gyur med kyi bden don du bskur/ de 'dra'i 'jig rten khams kyi phyi rol gyi rtag brtan skul 'ded mkhan ni lha dkon mchog yin la/ lha dkon mchog bzhugs gnas ni lha yul las ma 'das so//213

de ltar sa sgang lte gnas smra ba ni chos lugs lha'i rig pa'i rgyab rten gyi gzhung lugs gal chen du gyur/ mi rnams der cung zad dogs pa zos na srog chad kyang 'bab pa'i g.yab mor 'gyur ro// de nas spyi lo dus rabs bcu drug par bslebs tshe/ gnam dpyad rig pa'i tshan rin gong du chas pa dang bstun nas mi rnams 'jig rten khams la sngar bas rgyus cha je cher song ste/grags pa phyogs su g.yo ba'i tshan rig pa chen po ghi sgye nes dus yun ring po'i nang nyams rtog byas phyin nyi ma lte gnas smra ba'i (ma lta 'i 7)lta ba bton/ghi sgye nas sa sgang ni nyi mar bskor ba'i rgyu skar zhig yin pas/ 'jig rten khams kyi lte gnas sa sgang min zhes gsungs so// de ltar nyi ma lte gnas smra ba'i lta ba bton pas lha'i rig pa'i phyogs 'dzin khrod 'gul shugs chen po thebs/ yun ring po'i nang mtha' gcig tu bden don du gyur pa'i lha'i gsung glo bur du rdzun pa'i gnas su bcar/ chos lugs lha'i rig par srog la bsnun pa'i rdung rdeg cig thebs la/ bha ru no ni snga dus nas ghi bhe na'i rig gzhung khyab bsgrags dang srung skyob mkhan zhig yin no// 'on te khong gis de tsam gyis chog shes ma bsten par rig gzhung de yo bsrang dang gong 'phel gtordo nas rang nyid kyi 'jig rten khams kyi lta tshul gsar ba zhig grub par byas bha// ru nos/ nyi ma lte gnas smra ba ni srol rgyun lha'i rig par rdung deg byed pa'i bsam blo'i drag char bzhed mod/ de rang nyid kyi steng du'ang lha'i rig pa'i shan mang tsam lus yod de/ de ni gang yin zhe na/ des 'jig rten khams la lte gnas shig yod par khas blangs 'dug cing / de ltar na nges par du 'jig rten khams la mtha' yod pa'ang khas mi len thabs med du gyur stabs/ de khas blangs na mtha' de las da rung nges par du rtag brtan gyi 'ardo/ spyan cig shos shig gzhi grub pas/ de ni tan tan lha'i rig par mkho

ba zhig go/ de bas na drungs nas lha'i rig par dgag rgol bya dgos na/nges par du lha'i rig pa'i rnga ma de 'breg par bya dgos so// bha ru nos gzhi nas sa sgang lte gnas smra ba khas mi len pa'i lhongs su nyi ma lte gnas smra ba'ang mtha' gcig tu khas mi len te/ khong gis gzhi rgya che ba'i 'jig rten khams ni mtha' med 'byams klas shig yin pas/ der 'gul med kyi lte gnas shig drungs nas med par bzhed la/ 'jig rten khams kyi gnas gang yin kyang mtha' med cig ste tshang ma 'jig rten khams kyi lte gnas su 'gyur rung / de bas na 'jig rten khams kyang ga sa gar lte gnas su 'gyur 'dug go/ gzhan yang / bha ru nos/ mtha' med kyi 'jig rten khams su sa sgang nyi zla skar gsum dang bcas pa 'dus pa'i bya dngos thams cad la 'byung ba dang gong 'phel/ de nas 'jig pa'i brgyud rim zhig yod stabs/ rtsa ba nas rtag brtan 'gyur med kyi chos shig med par 'dod do//bha ru no'i lta ba gsar ba des lha'i rig pa'i rnga ma bcad zin la/ chos tshogs kyis rig gzhung de byung pa dang khyab spel byed par shirne tu 'jigs shing sdang par byed do//rang byung khams las 'das pa'i stobs shugs thams cad phyir 'bud gtong rjes/ bha ru nos 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsar dpyad skabs da rung chos lugs lha'i rig pa dang dngos 'gal du song pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi dngos po'i rig gzhung bton no//dngos po dang bsam blo'i 'brel ba'i steng / chos lugs lha'i rig pas dus rgyun de gnyis so sor phral nas bsam blo ni rang skyar gzhi grub tu ma zad/des dngos po'i dngos gzugs kyi 'byung rtsa gtan la 'bebs par 'dod de/dper na chos lugs lha'i rig pas ni mi zhig thog mar sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung por brten nas gzhi grub cing / yin na'ang gzugs can de'i phyi /lha tu

da rung der dbang mdzad pa'i rnam shes shig yod la/ mi'i lus phung ni 'jig srid kyang rnam shes de las ldog ste rtag brtan zhig tu bzhed/ der brten/rnam shes kyis lus phung la mi brten par ma zad/ da rung lus phung gi gzhi grub thag gcod par byed do//bha ru no dngos po'i rig gzhung ni lta ba de dang drungs nas 'gal zlar song yod de/ khong gis dngos po ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin la/'jig rten gyi chos thams cad ni dngos po'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba tsam du zad/bsam blo'i phyogs gtogs kyang dngos por brten nas byung bas slar yang dngos por 'gyur bar bzhed/ de ltar 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi 'byung ba dang gong 'phel tshang ma de'i nang grub kyi rgyu rkyen la brten nas byung zlos/ lha'i blo ni brgyud rim de dag gi khrod du gzhi nas phan med cig tu gyur bha ru nos lha kun khyab smra ba'i gzhung la brten nas dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba dang rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya de dag khyab spel gtong bas/rtsa ba nas chos lugs lha'i rig pa'i dam tshig la g.yo 'gul thebs pa dang /khong gis phyogs so sor gtam bshad mang du gnang zhing sgrub byed kyi gzhung mdzad par brtson pa lhur bzhes te/ rgya che'i mi dmangs tshor yar thon gyi bsam blo khyab bsgrags byas pas chos tshogs la 'jigs skul tshad med thebs/der brten/ bha ru no rang nyid phyi'i rgyal khab tu bzhugs nas lo ngo bcu phrag lhag 'gor yod na'ang / ro ma gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis sngar bzhin mig nang gi tsher mar bltas nas bsdad yod do//spyi lo 1592lor/ bha ru no khong nyid kyis mes rgyal dran pas dbyi tha lir phyir lkog phebs gnang zhing / we ne sir sku drag cig gi khyim gyi dge rgan byas so//21spya nas cung ma 'gyang bar we ni si'i dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis shes

te btson la bcug no ma chos tshogs kyis thos 'phral we ne+e sir 'brel gtug byas shing / bha ru no phyir ro ma chos tshogs kyi khrims gcod khang du 'khyer rgyu thag bcad/ de ltar khong snga phyir lo ngo brgyad kyi bar btson 'jug bgyis/skabs de dag tu chos tshogs kyis zhi drag gi lam nas khong gis log lta'i bsam blo bskyur bar 'bad mod/ bha ru no chos tshogs kyi ham drag 'jigs bskul gyis dpa' ma zhum par ma zad/ btson khang bed spyad de sngar bzhin tshan rig dang dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bden don khyab spel byas shing / mthar chos tshogs kyi thabs zad de lus la mnar gcod gtong / spyi lo 1600lo'i zla2pa'i tshes 8nyin/ chos tshogs khrims gcod khang nas bha ru no la srog thog gi khrims yig bsgrags/ skabs der btsan gyis khrims sgrog mkhan gyi mdun du bha ru nor btsan sgur byed du bcug yin na'ang khong gis drang bden gzengs bstod dang dpa' ngar zhum med kyis/ khyod tshos khrims yig bsgrags skabs ngas khrims yig thos pa las kyang sngangs par byed ces skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags so// lo rgyus kyis bden dpang byas pa ltar/ bha ru no'i lta ba ni yang dag tu gnas pa ra sprod byung /zla 2pa'i tshes 17nyin/ tshe hril por bden don la 'bad cing glan rmongs dang rjes lus la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dpa' mdzangs gnyis ldan gyi 'thab mo ba de dgung la 'phyur ba'i me spungs kyi nang sku tshe gtong / yin na'ang khong gis spel srung byas pa'i rig gzhung ni khong gi snying stobs dang lhan dus rtag tu mi rnams kyi sems khong du gnas so// spyi lo 1889lor mi rnams kyis khong sku tshe blos gtong ba'i me tog sos pa'i thang chen du dran rten gyi rdo ring zhig btsugs shing steng du bha ru no khong rang nyid kyi dam bca' ste/ skad cig tsam la shi ba dang // stong phrag mang por gson par byed// ces pa mngon du byed thub par gyur to// 217
skrabyaca

sabacadabacu dgur/ nye rabs dngos gtso'aja lugs dngagams zhib 6yina'ag gi mes po/wa waspru ran se sibha khon/spyi lo 1626lo'i zla 3 pa'i nyin zhig tu shing rta zhig lon 'on gyi phyi rol gyi kha ba mthug po chags pa'i lam du rgyug bzhin yod la/ shing rta'i steng dgung lo drug cu 'das pa'i bgres song zhig gis mgo bo rgyab yol la bsnyen zhing mig gnyis btsum ste shing rta'i yam yom gyi 'degs 'jog dang bstun nas bsam gzhigs la yur ba mthong nus/ glo bur du bgres song ha lam sad 'phral skad gsang mthon pos sdod sdod ces 'ur pa na/ shing rta bas ha ma gor dngangs pa'i gnas su bcar/ de nas bgres song des gnam gshes grang ba'i glags dang bstun nas grang bzo'i tshod lta zhig bya dgos tshul bshad de khong nyid thang la babs/ shing rta bas thang stong der mi bsgug thabs med byung / bgres song des sha rus 'jig pa'i grang rlung gi nang kha ba mthug po bcags te thag nye'i ru sde chung chung zhig tu phyin/ khong gis der bya bo zhig nyos nas bshas shing bya bo'i khog tu kha ba bkang ste/ grang bzos bza' bca' rul 'gog gi phan nus la nyams zhib byas so// gshes ka ya mtshan can dang tshan rig la dga' zhen che ba'i bgres song de ni/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dbyin ji'i mtshan snyan che ba'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba h+phu ran se si bha khon (7༅poloX stu170ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha000)zhes pa byi/ te/

nyin 'ga'i rjes su/ bha khon spro ba brtas bzhin mi rnams la khong nyid kyi tshod lta ste grang bzos bza' bca' mi dul bar phan nus chen po thon pa'i grub 'bras bsgrags/ 'on te khong nyid dgung lo bgres shing lus phung zhan la/de'i steng yun ring grang ngar che sar bsdad pas/ phyir lon 'on la bslebs rjes nad kyis mnan la/ de nas bzung yar bzhings thub ma byung / spyi lo 1626lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 9nyin bha khon khong nyid kyis tshan rig la yid smon byed bzhin sku gshegs/ khong gis spro sems kyis btsal 'tshol ngang kha rog tu shi 'gro zhes pa'i re 'dun don thog la 'khyol lo//bha khon ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje dus skabs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba dang bsam blo ba yin pas/ r+sākhong gi sku tshe ni tshan rig dar spel la 'bad de bzhud pa red do// khong gis mi tshor skad gsang chen pos tshan rig gi phan nus bsgrags shing / rang nyid kyi tshan rig tshod lta'i bya 'gul la dngos su zhugs/ yin na'ang / bha khon gyis 'gro ba mi'i rigs la bzhag pa'i phyag rjes ches che ba ni tshan rig gi khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras rang mtshan pa ma yin la/ 'o na gang yin zer na/ khong gis mi rnams kyis tshan rig zhib 'jug dang / ngos 'dzin gting zab tu phyogs pa dang rang byung bcos bsgyur bcas la lam gsar ba zhig btod de tshan rig gi byed thabs mkho 'don byas pa de red/ de yang de ni bha khon gyis 'gro ba mi'i rigs la 'bul gnang padzawa pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gsar ba ga spyi/ lo 1562lor/ bha khon ni lon zlon gyi sku drag gsar ba zhig gi khyim du 'khrungs shing / dgung lo bcu gnyis thog ming grags che ba'i khem sger lji slob chen (7)gloshālha dzumatshocing 622 )gyi gsum gcig slob gling la zhugs nadī ༵༵ bltas byas/ slob chen gyi skabs khong nyid bsam blo gtong bar

dga' bas dge slob tshos bsngags brjod mdzad/ gnas bab der bsam blo'i khyab khongs su/ chos tshogs dang dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa bas a ri si khro 'e ni som nyi ci yang med par gtso bor bkur bzhin yod la/ khong gis gsar du btod pa'i rnam 'byed rigs dpyad kyi thabs lam ste rtsa ba'i rigs pa spyir btang bar brten nas bya dngos bye brag pa'i tha tshig 'don pa'i bsam gzhigs thabs lam ni/ mi rnams kyis bden don 'tshol thabs gcig pur 'dod par ma zad/ lha'i rig pa'i nang don zhugs par byas pas/ rigs dpyadakyi sngon 'gro ni mchog gi sde snod dang lha'i rig pa'i bstan bcos gtso bo'i nang kho nar mchis par 'dod/ o'u se lim lta bur mtshon na/ lha dkon mchog gzhi grub pa'i gzugs nyid smra ba'i sgrub dpang zhes pa'i thabs lam 'di spyad pa yin te/ khong gis thog mar lha dkon mchog gi lta tshul dang /de nas der brten nas lha dkon mchog gzhi grub par bsgrubs pa red/ de bas na thog mar lung 'dren khungs skyel byas shing / de rjes rigs pas dpyad 'jug byed pa ni mi rnams kyi bsam gzhigs byed thabs gtso bor gyur/ dang thog bha khon khong nyid rnam 'byed rigs dpyad kyi thabs lam la'ang dga' zhen shin tu che bar ma zad/ a ri si 'o tshe'i mtshan nyid rig pa la'ang zhib 'jug nges can byas myong / yin na'ang dpyad gzhigs dang dbye zhib phra zhing zhib pa gnang ba brgyud phyin/ khong nyid lta tshul nas lta tshul gyi rigs dpyad byed thabs la som nyi dang sun snang skyes shing tha na phyogs yongs nas de'i phan nusakhas ma blangs te/ khong gis lung 'dren khungs skyel gyis sngon 'gro byas pa'i sgrub rim rnam gsum gyi rigs dpyad byed thabs ni rtsod pa'i skabs phan cung zad yod pa ma gtogs shes bya gsar ba 'byin mi nus pas/ mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba dngos la'ang yar brtson gyi phan nus ci yang mi 'dug par bzhed do// der brten/ bha khon gyi thugs su de 'dra'i dbang grags ldan ༵༵ ma

lag de tshar bcad de/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs yar thon dang gong 'phel la phan lha'i mtshan nyid rig pa gsar ba zhig 'dzugs pa'i spobs pa gting nas rgyas bha khon ni gzhon nu'i dus nas rlabs che ba'i dmigs yul zhig bzung yod mod/ 'on te 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang dmigs yul der sleb pa'i bgrod lam ni de 'dra'i bde mo zhig ma byung / slob chen mthar phyin nas cung ma 'gor bar a pha glo bur du sku 'das shing / khyim gyi dpal 'byor la dka' sdug chen po thon stabs/ khong nyid kyis gzhung lugs zhib 'jug gi mtshams mi 'jog thabs med byung ste gzu gyod ( sgo/ )byas nas kha gsos/ spyi lo 1602lo'i rjes nas khong nyid dbyin ji'i chab srid las rigs su zhugs la/deradapon las ha cang che stabs nan rje (zas)zhes pa'i cho lo thob/ snga phyir zhib dpyod dbu 'dzin dang / blon chen tham ga 'dzin pa/ khrims dpon chen mo sogs las gnas gal chen bzung / nye rabs dbyin ji'i chab srid kyi do rar bya ba mang po bsgrubs/ las byed kyi gnas la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung yang khong nyid kyi mi tshe'i dmigs 'ben de gtan nas 'bor ma myong / khong gis sngon chad go gnas mthon por bsnyeg pa ni tshan rig gsar btod kyi cha rkyen je legs su gtong ched yin zhes gsungs la/ gang ltar kyang de bden min mi shes na'ang / bha khon khong nyid kyis srid don sgrub zhor du gsung rtsom mi nyung ba zhig mdzad pa ngo ma yin/ dgung lo bgres dus lkog zos nyes can du gtug bsher byas pas/ de nas bzung khong gi chab srid kyi 'tsho ba mtshams 'jog dgos byung / pha yul du phebs te dben par bzhugs rjes/ khong gis shed shugs yod cog rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi steng bkol nas sku tshe rdzogs par byas so// de ltar bha khon gyis tshe gang bor 'grus 'gog lhod med bgyis padī/24khong nyid kyis mi tshe'i dmigs yul te nye rabs dngos gtso ring lugs

kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag btsugs nas 'gro ba mi'i ngos zin gyi bgrod lam gsar ba zhig gi sgo mo legs par phyes so//bha khon gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gsar 'dzugs ni dus yun ring por dbang bsgyur gyi go gnas bzung ba'i dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig par bltos te bshad pa yin te/ khong gis bltas na/ dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bkag bsdom dang 'ching rgyas bcings pa'i 'og mi rnams mchog gi sde snod dang dbang grags can gyi tshig la mgo 'khor nas don stong nyag nyog gi sgrub byed 'god cing / de ltar byas pas rang byung khams ngos 'dzin dang bcos bskrun byed mi nus par ma zad/ da rung rang shugs kyis shan zhugs te nor 'khrul gyi lta ba 'byung nges stabs rang byung khams ngos 'dzin dang bcos bskrun gyi gegs byed du 'gyur ro// de bas na bha khon gyis mis rang byung khams ngos 'dzin dang bcos bskrun bya dgos na/ thog mar nges par du dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'ching rgya las bkrol nas ngos 'dzin gyi bar gegs sel dgos par bzhed pas/ der brten nas khong nyid kyis mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng ming grags ldan pa'i ltar snang rigs bzhi'i (khramaṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)bshad srol bton no//bha khon gyis mi rnams kyi klad pa'i nang gi lta tshul 'phrul snang can la ltar snang zhes btags la/ khong gis mi'i ngos 'dzin gyi gegs byed la gtso bo ltar snang rigs bzhi yod par 'dod de/ dang po ni/ rigs rgyud ltar snang ste/de ni 'gro ba mir lhan skyes su ldan pa'i rang rig rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul red/ bha khon gyis 'di ltar 'dod de/ de yang chos lugs lha'i rig pas yun ring du shugs rkyen thebs pa'i dbang gis mis bya dngos rang mtshan par dbye zhib dang dpyad 'jog byed dus/ rang nyid kyi rtogs pas phyi rol gyi bya dngos kyi dbang bsgyur la/ de ltar byas pa'i mtha' 'ibras ni ngos 'a~X/ gyi

nang rang rig rang bzhin 'dres pas/ bden rdzun dang bzang ngan dpyad 'jog bya skabs rgyun par chos lugs kyi gzhung don gyis tshad gzhi byed do//don dam par de ni mi'i 'dod blos phyi rol gyi bya dngos la dbang mdzad pas ngos 'dzin gyi khrod rang rig rang bzhin med thabs med de/ de ltar rang rig rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul gyi shugs rkyen 'og tu/ mis 'jig rten gyi gnyug ri ma'i rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin ngos 'dzin la/ de lta bas na 'jig rten gyi ngos 'dzin yang dag cig skye mi nus so//gnyis pa ni brag phug ltar snang yin la/ de ni rang nyid kyi stong gi phyogs re ba'i nor 'khrul te/ bha khon gyis ni 'di ltar bzhed de/ de yang mi gcig brag phug tu 'tsho ba rol ba dang mtshungs la/ kho'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug dang slob gso thob tshad rgyud 'dzin sa bon sogs tshang ma de 'dra'i rgya shin tu chung ba'i khyab khongs kyis bkag rgya byas 'dug pas/ kho'i ngos 'dzin yang tshad de las gtan nas brgal mi nus/ de bas na/ 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi brgyud rim nang rang nyid gcig pu'i lta tshul gzhir byas nas rang nyid kyis shes 'dod pa'i bya dngos kho na ngos 'dzin byed stabs/ de lta na phyogs re bas yongs rdzogs bsdus pa'i nor skyon 'byung nges shing / phyogs yongs nas 'jig rten ngos 'dzin dang khong chud bya mi thub bo//gsum pa ni tshong ra ltar snang ste/ de ni mi rnams phan tshun 'gro 'ong byed skabs skad cha ma 'grig pas gzhi byas nas bslang ba'i zang zing gi nor 'khrul lo// bha khon gyis 'di ltar 'dod de/ mi rnams lhan du bsdad pas tshong rar tshong zog brje res byed pa dang 'dra bar phan tshun bar bsam blo brje res dang 'phrin gsar sbran brgyud sogs byed dgos shing / de ltar byed pa'i bar ba ni skad cha las ma 'das pas/ skad cha ni bsam gzhigs kyi dngos po'isnro6 shun te/ skad chas phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos ma nor bar mtshon par

byed dus/ da gzod bsam gzhigs dang 'phrin gsar sbran brgyud kyi yang dag rang bzhin khag theg bgyid nus so// de las ldog ste gal srid skad chas bya dngos kyi ngo bo yang dag par ston ma nus tshe/ mi rnams kyis skad cha de dag la brten nas bsam gzhigs sam phan tshun 'brel 'dres byed skabs bya dngos yang dag tu mtshon mi thub par ma zad/ de las ldog phyogs su chas te zang zing ches chen po bslang nges so// dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa bas go don tsam gyi steng nas rtsod pa'i thabs srol yod pa ltar/ kho tshos yang na spyir gzhi ma grub pa'i go don zhig bzos nas bcos mas bden don byed pa dang /yang na dmigs kyis go don rab rib ngag ngog byed la/ de'i dmigs yul ni mis 'jig rten la ngos 'dzin yang dag bskyed par mgo skor dang gegs byed pa'i ched du de ltar byas pa yin no//bzhi ba ni zlos gar khang ltar snang ste/ de ni mi rnams kyis dbang grags dngasrol rgyun mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag la rmongs bkur byas pa las grub pa'i phyogs zhen zhig go/ bha khon 'di ltar 'dod de/ de'ang sngar gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag tshang ma ni gar stegs steng gi zlos gar dang 'dra ste/de'i rgyab ljongs tshang ma mtshan nyid rig pa ba tsho rang nyid kyis gsar bzo byas pa yin la/ de ltar gsar bzo dang las snon bgyis pa'i rgyab ljongs kyi dpe ris ni dngos yod 'jig rten las mdzes shing zhib tshags che na'ang / der ni phal cher dngos yod 'jig rten gyi ngo ma'i rang bzhin bag la zha zhing khyad du byas pa'i rjes shul mang po zhig bzhag 'dug der brten/ mis gal te dbang grags can de dag la rmongs dad byas na/ dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang mtshungs par kho tshos gsar btod byas pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag sna tshogs ni ltos med kyi bden don du 'dod pa ltar yin la/ de ltar bzhed pas nges par du ngos 'dzin ni phyi rol gyi 'jig rten dang rgyang ༵༵ du

/sa shing / der brten nas phyi rol 'jig rten gyi ngos 'dzin 'dor bar byed bha khon gyi ltar snang rigs bzhir bshad pas/ chos lugs lha'i rig pa dang / dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i shugs rkyen 'og mi'i ngos 'dzin brgyud rim khrod kyi rang rig rang bzhin dang / phyogs ris tsam gyi rang bzhin/go don 'khri rtsed byed pa dang rmongs pas dad gus byed pa'i nor 'khrul mngon 'don byas par ma zad/ mis de ltar nor 'khrul 'byung dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen la da rung nyams zhib gang 'os byas so// rig pa'i gzhung lugs des gnas bab der dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig par dgag spong dang khas mi len pa dang /mi rnams dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'ching ba las dgrol ba'i go rtogs sad par bskul pas gsar brje'i phan rlabs chen po thon/ der ma zad deng rabs kyi mis ji ltar nor 'khrul mi 'byung pa'i phyogs la'ang dpyad gzhi'i rin thang nges can zhig 'dug go/ yin na'ang dus rabs kyi dbang gis bha khon gyis tshan rig gi lam nas mis nor 'khrul 'byung ba'i rtsa ba gsal bshad byed ma thub ste/ khong gis rang rig rang bzhin sogs nor 'khrul tshang ma mi'i rang gshes su bsdus pas nor 'khrul 'byung ba smos ma dgos/ der bltas na bha khon ni phan tshun nang 'gal du song 'dug don dngos su ngos 'dzin gyi nor 'khrul byung ba ni mi'i rang gshis ga la yin te/ cha rkyen 'dra mtshungs yin kyang mi gcig gis ngos 'dzin gyi nor 'khrul 'byung yang cig shos la yang dag pa'i ngos 'dzin thob rgyu yod srid pa sus kyang bston ga la nus/ mi gcig yin kyang skabs der nor skyon byung yang skabs gzhan zhig tu bden don yongs nas thob srid pa'ang yod stabs/ der gzhigs na mi'i nor 'khrul ni phyis nas grub par gdon mi za bas sel mi thub pa zhig ga la yin te ma byi)8 no//

ngos 'dzin gyi gegs byed sel 'don byas pa dang / bha khon gyis mi rnams la 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi thabs lam gsar pa bton cing / bha khon gyi yar sngon kha cig srol rgyun gyi dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig par dogs pa zos shing rno ngar ldan pa'i dgag spong byas na'ang / mthar de nyid drungs nas 'byin ma nus so// phyis bha khon gyi sku ring nye rabs nyams zhib mtshan rig dar pas srol rgyun dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig par rdung deg chen po thebs/rgyu mtshan gang zer na/ nyams zhib tshan rig (r+sā77stsa)ni shugs rig (7stsa)dang gnam dpyad rig pa/ dngos lugs rig pa bcas kyi khyab khongs su myur gyis gong du 'phel zhing grub 'bras g.yur du zos pas/ dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lha rig gi ma lag hril por rmang nas gtor bshig thebs par ma zad/ da rung 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi 'gro lam dang byed thabs gsar ba zhig sbrum par byas te/ dper na ghi dhe nes bton pa'i nyi ma lte gnas smra bas gzhung lugs kyi steng lha'i rig pa'i gnas gzhi sa sgang lte gnas smra ba yin log tu bsgrubs shing / de ni byed thabs smra ba'i cha nas mtshon na'ang gsar btod cig go/ khong gis dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ltaraspya mtshan can gyi go don dang rtsa ba'i rigs pa dang dbang grags can gyi gsung sgros gzhi byas pa ma yin par/ dus yun ring po'i nang nyams rtog dang tshod lta byas pa las thob pa'i 'jig rten gyi ngos 'dzin yang dag cig red/de ltar nyams rtog dang tshod lta'i byed thabs kyis srol rgyun gyi rnam 'byed rigs dpyad kyi thabs lam la rtsod zla byas shing / rnam 'byed rigs dpyad kyi thabs lam gyi ltos med dbang grags kyi rang bzhin mi 'grig par bsgrubs/bha khon gyis dus rabs de nyid kyi khyad chos dam du bzung zhing / nyams zhib tshan rig gi grub 'bras gal chen rnams kyis gzhi byas te nyams rtog dang chod lta'i byed thabs mtshan nyid rig pa'i khyab khongs su drangs la/ dgo~X /'i

mtshan nyid rig pa dang dngos 'gal du chas pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi ngos 'dzin thabs lam gyi shing rta'i srol phyes so//bha khon gyis tshan rig shes byas rang byung khams bcos bsgyur byed par phan nus gtos chen yod pa gzhir bzhag steng / khong gis shes yon ni stobs shugs yin zhes pa'i legs bshad grags chen de gsungs pa red/ mi zhig la shes yon yod tshe stobs shugs kyang ldan la/ mi'i stobs shugs kyang tan tan shes yon yod pa'i mtshon byed tsam du zad/ 'o na shes yon la stobs shugs ji ltar ldan zhe na/ bha khon gyis shes yon gyi stobs shugs ni des yang dag pa'i sgos rang byung khams kyi phyi rol chos nyid mngon 'don byed nus pas/shes yon ni gzhi grub kyi snang 'char (74)yin par bzhed do// de bas na mi la shes yon ldan pa na rang byung khams kyi phyi rol chos nyid kyang khong du chud la/ de khong du chud tshe mis rang byung khams kyi phyi rol chos nyid dang bstun nas sngar bas rang byung khams ngos 'dzin dang bcos bsgyur byed nus stabs/mi'i stobs shugs chen po phyogs yongs nas 'don thub pa red/ der bsam na/ bha khon gyis shes yon ni stobs shugs yin zhes pa'i gsung sgros ni dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rtsa don gzhir byas nas gsungs pa yin no//tshan rig shes byar 'jig rten bcos bsgyur byed pa'i stobs shugs ldan na/ mis ni thabs gang la brten nas de thob par 'gyur zhe na/ bha khon gyis 'di ltar 'dod de/ shes yon ni rang byung khams kyi nang grub kyi phyi rol chos nyid kyi mtshon byed yin pas/ shes yon thob dgos na nges par du rang byung khams dang 'brel 'dres bya dgos/ de ltar byas par brten nas gzod rang byung ngos 'dzin dang rgyus lon byed nus las rang shugs kyis rang byung gi nang grub chos nyid khong du chud par 'gyur/ mi dang rang byung 'brel 'dres byed ma~X / nyams rtog dang tshod lta byed pa'i skabs te phyi rol gyi chos kyis mi'i

dbang shes la tshor snang ster ba'i dus kyang yin la/ dper na/ nga tshos gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ldog gi tshul de'i gnas tshul chod dpog bya dgos na/nges par du gnam gshes kyi tshul sna tshogs la nyams rtog dang dbye zhib bya dgos pa ltar nyams rtog byed pa'i brgyud rim nang tshor snang grub pa red/gal te nga tshos sprin nag 'khrigs pa mthong pas rlung gnon (57)dma' zhing dbugs 'tshang ba'i snang ba 'byung la/ tshor snang de dag gis char 'bab par shes pa lta bu red/ der brten nas bha khon gyis mi gal srid smyo ba min tshe/shes yon thams cad tshor snang la nges par brten dgos par gsungs pas/tshor snang ni ngos 'dzin gyi 'byung khungs yin pa dang / tshor snang yang yang bskyar pas cung zad brtan po'i nyams myong grub ste/ gong du drangs pa'i dpe de ltar mis gnam gshis kyi gzigs rtog las tshor ba thengs mang du bsags spungs byas pa'i dbang gis/ phyis su sprin nag 'khrigs shing rlung gnon dma' ba sogs rang byung gi snang tshul byung tshe/ de 'phral char 'bab par thag gcodabyed nus pa lta bu ste/ de ni dus rgyun bshad pa'i nyams myong zhes pa red/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng ngos 'dzin ni tshor ba'i nyams myong las 'byung ba'i lta ba la nyams myong smra ba zer/ bha khon ni de 'dra'i dbyin ji'i dngos gtso ring lugs nyams myong smra ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed do// ngos 'dzin tshor ba'i nyams myong las 'byung zhing tshor ba'i nyams myong ni ngos 'dzin gyi gzhi yin na/ ngos 'dzin ni tshor ba'i nyams myong du bsdu rung ngam zhe na/ de ni mi rung zhes bha khon khong nyid kyis gsungs/ khong gis tshor snang la tshor dbang gi cha rkyen gyis bkag 'gog byed pa'i dbang gis dus rgyun bya dngos rang mtshan pa las hril po khong chud byed mi nus pa dang / bya dngos kyi phyi'i snang tshul tsam las de'i nang grub ngo bo (tshe467)ngos 'dzin mi thub bo// bya dngos de dag che chung gis bskal pa 'am/ yang na 'gul skyod ñtsha /ra

bul gyis bskal pa'i rkyen gyis tshor snang gis rtogs thub drungs nas yod pa ma yin la/ de bas na tshor ba'i nyams myong tsam la brten pas da rung tshan rig gi shes bya rtogs mi nus/ mis tshan rig shes bya khong du chud dgos na/ da dung sngar bas rjes dpag bsam gzhigs la brten nas tshor snang la kha gsab bya dgos so// bha khon gyis sngon gson nyams ldan pa'i sgos 'di ltar gsungs te/ ngos 'dzin tshor ba'i nyams myong du bsdu ba'i mi ni grog ma dang 'dra ste/des ni rgyu cha 'tshol sdud tsam las las snon byed mi shes pa ltar/ bya dngos rang mtshan pa ngos 'dzin tsam las spyi'am hril po'i shes yon yod mi srid/yang dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa de dag ni sdom dang 'dra ste khong gi rgyu cha skyug ste dra ba 'then pa ltar dang don med pa'i bsam blo'i ma lag bzo ba tsam las mi shes pas/ shes yon gsar ba gang yang 'byung mi nus/ bha khon gyis mtshan nyid rig pa ba ngo ma ni grog mar mtshungs mi rung la/ sdom la'ang mtshungs mi rung ste/ de ni nges par du las la brtson pa'i sbrang ma zhig dang mtshungs dgos te/ des rang byung khams chen po'i dga' tshal las ge sar gyi rtsi btu shes par ma zad/ ge sar gyi rtsi las snon gyis sbrang rtsi bzo yang shes dgos so// de bas na mtshan nyid rig pa ba ngo ma zhig yin tshe tshor snang gi rgyu cha dngos 'tshol sdud byed dgos la/ de dang dus mtshungs su rjes dpag gi byed thabs kyis tshor snang gi rgyu cha rnams las snon dag sgrig byas pas/ da gzod tshan rig gi shes bya thob nges so//'o na tshor snang gi rgyu char ji ltar las snon byed ces pa'am/ yang na byed thabs ji'adra'i sgos da gzod tshor snang gi rgyu cha las tshan rig gi shes bya thob par 'gyur ram zhe na/ der bha khon gyis thabs lam yang dag nyag gcig ni khong gsar btod pa'i gcig bsdus byed thabs ( khra/ poṣ+ṭha)yin la/gardokā /sdus byed thabs zhes pa ni tshor snang gi rgyu cha rang mtshan pas gzhi byas

te/ de bsdus pa las thon pa'i tha tshig spyir btang ba la go dper na/ nga tshos rang byung khams chen por nyams rtog byas pas/ nyi ma dang sa sgang bcas 'gul skyod byed bzhin pa dang / sa sgang stong gi dngos gzugs thams cad kyang 'gul skyod byed pa sogs gsar rtogs byung zhing / de 'dra'i snang tshul bye brag pa dag las don phyogs bsdus kyis tha tshig spyir btang ba zhig 'jog nus te/ des ni 'jig rten kyang 'gul skyod byed par shes pa ltar ro//bha khon gyis khong gi gcig bsdus byed thabs ni dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba tshos rgyun du bkol lob byas pa'i rnam 'byed byed thabs dang 'gal zlar spel pa yin te/ khong gis bzhed tshul la/ rnam 'byed byed thabs ni rtsa ba'i rigs pa spyir btang ba las tha tshig rang mtshan pa bsgrubs te go don bskyar bzlas byed tsam las shes pa gsar pa zhig 'dren mi nas/ 'on te gcig bsdus byed thabs ni de dang ldog phyogs su song pa ste/ des ni don dngos rang mtshan pa las tha tshig spyir btang ba phyogs bsdus byas shing /de'ang tshor snang gi rgyu cha rang mtshan pa las bya dngos kyi thun mong gi khyad chos dang chos nyid phyogs bsdus byas pa'i don te/ des ni sngar yod rgyu cha rang mtshan pa'i nang don je legs su gtong par ma zad/ da rung mi tshor tshor snang gi rgyu cha dang mi 'dra ba'i shes bya gsar pa mkho 'don byed de/ dper na/bya dngos rang mtshan par nyams rtog byas pa brgyud na bya dngos rang mtshan pa 'gul skyod byed pa tsam las rtogs mi nus/ yin na'ang bya dngos rang mtshan pa gcig bsdus bgyis phyin de'i nang nas shes bya gsar pa zhig phyogs bsdus byed thub ste/ de ni 'jig rten gyi bya dngos thams cad 'gul skyod byed pa de'o// de lta bas na gcig bsdus byed thabs ni mi rnams kyis tshan rig shes bya thob pa dang bden don khong du chud pa'i thabs lam yang dag nyag gcig go/bha khon gyis gcig bsdus brnan bshad byed pa las rnam 'byed khas ༵ byin

pa'i dmigs yul ni dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i dbang bsgyur go gnas brlags te/ mi rnams kyis don stong dang gzhigs rtsod kyang pa'i (7767)rigs dpyad las bcing dgrol byed pa'i ched red/ yin na'ang khong gi bzhed tshul la'ang phyogs re'i rang bzhin ldan te/ rgyu mtshan mi'i bsam gzhigs bya 'gul gyi khrod du rnam 'byed dang gcig bsdus gnyis ni so sor phral mi rung pa'i bya 'gul zhig red/ rnam 'byed kyis gcig bsdus mngon 'gro byed dgos la/ gcig bsdus kyis kyang rnam 'byed mdzub khrid byed par 'dzin dgos pas/ de gnyis gang chad kyang 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi tshan rig thabs lam du mi 'gyur ro/ dgon sde'i mtshan nyid rig pas bkol lob byas pa'i rnam 'byed byed thabs ni spyi mtshan gyi rnam 'byed byed thabs yin pas gcig bsdus kyis sngon 'gro mi byed stabs/ rnam 'byed rigs dpyad kyi phyi rol gyi rmang gzhi nyams par gyur la/ bha khon gyis spyi mtshan gyi rnam 'byed byed thabs la rgol ba'i dus drungs nas de'i phan nus khas blangs pas/gcig bsdus la rnam 'byed kyi mdzub khrid med par gyur cing / de ltar gyis cig shos kyi mthar lhung ste phyogs re rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul byung pa red do//bha khon gyis mi rnams la 'jig rten ngos 'dzin gyi bgrod lam gsar pa zhig phyes te thabs lam gsar pa mkho sprod byas shing / dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gsar pa zhig gi srol phyes so// der dus kyi dbang gis ma 'dang sa dang skyon gyi dri mas sbags pa ni da rung yod srid la/'on te de ni sngar ltar yo rab mtshan nyid rig pa gong 'phel gyi lo rgyus steng gi lam tshad rdo ring zhig ste/ de byung pa nas spyi mtshan bsam gzhigs kyis gzhi byas pa'i lha'i rig pas dbang gcod kyi dus rabs mjug bsgril par yongs bsgragasabyas pa dang dus mnyam du 'gro ba mi'i tshor snang gi nyams myong gis laX sdubs byas pa'i ngos 'dzin gyi bgrod lam gsar rkyang zhig gi dbu

btsugs par yang mtshon no// yo rob nye rabs kyi nyams myong smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ni lam der zhugs nas gong 'phel du song pa yin no// gzhan yang / bha khon gyis tshan rig gtsigs chen du brtsi zhing / tshan rig dar spel gyi ched 'bad pa lhod med de/ khong gis shes yon ni stobs shugs yin zhes pa'i legs bshad bton la/ des ni rtag tu mi rnams kyis shes yon la brtson pa dang / bden don 'tshol zhib kyi las la 'grus par skul bzhin yod do//

sagacad nyi zhug/ 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed/wa watho ma si ho sgye si/spyi lo 1621lor dbyin ji'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba grags can bha khon zhes byar rgyu za rngan len gyi gtug bsher byas pas chabasrid kyi gar stegs las bud cing phyir rang nyid kyi kha khu sim po'i sdod gnas su phebs te ched dmigs kyis gsung rtsom mdzad pa'i las la zhugs/'di ni sngon rngam zil ches cher ston pa'i chab srid kyi las dang bsdur tshe 'jam thing dang kher chad lta bur song 'dug yin na'ang bha khon la de 'dra'i snang ba mi 'char la/ nyin rer nyi rgas chu lha'i phang par gzim la nye ba'i dus/ khong nyid rgyun par me tog dga' tshal du 'cham 'cham byed pa'i srol chags shing /skabs der mi rnams kyis dus rgyun khong gi gam du lo sum cu lhag lon pa'i skyes pa zhig mthong thub/ mi de dang bha khon gnyis dga' spro bag phebs dang gling mol byed cing phyag tu smyug shog bsnams te zin tho phab bzhin yod la/de ni bha khon gyi sger gyi drung yig ste/ phyis su dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba grags can du gyur pa'i tho ma si ho sge si (66lor+sā7lo16012350660)zhes grags pa yin no// bha khon gyis drung yig der shin tu bstod bsngags byed de/ khong la rgyus yod pa'i mi'i nang na ho sgye si 'ba' zhig las khong gi dgongs don ji bzhin phab thub pa med par bzhed/ho k+to ༵ la mtshon na'ang dus rgyun bha khon dang lhan 'grogs gnang bas shugs

rkyen dang bag chags gang legs thebs rkyen/ khong gis phyis kyi mtshan nyid rig par byas rjes chen po 'jog pa'i rmang gzhi brtan po tshugs so// ho snye sis bha khon ngo mi shes pa'i yar sngon du/ kho'i dga' phyogs gtso bo ni rtsom rig dang lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa red/ slob chen mthar phyin rjes/khong nan rje zhig gi khyim gyi dge rgan byed skabs kyang gtso bo de dag dpe khrid bya dgos shing / bha khon gyis khong nyid mtshan nyid rig pa'i sgo mor 'khrid par mdzad/ dus phyis ho sge si thengs mang por yo rob skam sa chen por yul skor du phyin te mig rgya bskyed/ tshan rig pa mang po grogs por bsten la/lhag par du dngos lugs rig pa'i mkhas dbang snyan grags can gha lis le (lo lko14 0211 21 )dang grogs bshes su gyur pas/ khong gi bsam blor 'gyur ldog chen po byung / ho bhe sis gha lis le yis 'jig rten khams kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i sgo mo phyes par bsngags brjod gnang zhing dad gus kyang che/ de bas na de dag la brten nas/ khong gis 'jig rten gyi dngos po'i rang bzhin dang 'gulaskyod sogs kyi gnad la yid mngon par phyogs pas/ khong nyid kyi spyi mtshan bsam gzhigs kyi me lce bsgron par gyur to//spyi lo 1637lor/ ho sgye si yo rob skam sa chen po nas yul skor thengs gsum pa rdzogs nas phyir bslabs rjes/ khong nyid kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag 'dzugs pa'i dbu bzung zhing / de nas bzung mtshan nyid rig pa'i rgyal khams su ljongs rgyu byed pa'i sta gon la zhugs/ 'on te rgyal nang gi chab srid gnas tshul 'gyur ldog thal drags byung pas/ ho bhe sis re zhig de nyid mi 'jog thabs med kyis dngos yod chab srid kyi gnad la hur brtson sgos zhib 'jug byas par ma zad chab srid kyi dpyad rtsom yang mi nyung pa spel/ de ltar mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gi blos bslangs bzhengs skrun gyi bya ba bskyur zin to// de nas lo ngo nyi shur nye ba'i ring lus te spyi lo 1658lor sle| ༵ na/

khongagis mi'i rnam bshad ((7)ces pa'i gzhung dpe skrun byas pa nas da gzod khyad chos khyad par can gyis phyug pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gi blos bslangs bzhengs par gyur/ de dus kyi ho sgye si ni dgung lo bdun cur son pa'i bgres song zhig go/ dga' 'os pa ni ho snye si ni sku tshe ring pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig ste/ khong gis mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gsar 'dzugs gnang rjes/ da rung lo ngo nyi shu lhag la rang nyid kyi grub 'bras dag la zhib bsher dang skyon brtag byed long byung / de nas spyi lo 1679lo'i zla 12pa'i nang khong gis dgung lo go gnyis bzhes pa'i 'khrungs ltar gyi ston mor rol phyin/ da gzod 'jis rten mi yul dang bral bar gyur yo rob mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng / ho dhe si'i phyag ris gtso bo ni khong gis 'gyur med shugs rig gi rigs gzhung spyad de sngar bas bha khon gyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bsam blo ra sprod dang je legs su gtong zhing /'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gi blos bslangs bzhengs thub byung / phyogs gcig nas khong gis 'gyur med shugs rig gi rigs gzhung la brten nas 'jig rten gsal bshad byas pas/ khong gi mtshan nyid rig par tshan rig gi rgyab rten rnyed cing / 'jig rten la dbang byed pa'i rang byung gi stobs shugs las 'das pa thams cad phyir 'bud gtong pa red/ phyogs cig shos nas khong gis 'jig rten steng gi snang tshul mtha' dag 'gyur med shugs rig tu bsdus te 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa gzhan gyi gzhi grub khas ma blangs so// mtshan nyid rig pa'i lo rgyus steng de 'dra'i 'gyur med shugs rig gi rigs gzhung gis gzhi byas pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs la 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs su 'bod/ ho bho si ni yo roX snyizlo gi 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed pa bo red/

khong gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gi srol phye ba ni dngos gtso ring lugs gong 'phel du song nas dus rim gnyis pa ste 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs kyi gzugs gzhi grub pa'i dus rim du sleb pa yin no//phon ho bhe sis ji ltar 'gyur med shugs rig gi rigs gzhung gis 'jig rten 'grel bshad byas pa dang / khong gi smyug rtse'i 'jig rten mthar gtug na ji 'dra zhig yin zhe na/ ho sgye si khong nyid kyis nga tshor 'di ltar gsungs te/'jig rten gyi phyi'i dbyibs ni sna tshogs shig ste/ 'og kyang gal srid rtsa bar gtug na he bag che ba'i bya dngos rang mtshan pa de dag tshang ma rigs 'dra'i chos 'dus pa las grub pa red/ de 'dra'i 'jig rten 'grub byed kyi gdod ma'i rgyu chas la/ ho lha sis dngos gzugs zhes btags/ khong gis dngos gzugs ni nga tsho'i bsam blor rag ma las pa'i chos te/ de ni yul (0/ba)gyi cha shas ga ge mo zhig dang sbrel tshe de dang 'dra ba'i rgya khyon dang ldan no zhes gsungs/ mtshan nyid de'i steng nas khong gis bshad pa'i dngos gzugs la rtsa ba'i khyad chos gnyis dang ldan te/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten 'grub byed kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i dngos gzugs ni nga tsho'i bsam blo'i phyir phyi rol tu gzhi grub pa zhig red/ de'i nang don gang zer na/ dngos gzugs kyi gzhi grub ni nga tsho'i 'dod blo dang bstun nas 'gyur pa ma yin pas/ dngos po ni dang po dang 'du shes ni gnyis pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba red/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzugs kyi rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ni khyon che'i rang bzhin (ngalkoṣ+ṭha)te/ de ni ring thung dang leb dang mtho tshad gsum gyi cha nas yul nges can zhig 'gog par byed la/ de'i don chos shig la dngos gzugs su 'bod pa ni/ de la rnam dbyibs bongs tshad bcas rang mtshan pa dang ldan pa ni nga tsho'i dbang shes kyis bltas na mthong la reg na nom pa ltar red/ gal te de dag med tshe de'ang dngos gzugs su ga la 'gyur/23rdo sgye

sis 'jig rten hril po ni dngos yod dang dbyibs ldan gyi dngos gzugs kyis grub pa dang / gzugs dbyibs mi ldan pa'i chos gang yin de ni 'jig rten 'a/ba sdid kyi cha shas min pas 'phrul snang gi gzhi grub cig las ma 'das par baho d+ngha si/sa/ 'jig rten ni yul gcod cing gzugs dbyibs dang bcas pa'i dngos gzugs 'dus pa las grub par bzhed cing / der ma zad khyon che'i rang bzhin ni dngos gzugs kyi rtsa ba'i ngo bor 'dod de/ khong gis shes rtogs byung ba'i 'gul skyod kyang dbyibs ldan gyi dngos gzugs de dag yul gyi gnas su go sa 'gul spos byed pa tsam du zad do// khong gis 'di ltar 'dod de dngos po'i 'jig rten gyi 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa rigs gcig las med de/ de ni nga tshos mthong nus pa'i dngos gzugs mu mthud du gnas sheg dang bral nas/ yang gnas gzhan zhig thob par byed pa red/ de'ang byed las (67)dang ldog pa'i byed las kyis grub pa'i 'gyur med 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa'i dbang gis de las gzhan dngos po'i 'jig rten la 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa yod pa ma yin no//ho bhe sis 'gyur med shugs rig gi rigs gzhung spyad de 'jig rten gyi ljongs ris mtshon par byas pa de la gnas bab der chos lugs lha'i rig par dgag rgol byed pa'i gsar brje'i don snying ldan te/ khong gis 'jig rten 'di'i steng yul gcod cing rnam dbyibs yod la/ bltas na mthong zhing reg na nom pa'i chos tsam ni da gzod dam don du gzhi grub par thugs 'khrun bcad pas/ don dngos su lha dkon mchog dang lha 'dre'i rigs yod pa khas ma blangs pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan de dag tshang ma gzugs med kyi dngos gzugs yin pas/ da lta'i bar sus kyang mthong ma myong zhing / de 'dra'i gzugs meX snro0 chos la dngos yod 'jig rten gyi khrod du gzhi grub kyi gnas yod pa ma

yin no// ho bhe sis lha dkon mchog dang lha 'dre'i rigs ni mi rnams ma rig pas 'ching pa'i rkyen gyis rang byung snang tshul la 'grel bshad ma thub par brten nas byung pa'i rdzun gtam du zad pas/ phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten du rtsa ba nas yod mi srid par bzhed/ gzhan yang / khong gis shugs rig gi rigs gzhung spyad de dngos po'i 'jig rten 'gul skyod byed pa'i rgyu rkyen la 'grel bshad gnang pas/ rang byung khams las 'das pa'i stobs shugs gang yin gyis dngos po'i 'jig rten la dbang bgyid pa'i lta ba mthar bskud/der gzhigs na ho sgye sis phab pa'i 'jig rten gyi ljongs ris der lha med smra ba'i tshon mdangs kyis mdzes par byas 'dug go/yin na'ang / ho sgye sis bris pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi ljongs ris de ni phyi rol 'jig rten gyi phyogs yongs dang yang dag pa'i 'dra dpe zhig ma yin te/khong gis 'jig rten lha dkon mchog dang lha 'dre'i 'ching pa las thar thabs byas pa'i lhongs su/ 'jig rten gyi gzhi grub dang 'gul skyod la yang phyogs re ba'i 'grel bshad gnang pas 'gyur med smra ba'i nor 'khrul dmar rjen du bud/ khong gis 'gyur med shugs rig gi rigs gzhung la brten nas bya dngos gsal bshad gnang zhing / khyon che'i rang bzhin bya dngos kyi rtsa ba'i ngo bor bzung ste/ rnam dbyibs ldan min ni bya dngos gzhi grub ma grub kyi khyad par 'byed chos kyi mtshon byed du byas pas/ des ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos kyi spus tshad (ṭha)sna tshogs rang bzhin khas ma blangs pa red do// don dngos su phyi rol gyi bya dngos la khyon che'i rang bzhin ldan par ma zad/ da rung rang bzhin gzhan dag kyang ldan te/ dper na kha mdog dang dri ma lci yang sogs lta bu'o// bya dngos de dag gi rang bzhin gyis yul mi gcod cing rnam dbyibs kyang med na'ang / don dngos la bya dngos kyi nang du grub yod do//bya dngos shig bya dngos gzhan dang khyad par ldan pa ni nges par phyogasdu snang

po'i spus tshad kyi phyogs bsdus la rag las la/ dper na/ ljon shing zhig dngakhang ba zhig bsdur tshe/ de gnyis kyi rnam dbyibs las khyad par 'byed nus mod/ 'on kyang de ni bya dngos kyi phyi'i rnam pa'i mi 'dra sa red/ nga tshos ljon shing dang khang pa gnyis rtsa ba'i stong nas khyad par 'byed dgos na/ da dung mu mthud du de'i nang grub kyi rang bzhin la nyams zhib byed dgos te/nga tshos ljon shing srog ldan du ngos zin pa dang / khang pa ni so phag dang rdza g.yam srungs pa'i srog bral gyi dngos gzugs su ngos zin pa'i dus/ da gzod de gnyis rtsa ba nas so sor 'byed nus par gyur/ ho dhe sis bya dngos kyi phyogs shig gi rang bzhin te khyon che'i rang bzhin spyad de bya dngos sna tshogs kyi spus tshad kyi tshab byed la/ de ni phyogs yongs nas bya dngos kyi rang bzhin khong du chud mi thub pas/ bya dngos ngos 'dzin kyang yang dag cig bya mi nus pa red/ gzhan yang / khong gis dngos po'i 'jig rten gyi 'gul skyod tshang ma stabs bde'i go sa 'gul spos kyi stong gcig tu bsdus shing / de ltar byas pas dngos po'i 'jig rten gyi 'gul skyod rnam pa'i sna tshogs rang bzhin khyad gsod byas so/ phyi yul gyi dngos po'i 'jig rten du 'gyur med 'gul skyod (go sa 'gul spos)yod na'ang / de ni stabs bde'i 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa tsam yin la/ de las gzhan da rung dngos lugs 'gul skyod rdzas 'gyur 'gulaskyod dang skye dngos 'gul skyod bcas yod par ma zad/ de bas ches mtho ba'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi bsam gzhigs 'gul skyod dang spyi tshogs 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa sogs yod pa dang / ho sgye sis stabs bde'i 'gyur med 'gul skyod kyis 'gul skyod kyi rnam pa gzhan dag 'thus par bgyis par brten/ yang dag pa'i sgo nas dngos po'i 'jig rten gyi yul mi mthun pa'i ngo bo dang chos nyid ngos zin dang khong chud bya mi nus so// khong gi bsam blo'i zhagā ༵ de dag ni/ gnas bab de'i 'gyur med shugs rig gis dbang mdzad

go gnas kyi ngos 'dzin chu tshad khong gi steng nas mtshon pa red do//mi'i ngos 'dzin gyi 'byung khungs dang ngos 'dzin gyi brgyud rim thad/ho bhe sis bha khon gyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi nyams myong smra ba'i rgyun bskyangs yod de/ khong gis nga tsho'i shes yon yod tshad tshor snang las thob pa yin stabs/ tshor snang ni shes yon yod cog gi 'byung khungs su gsungs/ 'on te tshor snang ji ltar 'byung ba'i gnad don steng khong gis bha khon dang mi mthun pa'i 'gyur med smra ba'i 'grel bshad gnang 'dug go/ho snye sis tshor snang ni phyi rol bya dngos kyi byed las dang tshor dbang gi ldog pa'i byed las kyi khrod grub par 'dod de/ dper na/ phyi rol gyi bya dngos rang mtshan pa mi'i tshor pa'i dbang por 'phrad rjes/ mi'i tshor pa'i dbang pos de 'phral tshor nas bya dngos de'i rnam dbyibs dang gzugs dang sgra dri sogs tshor snang sna tshogs 'grub la 'dir tshor snang ni ches thog mar phyi rol gyi bya dngos dang 'phrad phyin grub pa yin te/ phyi rol gyi bya dngos dang 'phrad pa na tshor snang 'byung mi srid par 'dod pa'i cha nas bshad na/ ho sgye si ni dngos gtso ring lugs pa zhig red/ yin na'ang / khong gi 'gyur med smra ba'i bsam blo gzhir byas na/ khyon che'i rang bzhin tsam las khas mi len te/ bya dngos kyi rnam dbyibs ni bya dngos la lhan skyes su gnas pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri ni bya dngos rang stong du gzhi ma grub par bzhed/ 'o na gzugs sgra dri sogs kyi tshor ba ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ ho sge sis 'di ltar bzhed de/ nga tsho'i 'brel yod bya dngos kyi rnam dbyibs kyi tshor snang ni bya dngos rang nyid kyi lhan skyes kyi ngo bor brten nas byung zhing /gzugs sgra dri sogs kyi tshor ba ni phyi rol gyi bya dngos tshor dbang dang 'phrad rjes/ tshor dbang gis rang nyid kyi nus par brten nas bskrun pa zhig red/de bas na gzugs sgra dri sogs kyi tshor snang ni phyi rol gyi bya dngos rang spyardo gi
