rim pa gsum pa ni rgyal po gtum po'i dbang sgyur 'og gi 'dra mnyam min pa/ 'di ni mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam min pa'i tshad ches mtho ba yin la/dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi thad 'dra mnyam min pa'i 'phel rgyas kyis spyi tshogs 'gal ba ha cang dza drag can du gyur pas/ de nas srid dbang sger gcod kyi rgyal po gtum pos dbang sgyur ba'i srol byung / srid dbang sger gcod kyi rgyal pos bca' khrims snang med du btang zhing mi dmangs kyi khe dbang yod dgu 'phrog ste mi tshang mas kho'i 'dod blo ltar byed dgos byung pas mi'i rigs kyi 'dra mnyam min pa'i yang rtser pon/ ro'u se'u yis de ni bkag sdom gyi sgor dbyibs kyi mjug gnas shig dang 'dra ba la/ dus mtshams der thon pa dang mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam gyi 'gro 'go'i gnas dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ rgyal po gtum (rgyal ngan)po'i dbang sgyur 'og gi thal drags pa'i 'dra mnyam min pa de dus mtshungs su yang gnod pa dang sdug thug cig gi 'dra mnyam yang yin/ rgyu mtshan ni rgyal ngan gyi mdun tshang ma 'dra mtshungs su ci yang min/ yin kyang mthar son ldog 'gyur gyi dper ltar de lta bu'i thal drags kyi 'dra mnyam min pa mthar cis kyang 'dra mnyam gsar ba zhig tu 'gyur nges/ rgyal ngan gyi dbang sgyur slog nas rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gyi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gsar ba zhig 'dzugs dgos/ ro'u se'u yis gsar brje'i skul brda 'di ltar bton te/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal ngan gyis stobs shugs la tshobarten nas mi dmangs ci yang min par bgyid na/ mi dmangs kyis kyang stobs shugs bkol nas kho slog par byed pa smos ma dgos/ khong gis rgyal ngan ni ches dar ba'i skabs tsam du da gzod gtso bo yin pa las kho mthar skyod btang ba'i skabs su khos 'khang ra dang gtum spyod byed mi nus so// gcig lan gcig sloX snro/ pa ste ske dgag pa'am rgyal ngan 'dor ba'i mtha' 'bras kyi 'os

langasabya 'gul ni rgyal ngan gyis kha sang gang bsam du thag bcad pa'i blon dmangs kyi tshe srog dang rgyu nor gyi spyod tshul lugs mthun yin pa bzhin du tshul mthun du gnas par bzhed/ gtum drag gis kho srung bar byed la yang gtum drag gis kho slog par yang byed nus te/ bya dngos kun 'di ltar rang byung gi 'phel rim ltar byed pa'o// yang khong spro sems brtas pa'i ngang gsar brje'i dus rabs slebs la nye bar lung bstan pa dang / gsar brje 'di'i khrod du mi sna mthon po dma' mor dang phyug po dbul por 'gyur/ rigs mtho phal bar 'gyur ba sngon dpag byas/ ro'u se'u yi skad cha 'di dag gis lta ba gsal ston sgos mi mang dmangs tshogs kyi gsar brje'i stobs shugs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs srid dbang slog pa'i ldog med rang bzhin dang lugs mthun rang bzhin rigs pas bsgrubs/ dza drag che ba'i skad cha 'di dag dung bus pa ltar nus ldan sgos skabs der bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi gnya' gnon 'og rim pa gsum pa'i mi mang dmangs tshogs la skul 'ded thebs shing kho tshor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa'i gsar brje skul slong byas so/ro'u se'u yi mi'i rigs kyi 'dra mnyam min pa'i bshad tshul skor las nang don mang shas ni cha 'jog dang rigs 'ded (dper na mi'i rigs rang byung rnam pa dang mi gshis kyi cha 'jog skor yang lo rgyus don dngos dang mi mthun no/)yin na'ang / der yang dag dang lugs mthun gyi rgyu cha mi nyung ba zhig 'du ste/ dper na/ khong gis sger 'dzin lam lugs ni gcig na thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas kyi 'bras bu dang / yang na mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam min par byung ba'i 'byung rtsar bstan te/ sger 'dzin lam lugs dang rgyal khab bca' khrims bcas byung ba ni mi'i rigs la sgrog gi thog ma bskon pa dang / rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam shor zhing bkas bkod rgyud 'dzinā pyam

lugs kyis mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam min pa'i yang rtser son par bgyid cing /'byung 'gyur dza drag gsar brje slong la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs nub nges pa sngon dpag byas pa red/ bsam blo 'di dag gis tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas dpal 'byor rgyu rkyen gyis chab srid la thag gcod nus pa tshod dpag byas pas/ skabs de'i blo 'byed bsam blo ba gzhan pas bsam blo'i lta tshul las spyi tshogs 'gyur ldog gsal bshad byed pa'i rgya brtol pas ro'u se'u yi rang dbang dang / 'dra mnyam gyi bshad tshul gyi chu tshad sngon ma las 'phags pa red/ de bas kyang rtsa che ba ni ro'u se'u yis mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam min pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi rgyud rim gsal bshad byas par lo rgyus rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blo 'du zhing khos rang dbang 'dra mnyam de rang byung rnam pa'i rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam nas spyi tshogs rnam pa'i rang dbang med pa dang 'dra mnyam min pa/ de nas rim pa mtho ba'i rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gsar ba'i 'phel rgyas rgyud rim brjod pa dang / khos 'dra mnyam min pa dang ya rabs spyi tshogs byung ba ni yar rgyas kyi rigs shig yin mod/ 'on kyang yar rgyas 'di'i rigs su dbul phyug gtad langs su yod pas yang rjes su lus pa zhig kyang yin/ 'dra mnyam min pa dpal yon dang bstun nas yang rtser son pa dang go ldog tu song nas spyi tshogs kyang 'dra mnyam gsar ba zhig tu 'gyur/ bsam blo 'di dag gis lo rgyus kyi 'phel rgyas ni gcig gis gcig dgag pa'i dung 'khyil rnam pa'i mdun skyod kyi rtsod sgrub 'phel rgyas kyi rgyud rim zhig yin pa tshod dpag byas shing / blo 'byed bsam blo ba gzhan pas spyi tshogs mdun skyod ni drang thig las yar 'phel du sgom pa'i gzugs 'das rig pa'i lta ba las brtol/ de bas na/ en ghi sis ro'u se'u yi mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam min pa'i 'byung khungs dang gzhi rtsa'i rnam bshad ces pa ni rtsod sgruX /2 ba'i bcoms chos mchog gyur cig yin par bstod bsngags mdzad/

rgyal ngan sger gcod kyi dbang sgyur slog rjes/ mi'i rigs kyi 'dra mnyam dang rang dbang ji ltar mngon 'gyur byed ce na/ ro'u se'u yi spyi tshogs gan rgya'i rnam bshad ces par kho'i 'byor ldan gral rim dmangs gtso lam lugs kyi chab srid phugs bsam bton/ ma gzhir spyi tshogs gan rgya'i rnam bshadani dus rabs bcu bdun pa dang bco brgyad par yo rob gling la dar ba'i rgyal khab kyi 'byung khungs dang ngo bo'i cha 'jog 'grel ba'i rigs shig yin/ gzhung lugs 'di rigs kyis rgyal khab byung ba ni mi rnams kyi spyi mthun kha chad dang / kha chad khrod du tshang mas khas blangs pa'i dbang cha thob sprod kyi 'brel ba la gan rgya yin par 'dod/ dbyin ji'i ho ste sis/ rang byung rnam pa'i 'og tu mi rnams kyis phan tshun dmar gsod kyi rnyog 'dzing gi sdug bsngal bzo bsran byed mi thub par rang 'dod kyis dbang cha yod tshad dbang sgyur mkhan zhig la thob sprod byas shing / rang nyid blon 'bangs byas nas sgrig rim dang bde 'jags thob pa bzhed do// de lta bu'i spyi tshogs gan rgya'i rnam bshad kyis rgyal po'i lam lugs kyi lugs mthun rang bzhin rigs sgrub byas shing rgyal po'i lam lugs kyi rgyal khab kyi ched du zhabs 'degs zhus/ ro'u se'us bshad tshul 'di'i rigs dgag nas 'di ltar/ mi dmangs tshang ma smyon pa yin na ma gtogs mi dmangs kyis rang gi khe dbang dbang sgyur bar ster mi srid/ rgyu mtshan ni rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam ni mi'i lhan skyes kyi khe dbang yin la khe dbang 'di dag dor na ni mi'i thob thang dor ba yin pas/khos de lta bu'i spyi tshogs gan rgya'i rnam bshad kyis mi'i rang byung rang bzhin dang 'gal bas rdzun gtam mgo skor yin par 'dod/ ro'u se'u yi bsam par spyi tshogs gan rgya ngo ma ni mi dmangs dang dbang bsgyur mkhan gyis mnyam du btsugs pa'i kha chad tsam gtan nas min par mi dmangs rang dang 'brel ba'i chab srid thun mong rtsa 'dzugs (rgyal khaX/snar

gyi kha chad yin/ mi rnams kyis spyi tshogs gan rgya 'dzugs pa'i skabs su/ mi tshang mas rang rang gi khe dbang yod tshad spyi la phul bas mi re rer yang rgyal khab 'di'i thun mong las 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang thob pa dang / mi dmangs ni chings yig 'jog mkhan dang rgyal khab kyi bdag po red/ de bas kho tshos rgyal khab kyi dbang shugs rtsis na/ kho tshor phyi ngos nas rang byung gi 'dra mnyam dang / rang dbang shor na'ang don dngos su chab srid dang bca' khrims kyi 'dra mnyam dang rang dbang sngar las gsar ba dang tshad mtho ba zhig thob po// dngos gnas spyi tshogs gan rgyas btsugs pa'i rgyal khab tu mi dmangs tshang ma ni bdag dbang can nyid yin la/ mi dmangs kyi bdag dbang ni thun mong gi 'dod blos mngon par byed de/ der ni mi dmangs kyi thun mong gi 'dun pa dang thun mong gi khe phan 'dus yod pas/ rgyal khab kyi bya 'gul yod tshad thun mong gi 'dod blo ltar byed dgos/ de bas na de ni nam yang drang bden zhig go/ dngos gnas spyi tshogs gan rgyas btsugs pa'i rgyal khab tu mi dmangs la thad kur khrims 'dzugs kyi dbang cha yod la/ mi dmangs kyis thun mong gi 'dod blo ltar bca' khrims gtan 'khel byas stabs/ bca' khrims kyi gam du mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin te mi su la'ang bca' khrims las brgal ba'i rang dbang med/ mi tshang mas bca' khrims brtsi ba'i skabs su da gzod kho tshor rang dbang ldan/ dngos gnas spyi tshogs gan rgyas btsugs pa'i rgyal khab tu mi dmangs kyi khrims 'dzugs dbang cha ni ches mtho'i dbang shugs yin pas/ dbang shugs gzhan yod tshad (srid 'dzin dbang cha dang khrims 'dzin dbang cha sogs) kyis de brtsi dgos so//srid gzhung ni mi dmangs kyi 'dun pa lag bltar mkhan yin zhing / gal te srid gzhung thun mong gi 'dod blo dang 'gal na/ mi dmangs la de mtha' gcik+ta ༵ slog pa'i dbang cha yod/ srid gzhung gi 'go 'dzin pa ni mi dmangs

kyi zhabs 'degs pa yin pas mi dmangs kyi 'dun pa ltar bya ba bsgrub dgos shing dgos dbang gis mi dmangs kyis gsar bsko'am rnying 'then byed chogaro'u se'u yis ho bhe si'i rgyal dbang srung skyob ni de las ldog pa dang / ro'u se'u yi spyi tshogs gan rgya'i rnam bshad du bdag dbang dmangs la yod pa'i (yang na mi dmangs kyi bdag dbang )dmangs gtso ring lugs kyi bsam blo bstan yod la// des skabs de'i rim pa gsum pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi re 'dod gcig bsdus sgos 'thus tshab byas yod pa dang / gzhung lugs kyi skad cha bod spyad nas kho tsho'i srid dbang 'phrog len gyi re 'dun bsgrags yod pa red/ de bas na/ ro'u se'u yi spyi tshogs gan rgya'i rnam bshad ni khong gi mi'i rigs 'dra mnyam min pa'i skor gyi gzhung lugs dang 'dra bar skabs de'i h+pha ran se'i rim pa gsum pa'i rgya che ba'i mi dmangs la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod la rgol ba'i gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod kyi rigs sad du bcug par ma zad/ da rung kho tshos 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs pa'i bsam blo'i mtshon char gyur/ro'u se'u yi spyi tshogs chab srid kyi rig gzhung du chod gtam (/khyilo)mang po zhig ni dbyibs 'jog dang gtan tshigs kyis gzhi byas pas tshan rig gasnrub byed yid rton rung pa zhig med stabs/ de la mi 'dang sa dang phan tshun 'gal 'dzol du song pa mang po zhig yod do// dper na/ khong gi lhan skyes kyi mi'i thob thang dang spyir mi gshis bzang ba'i rtog bzo'i khrod du sngon rtogs smra ba dang lkog gyur gyi mi gshes smra ba'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi cha nges can zhig ldan la/ khos spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas ni spyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i 'gal ba ste thon skyed nus shugs dang thon skyed 'brel ba/ dpal 'byor rmang gzhi dang steng gi bkod pa'i 'gal ba 'gul skyod kyi phyi rol chos nyid kyi nus pa'i 'bras bur ma shes stabs/ khos sger 'dzin lam lugs ni mi'i 3/snas

'dra mnyam min pa'i 'byung gzhir bstan mod/ 'on kyang yang khos sger 'dzin lam lugs la srung 'geb byed pa dang / yang khong gis sger 'dzin lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs su bshu gzhog gral rim dang bshu gzhog myong ba'i gral rim gyi khe phan rtsa ba nas 'gal zlar gyur pa dang / gcig gyur gyi thun mong 'dod blo dang dmangs yongs 'thus tshab kyi bca' khrims 'byung mi thub pa mi shes pas/ mi tshang mar rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gyi bshad tshul yang stong bar gyur/ de bas na/ en snyi sis/ ro'u so'u yi chab srid phugs bsam de lag lenakhrod du 'byor ldan gral gyi dmangs gtso spyi mthun rgyal khab tsam du zad ces gsungs/ 'on kyang skabs de'i h+pha ran se'i 'gal ba gtso bo ni rgya che ba'i rim pa gsum pa ba dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod lam lugs bar gyi 'gal ba yin pas/ ro'u so'u yi spyi tshogs chab srid kyi gzhung lugs la mi 'dang sa de dag yod na'ang / sngar bzhin rgya che ba'i mi dmangs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la rgol ba'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i skabs su nus pa chen po thon zhing mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus su shugs rkyen gting zab thebs/ da lta yang ro'u se'u yi spyi tshogs chab srid kyi gzhung lugs kyis nga tshor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi chab srid bsam blo'i dug lhag la ngos 'dzin dang sel thabs thad blo sgo 'byed pa'i don snying ldan no//yo6

sabacadasterabargyad sda/ rig gnas kun 'dus grub mtha'i dadu mdzod/wa rnyis rte ro ṭha/en ghi sis/ gal te mi sus bden don dang drang bden gyi brtse zhen ched (skad cha 'di'i drang phyogs kyi don ltar bshad pa)mi tshe hril bo phud ce na/rnyis rte ro ṭha ni de lta bu zhig yin no// gsungs/ ②lhas rnye ro ṭha ni h+pha ran se'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig yin la/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i yo rab gling du grags 'gul thebs pa'i blo 'byed bya 'gul gyi skabs su/ khong ni mkhas pa mang po'i khrod nas 'bur du thon te phul tu byung ba'i dbu khrid pa chen por gyur/ de ltar 'gyur don khong rig pa rno ba dang rnam rig gsal la mthong thos khyad par ba zhig yin pa las kyang gal che ba ni kho'i mi tshe hril bor bden don 'tshol snyeg gi lam gyi bla na med pa'i mi gshis dang 'jigs pa med pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi snying stobs la mi rnams kyis gus bkur dang bstod bsngags thob po//nyis rte ro ṭha ni h+pha ran se'i lung gī le'i (tshe'i 4)lag shes bzo las pa chung chung zhig gi khyim nas skyes shing / pha ni sa de'i skad grags che ba'i gri bzo mkhan zhig yin/ pha'i gso skyong 'og spyi lo 1732lor nyis rnye ro ṭha pha ri si slob chen mthar phyin tshe zhib 'jug slob ma'i 'dzin rtags thob/ yin kyang las gnas gdam pa'i thad nyis rje ro ṭha dang pha'i bar 'gal ba byung / lo bgres pa'i phas bu mthar phyin rjes gzu gyod pa zhig byed pa'i re ba rdzutā pa

dang / rnyis rte ro ṭha gzu gyod pa'i las la 'dun pa spu tsam yang med par kho'i phugs bsam dang 'tshol snyig ni mu mthud du shes bya'i bang mdzod du rtsad zhib byed rgyu de yin/ phas bu'i re 'dod ma rtogs par thengs mang kha brda byas rung 'bras bu ma smin pas/ mthar rnyis rnye ro ṭha dang 'gro 'ong bcad nas khor 'tsho ba'i 'gro song ma gtong / rnyis rnye ro ṭhas rang gi phugs bsam mngon 'gyur byed pa'i ched du pha yi ngo rgol la ma 'jom par blo thag rbad chad kyis rang gis gdam pa'i mi tshe'i lam phyogs su gom kha bsgyur/ de nas bzung rnyis rte ro bhas dpe klog las gzhan dpe tshong gnyer mkhan la brten nas chos khang la bsgrags yig bris te 'tsho ba ngan ngon la mi bsten thabs med byung /'on kyang phyi'i nom pas dbul ba'i rnyis r+bhe ro ṭha bsam pa'i thad nas nyin rer 'thus sgo je tshang dang je phyug tu gyur/ dka' spyad 'bad brtson brgyud de khong rtsis rig la nang byan chud pa ra ma zad/ snyi ri si'i yi ge dang dbyi ṭa li'i yi gedabyin yig sogs kyang khong du chud la/ bha khon (2 2'a000)dang ho bhe si(50664)lo khe sogs ming grags can gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i bsam blor blo skyed gting zab thebs shing / rjes su kho rang nyid shes ldan gyi mtshan nyid rig pa zhig tu 'gyur ba'i rmang gzhi bting /rnyis rnye ro ṭhas rig gnas kun 'dus zhes pa'i dpe cha rtsom sgrig mdzad de ming grags cher gyur la/ go skabs de 'dra thob pa ni glo bur ba zhig ste/rnyis rte ro ṭhas gnyen sgrig byas rjes/ sngar bzhin las 'gan nges gtan zhig med par yig sgyur la brten nas dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba rol/ thengs shig dpe skrun khang zhig dang rnyis rte ro ṭha bgros mthar khong gis dbyin yig gi rig gnas kun 'dus zhes pa'i dpe deb de h+pha ran se'i yi ger bsgyur dgos par 'gan blangs nas kha gsab dang mi 'dang sar gsar snon byed pa'i re ba brdo18/ spyi lo 1747lor phyogs gnyis gas chod yig bkod pa dang / rnyis rnye

ro ṭha rig gnas kun 'dus kyi rtsom sgrig pa gtso bor bskos/ de nas bzung mi lo nyer lnga tsam gyi ring rnyis rte ro bla'i sems shugs dang nus pa yod rgu phal cher bya bzhag chen po 'di'i thad phud pa red/rig gnas kun 'dus kyi ming cha tshang la rig gnas kun 'dus sam tshan rig sgyu rtsal dang lag rtsal zhib 'grel tshig mdzod ces zer la/ der glegs bam sor lnga yod de/ nang don gtso bo ni rang byung tshan rig dang spyi tshogs tshan rig 'phrul chas bzo rtsal sogs so// 'di dag la la ni dbyin yig gi rig gnas kun 'dus las bsgyur ba dang / la la ni t+tas rte ro ṭha sogs kyis bris pa red/ thog mar nyis rte ro blas las 'gan 'di bzhes pa'i dmigs 'ben gtso bo ni go skabs 'di bed spyad nas mi dmangs la tshan rig shes bya dang dngos gtso smra ba/ dmangs gtso/ rang dbang sogs kyi bsam blo khyab bsgrags 'dod pa red/ rig gnas kun 'dus kyi nang don de bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs dang chos lugs lha rig par 'gal 'dug pas rig gnas kun 'dus dpe skrun gyi rgyud rim du gtso sgrig pa t+tas rte ro ṭha la dka' khag dang gnod pa sna tshogs thebs/spyi lo 1751lor/ rig gnas kun 'dus kyi glegs bam dang po par du bskrun thub byung zhing / phyi lor h+pha ran se'i gong ma'i srid 'gan tshogs pas 'gog pa'i bka' phab/ spyi lo 1759lor skabs de'i rtog dpyod pa'i 'go ba chen mos rig gnas kun 'dus la gtug bsher byas par ma zad/ chos lugs la dgrar bltas pa'i skyon bkal nas rig gnas kun 'dus par skrun byed du ma bcug dus mnyam du gong mas yang rig gnas kun 'dus zhes pa'i dpe char le bda' dang btsan gyis dpe cha yod tshad mer bsreg dgos pa'i bka' phab/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin log spyod kyi ngan shugs 'og rig gnas kun 'dus lo brgyad tsam gyi yun la par bskrun byed du ma bcu/ chos

rnyis dhe ro thar yi mug chen po skyes/yin kyang phyi nas thon pa'i dgra bo'i gnon shugs de tshod kyis thug thub la/ de bas kyang lhas rte ro ṭha khong nyid ches yid skyo ba'i gnas ni las rogs pa'i nang kha 'thor ya bral byung ba de yin te/ log spyod stobs shugs kyi gdug rtsub 'og sngon rnyis rte ro ṭha dang mnyam 'brel byas pa'i mi 'ga' skrag nas rig gnas kun 'dus kyi rtsom sgrig las gnas las bud/ khyad par du lhas rte ro ṭha'i las rogs gtso bo dang rtsom sgrig pa gzhon pa/ skad grags can gyi rtsis rig mkhas pa dā lan sgye yis las gnas las 'bud par bshad pas/ khong gi sems la sdug bsngal tshad med bskyed/ gzhan yang skabs de'i skad grags che ba'i bsam blo ba ro'u se'u dang yang lta ba ma mthun stabs rtes ḍho ro ṭha dang 'brel ba gtsang gcod bgyis pas/ spyi tshogs su shugs rkyen chen po bzos/ 'on kyang phyi'i gnon shugs dang nang khul gyi kha 'thor gang yin rung rnyis rnye ro ṭha'i mu mthud du mdun skyod byed pa'i sems thag de bsgul ma thub/ khos mi je nyung du song pa'i gnas tshul 'og rang gcig pus 'gan khur nas brtson pa mthar skyel byas pas/ spyi lo 1772lor khong gi 'char gzhi ltar glegs bam sum cu so lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi rig gnas kun 'dus zhes pa legs grub byung pas/ h+pha ran se'i mi rigs la yun brtan gyi bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi rdo ring zhig btsugs pa dang mnyam du rtsom sgrig gi rgyud rim du khong gi sra brtan 'gyur med kyi spobs pa la'ang h+pha ran se'i mi dmangs kyis brtsi bkur thob/lhas rte ro blas rig gnas kun 'dus rtsom sgrig byed skabs kyang mtshan nyid rig par zhib 'jug byas nas gsung rtsom mi nyung ba zhig mdzad pas/ kho rang gis gzhi byas pa'i rig gnas kun 'dus grub mtha'i dngos gtso ring luX spyang / h+pha ran se'i bsam blo'i lo rgyus steng rig gnas kun 'dus grub

mthar don gnyis yod de/ sgra yangs pa'i sgo nas bshad na/ rig gnas kun 'dus zhes pa'i dpe cha rtsom sgrig la zhugs mkhan yod tshad dam yang na der rtsom 'bri mkhan tshang ma grub mtha' 'dir gtogs pa dang / sgra dog pa'i sgo nas bshad na/ rnyis rte ro ṭha gtso byas pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs pa'i grub mtha' tsam la go'o// dper na lā me 'e ri dang / tel we khri'u sogs mtshan nyid rig pa ba rig gnas kun 'dus rtsom sgrig gi bya bar ma zhugs rung mi rnams khong tsho sngar mus bzhin rig gnas kun 'dus grub mtha'i dngos gtso ring lugs par 'dod/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho rnyis rnye ro ṭha yi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta tshul dang mthun pa'i rkyen gyis so//rnyis rte ro ṭha ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i skabs kyi mi zhig yin pa dang / skabs de'i rang byung tshan rig gi yul du ('phrul chas) 'gyur med shugs rig gis sngar ltar dbang bsgyur yod do// de bas na/ rnyis rte ro bla'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul spyir 'gyur med dang gzugs 'das rig pa'i bsam gzhigs kyi 'khyer so las 'das med de/ lhag par du snga dus khong gi mi 'dang sa'i tshul ches gsal/ rnyis r+bhe ro 'as srol rgyun gyi chos lugs lha rig par dgag pa rgyag na'ang kho yang 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba po gzhan dang 'dra bar dkon mchog gam lha yod par ma dgag rgyu mtshan khong gis bltas na nus pa dang ldog nus shugs rig gi chos nyid kyis gzhogs 'dogs byas pa'i rang byung khams su cis kyang ang dang po'i sgul shugs shig yod tshe/ da gzod gzhi grub dang 'phel rgyas yong thub/ de yang ang dang po'i sgul shugs ni dkon mchog gi nus shugs su 'dod do// de ni rnyis rte ro ṭha'i steng mngon pa'i 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba'i thun mong gi lha rig pa'i mjug ma red/ yin kyang / spyi lo 1749lor rnyis rte ro jas spel pa'i long ba'i 'phrin yig rnam bshad (྅jom tsā/ )ces par rang gi lha ri~X pya'i

mjug ma bcad de lha med smra ba'i bsam blo bton nas/ nga lha yod par yid ches dgos na nges par du ngas lha mthong dgos/ de las cig shos su gyur na gzhan gang la'ang yid mi ches zer/ 'dis don dngos su lha yod pa dgag 'dug go/ rtsom yig 'dis dngos gtso smra ba dang lha med smra ba'i lta ba khyab bsgrags byas rkyen/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang 'dzin las khungs dang chos tshogs la 'gal nas rnyis rte ro blar nyes med nyes 'dzugs byas te zla gsum lhag la bkag yin na'ang khong gis khrims khang du shing thur gyis smyug gu byas shing byang rtsi dred nas chang dang bsres pas snag tsha bzos/ tshags par gyi stong sar mi mthud du khong gi lha med smra ba'i bsam blo brjod pas/ kho'i da~X' mi zhum zhing gnya' mi chag pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi snying stobs gsal bar ma na/rnyis rte ro blar ci'i phyir 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba bo gzhan las brgal thub pa dang / rang gi lha rig pa'i mjug ma rtsa ba nas bcad de mu mthud du dgag rtsod kyi lha med smra ba zhig tu gyur pa red ce na/ rgyu mtshan ni/rnyis snya ro ṭha'i 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba'i 'jig rten lta tshul du da dung rtsod sgrub kyi rgyu cha 'ga' 'dus yod de/ khong gis rtsod sgrub kyi bsam gzhigs kyis 'jig rten la bltas na 'gyur med smra ba'i gzhi rgya las brtol nges la thob pa'i 'bras bu'ang mi mthun/ de ni skabs der mtshon na ha cang dka' gzhig lhan la rnyis rnye ro ṭha bsam blo'i gtso dpon du 'gyur ba'i 'gag rtsa'ang yin dus rabs bcu bdun par 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs pas/'jig rten gyi 'byung gzhi la zhib dpyad byed pa'i skabs su/ dngos po ni 'jig rten gyi 'byung gzhi yin par brjod de/ dngos po ni ang dang po dang bkāswā spya ni ang gnyis pa ste/ bsam blo ni dngos po las mched par 'dod/

de lta bu'i 'jig rten spyi'i lta stangs ni yang dag pa zhig yin pas/ chos lugs lha rig pa dang sems gtso ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing khrod du'ang phan nus thon/ yin na'ang mtshan nyid rig pa ba de dag la dngos po'i ngos 'dzin thad yang 'gyur med smra ba'i rgyas btab 'dug ste/ khong tshos dngos po'i gzhi rtsa'i rang bzhin mngon pa ni rgya skyed kyi rang bzhin te/ ring ba dang yangs pa mtho ba'i yul te/ dngos po tshang ma ni gzugs can yin la/gzugs med ni dngos po ma yin par 'dod/ lta tshul 'dis rang byung las brgal ba'i lha'i gzhi grub dgag na'ang de nyid tshan rig dang mi mthun te/des 'jig rten gyi bya dngos bar gyi rang bzhin gyi khyad par khyad du bsad pas/'jig rten steng ci'i phyir sna mang gi bya dngos yod pa'i dngos don 'di gsal bshad byed mi thub po// yang chos lugs lha rig pas ni 'jig rten steng gi bya dngos mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa ni dkon mchog gis dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas bkod sgrig byas pa'i 'bras bur rlom pa red/ der bltas na 'gyur med dngos gtso smra bas khungs med kyi gtam der rgol ba'i nus pa zad pa red/cis ro 'ge 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba'i bya dngos kyi rang bzhin gcig rkyang can du bsgyur ba'i nor 'khrul gyi phyogs la rgol phyir dngos po ni rgyu mi 'dra ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i bsam blo bton/ kho'i bsam par 'jig rten ni rgyu mi 'dra ba du ma'i dngos po'i rgyu cha 'dus pa las grub par 'dod de/rgyu mi 'dra ba'i dngos po'i rgyu cha de dag la brten nas da gzod 'jig rten steng gi 'dra min sna tshogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul 'di grub la/gal te rgyu mthun gyi dngos po'i rgyu chas 'jig rten 'di grub par byas na tshon mdog gcig gis 'jig rten bris pa dang 'dra bar dngos gnas bro ba med pa dang ches spyir btang ba zhig tu bzhed/ lhas rnye ro ja'i gsal bshad 'dir skabs der tshan rig gi khungs lung 'dzoms po zhig med na'ang / dus 3tāzlos

bcu bdun pa'i 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs dang bsdur na sngon thon chen po zhig red do//rnyis rte ro bla'i byas rjes 'gangs chen gzhan gcig ni dngos po dang 'gul skyod kyi 'brel ba dpyad sdur byas pa de yin/ sngon gyi 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs pas 'gyur med shugs rig gi nus pa dang ldog pa'i nus pa'i gnas lugs sgos 'jig rten stong gi dngos gzugs 'gul skyod yod tshad kyi rgyu rkyen gsal bshad byas te/ dkon mchog gis 'jig rten bkod sgrig byas pa'i lha rig pa'i lta bar ngo rgol byed pa'i phyir yin na'ang / kho tshos nor 'khrul sgos 'gul skyod dang dngos po so sor phye nas dngos po 'gul skyod kyi rgyu mtshan phyi'i sgul shugs su 'du bar byas shing / mjug mthar yang ches thog ma'i skul mkhan zhig yod pa khas len dgos byung pas/ don du dkon mchog gagigrub pa'i khas len du song ngo // yin kyang nyis rte ro ṭha yang lha med smra ba'i tshad du slebs pa ni khong gi gzhung lugs kyi tshad 'gyur med smra ba'i gzhi sgrom de las brgal te 'gul skyod dang dngos po zung 'brel byas so// khos 'gul skyod ni dngos po dang kha 'bral mi rung bar mnyam du 'brel 'dug par bsam/ 'gul skyod ces pa ni dngos po rang nyid kyi 'gul skyod de dngos po'i nang gnas kyi rgyu rkyen gyis byung bar byas pa las phyi'i shugs kyi ram 'degs la brten mi dgos te/ dper na/ gal te ze tshwa dang mu zi/ me bcas mnyam du bzhag na de tsho'i bar phan tshun gyi nus pas myur du 'gad gtor 'byung pa lta bu'o// rnyis rnye ro ṭhas dngos po rang nyid kyi 'gul skyod gtso bor brjod nas phyi rol na yod pa dang rang byung dang brgal ba'i stobs shugs sogs gang rung gis dngos po'i 'gul skyod la ram 'degs yod pa dgag pas/ des ni ches thog ma'i skul mkhan yod pa khas ma bzhes shing 'gyur med smra bas rjes su bdīkā sna'i lha rig pa'i mjug ma bcad zin to// yin kyang dus rabs dang

tshan rig gi chu tshad kyi dbang gis rnyis rte ro jas yang dag sgos 'gul skyod ni bya dngos nang khul gyi rgyu rkyen gyis 'byung du bcug par 'dod na'ang / khong gis bya dngos nang khul gyi 'gal ba ni bya dngos skul 'ded kyi gzhi rtsa'i rgyu rkyen yin pa ma shes pas sngar ltar nus pa dang ldog nus kyi sgo nas bya dngos nang khul gyi 'gul skyod gsal bshad byas pa red/mi'i bsam gzhigs byung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / mi'i lus phung dang bsam gzhigs kyi 'brel ba ji ltar gsal bshad bya rgyu de yang snga mo zhig nas lha rig pa ba dang dngos gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba rim byon gyis rgyun mi chad par rtsod gleng byed pa'i gzhi zhig ste/ lha rig pa ba dang sems gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba 'gas bsam gzhigs lkog gyur can du bsgyur te/ dper na rnam shes mi 'jig pa dang / rnam shes btsal 'tshol sogs kyi bshad tshul tshang mas bsam gzhigs ni mi lus dang bral nas gnas thub par ma zad/ mi lus kyi stobs shugs la dbang bsgyur thub par 'dod pa red/ 'gyur med dngos gtso smra bas lha rig pa dang sems gtso smra bar dgag pa rgyag pa'i skabs su/ bsam gzhigs mi lus la brten pa'i rang bzhin gtso bor brjod nas dngos po med pa'i klad par bsam gzhigs yod mi srid par snyam/ de 'dra'i gsal bshad kyis nus shugs yod pa'i sgo nas lha rig pa dang semasagatso smra bar dgag pa brgyab pas spyi babs nas bshad na yang dag pa red/ 'on kyang 'gyur med smra bas bsam gzhigs mi lus la brten pa stabs bdes 'gyur med rten gnas kyi 'brel par bshad pas/ ha lam klad chen las bsam gzhigs byung ba ni skye khams kyi nus pa tsam ste 'gyur med tshur 'phros rigs shig tu song / dper na/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba bo ho snye sis tshor snang ni phyi yul gyi nus pa dang dbang po'i ldog nus khrod du byung bar bzhed la/ de 'dra'i gsal bshad (3༷sal

bshad)tshan rig dang mi mthun par ma zad da dung mi'i rigs kyi bsam gzhigasakyi byung ba dang 'phel rgyas kyi don dngos dang yang mi mthun pa red/spya bas ṭā/ des sngar bzhin lha rig pa dang sems gtso smra ba rtsod pas bzlog thub cis// rnye ro blas bsam gzhigs kyi 'byung rtsa'i thad dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ khong gis bsam gzhigs ni mi'i klad pa'i 'gul skyod kyi nus pa zhig ste mi'i klad pa dang bral na bsam gzhigs zhes pa'ang gzhi med du 'gyur la/ klad pa'i gzhi grub ni bsam gzhigs 'byung ba'i sngon 'gror 'dod/ 'on kyang nyis rnye ro ṭha yang 'gyur med smra bas bsam gzhigs ni klad pa'i 'gyur med tshur 'phror 'dod pa'i lta ba ltar mi bzhed par bsam gzhigs dang dngos po'i 'brel ba ni sla mo dang 'gyur med kyi rten gnas 'brel ba zhig min par gsungs/ bsam gzhigs ni dngos po tshang mar yod pa zhig min par dngos po'i mtho rim rnam pa dang phan tshun 'brel ba kho na red/ de bas na mi'i rigs kyi bsam gzhigs kyi byung bas yun ring gi 'phel rgyas brgyud rim gyi lo rgyus brgyud myong ba red/khong gis bltas na thog mar rang byung khams kyi skye med dngos po'i khrod du rtul bo'i myong tshor rang bzhin zhig yod la/ de ni shugs zhan pa'i tshor snang zhig red/rjes su skye ldan dngos po byung rjes rtsi shing dang srog chags bar gnas pa'i gson gshis dod pa'i myong tshor rang bzhin zhig byung / de ni tshor snang gi nus shugs shig yin pas/ de ni rtul bo'i myong tshor rang bzhin las sngon du skyod 'dug yin kyang bsam gzhigs 'byung bar da dung bar thag ring po zhig mchis/ de las dus yun ring bo rgyud mthar da gzod rang byung khams su bdī/ /zhigs ldan pa'i mi byung bar bzhed/ der bltas na/ nyis rte ro ṭhas

ltos na rang byung khams su sngon la rtul bo'i skye dngos nas myong tshor skye dngos dang / de nas bsam gzhigs kyi skye dngos byung ste yun ring gi 'phel rgyas rgyud rim brgyud par 'dod pa gsal/ rnyis rte ro blas ngal rtsol dang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen gzhan pas rgyud rim 'dir thon pa'i nus pa mi shes stabs/ tshan rig gi sgo nas mi'i rigs kyi bsam gzhigs byung ba'i gzhi rtsa gsod 'grol byed mi thub/ yin na'ang rnyis rnye ro bla'i bsam blo skabs de'i lo rgyus cha rkyen ha cang ldan dka' ba zhig red/ des lha rig pa dang sems gtso smra ba dgag pa dang / de dang mnyam du 'gyur med smra ba'i shugs rkyen zur du phud nas rjes sor mi'i rigs la tshan rig sgos bsam gzhigs kyi ngo bo gsed 'grol byed par rin thang ldan pa'i sgrub byed bton pa red/lhas ro blas mtshan nyid rig pa'i thad kyi byas rjes 'di dag ni rnying hrul du gyur pa'i lding khang chung chung zhig las mi lo sum cur sdug rus byas nas 'grub pa red/ sku ma 'das pa'i gza' 'khor gnyis kyi sngon du da gzod gzhi rgya cung che ba'i sdod khang zhig lag son byung / dgung lo bgres pa'i rnyis rnye ro bla'i 'thab rtsod kyi 'dun pa sngar bzhin spu tsam yang nyams med de/khong sku bsnyung ba'i skabs der ye shu'i chos 'chad mkhan zhig thon nas khong chos sgor zhugs par bskul zhing / sngar khong gis lha med smra ba bsgrags par 'gyod bshags byas na lha yul du 'gro thub par bshad kyang rnyis rnye ro jas kha ya ci yang ma gnang bar dngos gtso smra ba dang lha med smra ba zhig gi yun brtan 'gyur med kyi bla med rang bzhin mngon par bgyis/ spyi lo 1784lo'i zla 7mas 11nyin gyi dgung zas bzhes rjes/ rnyis rte ro 'ar chung mas bton pa'i ches mjug gi dri bar lan 'debs khom ma byung bar 'jig rten mi yul dang gtan du bral song /rnyisalha ro ṭha 'das rjes kyi yun ring zhig la kho'i gzhung lugs sdu shārtsi

mthong ma thob/ de ni khong rang nyid kyis gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom pa bo mi nyung ba zhig 'das nas yun ring po zhig song rjes da gzod kho tshor thob 'os pa'i bstod bsngags thob la/ de ni skyes stobs kyi shes rab can phal che ba'i las dbang ste/ de dag gis kho tsho'i dus skabs der rtogs pa'i ched ma yin no//stabs legs pa zhig la mar khe si'i ring lugs byung rjes/ rnyis rte ro ja'i gzhung lugs grub 'bras dang lo rgyus kyi phan nus las gzhan kho'i bla na med pa'i rang gshes la drang bden gyi gdeng 'jog dang khas len dag sel gnang zhing / khong gi mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus steng bzhag pa'i mdzad 'phrin de mi rabs rjes mas nam yang brjed thabs bral ba zhig red/358

saricadanyer dgug/ khe phan gyi sgo nas mi'i bya 'gulayodatsan gsalagashad byed pa'i mtshan nyid rig par/wa wanyal wakhri'u/lug dang seng ge gnyis las gang ni gdug rtsub che zhe na/ mi tshos rgyun par lug ni zhi dul dang seng ge ni gdug rtsub skrag 'os pa zhig tu 'dod mod/'on kyang dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i h+pha ran se'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba hel we khri'us kun dang mi mthun pa'i lta ba zhig bton te/ khong gis rtswa dang lo ma'i steng du 'tsho ba rol ba'i 'bu srin la mtshon na rtswa za ba'i lug ni skrag sa'i yul red/ rgyu mtshan ni lug gis rtswa za skabs 'bu srin yang za srid la/ seng ge yis rtswa dang 'bu srin mi za bar ma zad da dung 'bu srin la gnod skyel mkhan gyi lug la chad pa gcod/ de bas na/ hel we khri'u yis gal te 'bu srin gyi khe phan la bltas nas dpyad 'jog byas na lug ni seng ge las gdug rtsub che bar 'dod de/ khong gis khe phan mi mthun pas 'di ltar bya dngos kyi rnam pa 'gyur 'gro ste/ seng ge ni nga tsho'i mig sngar gdug rtsub che ba'i srog chags shig yin la 'bu srin la mtshon na lug red/ hel we khri'us dper brjod 'di bed spyad nas khong gi skad grags che ba'i khe phan gzhung lugs gsal bshad byas pa red/khu lo t+ta a rnyi re an tel we 'i'u (mamacho ma tshoṣ+ṭha tshopo ṣ+ṭha)ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i h+pha ran se'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi 3/rdon

nyid rig pa ba dang blo 'byed bsam blo ba zhig red/ khong spyi lo 1715lor pha ri si'i rgyal blon dbang sgyur tshogs khag gi sman pa zhig gi khyim du sku bltams pas/ chung dus nas slob gso bzang po zhig thob/ 'on kyang khong slob grwa'i chos lugs lha rig par zhen pa gting nas log ste bsam pa'i 'char so spyi tshogs su 'khor nas mdun skyod kyi bsam blo bsdu len byas/ de nas na tshod gzhon pa'i skabs su gong ma'i srid gzhung gi spyi khyab khral dpon byas myong ba dang / las gnas (rigs)'dir rtag par rgyal khab kyi gang sar song nas mi sna tshogs la 'brel 'dris byed dgos pas/ khor skabs de'i h+pha ran se'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod dbang sgyur gyi mun nag dang mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal la rgyus lon byed pa'i go skabs nges can byung / skabs de'i h+pha ran se spyi tshogs kyi skyon dang lugs mthun min pa'i rang bzhin lkog 'byin byed pa'i phyir du/ hel we khri'us kho'i gzhung lugs la zhib 'jug byed 'go brtsams/ khos rang gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs bton cing de spyad nas spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus snang tshul gsal bshad byas pas khe phan gzhir bzung ba'i spyi tshogs gzhung lugs cha tshang zhig grub/tel we khri'us khe phan ni mi yi bya 'gul tshang ma thag gcod byed pa'i stobs shugs su bzhed de/ khong gis khe phan ni nga tsho'i skul shugs gcig pu yin te/ mi rnams kyis rang srog blos btang bar 'dra na'ang gzhan gyi bde ba'i ched du rang gi bde ba blos mi gtong ste/ chu rgyun ni chu 'gor phyir mi bzhur pa dang / mi rnams kyis kyang rang gi khe phan gyi rgyun gcod mi srid ces gsungs/ hel we khri'u yis da rung khe phan gyi nus pa rang byung chos nyid kyi tshad du bton nas/ khong gis/ gal te rang byung khams ni 'gul skyod kyi chos nyid ltar yin na sems khams ni khe phan gyi chos nyid ji bzhin no zer/de 130 na/ hel we khri'u yis 'bu srin gyi mig nang lug ni seng ge las gdug

rtsub che ba'i dpe yis khe phan gyi gtan 'khel nus pa gsal bshad byas shing /spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i gang sa gang du khe phan gyis mi yi yod tshad la ram 'degs byed pa dang / mi re re'i ngos zin dang bya 'gul gtan 'khel byas par ma zad/ spyi tshogs hril po'i khrims lugs rmang gzhi dang kun spyod tshad gzhir gyur pa red/ dus nam dang gnas gang zhig tu kun spyod kyi gnad don thad dang yang na ngos zin gyi gnad don tshang mar mi rang gi khe phan gyis rang gi dpyad 'jog thag gcod byed pa dang / spyi'i khe phan gyis rgyal khab kyi dpyad 'jog thag gcod byed par 'dod/ khong gis/ mi'i spyod lam gyis nam yang kho'i shes rtogs kyi khe phan dang bstun la mi rnams kyis de tshor yod med gang yin rung de ni don dngos thad kyi gnas lugs sheg go zer/tel we khri'us bshad pa'i khe phan gyi don khyab rgya ha cang che ste/ der mi rnams kyi don dngos 'tsho ba'i gon pa dang kha zas/ sdod gnas/ 'gro 'dug sogs kyi dngos po'i dgos mkho dang / yang mi rnams kyi mtshan snyan dang go gnas/ dbang cha/ brtse dung sogs bsam pa'i 'tsho ba'i 'tshol snyeg sogs 'du ba red/ khong gis gal te lus phung gso ba'i zas rigs ni chu dang mkha' dbugs bzhin ma bcas lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos po zhig yin na/ mi nam yang 'gul 'dod mi skyes la/ nam zhig bkres tshe da gzod 'gul skyod byed do// hel we khri'us ci'i phyir mi gzengs bstod dang rgyu nor/ sku drag gi go gnas rim par dga' ba gsal bshad byed skabs/ khong gis mi gzengs bstod (mtshan snyan)dang rgyu nor/ sku drag gi go gnas la dga' ba min par 'di'i rigs kyi mtshan snyan dang rgyu nor/ sku drag gi go gnas 'di dag gis tshab byas pa'i bde skyid la dga' ba red/ rgyu mtshan ni mtshan snyan gyis mi'i sems su spro snang thob tu 'jug pa dang / rgyu nor gyis mi'i lus phung thad kyi re ba skong thub pa dang / sku drag gi go gnas kyis bde skyid myong ba'i dbyirdo cha

thob thub pa red/ hel we khri'u yis spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi snang tshul gang mang zhig las khe phan gyis mi'i don dngos spyod lam la bkod sgrig byed par ma zad/ da dung mi'i bsam pa'i 'gul skyod la'ang bkod sgrig byed/ de bas na/khe phan gyis mi yi bkod sgrig nus pa ni spyir btang ba dang / nges can pa ste bzlog mi thub pa'i mjug 'bras shig tu rtogs so/holawe khri'u yi khe phan bshad tshul gyi gzhung lugs rten gzhi ni kho'i mi gshes smra ba red/ nyel we khri'u yis bshad pa'i mi gshes la yang bdag gces kyang zer/ khong gis bdag gces dang sger sems/ rang don sogs don gcig tu bzhag ste/ nga tshor chung dus nas rang chas su gnas pa'i brtse sems gcig pu ni bdag la gces pa yin la/ de 'dra'i lus phung gi myong tshor rang bzhin gyis gzhi byas pa'i gces sems ni mi su dang su la yod pa red/ mi rnams kyi slob gso ji 'dra'i mi mthun na'ang 'di'i rigs kyi brtse sems nam yang kho tsho'i steng du 'dra mtshungs yin te/ dus rabs nam zhig dang / rgyal khabagang du'ang mi rnams rang la gces pa ni gzhan la gces pa'i tshad las brgal ba red/ der bltas na/ hol we khri'us bdag gces ni mi'i rigs kyi brtse sems gcig pu yin la mi re rer yod pa'i 'gyur med kyi rang gshes su gsungs pas/ don dngos su mi yi rang gshis ni sger sems las ma 'das par bstan la/ de ni kho'i khe phan bshad tshul gyi gzhung lugs kyi sngon 'gro da/ nyal we khri'u yis ci'i phyir sger sems ni mi yi rang gshes su ltos pa red ce na/ 'di khong gis brnan bshad byed pa'i tshor ba'i nyams myong gi ngos zin smra ba dang 'brel che ste/ khong gis mi la lus phung gi myong tshor rang bzhin dang dran pa gnyis kyi nus shugs ldan pas da gzod 'jig rten ngos zin nas ba~Xs byung / de las lus phung myong tshor rang bzhin gyi tshor snang ni 'go

'dzin sa yin par bzhed/ tel we khri'us yang tshor snang la bde ba'i tshor snang dang sdug bsngal gyi tshor snang gnyis su bgos nas kho'i bsam par sdug bsngal la gzur ba dang bde skyid 'tshol snyeg byed pa ni mi'i lus phung myong tshor gyi re ba dang mi'i rigs thun mong gi rang gshis su 'dod de/ khong gis mi la lus phung gi bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi tshor snang ldan pas sdug bsngal la gzur nas bde ba 'tshol ba red/ de bas na khos phyi ma la gzur zhing snga ma don du gnyer ro// de 'dra'i rtag par gzur ba dang 'tshol snyeg la bdag gis bdag gces su 'bod do// de 'dra'i brtse sems ni lus phung myong tshor rang bzhin gyi thad ga'i mjug 'bras red/ de bas na de ni mi re rer yod pas mi dang 'bral thabs med do// der gzhigs na hel we khri'u yis de 'dra'i sdug gzur bde 'tshol gyi rang mos rang bzhin gyis mi rnams kyi 'dod pa dang brtse sems yod tshad thag gcod byed pa dang / yang mi rnams kyi mtshan snyan dang go gnas/rgyu nor sogs 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i nang nus la skul lcag byas par snyam pa red/khong gis bltas na mi rnams kyi phyogs so so'i khe phan mdor bsdus na tshang ma ni rnam pa tsam 'gyur ba'i bdag gces las ma 'das par 'dod de/ khos lus phung myong tshor rang bzhin las mi'i rigs kyi thun mong gi rang gshes ni sdug gzur bde 'tshol gyi mi gshes sger sems smra ba'i lta ba bton/ hol we khri'u yi ngos zin smra bar dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lugs mthun gyi cha yod mod/'on kyang kho'i mjug sdom ni nor 'khrul du song ngo // hel we khri'u yis ngos zin gyi 'byung khungs ni phyi rol gyi khams yin pa khag thag byas cing tshor ba'i nyams myong nas 'go bcoms par bzhed pas/ de ni dngos gtso ring lugs kyi yang dag lta ba red/ 'on kyang khos lus phung myong tshor rang bzhin gyi mngon sum ngos zin gyi nus pa phyogs re 'ud brjod byas te/ de ni mi'i bya spyod thams cad kyi nges 'bebs stobs shugs su bshad nas/ mi'i ngozlo /na

tshang ma tshor snang gi phyogs su 'dus shing rjes dpag gi ngos zin dang mngon sum gyi ngos zin bar gyi spus tshad kyi dbye ba 'byed ma shes la/ mngon sum ngos zin nas rjes dpag ngos zin tu 'phel ba'i dgos nges rang bzhin ma shes stabs/ rjes dpag ngos zin gyis mi'i mdzub ston nus pa mthar khas ma blangs shing / de ni mngon gsal du nor 'khrul rkyang kyang red/ rgyu mtshan ni mi dang srog chags kyi khyad par gtso bo zhig ni mi la rjes dpag ldan zhing bsam gzhigs byed thub pa'o// nyal we khri'u yis mngon sum gtso bor brjod pa las rjes dpag khas ma blangs pas mi dang srog chags gzhan pa'i khyad par med par bzos pa red/ gral rim spyi tshogs nang du mi rnams kyi spyi tshogs lag len khrod kyi go gnas mi 'dra bas dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi myong tshor dang ngos zin yang mi 'dra/ der brten bde sdug gi ngos zin dang rnam 'gyur 'dzin stangs yang mi 'dra ste/ dper na/ sa bdag dang ma rtsa can gyis ngal rtsol bar bshu gzhog byed pa bde bar blta ba dang / bag med rgyas spros byed pa bde bar blta la/ ngal rtsol dang gron chung bab chags sdug tu blta'o/'on te ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon myong ba sdug tu blta zhing / phan tshun rogs ram dang / las la brtson zhing bsri tshags bab chags byed pa bde bar byed/ de 'dra'i sdug bsngal dang bde skyid myong tshor gyi 'gal zla ni mi rnams gral rim mi mthun pa'i langs phyogs dang gral rim khe phan gyis thag bcad pa red/ mi rnams kyis sdug dang bde ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin stangs la lus phung myong tshor rang bzhin gyi tshod 'dzin thebs pa las gzhan gtso bo ni rjes dpag ngos zin gyi dbang bsgyur pa red/ rjes dpag gi ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba ldan pa'i mi'i steng du lus phung gi myong ba'i bkres skom dang grang ngar/ rma nad sogs kyi tshor snang la yang ngo bo mi 'dra ba dang spyi tshokārmi don snying mi 'dra ba yod/ mtha' mtshams bsrung nas dgra bo dang

'thab 'dzing byed pa'i mtha' srung dmag gis rgyal khab kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can mngon 'gyur byed pa'i ched du sdug rang gcig pus myong nas mi khri stong mang por bde skyid ldan pa'i bla med bsam blo'i mdzub ston 'og 'khyag zas 'khyag 'thung dang grang ngar bzo bsran byed pa'i sdug de bde bar blta ba dang / tha na dgos mkho byung tshe 'dzem med ngang rang srog blos btang ba red/ de bas na/ mi rnams kyi 'gul skyod la nam yang rjes dpag gi dmigs 'ben gyis bkod sgrig byas yod do/ hel we khri'us mi gshes sdug byol bde 'tshol gyi lus phung myong tshor rang bzhin du bsdus shing / de mi rnams kyis khe phan 'tshol snyeg gi rten gzhir byas pas/ rjes dpag ngos zin gyi mdzub ston nus pa drungs nas med par bzos la/ don dngos su mi yi ngos zin bya 'gul stabs bde'i sgos dma' rim srog chags kyi gzhi rtsa'i nus pa'i re bar 'du bar byas mi gshis stabs bde sgos srog chags rang bzhin du 'du bar byas/ de ni rtsa ba nas nor 'khrul red do//hol we khri'u yi khe phan gzhung lugs kyis lkog gyur dang gral rim las 'das pa'i mi gshes smra ba spyad nas spyi tshogs lo rgyus snang tshul zhib dpyad byas stabs/ khong gis dngos gnas mi yi rang gshis gdeng tshod yang dag byed thub ste/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar gral rim gyi spyi tshogs su mi gshes ni kho gnas sa'i gral rim go gnas kyis thag bcad la/ gral rim mi 'dra ba'i mi'i mi gshis mi 'dra ba'o// hel we khri'u yis tshul 'di ma shes pas khos bshad pa'i sdug byol bde snyeg gam bdag gces kyis don dngos su 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang phan ring lugs khyab bsgrags byas pa yin pas/ 'byor ldan gral rim khe phan gyi tshur snang zhig go/ khos sger sems ni mi tshang mar thun mong du yod pa'i rang gshis yin pa dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi khe phan ni mi'i rigs spyi'i khe phan yin par bshad pas tag tag mi'i rang gshes 'khyo/ sbyar

bshad 'dug de ltar yin na'ang de 'dra'i bshad tshul ni 'byor ldan gral rim gsar brje dus skabs su yang sngon thon te/ rgyu mtshan de'i 'gal zla ni lha'i rang bzhin dang 'dod spang ring lugs kyi chos tshogs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi stobs shugs bcas 'ud bstod byas pa'o//hel we khri'u yis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod kyi dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i phyir gom gang mdun spos sgos mi yi khe phan de mi sger khe phan dang tshogs chung khe phan/ spyi'i khe phan (rgyal khab kyi khe phan yang zer) te gsum du bgos/ khong gis mi re re yang bdag gces khrims srol gyi skul 'ded 'og thog mar nges par du mi sger khe phan 'tshol snyeg byed/ gal te mi tshang mas tshod med par mi sger gyi khe phan 'tshol snyeg byas na mi dang mi'i bar 'gal ba tshad med 'byung bas/ spyi tshogs go rim rtog 'dzing gi khrod lhung du 'jug par 'dod de/ khong gis gal te mi tshang mas rang gi khe phan la gzhigs pa dang sger khe ni mes rgyal las gces par bzung na/ 'o na dmag byas pa'i pha des rang gi khyim gzhis kyi bde skyid ched dmag las bros byol byed dgos pa dang / spyi sgor bzung ba'i phas rang gi bu dang bu mo'i ched spyi sgor khyur min byed dgos pas/ de ni byed mi chog pa red/ spyi'i khe phan dang spyi tshogs go rim (sgrig lam)srung skyob byed pa'i ched hel we khri'u yis mi sger khe phan nges par du spyi'i khe phan dang 'brel dgos pa'i rtsa don bton/ khong gis mi rnams kyis khe phan 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i skabs su spyi tshogs khe phan la gnod ma /la na tram̐ sger gyi khe phan dang spyi tshogs kyi khe phan mnyam 'brel byas par 'a da k+ta la ༵ khri/ 'u yis mi sger gyi khe phan dang rgyal khab kyi khe phan la gnod pa byed pa'i tshogs khag chung ba'i khe phan la rtsa ba nas ngo rgol byed la/ 'di'i tshokāswā /ga chung ba'i khe phan ni skabs de'i h+pha ran se'i rgyal rgyud dang dge

'dun pa/ sku drag sogs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur tshogs khag gi khe phan no// khos tshogs khag chung ba 'di dag gi khe phan dang spyi'i khe phan ni phan tshun 'gal zhing / de spyi tshogs la gnod pa zhig dang kun spyod dang ches mi mthun pa'i khe phan yin par bstan/ gal te rang dgar 'phel rgyas su song na mi rnams kyi rgyal gces bsam pa rmeg med du gtong srid pa red/ khos de 'dra'i rigs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi tshogs khag chung ba ni nye 'brel dang phyogs ris 'brel bas grub pa dang / chab srid kyi thad rang gi dga' nye kho na bsko bzhag byas pas mngon par sgrig khrims kyis go mi chod pa ni h+pha ran se'i chab srid rul sungs su 'gyur bar byed du bcug cing spyi tshogs kha 'thor/ mi rnams kyi 'tsho bar sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i nyes pa'i khungs yin pas nges par du rtsa ba nas phyir 'byin dgos par bstan pa red/tel we khri'us bton pa'i khe phan gyi gzhung lugs kyis dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i h+pha ran se'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi 'dun pa dang re ba mtshon pas/yar thon gyi don snying chen po dang ldan no// rgyu mtshan ni skabs de'i h+pha ran se'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sger gcod lam lugs dang chos lugs lha rig pa'i dbang sgyur gyis spyi tshogs kyi yar thon la bkag 'gog tshabs chen byas shing / sku drag dang dge 'dun pas khyad dbang mang po longs su spyod chog pa dang / rim pa gsum pa'i rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs la gdug rtsub che ba'i bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon byas te khe phan phon chen po btsan 'phrog byas/kho tshos 'dod spang ring lugs 'ud bstod shugs chen byas shing / mi rnams kyis sdug bsngal bzod bsran byas te mi tshe 'di'i khe phan bskyur nas re ba dngos med 'phrul snang gi lha yul du bcol dgos par bskul/ hel we khri'u yi khe phan gyi gzhung lugs kyis shugs chen pos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur mkhan gyi mgo bskor brtol zhing mi rnams kyis mi tshe 'di'i khe phan 3/snag

dgos pa'i chos 'chad par le bda' byas la/ de'i dmigs yul ni mi rnams kyi khe phan 'phrog pa'i ched du red/ hel we khri'u yi khe phan gzhung lugs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur mkhan gyi khyad dbang la rgol ba dang mi mang dmangs tshogs kyi bsam blo'i tshod snang la skul 'ded byas so//hel we khri'u yis bton pa'i khe phan gyi gzhung lugs la lugs mthun rang bzhin gyi cha nges can ldan la/ sngon gyi bsam blo ba mi nyung ba zhig gis spyi tshogs lo rgyus 'phel rgyas ni chos nyid spu tsam yang med par res su 'khor bar lta ba las gom chen zhig mdun du spos pa dang / rjes su mar khe si ring lugs kyis de'i lugs mthun gyi rgyu cha bsdus nas tshan rig gi dngos po'i khe phan gyi gzhung lugs bton zhing / mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyis thon skyed rgyud rim gyi khrod du thon skyed 'brel bas rmang gzhi byas pa'i dpal 'byor khe phan mngon 'donacos la/ de ni mi yi khe phan gyi dngos po'i 'byung khungs yin/ thon skyed 'brel ba de gral rim spyi tshogs su gral rim 'brel bas mtshon pa yin pas mi rnams kyi dngos po'i khe phan gral rim khe phan nges can zhig dang mi 'bral/mar khe si ring lugs kyis da dung 'byor med gral rim gyi gral rim khe phan dngasbyi tshogs 'phel rgyas khe phan mi mang dmangs tshogs kyi khe phan gyi gcig mthun rang bzhin rgyas bshad byas nas mi sger khe phan ni gral rim khe phan la bstun dgos pa dang / gral rim khe phan ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas khe phan la bstun dgos par bstan pa red/ gzhung lugs de dag ni hel we khri'u yi thad mthong gi khe phan gzhung lugs las ches cher 'das 'dug la/ de lta na'ang lo rgyus la phyir 'dang rgyab na nga tshos nyel we khri'u yi mdzad rjes brjed mi nyan no//368
guzurnga

sabacad sum cub/ 'jar man gyi gna'ayo'i mtshananyida'ag pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed/wa wa.e man norakhāng ji/nyin rer nub kha'i nyi 'od lhing 'jags kyi lam phran du 'phro ba'i skabs su/ lam 'gram gyi byang chub ljon pa'i 'og tu stod gos skya mdog gyon zhing 'khar ba thogs pa'i rgan po stod rgur zhig rtag par 'cham 'cham 'gro bzhin yod/ khong spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang 'gro zhor du nye 'khor gyi mir lag g.yug byed pa dang / lam 'gro ba dang sdod mis kyang rang 'gul gyis bgres po der gus tshul byed/ ya mtshan pa zhig ni mi rnams kyis bgres po 'dir 'tshams 'dri zhus rjes tshang mas goms gshis ltar rang gi chu tshod 'khor lor blta/ rgyu mtshan bgres song de nyin rer lam phran 'dir phebs dus ni phyi dro'i chu tshod gsum dang phyed tag tag red/de ni 'jar man gyi snyan ngag mkhan po had ne (ṣ+ṭhatsho)yis bris pa'i gson gshis dod pa'i ri mo zhig ste/ bgres po de ni 'jar man gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i mkhan po e man nor khāng ji (74045 sgo7)red/khrang 'i ni nye rabs kyi yo rob gling du shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig ste khong gi mi tshe'i brgyud rim ni ha cang rang ga ba zhig yin/ khong mi tshe hril bor phal cher pha yul ghi ne si stor dang kha bral ma myong / sku na chung dus pha yul nas slob chung dang slob 'bring la zhug(7/3de

nas lo bcu drug steng ghi ne si bho slob grwa chen mor rgyugs 'phrod/ slob mthar phyin rjes sku drag gi khyim tshang 'ga'i nang lo dgur khyim gzhis dge rgan mdzad/spyi lo 1755lor slar yang ghi ne si bho slob grwa chen mor song nas sgrig yan 'chad 'khrid dge rgan gyi 'gan bzhes/ spyi lo 1770lor khāng khri dngos su ghi ne si bho slob grwa chen mo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i dge rgan chen mor bskos/1786lor slob grwa de'i slob gtso'i 'gan bzhes pa dang / las bral ngal gso byas rjes sngar gzhis su slebs nas tshe mthar bskyal/ rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba'i nang du khung ji'i za 'thung 'gro 'chags la ha cang bkod sgrig yod de/ nyin re'i chu tshod lnga dang phyed kyi steng mal las bzhings shing kha h+phe 'thung la/ de nas slob khrid byed pa/ rtsom 'bri ba/ za ma za ba/ 'cham 'cham byed pa sogs tshang ma dus ltar byed pas khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon gyis kho'i spyod stangs las dus tshod ma nor bar tshod dpag byed thub/ de bas khāng khri'i phyi tshul gyis mi rnams la bzhag pa'i bag chags ni 'tsho bar brtson 'grus dang lugs brtsi srol srung / gshis 'jam 'grogs bde yi slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo zhig las ma 'das so// yin na'ang had ne yis/ gal te skabs de'i ghi ne si bho yi mi rnams kyis khāng khri'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i rin thang dang don snying chen po shes na kho tshos phyi rnam spyir btang dang lus stod cung tsam rgur ba'i bgres por ha cang brtsi bkur byed pa dang de las spobs stobs skyes nges so zhes pa ltar ro//khrang ji 'tsho bzhugs kyi skabs su dbyin jir bzo las gsar brje 'go brtsams zhing / h+pha ran se'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyis chab srid kyi gsar brje chen po skul spel byas pas/ yo rob gling hril bo 'byor ldan gral rim gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub tu tshud/ yin na'ang 'jar man ni shin tu rjes lus kyi rgyal khaX byis yin/ skabs der 'jar man bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sa khongs

bcad bzung sgos rgyal phran chung chung nyis brgya lhag tu gyur yod/ der bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin thon skyed 'brel bas dbang sgyur go gnas yongs su bzung stabs/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo tshong las la dar rgyas cung tsam byung / 'on kyang gzhi khyon dang grangs ga'i thad nas dbyin h+pha rgyal khab la bsdur thabs med/ 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur la'ang zhen pa log yod na'ang rang la 'gog rgol gyi stobs shugs med pas/ o rob gling gi gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub 'jar man la thon byung /lhag par du khyim mtshes rgyal khab dbyin ji'i gsar brje chen pos gnyid du yur ba'i 'jar man gyi mi'i mi rigs 'du shes dang gsar brje 'du shes bslang / 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og chab srid kyi thad nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur gyi 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim la dngos su 'gog rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs med stabs/ bsam blo'i thad nas mtshan nyid rig pa'i gsar brje zhig skul slong byas te 'jar man gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i srol btod/ khāng khri ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i gsar brje de'i srol 'byed mkhan no// kho'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo gcig bsdus sgos skabs 'di'i 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i 'dod pa dang / yang gsar brje'i stobs shugs bral ba'i 'gal 'du'i sems khams dang mthun thabs byed pa'i las phyogs mtshon yod/khrang khri'i mi tshe gcig po'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bya 'gul ni khong nyid spyi lo 1770lor slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo mdzad pa'i bar mtshams byas te snga phyi'i dus skabs gnyis su dbye chog 1770lo'i snga rol la thog ma'i sun 'byin dus skabs dang de'i rjes la sun 'byin dus skabs zhes zer/ dus skabs de gnyis su kho'i mtshan nyid rig pa la nang don dang gshis ku'i steng mi 'dra sa yod/375

thog ma'i sun 'byin dus skabs su khāng khris gtso bo rang byung khams la zhib 'jug byas shing / mtshan nyid rig pa'i thad kyi byas rjes ni dngos gtso dang rtsod sgrub kyi rang byung lta bas yun ring la dbang sgyur go gnas bzung ba'i gzugs 'das rig pa'i rang byung lta ba'i 'thus tshab byed thub byung / khāng khri'i yar sngon du rang byung tshan rig gi khongs su dbang sgyur go gnas bzung yod pa ni dbyin ji'i tshan rig pa nyo'u 'on gyi gzugs 'das rig pa'i rang byung lta ba yin la/ ho'u 'on gyis sngon gyi mi'i bsam blo'i rmang gzhi'i steng thengs dang por 'gyur med dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba spyad nas 'jig rten gyi dbyibs ris shig bris yod de/ de yang 'jig rten ni shugs dang ldog shugs kyi 'gyur med shugs rig gi chos nyid kyis gzhogs 'degs byas pa dang / ches thog mar nges par du g.yo sgul mkhan dang po yod dgos la de ni lha'o// 'jig rten de lha'i g.yo sgul dang po'i shugs rkyen thebs rjes mu mthun du chos nyid ldan pa dang go rim ldan pa'i sgo nas 'gul spyod byed/ 'di'i rang gshis dang nang don la 'gyur ba spu tsam yang med de/ lhas bzo skrun byed skabs tshul ci 'dra yin na nam yang de ltar du 'dod pas/ des 'jig rten ni 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldo ga med pa'i gzugs 'das rig pa'i rang byung lta bar rlom/ de lta bu'i rang byung lta tshul gyis tshan rig dang bstun pa'i sgos rang byung gi 'phel rgyas rgyud rim 'grel bshad byed mi thub par ma zad/ṭā zlorno zlo/ /byi snal dang po'i shugs rkyen la rogs bcol pas lha rig smra bar blang khri'i rang byung lta tshul gyis nyo'u 'on gyi dngos gtso ring lugs bsam blo'i rgyun skyong ba dang 'jig rten byung tshul gyi dri ba'i thad nas yang nyo'u khro dang mi 'dra ba'i lan btab ste/ skad grags che ba'i skar sprin chags 'jog smra kāḥ6 (22skya 7)bsam blo bton/ khung khris 'jig rten gyi khams su nyi

ma dang sa gzhi 'khor skar sogs 'du la/ tshang ma ni gdod ma'i skar sprin zhig rim 'gyur byung ba las thon par snyam/ gdod ma'i skar sprin zhes pa ni 'jig rten khams su bkram pa'i du sprin gyi rnam pa'i dngos po'i rdul phran rigs zhig ste/ phan tshun gyi 'gug shugs kyi rkyen gyis gdod ma'i skar sprin rim bzhin gzhi gcig tu gyur bas 'gug shugs lte ba zhig grub/ de dang mnyam du 'bud shugs kyi rkyen gyis yang 'gug shugs lte ba'i gdod ma'i skar sprin rtsib phyogs su 'khor bas 'gul skyod kyi dkyu rim zhig grub/ 'gug shugs dang 'bud shugs kyi phan tshun shugs rkyen 'og 'jig rten ni 'khor skyod byed bzhin pa'i leb zlum sprin gzugs rigs zhig tu gyur pa de ni nyi ma'i khyim rgyud red/ de'i lte gnas ni nyi ma yin te/ nyi ma'i mtha' 'khor du bkram la nyi mar skor ba byed pa'i dngos gzugs ni sa'i go la dang 'khor skar gzhan pa yin no// khāng khris nyi ma'i khyim rgyud las gzhan nyi ma'i pha rol gyi nam mkha'i khams nas 'jig rten hril bo yang gdod ma'i skar sprin rim 'gyur byung ba las thon par snyam mo//khāng khri'i skar sprin chags 'jog smra bas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lkog gyur gsed 'grol byas pas gnam rig tshan rig 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon la/ de las kyang gal che ba ni de'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i don snying red/ skar sprin chags 'jog smra bas 'jig rten khams ni dngos po'i rdul phran gyi gdod ma'i skar sprin rim bzhin 'gyur ba las byung bar 'dod pa dang /des ni dngos po ni 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa yin pa'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rang byung lta tshul rgyun 'khyongs byas 'dug go/ khāng khris spobs pa dang bcas te nga la dngos po byin dang / ngas khyod tshor 'jig rten ni 'di yis ji ltar grub pa'i tshul ston zhes smras myong / gzhan skar sprin chags 'jog smra bas 'jig rten khams kyi grub cha ni chung ba nas che ba dang dma' rim na~X snatho

rim du rim gyis 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi rgyud rim du 'dod pa dang /der ma zad 'phel rgyas kyi gzhi rtsa'i rgyu rkyen ni 'jig rten nang khul gyi 'gug shugs dang 'bud shugs kyi 'gal 'du yin par bzhed pas/ gting zab sgos 'jig rten gyi khams grub pa'i rtsod sgrub rgyud rim gsed 'grol byas shing /de nas bzung 'jig rten la lo rgyus dang rgyud rim med par 'dod pa'i gzugs 'das rig pa'i bsam gzhigs rnam pa'i lta tshul la thengs dang por gnod byed bton/ tso'adi ni nye rabs mi'i rigs kyi rang byung lta tshul gyi thengs dang po'i gsar brje yin la/ des ni rang byung khams la tshan rig sgos ngos zin dang zhib 'jug byed pa'i lam gsar ba zhig gsar du btod do//yin na'ang khāng 'ir rang byung lta tshul gyi gsar brje de mngon gsal du mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i spobs pa zad de/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin stobs shugs kyi gnod skyon las yol phyir khong gis gsang ming spyad nas rang gi dpyad rtsom spel ba dang / de'i nang don thad nas yang gsar brje'i rgyu rkyen dang chos lugs lta ba mthun sbyor byed ci thub byas la/ khos 'jig rten gyi khams gdod ma'i skar sprin las byung na'ang sadod ma'i skar sprin de mdor dril na lhas bzo skrun byas par 'dod/ der bltas na/ khāng khris chos tshogs dang bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi dbang 'dzin las khungs la phog thug mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ khong gis dngos gtso dang rtsod sgrub rang byung lta tshul yang dag pa'i sgos brjod pa dang mnyam du rgya che ba'i dngos po'i 'jig rten du'ang lha ga'i grub pa'i tshul la btsan gyis mthun thabs byas so//de yang dgag sgrub dus skabs su khāng khris rang byung khams kyi zhib 'jug gi kha lo mi yis nus pa'i ngos zin gyi zhib 'jug phyogs su bsgyur/kho'i 'byin sgrub ces pa ni rtog dpyod dang zhib 'jug gi don yin/ khāng khris khoX 08 bsam blo'i 'gyur ba 'di gtso bo 'jar man gyi blo sgo 'byed pa'i bsam

blo ba ro'u se'u'i e mer ( tshor+sā16)zhes pa'i deb las blo skyed thebs pas/mi ngo shes dgos pa dang mir brtsi bkur byed dgos pa shes par ma zad/ da dung mir zhib 'jug byed pa ni mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i thog ma'i las 'gan du rtogs/ khāng khris mi tshe hril bor rgyun skyong ba'i dus ltar 'cham 'cham la 'gro ba'i goms srol de thengs gcig tsam la chad/ rgyu mtshan ni khong gis e mer zhes pa'i dpe cha bklags pas brjed song ba red/khāng khri'i yar sngon du/ ngos zin gyi 'byung khungs dang ngos zin gyi brten 'os rang bzhin sogs kyi gnad don phyogs la/ nyams myong smra ba dang rjes dpag gtso smra ba ste grub mtha' chen po gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i bar dza drag che ba'i rtsod gleng byung / khrang khris grub mtha' de gnyis kyis rang lta mkhregs kyis tshor ba'i nyams myong ltos med can du byas pa min/ rjes dpag bsam gzhigs kyi nus par phyogs re 'ud brjod bgyis yod pas/ de gnyis gang gis kyang bden don thob mi srid par bzhed/ grub mtha' de gnyis la nor 'khrul de 'dra 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni kho tshos ngos zin gyi sngon du mi rang nyid kyi ngos zin nus par brtag zhib dang zhib 'jug ma byas pas red/ yang gcig bshad na kho tsho tshang mas mi'i ngos zin gyi nus pa mthar gtug na ji 'dra zhig yod pa ma shes par rang dgar sdom tshig bkod de/rang 'dod kyis rang nyid la bden don thob zin par 'dod do// der brten khāng khris ngos zin gyi sngon du nges par du thog mar mi yi ngos zin nus par zhib 'jug byed pa dang rjes sor ngos zin gyi yul khong du chud par byed dgos par bzhed/ khong gis nyams myong smra ba dang rjes dpag gtso smra ba'i phyogs re rang bzhin sel bar bsam pa de ni lugs mthun zhig red/ yin na'ang khos grub mtha' de gnyis kyi nor 'khrul 'byung gzhi ni ngos zin gyi sngon du mi yi ngos zin nus shugs la zhib 'jug ma byas par ma zad/ mi yi ngos zinā /sa

shugs la 'ib 'jug byed pa khong rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhir byas pa de ni nor 'khrul red/ don dngos su mi yi ngos zin nus shugs ni ngos zin rgyud rim du mngon pa dang 'phel rgyas byung ba yin te/ dper na chu'i nang nas da gzod rkyal rtsal slob thub pa dang rtsal je mthor gtong ba nang bzhin ngos zin gyi rgyud rim dang lag len bya 'gul khrod da gzod mi yi ngos zin nas shugs rgyus lon dang je mthor gtong thub/yang khāng khris mi yi ngos zin nus shugs ni lag len nyams myong gi sngon dang ngos zin gyi sngon du yod par 'dod de/ 'di 'dra'i lta tshul la mtshan nyid rig pas sngon rtogs smra ba zhes zer/ de ni sems gtso ring lugs kyi lta tshul zhig go/ phyis su mi la las khrung khris ngos zin gyi sngon du mi yi ngos zin nas shugs la zhib 'jug byed 'dod pa de ni/ mi la rkyal rtsal shes 'dod na khyed rang thog mar chur ma zhugs zhes pa'i dgod bro'i 'chal gtam bshad pa nang bzhin red ces skyon brjod par byed do//khāng jis mi'i ngos zin nas shugs gtso bo ni tshan rig shes bya thob par 'dod la/ ci zhig ni tshan rig shes bya yin zhe na/ khong gis shes bya'i gtan tshigs kyi rnam pa ni dpyad 'jog cig ste gtso gzhi dang gsal ba'i dpyad 'jog gi rnam pas rang skya ba'i lta tshul de gnyis mnyam 'brel byas na da gzod shes byar brtsi rung / yin na'ang dpyad 'jog byas pa tshang ma tshan rig shes byar 'jog rung pa ma yin no// khor mtshon na sngar gyi nyams myong smra ba dang rjes dpag gtso smra bas thob pa'i dpyad 'jog tshang ma tshan rig shes byar mi 'dod de/ nyams myong smra bas thob pa ni sna 'dzoms dpyad 'jog cig ste phyis su sbyong brtson la brten nas thob pa'i dpyad 'jog cig go/'di lta bu'i dpyad 'jog khrod du gsal pas gtso gzhi'i don spyir nang don gsar ba bsnan la/yi/ spyazlong de gnyis bar du spyir btang dang yong nges kyi 'brel ba med de

dper na/ stod gos 'di ni sngon po red lta bu ni sna 'dzoms dpyad 'jog cig ste/ gsal ba sngon po yis gtso gzhi stod gos la kha dog bsnan kyang sngon po dang stod gos bar du spyir btang yong nges kyi 'brel ba med de/ rgyu mtshan ni stod gos sngon po yin rung la dkar dmar gang rung yang yin rung ngo //'on te rjes dpag gtso smra bar thob pa ni dbye 'ib dpyad 'jog (1/loro/1lo)cig ste skyes stobs dang spyir btang yong nges rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpyad 'jog go/ dper na mtha' mtshungs zur gsum dbyibs ni zur gsum dbyibs yin zhes pa lta bu ni dbye zhib dpyad 'jog ste/ 'di'i gsal ba zur gsum dbyibs dang gtso gzhi mtha' mtshungs zur gsum dbyibs gnyis kyi bar du yong nges kyi 'brel ba ldan/ yin na'ang gsal bas gtso gzhir nang don gsar ba snon mi nus te gtso gzhi'i rgyas bshad tsam du zad do// de las mthong ba ni nyams myong smra ba'i sna 'dzoms dpyad 'jog dang rjes dpag gtso smra ba'i dbye zhib dpyad 'jog gang yin rung tshang mar rang rang gi bzang cha ldan la phyogs lhung rang bzhin yang ldan pas tshang ma tshan rig shes bya ma yin no// khrang khris tshan rig shes bya yang dag ni dngos gnas 'di gnyis kyi legs cha zung 'brel byas nas phyis byung dang nang don gsar ba snon nus pa zhig mnyam du yin dgos par ma zad/ de dang skyes stobs dang spyir btang yong nges rang bzhin can gyi dpyad 'jog cig ste/ de la khong gis skyes stobs sna 'dzoms dpyad 'jog ces brjod/ de las skyes stobs sna 'dzoms dpyad 'jog yod med 'tshol ba dang gal te yod na mir yang de'i gnad don ji ltar thob pa ni yang khāng khri'i zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dri gzhi zhig tu gyur/ khāng khri'i mi la lhan skyes sna 'dzoms kyi brdar sha gcod pa'i brgyud rim du gtso bo mngon sum dang rtogs pa'i rang bzhin dang rjes dpag gi rim pa gsum brgyud par 'dod de/ mngon sum ni ngos zin gyi ches thog ma'i rim ༵ /ga

yin la/ rim pa 'dir mi rnams la thob pa'i mngon sum gyi shes bya ni/ thog mar dngos po rang gzugs (don du nga tshos bshad pa'i phyi'i 'jig rten)kyis mi'i dbang bor skul 'ded byas pa las grub pa dang / gal te phyi'i dngos po'i rang gzugs kyi skul 'ded med na mi la tshor ba yod mi srid la/mngon sum gyi shes bya yang yod mi srid par 'dod la/ 'on te de 'phral mu mthud du/ khung khris yang dngos po rang gzugs las thon pa'i tshor snang tshang ma rab rib dang thar thor sil bu yin pas/ de rang nyid la dus dang yul nges gtan med cing mis de nyid ngos 'dzin dang khong du chud thabs mi 'dugader brten rjes thob kyi tshor snang gi rgyu cha tsam la brten na mngon sum shes bya 'grub mi thub la/ mngon sum gyi shes bya 'grub par mkho ba'i dus dang yul gyi rnam pa ni thog mar skyes stobs kyis mi'i sems su mnga' ba dang mis 'di lta bu'i sngon rtogs kyi yul dus rnam pas rab rib dang thar thor sil bu'i rjes thob tshor snang gi rgyu cha legs sgrig byas rjes gzod bya dngos la yul dus rnam pa ldan zhing de las mngon sum gyi shes bya grub pa red/ khāng jis rtsis rig ni de 'dra'i mngon sum shes bya yin te/ des phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos la dus kyi rgyun mthud par byed pa dang / dbyibs rtsis rig pas ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos la gnas yul ster bar byed/ 'di ltar khung khrir mtshon na rtsis rig ni ches thog mar phyi rol gyi 'jig rten te dngos po rang gzugs (705)las byung na'ang / de la rang rig rang bzhin dang skyes stobs kyi rang bzhin ldan pas/ de ni phyi rol 'jig rten gyi tshur snang min no// nga tshos shes gsal ltar rtsis rig ni mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed lag len las thon pa dang de phyi rol 'jig rten gyi grangs tshod 'brel ba tshur snang byas pa yin/ yang gcig bshad na thog mar phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos la dus dang yul gyi grangs tshad 'brel ba yod3 72 dang phyis su gzod 'di dag gi 'brel ba ngos zin pa'i rtsis rig shes

bya byung / khrung khris rtsis rig ni mi'i rang rig gi thon chos kyi khongs su 'du bar byas shing / de ltar byas pas rtsis rig dang phyi rol 'jig rten gyi don dngos 'brel ba bzlog go/ khāng khri'i bsam par rnyog 'dzing go rim bral ba'i tshor snang rgyu cha de sngon rtogs kyi yul dus rnam pas legs sgrig byas rjes/yul dus go rim dang gnas yul mngon zhing nga tshos ngos zin thub pa'i snang tshul 'jig rten (7477)grub/ yin na'ang lhag par du snang tshul 'jig rten gyi bya dngos so so'i bar gyi nang gnas 'brel ba dang chos nyid gsed 'grol byas nas de las kyang gting zab pa'i tshan rig shes bya khong du chud cing / yi ngos zin da dung mngon sum nas shes pa'i bar du 'phel dgos pa red shes pa'i rim par mis tshor snang spyad pa min zhing rigs sam don spyi'i sgos snang tshul 'jig rten ngos zin byas pa dang re 'ga' 'am kher rkyang snang tshul bar gyi nang gnas 'brel ba gsed 'grol byas pa dper na/ mig shes la brten nas nyi ma 'char ba mthong ba dang / lag pa'i tshor shes la brten nas rdo ba tsha bar snyam pa dang / snang tshul rigs mi 'dra ba de gnyis mi rnams kyis rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba'i khyab khongs spyad nas snang tshul gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbrel skabs su gzod de tsho'i bar gyi rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba gsed 'grol byed thub pa dang / nyi ma 'char bas rdo ba tsha ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi shes bya ngos zin thub pa red/ 'o na rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba'i khyab khongs ni phyogs gang nas thon zhe na/ khāng khri'i bsam par de ni phyi rol gyi 'jig rten las thon pa min par mi'i sems su rang chas kyis yod la/ mi'i sems su rgyu 'bras dang yong nges/glo bur/ srid pa dang dngos yod sogs khyab khongs bcu gnyis yod pa dang /mis sems kyi sngon rtogs bcu gnyis po de spyad nas snang tshul 'jig rten legs sgrig byas na da gzod snang tshul 'jig rten gyi bya dngos so so'i sdu/ du

nangaganas 'brel ba dang chos nyid spyod thub/ snang tshul 'jig rten gyi chos nyid dang nang gnas 'brel ba'i shes bya'i skor ni rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya yin te/ khong gis rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya ni rtsis rig dang 'dra bar phyi rol 'jig rten gyi tshur snang min par 'dod/ gal te rtsis rig la ches thog mar phyi rol bya dngos kyi skul 'ded mkho bas da gzod grub zhe na/ rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya yang rtsa ba nas mi'i rang rig nyid las byung ba'i thon dngos las ma 'das pas/ khrang khris mis rang byung khams la khrims btsugs zhes pa'i skul tshig bton zhing rang byung khams kyi chos nyid phyi rol yul du yod pa min par mi'i rang snang gis gsar bskrun byas pa dang rang byung khams la stobs shugs bsnan par 'dod/ 'di ltar khrung khris phyi rol 'jig rten dang rang byung tshan rig shes bya'i bar gyi 'brel ba dngos go bzlog par byas pa yin na'ang / khos yang mi'i rang rig sgul nus rang bzhin nan gyis brjod pa dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dang lha'i rig par rgol ba'i don snying ldan no//khāng ji'i bsam par mngon sum dang shes pa'i rgyud rim gnyis brgyud nas mis snang tshul 'jig rten ngos zin pa'i tshad du slebs te/ skyes stobs sna 'dzoms kyi dpyad 'jog gi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsis rig dang rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya thob na'ang / mi'i sems snang tshul 'jig rten du gnas mi 'dod par de las brgal nas phyi'i dngos po'i rang gzugs ngos 'dzin par byed pas/ de bas shes pa yang 'phel nas rjes dpag gi tshad du slebs so//rjes dpag ni ngos zin gyi ches mtho ba'i rim pa yin la/ rim pa der mi'i ngos 'dzin yul sngon gyi snang tshul 'jig rten nas phyi'i dngos po'i rang gzugs su gnas gyur/ yin kyang mi'i ngos 'dzin gyi thabs dang ngos 'dzin khrodakhyad pa'i khyab khongs sngar ltar mngon sum dang shes pa'i tshad las gong 'dīkā ḍi ma song / de ltar mis sngon gyi byed thabs dang khyab khongs spyad nas

dngos po'i rang gzugs ngos 'dzin byed pa'i skabs su 'gal ba 'byung nges la/ khāng khris 'gal ba 'dir lugs gnyis rgyab 'gal (kro tshikhu)zhes brjod de/ dper na shes pa'i khyab khongs kyis 'jig rten nges gtan byed pa'i skabs su/ 'jig rten gyi dus dang yul gyi thad nas tshad dang ldan par byas yod ces brjod chog la/ yang 'jig rten ni yul dus kyi thad nas tshad med par byas yod ces brjod kyang chog tshad ldan dang tshad med phan tshun 'gal ba'i dpyad 'jog dus mnyam du 'dzoms par gtan tshigs kyi steng phan tshun nang 'gal red/ khāng khris ngos 'dzin thad kyi 'gal ba gsed 'grol byas pa 'di ni rtsod sgrub bsam gzhigs 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar mdzad 'phrin bzhag pa yin na'ang / khong 'di nas rtogs thabs med smra ba'i phyogs su lhung / khāng khris mis dngos po'i rang gzugs ngos 'dzin skabs lugs gnyis rgyab 'gal 'byung bar 'dod pas/ mi'i dngos po'i rang gzugs ngos 'dzin byed mi thub cing dngos po'i rang gzugs ni rtogs thabs bral ba de gsal bshad byas/ dngos po'i rang gzugs ni dad pa byed yul tsam las ngos zin gyi yul ma yin no// gong smos ltar khāng khris mi'i ngos 'dzin nas shugs kyi zhib 'jug 'di'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i langs phyogs su bar 'dum dang mthun 'grig gi dri mas khengs pas ngo bo nyis ldan gyi rang bzhin yod pa gsal/ khong gis tshan rig shes byar sbyangs stobs kyi nyams myong mkho zhing nyams myong yang thog mar dngos po'i rang gzugs dang dbang shes 'phrad pa las byung bar 'dod tshe/ de ni dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta tshul yin/ yang khong gis tshan rig shes byar skyes stobs kyi rnam pa mkho ba dang rnam pa de yang mi'i klad par rang chas su gnas shing / de ni mi'i rang rig las thon pa'i chos shig tu 'dod skabs/ slar yang sems gtso'i sngon rtogs smra ba'i phyogs su lhung / yang khāng khris mi'i ngos 'dzin rgyud rim gyi rang snang sgul nastu snang

bzhin nan brjod byas zhing mis rang byung khams la khrims 'dzugs par skul tshig bton skabs/ rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blo zab mo ldan zhing 'byor ldan gral rim gyis mi dang tshan rig la brtsi mthong byed pa'i yar brtson gyi bsam blo mngon pa dang / yang khong gis ngos 'dzin thad kyi 'gal ba spyad de mi rnams kyis phyi'i 'jig rten ngos 'dzin thub pa dgag pa'i skabs su/ yang mi'i ngos 'dzin nus shugs dang ngos 'dzin khyab yul tshod 'dzin byas pas rtogs thabs med par smra ba'i phyogs su chas shing / khong gis ngos zin gyi yul du ma gyur pa'i dngos po'i rang gzugs de dad pa'i yul du 'dod pas/ chos lugs lha'i rig par mthun rkyen bskrun/ khrung khri'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i thad kyi khyad chos 'di ni 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gnyom chung rang bzhin dang g.yo 'gul rang bzhin de bsam blo'i khyab khongs kyi dmigs 'dzin mtshon byed red/khāng khri ni 'jar man gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i srol 'byed yin zhing / khong gi mtshan nyid rig pa ni skyog mtshams gsar ba zhig yin pa dang /khong gi rjes 'dzin pa he ཿla gyis dngos po'i rang gzugs yod pa dgag cing rtogs thabs med par smra ba'i lta tshul zur du phud de mthar thug gi sems gtso ring lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i steng nas khong gi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blo 'phel rgyas su btang zhing sems gtso ring lugs kyi rtsod sgrub smra ba'i shing rta'i srol btod de/ gzugs 'das rig pa'i bsam gzhigs kyi rnam pa de rtsod sgrub bsam gzhigs kyi rnam par bsgyur/ don snying 'di'i thad nas bshad na/khung khri'i mtshan nyid rig pa de mtshan nyid rig pa 'phel ba'i lo rgyus steng gi mdzad rjes ni khas len 'os pa zhig go/386

sa༄cad so gcig pa/ zab rgyasaldan pa'i phyi don sems gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid mkhan po/wa he snyel/dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i 'gor 'jar man gyi yad na slob grwa chen mor mtshan nyid rig pa'i dge rgan gsar ba zhig thon pa dang / mi de ni lo sum cur slebs tsam yin na'ang ha cang bab brtan po zhig yin la/ gshis rgyud ni cung sazhan dang mi mthun pa zhig go/ khong rtag par slob grwa'i ra bar gcig pu 'cham 'cham la 'gro zhing mtha' 'khor gyi mir 'tshams 'dri'i brda mi ston la mtshams mtshams su 'dang rgyag gi nang du tshud nas don dngos 'tsho ba'i go rim tshang ma brjed 'gro bas mi la gad rgyangs shor ba'i dgod kha slong du 'jugathengs shig khong yin pa ni phyi dro'i chu tshod gsum gyi steng slob khrid byed du 'gro dgos mod/ 'on kyang kho chu tshod gcig gi sngon slob khang du phebs nas 'go brtsams pa dang bar mtshams med par slob khrid byas shing / 'og na nyan bzhin pa'i slob ma ni dge rgan gzhan zhig gi slob khrid la nyan pa'i slob ma yin la slob ma dag gis khong dus tshod nor ba'i brda bstan kyang khos sngon ltar yid ches dang kha ya mi byed par slob khrid mdzad/ 'dzin grwa de'i dge rgan gyis kho rang nyid dus 'gyangs byung song snyam/ de nas chu tshod gsum gyi steng he rgyul khong nyid kyi slob ma slob khrid la nyan par thon dus da gzod khos dus nor byung song pa shes pas dgod cig shor/ de 'dra'i ya mtshan pa'i dge rgan de ni 'jar man gyi gna' bo'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid ma/shā po

ltar/ yad na slob grwa chen mor thon nas mtshan nyid rig pa'i dge rgan mdzad/skabs der rang lo sum cur son pa'i he phel sngon byon mkhas dbang dag gi gsung rtsom gyi ro bcud kyis yid blo mi 'gengs par kho rtag par 'dang rgyag tu tshud de rang gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag bzo stangs la mno bsam bzhes/lo mang gi bsam blo gtong ba rgyud spyi lo 1806lor khos yid kyi snang tshul rig pa (7774lha)zhes pa'i gzhung grags can de bcoms pa dang / khong gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gi rtsa don dang thabs lam gyi skya ris btab/rjes su mar khe sis der ni he phel gyi dam pa'i gsung rab tu bsngags/ yin na'ang cung ma 'gyangs par 'jar man dang h+pha ran se'i yad na dmag 'khrug langs pas h+pha dmag gis yad na bcad bzung byas stabs/ he ཿla gyis da dung par du ma bskrun pa'i rtsom gyi ma yig khyer nas yad na slob grwa chen mo dang kha bralade/ 'i rjes kyi lo ngo bcu phrag gi ring la he ཿla gyis snga phyir gsar 'gyur khang gi rtsom sgrig pa dang slob 'bring gi gtso dpon sogs kyi 'gan bzhes shing bya ba sgrub pa ha cang phul tu byung na'ang / khong gi thugs zhen sngar bzhin spyi mtshan gyi bsam ga'igs la 'khor nas sdug rus chen pos rang gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag la bsam blo gtong ba red/1816lor he ཿla ho dha bho slob grwa chen mo'i slob dpon du gdan 'dren byas pa dang / 1818lor khong nyid slar yang bhal lin slob grwa chen mo'i slob dpon du gdan 'dren mdzad la/ de nas cung ma 'gor bhal lin slob grwa chen mo'i slob gtsor bskos/ slob grwa chen mo'i bshad stegs su he ཿla la phyogs yongs dang go rim ldan pa'i sgo nas kho'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo bshad pa'i go skabs byung zhing skabs der mtshan nyid rig pa'i kun 'dus mdor bstan (0stsalha mjo)zhes pa 'i bslab deb bcoms/ des ni khozlo /nga

nyid kyis mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag btsugs pa mtshon pa red/ho ཿla gyi rgya che ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag khrod kho rang gi shes rab dang yon tan 'dus yod na'ang / mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gzhan dang 'dra bar sngon byon dag gi bsam blo'i 'bras bus rmang gzhi byas pa bshad ma dgos te/ he snyel gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ni khāng khris gsar bskrun byas pa'i 'jar man gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i rgyun mthud dang 'phel rgyas gtong pa yin la/ khong gis khāng khri'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i steng gi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rgyu cha zur du phud nas sems gtso ring lugs dang rtsod sgrub smra ba'i bsam blo rgyud 'dzin dang gong 'phel du gtong pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng /rang nyid kyi rgya khyon che ba'i phyi don sems gtso'i ring lugs kyi ma lag btsugs so// he ཿla gyis rang byung khams dang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs khung khris bshad pa ltar de'i phyi'i dngos po rigs shig la brten nas byung zhing thag bcad pa red/ yin na'ang 'di khāng 'is bshad pa'i rang gnas kyi dngos po'i gras shig gtan nas min par ltos med kyi shes pa zhig yin par 'dod/ci zhig ni ltos med kyi shes pa yin zhe na/ he ཿla gyis ltos med kyi shes pa ni mi che ge mo zhig gi shes pa min la mi'i rigs kyi shes pa'ang min par de ni 'jig rten gyi shes pa zhig yin te/ de rang byung khams dang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs la ma brten par kher rkyang du gnas shing rang byung dang mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'byung rtsa yin/ 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsa 'di'i ltos med kyi shes pa yang khrang khris bshad pa'i sgyid lug gzhan skul gyi rigs shig dang mi 'dra zhing /de ni sgul nus la dge mtshan ldan pas/ de'i rang nyid rgya bskyed pa'i rgyud rim ni 'jig rten grub pa'i dus te/ rang nyid kyi ngos zin rgyud rim yang yin/ rgyud rim de nyid ni rim pa gtso bo gsum las brgal dgos te/ de ni gta)/ /gas kyi rim pa dang / rang byung gi rim pa/ shes pa'i rim pa bcas

so// 'di dang mthun par he ཿla gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag la yang gtan tshigs rig pa/ rang byung mtshan nyid rig pa dang shes pa'i mtshan nyid rig par bkar nas so sor gong 'phel gyi rgyud rim de dag la zhib brjod gnang 'dug go/gtan tshigs kyi dus mtshams su rang byung khams dang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs da dung byung med la/ ltos med kyi shes pas ni rang nyid ngos 'dzin gyi don spyi'i 'gul skyod tsam bstan/ de 'dra'i don spyi'i 'gul skyod ni 'thab 'khrug sngon gyi dmag don dngos sbyong dang 'dra bar ltos med shes pas rang byung khams dang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs gsar skrun gyi gong rol du/ rang nyid kyis don spyi'i khyab khongs su rang nyid ngos 'dzin gyi tshad du bsleb min lta 'dod de/ de 'phral de nyid kyis gzhi grub —ngo bo don spyi'i dus mtshams chung ngu gsum brgyud de rang nyid ngos 'dzin gyi tshad du bslobs rjes/ des nges par du bsam gzhigs kyi yul brtol nas phyi gnas kyi rang byung khams su gnas gyur cing phyi gnas kyi rang byung khams brgyud nas rang nyid ngos zin/de nas bzung ltos med shes pa ni gtan tshigs kyi rim pa nas rang byung gi rim par 'phel ba red/rang byung gi rim pa'i skabs su/ ltos med shes pa (2671 mu)slar lkog gyur don spyi'i rnam par mi 'byung bar mngon sum gyi dngos po sna tshogs kyi 'gul skyod dang 'phel rgyas kyi rnam par mngon/ phyi ngos nas bltas na rang byung khams kyis dngos yod bya dngos kyi 'gyur ldog dang 'phel rgyas ston par snang yang don gyis sngar bzhin ltos med shes pas nus pa thon bzhin yod pas/rang byung khams ni ltos med shes pa'i phyi'i rnam pa tsam du zad/ ltos med shes pas rang byung gi dus mtshams su yang 'phel rgyas kyi rim pa chung ba gsum ste/ 'gyur med rang bzhin dang dngos lugs rang bzhin/ skye lda/9 /nga
